name: Flarewise
description: Crohn's-friendly food catalog. Static JSON export for humans, apps, and AI agents.

rubric.agentBrief: Flarewise rubric (cite briefly): crohnsScore 1–10 higher = gentler. Bands: 9–10 Flare safe; 7.5–8.9 Everyday; 6.5–7.4 Careful (Good-day fit when feeling ≥7); <6.5 Avoid (hide). Today dial (feeling 1 rough → 10 great) sets a min crohnsScore floor: rough ≈ Flare-safe only; cautious ≈ Flare-safe+Everyday; steady/good/great opens Careful. Vacation items (theme parks & cruises) are hidden by default unless Vacation mode is selected in the Filters pane — always tag theme-park items with 'vacation' plus destination tags ('disneyland', 'california-adventure', 'knotts-berry-farm') and cruise items with 'disney-cruise' plus ship tags ('disney-wonder', 'disney-magic', 'disney-treasure'). Guardrails: set citrusFree=false for any lemon, lime, orange, grapefruit (1.0 hard avoid), yuzu/ponzu, or bergamot/Earl Grey; aged cheeses (Cheddar, Swiss, Gruyère, Havarti, Provolone, Parmigiano-Reggiano, Manchego) are lactoseSafe=true. Draft/rank from live neighbors + these bands — cite score/tier, not vibes. Skip medical-disclaimer boilerplate in SMS.

items.name: Cabanas & Marceline Market Warm Asian White Rice Congee Porridge (Standalone)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
items.whyItWorks: Simmered for hours until white rice breaks down into a silky, starch-rich gruel—10/10 gut-soothing flare rescue available every morning at the buffet soup/hot cereal station.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ladle a bowl of plain hot white rice congee, season with a splash of tamari/soy sauce and shredded chicken or hard-boiled egg, and skip the chili oil, raw scallions, and fried shallots.
watchOuts: Strictly skip the chili oil, raw green onions, and peanuts on the condiment tray

items.name: Chawanmushi (Savory Japanese Steamed Egg Custard)
items.whyItWorks: Silky dashi-infused steamed egg custard requires zero chewing and soothes an angry stomach immediately.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk eggs gently with warm dashi or chicken broth (1:3 ratio), strain through a sieve, and steam covered on low heat for 10-12 minutes.

items.name: Congee (Jook / Savory Chicken & Egg Rice Porridge)
items.whyItWorks: White rice simmered in chicken bone broth until it completely breaks down into a thick, velvety savory porridge.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer 1 part white jasmine rice in 7 parts chicken bone broth with ginger powder. Top with finely shredded chicken, soft-boiled egg, and soy sauce.

items.name: Gyeran-jjim (Korean Volcano Steamed Eggs)
items.whyItWorks: Eggs whisked with kelp/anchovy or chicken broth and steamed until fluffy and cloud-like with a drop of sesame oil.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer whisked eggs and salted chicken broth in a small pot for 5-6 minutes covered, drizzle with 1 drop toasted sesame oil, and skip the raw scallion garnish.

items.name: Malt-O-Meal Original Hot Farina ("Brulee" Style)
items.whyItWorks: Finely milled wheat endosperm (~1g fiber), fortified with iron and B vitamins, requiring zero mechanical grinding for the bowel.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Cook smooth with lactose-free or oat milk. Top with a thin pat of butter and 1 tsp brown sugar (melted on top), or swirl in 1 tbsp smooth peanut butter and pure maple syrup.
watchOuts: Never use chunky peanut butter

items.name: Maple-Salted Hydration Water (Clean ORS)
items.whyItWorks: Uses sodium-glucose co-transport to pull water into the bloodstream without artificial sweeteners (sucralose/sorbitol) or citrus extracts that trigger osmotic diarrhea.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mix 16 oz cold water + 1 tbsp pure maple syrup + 1/8 to 1/4 tsp sea salt.

items.name: Pastina ("Italian Penicillin" Egg & Broth Stars)
items.whyItWorks: Tiny star-shaped white pasta simmered directly in chicken bone broth, finished with a beaten egg, butter, and aged parmesan for instant soothing calories.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer pastina or orzo in chicken bone broth for 5 mins until tender, remove from heat, and whisk in 1 beaten egg, a pat of butter, and grated parmesan.

items.name: Peppermint, Chamomile, or Ginger Herbal Tea
items.whyItWorks: Natural antispasmodics that calm smooth muscle cramping in the intestinal tract.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Steep pure peppermint, chamomile, or ginger tea bags in hot water with honey.
watchOuts: Always check herbal tea labels to ensure zero Earl Grey/bergamot, hibiscus, or citrus peel fillers

items.name: Seolleongtang or Samgyetang (Korean Bone Broth Soup)
items.whyItWorks: Korean ox-bone soup is simmered for 12+ hours until pure collagen and protein, served with soft white rice and thin beef slices - zero spice, zero fiber, pure gut healing.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Season with sea salt at the table to taste. Skip the radish/cabbage kimchi and raw chopped green onions.

items.name: Sweet Eel Sauce (Unagi No Tare)
items.whyItWorks: Equal parts soy sauce, mirin, and sugar simmered until syrupy - 10/10 umami flavor with 0g fiber and zero citrus extracts.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drizzle over white rice, salmon, chicken, udon, or eggs.

items.name: Warm Bone Broth Mug (Chicken or Beef)
items.whyItWorks: Sipping salted chicken or beef bone broth with a drop of toasted sesame oil or ground ginger restores sodium and hydrates an inflamed gut faster than plain water.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Heat 1 cup bone broth on the stovetop with a pinch of sea salt and 1 drop toasted sesame oil.

items.name: Cream of Rice Hot Cereal (The Acute Flare Breakfast Gold Standard)
items.whyItWorks: The single safest breakfast on earth during an acute Crohn's or Colitis flare. Made exclusively of finely granulated white rice enriched with iron and B vitamins. It has 0g fiber, is naturally gluten-free, non-allergenic, and digests into pure soothing glucose without any mechanical work from the bowel.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 1/4 cup Cream of Rice into 1 cup boiling water or lactose-free milk for 2.5 minutes until thick and creamy. Sweeten with a drizzle of pure maple syrup or stir in a spoonful of smooth creamy peanut butter.
watchOuts: Practically zero GI risk; use water or lactose-free milk during acute inflammation.

items.name: Member's Mark 100% Pure Liquid Egg Whites (6 x 16 oz Cartons)
items.whyItWorks: Pure pasteurized egg whites offer 100% bioavailable protein with zero fat, zero cholesterol, zero lactose, and zero fiber. It is arguably the easiest protein for a severely inflamed bowel to absorb.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Scramble gently in a non-stick pan with light cooking spray. Pair with soft white toast and seedless jelly.

items.name: Costco Kirkland Signature Organic Sipping Chicken Bone Broth (Carton)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Costco Wholesale (Logan / Lehi / South Jordan / Sandy, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Delivers 9g of easily absorbed collagen/gelatin protein per cup with 0g fiber, 0g fat, and gentle electrolytes—the ultimate flare-day base for cooking white rice or egg noodles.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm gently on the stovetop to sip plain, or use it instead of water to boil white jasmine rice, pastina, or scrambled egg drop soup.
watchOuts: Zero gut triggers—add a pinch of sea salt if extra sodium hydration is needed during a flare

items.name: Fody Foods Garlic-Infused Extra Virgin Olive Oil (True Garlic Aroma)
items.whyItWorks: A scientific breakthrough for allium-sensitive IBD patients! Garlic fructans are water-soluble carbohydrates that cannot dissolve in oil. Oil infused with whole garlic cloves captures 100% of the delicious garlic aroma without a single molecule of fermentable fructans.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: The safest way on earth to cook with authentic garlic flavor in Crohn's and Colitis. Use for sautéing chicken, drizzling on potatoes, or pasta.
watchOuts: 100% low-FODMAP and fructan-free certified by Monash University.

items.name: Fody Foods Shallot-Infused Extra Virgin Olive Oil (True Onion Aroma)
items.whyItWorks: Captures rich sweet shallot and onion aroma in extra virgin olive oil while leaving all gas-producing allium fructans behind. Allows IBD patients to enjoy authentic onion flavor in soups, rice, and stews with zero bloating or cramping.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Sauté vegetables and meats with shallot oil as a direct drop-in replacement for diced onions.
watchOuts: Completely fructan-free and gut-safe.

items.name: Kirkland Signature Organic Thai Hom Mali Jasmine Rice (50 lb Bag)
items.whyItWorks: Premium polished white jasmine rice is practically 100% absorbable starch with minimal residue. It calms nausea, regulates stool consistency, and provides clean glucose for cells without irritating the colon.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Cook with 1.5 parts water to 1 part rice until soft and fluffy. Season simply with sea salt and a touch of olive oil.

items.name: Lundberg Organic White Jasmine Rice (Steamed Fluffy)
items.whyItWorks: The undisputed foundational carbohydrate for Crohn's and Colitis patients worldwide. Completely polished long-grain white rice is hypoallergenic, has virtually 0g insoluble fiber, absorbs smoothly, and provides immediate clean energy to heal intestines.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Rinse rice until water runs clear. Cook 1 cup rice in 1.75 cups water with a pinch of sea salt for 15 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
watchOuts: The safest carbohydrate staple in gastroenterology.

items.name: Member's Mark Long Grain Enriched White Rice (25 lb Bag)
items.whyItWorks: Standard polished white rice enriched with B vitamins and iron. Completely non-allergenic and low in residue, white rice absorbs fluids and calms gut spasms during acute Crohn's flares.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Steam thoroughly with 2 parts water to 1 part rice. Season with salt and a touch of butter or olive oil.

items.name: Ripe Yellow Banana (The Gold Standard Flare Fruit)
items.whyItWorks: The #1 gold-standard fruit for active IBD and flares. Fully ripe yellow bananas (with slight sugar spots) have converted all resistant starches into easily absorbed simple glucose and fructose. They are rich in soluble pectin, which firms loose watery stools and normalizes transit without scratching inflamed mucosa.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose yellow bananas with light brown speckles (fully ripe). Peel thoroughly and chew well. Avoid greenish bananas during flares as high resistant starch causes fermentation and gas.
watchOuts: Avoid unripe green-tipped bananas during flares—their resistant starch can trigger excess gas and bloating.

items.name: Side Bowl of Warm Steamed Jasmine White Rice
items.whyItWorks: Pure steamed jasmine white rice is the ultimate soothing staple in DCA. It calms nausea, slows bowel transit, requires minimal digestive work, and contains zero dairy, gluten, or seeds.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order an extra side bowl of plain steamed white rice. Eat plain or lightly seasoned with soy sauce.

items.name: Soft-Scrambled Large Eggs (Cooked in Butter or Olive Oil)
items.whyItWorks: Egg protein (ovalbumin) has the highest biological value of any whole food (BV = 100). Soft curds require zero chewing energy, contain 0g fiber, are naturally lactose-free, and provide essential amino acids to rebuild damaged intestinal mucosa.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 2 eggs with a splash of water and salt. Cook over low heat in a nonstick skillet with a dab of butter until soft, creamy curds form. Do not overcook or brown.
watchOuts: One of the most restorative, easily digested whole protein sources for IBD.

items.name: Swanson 100% Natural Chicken Broth (Warm Hydration)
items.whyItWorks: The ultimate liquid hydration therapy during flares. Delivers sodium and potassium to prevent dehydration and orthostatic dizziness, while warm fluid relaxes gastrointestinal spastic contractions with zero residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pour into a mug and heat in microwave or saucepan until warm. Sip slowly throughout the day.
watchOuts: Look for natural chicken broth without added onion powder or garlic if sensitive to alliums.

items.name: Warm Steamed Premium White Calrose Rice Bowl
items.whyItWorks: Pure steamed short-grain white rice is one of the safest foods on earth for active inflammatory bowel disease. It is non-allergenic, virtually fiber-free, easy to absorb, and actively soothes hyperactive intestines.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order plain steamed white rice without sushi vinegar seasoning, sesame seeds, or sauce.

items.name: California Olive Ranch Cold-Pressed Extra Virgin Olive Oil
items.whyItWorks: The gold-standard culinary fat in gastroenterology. Rich in monounsaturated oleic acid and oleocanthal (a natural phenolic compound that exerts anti-inflammatory effects mirroring ibuprofen without gastric toxicity). Soothes mucosal lining and aids nutrient absorption.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drizzle 1–2 teaspoons over warm white rice, boiled carrots, or scrambled eggs. Safe across all disease phases.
watchOuts: Pure liquid fat; maintain standard 1-tablespoon servings.

items.name: CeraLyte 70 Rice-Based Oral Rehydration Solution
items.whyItWorks: The clinical gold-standard ORS for short bowel syndrome, severe Crohn's enteritis, and high-output ileostomies. Uses rice carbohydrate polymers instead of simple sugars, allowing continuous enzyme-mediated sodium absorption that reduces stool volume and stops diarrhea.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mix 1 packet with 32 oz (1 liter) of clean water. Sip throughout the day as prescribed by your gastroenterologist or GI dietitian.

items.name: Holiday Leftover Homemade Turkey Carcass Bone Broth & Egg Noodle Soup
items.whyItWorks: Simmering the holiday turkey frame releases gut-soothing glycine, proline, and gelatin; combined with shredded turkey breast, peeled soft-boiled carrots, and tender egg noodles or white rice, it helps your gut recover after rich holiday meals.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Strain the turkey broth through a fine mesh sieve, chill and skim off the solid yellow fat cap, then simmer with shredded turkey breast, peeled sliced carrots, and egg noodles or white rice.
watchOuts: Skim the rendered turkey fat off the top of the broth and strain out fibrous celery strings and onion skins

items.name: Kirkland Signature Boneless Skinless Chicken Breasts (Individually Wrapped)
items.whyItWorks: The gold-standard baseline protein for Crohn's and Colitis patients. Clean, unseasoned chicken breast contains virtually zero fat and zero fiber, making it the least inflammatory whole-food protein on earth.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Poach in salted water or bake covered with foil to keep it tender and moist. Shred over white rice or noodle broth.

items.name: Member's Mark Boneless Skinless Chicken Tenderloins (Frozen 6 lb)
items.whyItWorks: Tenderloins are the naturally most tender cut of the chicken breast, cooking quickly without toughening. Free of marinades, breading, or additives, making them an ideal flare-safe staple.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Poach in lightly salted water or bake in foil. Shred or dice over warm white rice or rice noodles.

items.name: Nabisco Premium Saltine Crackers (Original Salted)
items.whyItWorks: The timeless cornerstone of the IBD bland diet. Made of refined white flour, baking soda, yeast, and light salt, saltine crackers provide pure, easily absorbed carbohydrates. The gentle sodium helps replenish electrolytes lost during diarrhea bouts with zero abrasive fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Keep a sleeve of Premium Saltines in your pantry or travel bag for acute nausea or flare days. Nibble slowly with sips of water or warm broth.
watchOuts: Contains gluten; choose certified gluten-free table crackers if diagnosed with co-occurring celiac disease.

items.name: Neocate Splash Elemental Ready-to-Drink Formula
items.whyItWorks: A 100% elemental formula based on free amino acids requiring zero gastrointestinal digestion. Clinically hypoallergenic, dairy-protein-free, zero fiber, and absorbed in the very first inches of the proximal small intestine.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drink cold straight from the Tetra Pak. Essential for strict elemental diet therapy or severe small bowel inflammation.

items.name: Pedialyte Classic Oral Electrolyte Solution
items.whyItWorks: Medical-grade oral rehydration therapy meeting World Health Organization (WHO) osmotic standards. Contains twice the sodium and half the sugar of sports drinks, maximizing cellular water absorption without drawing fluid into the bowel.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Sip 4–8 oz slowly throughout the day during heavy watery diarrhea or flare-ups. Serve chilled over ice.
watchOuts: Top clinical recommendation for preventing dehydration and electrolyte imbalances.

items.name: Peptamen Semi-Elemental Peptide Formula (Nestle)
items.whyItWorks: Enzymatically hydrolyzed 100% whey peptide formulation with 70% of fat as rapid-absorbing Medium Chain Triglycerides (MCT). Formulated specifically for patients with impaired GI function, short bowel syndrome, or extensive mucosal damage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Consume chilled. Sip slowly over 30 minutes.

items.name: Plain Poached or Baked Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast
items.whyItWorks: The absolute gold standard meat for Crohn's and Colitis. Boneless white breast meat contains virtually no connective tissue, no gristle, very low fat, and zero fiber. It breaks down easily in stomach acid, providing bioavailable protein to heal the gut.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer breast gently in chicken broth with sea salt for 15 minutes until internal temp reaches 165°F. Shred finely with two forks.
watchOuts: Avoid charring, blackening, or heavily peppering the chicken exterior.

items.name: TownePlace Suites Salt Lake City Draper In-Suite Kitchen Meal (Stovetop Jasmine Rice, Bone Broth & Rotisserie Chicken)
items.brandOrRestaurant: TownePlace Suites by Marriott Salt Lake City Draper (Draper, UT)
searchKeywords: flare safe hotel dinner draper utah
items.whyItWorks: Every room at TownePlace Suites Draper includes a full-size refrigerator, 2-burner stovetop, dishwasher, and toaster—letting you simmer white rice in chicken bone broth with shredded Harmons/Costco rotisserie chicken breast and toast real sourdough bread with zero restaurant grease.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stock your suite fridge from nearby Harmons Draper or Costco Sandy with Kirkland Chicken Bone Broth, microwave/stovetop jasmine rice pouches, plain rotisserie chicken breast, eggs, and Artisan Sourdough bread.
watchOuts: Zero gut triggers—gives you a 100% controlled safety net whenever eating out in Draper feels risky

items.name: 4th & Heart Original Grass-Fed Ghee (100% Clarified Butter)
items.whyItWorks: Clarified butter slow-cooked until all water evaporates and all milk solids (casein and whey) and lactose are skimmed and filtered out. Ghee is naturally 100% lactose-free and casein-free, and exceptionally rich in short-chain butyric acid—the primary energy source for healing colonocytes.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Melt over hot rice, oatmeal, or vegetables. Safe for individuals with severe lactose intolerance or milk protein sensitivities.
watchOuts: 100% pure butter oil; safe for all IBD dietary stages.

items.name: Cream of Wheat Instant Original Hot Cereal
items.whyItWorks: Enriched with calcium carbonate and ferric orthophosphate (iron). The smooth, bland porridge is tolerated by even the most acutely inflamed guts during flare-up bowel rest.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mix packet with 1/2 cup boiling water or lactose-free milk. Stir well.

items.name: Cream of Wheat Original Hot Cereal (Smooth Farina)
items.whyItWorks: Fine wheat farina with the coarse outer bran removed. It cooks into an ultra-smooth, velvety porridge delivering 50% of daily iron (vital for anemia in IBD) with only 1g of gentle soluble fiber. Melts down effortlessly in gastric acid.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Cook on stovetop for 2.5 minutes. Swirl in a teaspoon of brown sugar, pure maple syrup, or a dash of cinnamon.
watchOuts: Contains wheat (gluten); choose Cream of Rice if co-diagnosed with celiac disease.

items.name: Kirkland Signature Hand-Pulled Rotisserie Chicken Breast Meat (Vacuum Pack)
items.whyItWorks: Sold in the refrigerated deli cases, these bags contain 100% white breast meat stripped clean of fatty skin, wing fat, cartilage, and bones. It provides ultra-convenient, pure lean protein with zero roughage, ideal for active flare recovery.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat cold right out of the bag, shred into warm white rice, or gently warm in chicken bone broth. Discard any stray bits of dark skin if found.

items.name: Kirkland Signature Organic Unsweetened Applesauce Pouches
items.whyItWorks: Cooked and finely pureed peeled apples provide soothing soluble pectin without harsh insoluble skin flakes. Soluble pectin forms a protective gel that helps firm up loose bowel movements during flare recovery.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ready to eat directly from the squeeze pouch at room temperature or chilled. A perfect portable emergency flare snack.

items.name: Kraft Jell-O Strawberry Gelatin Dessert (Prepared)
items.whyItWorks: The classic hospital and colonoscopy clear-liquid prep staple. Gelatin is derived from collagen peptides and water. It dissolves into a completely liquid state at body temperature, leaving zero digestive residue in the intestinal tract.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Prepare according to box directions or buy pre-made cups. Excellent for acute flare-up hydration and gentle sweetness.
watchOuts: Avoid red-colored gelatin 48 hours prior to a scheduled colonoscopy.

items.name: Malt-O-Meal Original Quick Hot Wheat Cereal (Farina)
items.whyItWorks: Finely milled enriched wheat farina with all coarse bran removed. Cooks in 3 minutes into a velvety, silky smooth porridge that coats the stomach without friction. Delivers 60% daily value of bioavailable iron to replenish anemia.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 3 tbsp into 1 cup boiling water or almond milk. Simmer on low for 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Top with brown sugar or maple syrup.

items.name: Member's Mark Organic Unsweetened Applesauce Cups (36-Pack)
items.whyItWorks: Peeled and steamed organic apples pureed smooth without added sugar or corn syrup. Soluble pectin coats the intestinal wall and supports stool formation during diarrheal episodes.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat at room temperature or chilled. Excellent soothing snack when the stomach is upset.

items.name: Modulen IBD Powdered Nutritional Formula (Nestle)
items.whyItWorks: Specifically developed for Crohn's disease dietary management and Exclusive Enteral Nutrition (EEN). Rich in naturally occurring bioactive TGF-beta 2, a cytokine demonstrated in clinical trials to reduce mucosal inflammation and promote gut mucosal healing.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mix measured scoops with cool filtered water using a shaker bottle or blender on low speed. Do not boil or use hot liquids to protect the delicate TGF-beta proteins.

items.name: Smooth Unsweetened Applesauce Cup
items.whyItWorks: Cooking and pureeing apples completely removes the tough insoluble peel and hydrolyzes cellular fiber into gentle soluble pectin. It acts like a soothing balm in the colon, binding loose bowel movements and supplying easily absorbed energy.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Select unsweetened or natural varieties without high-fructose corn syrup or chunked pieces. Serve chilled or room temperature.
watchOuts: Choose smooth pureed varieties rather than chunky homestyle applesauce with leftover skin fragments.

items.name: Traditional Medicinals Throat Coat Tea (Slippery Elm & Licorice)
items.whyItWorks: Contains wild-harvested slippery elm inner bark, organic marshmallow root, and sweet licorice root. The high concentration of natural mucilage polysaccharides creates a soothing, protective gel coating across inflamed mucosal tissue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pour 8 oz boiling water over tea bag and cover with a lid. Steep for a full 10-15 minutes, then gently squeeze the bag to express the viscous, mucosal-protective herbal extract.

items.name: Twinings Pure Chamomile Herbal Tea (Caffeine-Free Antispasmodic)
items.whyItWorks: Chamomile contains the bioflavonoid apigenin, which binds to benzodiazepine receptors in the nervous system and exerts natural antispasmodic and muscle-relaxant effects on the gastrointestinal tract, easing colonic cramps.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Steep 1 tea bag in 8 oz boiling water for 4–5 minutes. Sip warm before bedtime or during cramps.
watchOuts: 100% caffeine-free; gentle on the stomach.

items.name: Tyson Grilled & Ready Fully Cooked Frozen Chicken Breast Strips
items.whyItWorks: A lifesaving freezer staple for IBD patients with zero energy to cook: 100% real boneless, skinless chicken breast strips, flame-grilled and flash-frozen. Contains 0g breading, 0g fiber, under 2g fat, and heats in 90 seconds.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Microwave 3 oz of strips for 60–90 seconds. Serve over warm white rice, stirred into chicken broth, or in a soft flour tortilla.
watchOuts: Completely unbreaded and lean; safe for acute flares, strictures, and remission.

items.name: Vital Proteins Unflavored Collagen Peptides Powder
items.whyItWorks: Hydrolyzed bovine collagen peptides providing 18g protein rich in glycine, proline, and hydroxyproline—key amino acids utilized in mucosal epithelial cell barrier synthesis. Dissolves 100% clear with zero flavor, zero fiber, and zero dairy.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stir 1-2 scoops into warm herbal tea, plain bone broth, oatmeal, or applesauce until completely dissolved.

items.name: 24-Hour Room Service Clear Chicken Noodle Soup with Sourdough Roll
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · 24-Hour Stateroom Dining
items.whyItWorks: Clear hydrating chicken broth with pulled white chicken, soft egg noodles, cooked carrots, and a sourdough baguette roll—the #1 24-hour flare rescue on the ship.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order anytime day or night via stateroom phone; sip the warm broth, egg noodles, and chicken with the sourdough roll.
watchOuts: Leave any fibrous celery pieces at the bottom of the bowl if mid-flare

items.name: Bob's Red Mill Organic Creamy Wheat Farina Cereal
items.whyItWorks: Made strictly from the tender inner endosperm of organic hard red wheat. Gently ground to create a velvety hot porridge with under 1g fiber per serving.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer 3 tbsp in 1 cup water with a pinch of sea salt for 5 minutes on stovetop.

items.name: Buddha Teas Organic Pure Marshmallow Root Tea
items.whyItWorks: 100% pure organic Althaea officinalis root. Exceptionally gentle, anti-inflammatory, and creates a slippery protective barrier that calms irritated bowel linings, relaxes smooth muscle spasm, and eases tenesmus.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Steep in hot water for 10 minutes. Can also be cold-brewed in the fridge overnight for maximum extraction of heat-sensitive mucilage.

items.name: Buffet Carving Station (Roast Turkey, Prime Rib, or Ham)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
items.whyItWorks: Hand-carved roasted turkey breast, tenderloin/roast beef, and glazed ham paired with peeled mashed potatoes and savory gravy give you a 9.5/10 hot Thanksgiving-style lunch every day at sea.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Head straight to the carving board at Cabanas or Marceline Market, ask for lean center slices (no peppercorn bark), and pair with whipped mashed potatoes, gravy, and a soft white dinner roll.
watchOuts: Outer black peppercorn or herb crusts on carved beef

items.name: Buffet Hot Porridge Bar (Grits, Farina, or White Rice Congee)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
items.whyItWorks: Cabanas and Marceline Market stock hot Cream of Wheat/farina, hominy grits, and individual boxes of Rice Krispies/Corn Flakes alongside lactose-free/oat milk.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: On a rough flare morning at sea, grab hot Cream of Wheat/grits or a bowl of Rice Krispies with oat/soy/lactose-free milk and a ripe banana or melon slices.
watchOuts: Avoid the Muesli / Bircher muesli (raw rolled oats, nuts, and dried fruit skins)

items.name: Buffet Made-to-Order Omelet & Soft Scrambled Eggs
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
items.whyItWorks: Fresh-cracked eggs cooked to order with diced ham and aged cheddar or Swiss provide 20g+ of zero-fiber protein to anchor a cruise morning.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Step up to the omelet window at Cabanas or Marceline Market and order a plain, ham-and-cheddar, or Swiss omelet (strictly no raw diced onions, bell peppers, tomatoes, or mushrooms). Pair with a white bagel, croissant, or hash brown inside.
watchOuts: Pre-mixed liquid buffet scrambled eggs if they contain dairy cream (use the fresh omelet station if lactose sensitive)
Diced raw pepper/onion mix-ins

items.name: Buffet Peel-and-Eat Shrimp, Crab Legs & Smoked Salmon
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
items.whyItWorks: Chilled poached shrimp, snow crab/stone crab claws, and cured smoked salmon have 0g fiber, zero fried grease, and digest rapidly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Load up on plain poached shrimp and smoked salmon (great on a toasted white bagel at breakfast or with white rice at lunch). Skip spicy horseradish cocktail sauce and lemon wedges if flaring.
watchOuts: Horseradish in cocktail sauce
Lemon wedges and capers

items.name: Cantonese Steamed Egg with Minced Pork
items.whyItWorks: Silky steamed egg custard topped with finely minced savory pork and soy sauce over white rice.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Steam whisked eggs with warm chicken broth for 10 mins, top with browned finely minced pork and a splash of soy sauce and sesame oil.

items.name: Castle Hot Cocoa (With Lactose-Free or Oat Milk)
items.whyItWorks: Comforting, rich calories without coffee acidity or dairy lactase issues when mixed into warm oat or lactose-free milk.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk Castle hot cocoa mix into warm lactose-free milk, oat milk, or almond milk.

items.name: Chester's Butter Puffcorn (The 100% Hull-Free Popcorn Alternative)
items.whyItWorks: The holy grail movie snack for Crohn's and Colitis patients! Unlike real popcorn which has razor-sharp hulls, Puffcorn is made from puffed cornmeal extruded into soft cloud-like puffs. It has ZERO seeds, ZERO hulls, and literally dissolves into smooth mush on contact with saliva.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: The safest crunchy movie snack for IBD. Safe even for patients with intestinal strictures or stomas.
watchOuts: Contains artificial butter flavor and dairy whey seasoning; safe for mild lactose tolerance.

items.name: Chinese Egg Drop Soup or Pork Wonton Soup
items.whyItWorks: Silky cornstarch-thickened chicken broth with ribbons of cooked egg and thin wheat wonton skins.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order standard Egg Drop or Wonton Soup and skip the deep-fried crunchy noodle strips during an active flare.

items.name: Coconut Secret Organic Raw Coconut Aminos (Soy-Free & Low Sodium)
items.whyItWorks: Made from naturally fermented coconut palm blossom sap and sea salt. It contains NO coconut meat or fiber, is 100% soy-free, 100% gluten-free, and has 73% less sodium than soy sauce. Gentle, sweet, and soothing on digestion.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drizzle freely over rice bowls, chicken, or salmon.
watchOuts: Made from liquid tree sap; completely free of woody coconut fibers.

items.name: Costco Kirkland Signature $4.99 Whole Seasoned Rotisserie Chicken (Skinless Breast)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Costco Wholesale (North Logan, Draper, South Jordan & Nationwide)
items.whyItWorks: Slow-roasted until ultra-tender and juicy: removing the outer skin yields 3+ pounds of zero-fiber, gluten-free, dairy-free, citrus-free lean protein for $4.99.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel off the seasoned skin during a flare, shred the warm breast meat over white rice, mashed potatoes, or sourdough toast, and save the carcass for gut-healing bone broth.
watchOuts: Discard the outer skin if sensitive to carrageenan/seasoning rub or rendered poultry fat

items.name: Creamy Butternut Squash Soup
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Animator's Palate / 1923 / Cabanas
items.whyItWorks: Pureed peeled butternut squash and warm broth require zero chewing and deliver soothing soluble pectin that calms intestinal transit.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order or blend completely smooth without crunchy croutons, bacon bits, or pumpkin seed garnishes. Take a Lactaid enzyme if made with heavy dairy cream.
watchOuts: Toasted pumpkin seed (pepita) garnish
Heavy dairy cream if lactose sensitive

items.name: Creamy Parmesan & Chicken Risotto
items.whyItWorks: Arborio white rice releases starch that creates a velvety sauce using only chicken bone broth, butter, and aged parmesan - zero heavy cream needed.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer arborio rice in warm chicken broth, finish with butter and aged parmesan, and top with pan-seared chicken tenders or scallops.

items.name: DCL Kids' Menu Staples (Any Adult Can Order): Plain Chicken, Mini Steak, Salmon & Mickey Bar
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · All Main Dining Rooms (Kids' Menu)
items.whyItWorks: Every single night in every restaurant, adults are welcome to order off the DCL Kids' Menu—which features completely unspiced grilled chicken breast, baked salmon, mini beef tenderloin/sirloin steak, plain mac & cheese, mashed potatoes, white rice, and the Mickey Ice Cream Bar.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Whenever a main dining menu looks risky during a flare, ask your server for the Kids' Menu Grilled Chicken Breast, Baked Salmon, or Mini Steak with mashed potatoes or white rice (you can ask for an adult-sized portion!).
watchOuts: Ask for an adult-sized double portion of the protein

items.name: Disneyland & DCA Outdoor Fruit Carts: Fresh Ripe Banana & Cut Cantaloupe/Honeydew Cup
items.brandOrRestaurant: Main Street Fruit Cart, Ship to Shore & Fillmore's Taste-In (Disneyland & DCA)
items.whyItWorks: Whole ripe bananas ($2–$3 at fruit carts in every land) and chilled seedless cantaloupe/honeydew melon cups are hydrating, potassium-rich, and 9.5/10 flare-safe.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick up 2 ripe bananas at Main Street Fruit Cart (Disneyland) or Fillmore's Taste-In (Cars Land DCA) each morning to keep in your park bag—never add the Tajín chili-lime packet!
watchOuts: Discard the Tajín chili-lime seasoning packet often offered with fruit cups (chili + dehydrated lime trigger)

items.name: GoGo SqueeZ 100% Fruit Applesauce On-The-Go Pouch
items.whyItWorks: 100% pure pureed apples with zero skins, seeds, or added sugar. The sealed pouch makes it completely shelf-stable and pocket-friendly for work, school, or travel emergencies.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Twist off the helicopter cap and squeeze directly into mouth. Excellent quick energy boost when you cannot tolerate solid food.
watchOuts: Avoid fruit pouch varieties with blended strawberry/raspberry seeds or added citric acid.

items.name: Golden Milk (Turmeric & Ginger Oat Latte)
items.whyItWorks: Warm oat milk whisked with anti-inflammatory turmeric, cinnamon, ginger, and maple syrup.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm 1 cup oat or lactose-free milk with 1/2 tsp ground turmeric, a pinch of cinnamon, ground ginger, and 1 tsp maple syrup or honey.

items.name: Great Lakes Wellness Pure Unflavored Beef Gelatin
items.whyItWorks: 100% pure bovine gelatin that coats and soothes inflamed mucosal linings. Zero carbs, zero sugar, zero fiber, and provides gentle protein that gels liquids into tender, digest-safe fruit gelatin treats.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bloom 1 tbsp in cold water for 3 minutes, then dissolve in warm 100% apple or white grape juice and chill in fridge until set.

items.name: Greek Avgolemono (Egg-Velvet Chicken & Rice Soup)
items.whyItWorks: Thickens rich chicken bone broth and white rice using tempered egg yolks instead of heavy dairy.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Temper whisked eggs with hot chicken broth and stir into cooked white rice and shredded chicken. Skip citrus zest/peel extracts; season with salt and a pinch of dried dill.

items.name: Gut-Safe "Yum Yum" / Burger Sauce
items.whyItWorks: Provides creamy, tangy hibachi and burger flavor using smooth powders instead of raw onion or pickle chunks.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 1/2 cup mayo + 1 tbsp smooth ketchup + 1 tsp melted butter + 1/2 tsp garlic powder + 1/2 tsp onion powder + 1 tsp sugar + splash of water.

items.name: Hard-Boiled Large Egg (Chilled Protein Snack)
items.whyItWorks: A portable, pre-portioned package of 6g pure protein and choline with zero carbohydrates and zero fiber. Chilled hard-boiled eggs are gentle, non-irritating, and stabilize blood sugar on busy days.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel shell cleanly and sprinkle with a pinch of sea salt. Chew yolk and white thoroughly.
watchOuts: Ensure shell fragments are 100% removed before eating.

items.name: Iced Lobster and Jumbo Shrimp Cocktail
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's
items.whyItWorks: Poached chilled lobster and jumbo shrimp are pure, zero-fiber, lean marine protein with virtually no fat or roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order at Triton's or Lumiere's and eat the poached shrimp, lobster, and tender asparagus tips only (leave the woody bottom asparagus stalks and skip spicy horseradish cream if flaring).
watchOuts: Spicy horseradish cream
Woody bottom stems of asparagus garnish
Lemon wedge squeeze

items.name: Japanese Chicken or Tamago Udon Soup
items.whyItWorks: Thick white wheat udon noodles are ultra-soft and slippery; mild dashi and soy broth settles cramps and restores electrolytes.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer pre-cooked vacuum-packed udon noodles in chicken broth with a splash of soy sauce and mirin. Top with thinly sliced skinless chicken breast and swirled egg drop.

items.name: Kate Farms Pediatric Peptide 1.5 Formula
items.whyItWorks: Enzymatically hydrolyzed pea peptide formula designed for impaired digestive tracts, severe enteritis, and malabsorption. Broken-down small peptides and MCT oil absorb effortlessly in the upper jejunum without demanding pancreatic enzyme activity.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Keep chilled in refrigerator. Drink straight from carton or administer via enteral feeding tube as prescribed by a clinical dietitian.

items.name: Kirkland Signature Wild Alaskan Sockeye Salmon Filets (Frozen)
items.whyItWorks: Individually vacuum-sealed wild sockeye salmon portions provide premium EPA and DHA omega-3 fatty acids, proven to exert anti-inflammatory effects on the intestinal mucosa. Bakes up moist, tender, and easily absorbed.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Thaw in refrigerator. Bake or pan-sear with a drizzle of olive oil and sea salt. Pair with steamed white jasmine rice.

items.name: Kraft Jet-Puffed Regular or Mini Marshmallows
items.whyItWorks: Marshmallows consist purely of whipped sugar, corn syrup, water, and gelatin. They possess zero fiber and zero fat, melting into pure liquid at body temperature. Widely tolerated even during severe flare-ups.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat straight from the bag or drop into warm herbal tea or lactose-free hot cocoa for a soothing sweet treat.
watchOuts: Virtually zero GI risk, but high in simple sugars—consume in reasonable moderation.

items.name: Lactose-Free Greek Yogurt Herbed Ranch Dip
items.whyItWorks: Uses strained Greek yogurt or lactose-free sour cream with savory powders to avoid high-lactose buttermilk and MSG/preservatives.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk plain strained Greek yogurt with a splash of lactose-free milk, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and finely rubbed dried dill.

items.name: Main Dining "Lighter Note" Chicken, Salmon, or Sirloin
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · All Main Dining Rooms
items.whyItWorks: Printed at the bottom of EVERY main dining menu across Wonder, Magic, and Treasure: plain slow-roasted chicken breast, oven-baked salmon filet, or grilled sirloin with steamed white rice or baked potato.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Your ultimate flare safety net on any night in any restaurant: order the Lighter Note Oven-Baked Salmon or Roasted Chicken Breast with steamed white rice or a peeled baked potato (scoop out the inside).
watchOuts: Skip the skin on the baked potato
Ask for steamed carrots or skip the mixed garden vegetables if flaring

items.name: Malt-O-Meal Crispy Rice / Rice Chex
items.whyItWorks: Puffed white rice has 0g insoluble fiber and dissolves into harmless starch the second it hits liquid. Rice Chex is also certified gluten-free.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Let soak in cold lactose-free or almond milk for 60-90 seconds with a drizzle of honey or maple syrup.

items.name: Member's Mark Hand-Pulled Rotisserie Chicken Breast Meat (Deli Tub)
items.whyItWorks: Freshly stripped tender white chicken breast packaged without bones, heavy skin fat, or gristle. A lifesaver for busy weeknights or flare recovery when cooking raw poultry is exhausting.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat chilled, warm gently in microwave or skillet, or add to chicken noodle soup or plain white rice.

items.name: Nigiri & Sashimi (Salmon, Tuna, Yellowtail, Tamago)
items.whyItWorks: Raw or seared sushi-grade fish and sweet Japanese omelet (Tamago) over seasoned white sushi rice is arguably the cleanest, highest-protein, zero-fiber meal on earth.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for no sesame seeds on the rice. Dip in plain soy sauce and sweet eel sauce (skip spicy mayo, ponzu, and wasabi during flares).

items.name: Open-Faced Hot Turkey or Roast Beef Manhattan
items.whyItWorks: Soft white or potato bread topped with warm deli turkey, mashed peeled potatoes, and smooth bone-broth gravy - eats with a fork with zero tough crusts.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer potato bread, warm sliced turkey breast, and mashed potatoes, then ladle warm savory bone-broth gravy over the top so the bread softens completely.

items.name: Outshine Fruit Bars (Smooth Varieties) or Fudgsicles
items.whyItWorks: Cold, hydrating, soothing, and zero residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stick to Fudgsicles or smooth Peach/Grape bars. Verify zero real berry seeds and check labels to avoid grapefruit or citrus peel extracts.

items.name: Oven-Baked Salmon Fillet with Steamed Jasmine Rice (Let the Magic Begin Menu)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Let the Magic Begin Menu
items.whyItWorks: Textbook 9.5/10 flare meal on Night 1: plain oven-baked omega-3 salmon over steamed white jasmine rice.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the baked salmon and steamed jasmine rice; leave the fibrous bok choy stalks on the side.
watchOuts: Skip the bok choy stalks if flaring

items.name: Pan-Seared Salmon & Cheddar Polenta (or Grits)
items.whyItWorks: Salmon flakes apart with zero tough connective tissue; corn grits/polenta cook down completely smooth.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pan-sear skinless salmon bites or fillet with a sweet soy or teriyaki glaze. Serve over soft-cooked quick corn grits stirred with butter and sharp cheddar or grated parmesan.

items.name: Panda Express Steamed White Rice (Side / Bowl Base)
items.whyItWorks: Pure, plain steamed long-grain white rice prepared with water only. Zero added oils, zero garlic, zero onion, zero dairy, and zero citrus. Available at virtually every airport, mall, and roadside travel plaza across the country.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a large or medium carton of "Steamed White Rice." Ask them not to pour any sauce over it.

items.name: Pirate's Booty or Chester's Butter Puffcorn
items.whyItWorks: Extruded corn and rice meal with 0% hulls. Gives you the exact salty, crunchy movie-popcorn fix, but melts into foam on your tongue so nothing scrapes your intestine.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab and eat straight from the bag.

items.name: Post-Holiday Soothing Hot Ginger & Peppermint Herbal Tea
items.whyItWorks: Steeped fresh ginger root and dried peppermint leaves. Gingerols reduce gastrointestinal mucosal inflammation and nausea, while menthol calms colon spasms. Zero caffeine, zero acid.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Steep 1 tea bag or fresh ginger slices in hot water for 5 minutes; sweeten with a teaspoon of pure honey.
watchOuts: None; premier soothing digestive tea

items.name: Potage Parmentier (Smooth Leek & Potato Soup)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Wonder · Triton's
items.whyItWorks: Peeled potatoes and tender simmered leeks are pureed into a velvety, liquid-smooth French bisque that requires zero mechanical chewing.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: At Lumiere's or Triton's, order without raw chive garnish or crunchy croutons. At home, simmer peeled potatoes in broth with onion powder and blend smooth with lactose-free cream and butter.
watchOuts: Raw chopped chive garnish
Dairy cream base if lactose sensitive

items.name: Potato Gnocchi in Brown Butter & Parmesan
items.whyItWorks: Shelf-stable or refrigerated potato gnocchi are pillows of mashed peeled potato and white flour that boil in 180 seconds and require almost zero chewing.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil gnocchi until they float, then toss in a skillet with melted butter, a splash of pasta water, garlic powder, and aged Parmigiano-Reggiano (~0g lactose).

items.name: Sam's Club Member's Mark $4.98 Whole Rotisserie Chicken & Deli Mashed Potatoes
items.brandOrRestaurant: Sam's Club Deli (Logan, South Jordan & Nationwide)
groceryIngredients: Member's Mark Yukon Gold Mashed Potatoes

watchOuts: Remove outer chicken skin if flaring

items.name: Shredded Chicken & White Rice Caldo (Mexican Chicken Soup)
items.whyItWorks: Rich chicken bone broth simmered with jasmine rice, shredded chicken breast, a pinch of cumin, and soft-cooked peeled carrots and diced peeled zucchini.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Top with cubed ripe avocado and skip raw onions, jalapenos, and lime peel extracts.

items.name: Sit-Down Breakfast Hot Oatmeal, Cream of Wheat & White Hominy Grits
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
items.whyItWorks: Silky Cream of Wheat (farina), plain white hominy grits, and slow-simmered oatmeal are top-tier soluble-fiber flare foods.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order with brown sugar, honey, or maple syrup on the side and ask your server to hold the toasted pecan garnish.
watchOuts: Hold toasted pecans that sometimes accompany hot oatmeal
Request almond/oat milk instead of dairy milk

items.name: Smooth Egg Salad on Brioche
items.whyItWorks: Pure protein and fat, zero plant fiber, dissolves effortlessly in the stomach.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mash 2 hard-boiled eggs fine with 1 tbsp mayo, 1/2 tsp smooth yellow or Dijon mustard (no whole seeds), salt, and paprika. Serve on potato bread, brioche, or sweet Hawaiian rolls.

items.name: StarKist Chunk Light Tuna in Water (Drained Can or Pouch)
items.whyItWorks: Wild skipjack tuna packed in water provides 20g+ of pure lean animal protein per can with virtually zero fat (under 1g) and zero fiber. Extremely light on digestion and easy to flake into soft bites.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain water completely. Mix with 1 tablespoon of plain mayonnaise or olive oil and spread on white toast or saltines.
watchOuts: Avoid canned tuna packed in heavy spicy oils or containing celery/onion seasonings.

items.name: Takara Sushi (Logan) Salmon, Tuna & Yellowtail Nigiri + Miso Soup
items.whyItWorks: Pure raw salmon, tuna, albacore, or tamago (sweet egg) over seasoned white sushi rice with a warm bowl of probiotic miso broth—nearly zero fiber and zero dairy.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Salmon (Sake), Tuna (Maguro), Yellowtail (Hamachi), or Tamago Nigiri with a cup of Miso Soup and gluten-free tamari/soy sauce.
watchOuts: Skip wasabi paste and raw jalapeño toppings

items.name: Thanksgiving & Christmas Peeled Whipped Yukon Gold Mashed Potatoes
items.whyItWorks: Fully peeled, boiled, and whipped potatoes provide pure, soothing soluble starch that slows gut transit and cushions the GI tract.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ensure potatoes are 100% peeled (no "rustic" skins mixed in) and whipped with bone broth, ghee/butter, and lactose-free milk/sour cream (or take a Lactaid at a family potluck).
watchOuts: Avoid "smashed" potatoes with skins left on or heavy raw roasted garlic

items.name: Thanksgiving & Christmas Roasted Turkey Breast with Strained Pan Gravy
groceryIngredients: Whole Turkey or Bone-In Turkey Breast
items.whyItWorks: Carved skinless white-meat turkey breast is 100% fiber-free, ultra-lean, and rich in L-tryptophan and B-vitamins—the safest centerpiece on any Thanksgiving or Christmas table.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Carve slices from the interior white turkey breast (skipping heavily peppered/crispy skin if flaring) and top with smooth strained bone-broth pan gravy (no chopped giblets or onions).
watchOuts: Skip crispy heavily seasoned skin and chunky giblet/mushroom gravies

items.name: Thomas2Go @ BambooHR (Lindon, UT) Gentle Shredded Chicken & White Rice Porridge (Congee)
items.whyItWorks: Traditional long-simmered white rice porridge cooked in clear chicken broth until grains dissolve into a soothing, silky cream. Requires zero digestive effort.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ladle a bowl of warm chicken congee; season with a drop of tamari soy sauce (skip scallions, chili oil, and fried garlic).
watchOuts: None; premier flare-safe corporate comfort meal

items.name: Traditional Artisanal White Sourdough Bread (Naturally Fermented)
items.whyItWorks: The gold-standard daily bread for IBD. Natural wild yeast and lactobacilli fermentation over 24+ hours pre-digests wheat fructans (making it officially low-FODMAP) and partially breaks down gluten protein peptides, resulting in superior gastric tolerance and zero bloating.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast lightly and spread with pure butter, smooth peanut butter, or use for lean turkey sandwiches. Chew crust thoroughly or slice crust away if jaw or bowel is fatigued.
watchOuts: Look for authentic slow-fermented sourdough without added instant commercial yeast.

items.name: Wonton or Ramen Noodle Broth Bowl
items.whyItWorks: Hot bone broth hydrates an irritated bowel and replaces sodium, while refined wheat noodles and thin wonton wrappers require almost zero digestive effort.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer ramen noodles (ditch spicy chili packets) or frozen chicken/pork wontons in rich chicken bone broth. Add 1 drop toasted sesame oil and a soft-boiled egg.

items.name: 100% Pure Grade A Amber Maple Syrup (Pure Tree Sap)
items.whyItWorks: 100% pure boiled maple tree sap. Unlike commercial pancake syrups made of high-fructose corn syrup, pure maple syrup is predominantly sucrose with mineral trace elements (manganese and zinc). It contains 0g fiber, zero artificial sweeteners, and is certified low-FODMAP.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drizzle 1–2 tablespoons over oatmeal, pancakes, Cream of Rice, or waffles. Avoid pancake syrups sweetened with sorbitol or high-fructose corn syrup.
watchOuts: Read label carefully: must state '100% Pure Maple Syrup', not 'Maple-Flavored Corn Syrup'.

items.name: Bumble Bee Wild Pink Salmon in Water (Skinless & Boneless)
items.whyItWorks: Packed with anti-inflammatory marine omega-3 fatty acids (EPA and DHA) that actively dampen intestinal cytokine inflammation. Tender, flaky texture melts with gentle chewing.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain and flake with a fork. Delicious tossed with warm white rice or served on sourdough bread.
watchOuts: Buy skinless & boneless cans/pouches to avoid hard bone fragments.

items.name: Disneyland Bengal Barbecue Plain Steamed Jasmine White Rice Cup
items.whyItWorks: One of the best emergency flare-safe hacks in Disneyland! Warm, fluffy steamed white jasmine rice with zero butter, oil, spices, or seeds. Soothes an upset stomach immediately.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a cup of plain steamed white rice (request no spicy seasonings or furikake seeds).
watchOuts: None; premier flare-safe theme park carbohydrate

items.name: Dum-Dums Original Pops Lollipops
items.whyItWorks: Hard sugar candies dissolve slowly in the mouth via saliva, preventing bolus digestion in the stomach. Sucking on a pop promotes salivary enzymes and eases mild nausea during flare days.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Suck on a pop slowly; do not bite down on hard candy to protect dental enamel.
watchOuts: Pure sugar; zero dietary residue.

items.name: Holiday Fluffy Mashed Idaho Russet Potatoes with Melted Butter & Sea Salt
items.whyItWorks: Peeled Idaho russet potatoes boiled until fork-tender and whipped smooth with melted butter, light milk, and sea salt. Zero skins, zero roughage, and high in potassium.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy warm whipped mashed potatoes; top with clear turkey broth or light gravy.
watchOuts: Ensure potatoes are peeled with zero skins remaining

items.name: Isopure Zero Carb Unflavored Whey Protein Isolate Powder
items.whyItWorks: Cross-flow microfiltered 100% whey protein isolate containing virtually zero lactose (<0.5g), 0g fat, 0g carbohydrates, and zero artificial sweeteners, gums, or colors. The gold-standard clean protein builder for IBD recovery.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 1 scoop into Cream of Rice, pureed banana smoothies, or lactose-free milk.

items.name: Kirkland Signature Wild Alaska Pink Salmon (Canned in Water)
items.whyItWorks: Cooked right in the can with water and salt, the tender salmon flakes are rich in anti-inflammatory omega-3 fats. Pressure-cooking softens tiny calcium-rich bones so they dissolve effortlessly without roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain and flake with a fork. Mix with a dab of light mayonnaise and spread onto white toast or stir into warm rice.

items.name: Member's Mark Fresh Farm-Raised Atlantic Salmon Filets
items.whyItWorks: High-fat marine protein rich in natural anti-inflammatory omega-3 fatty acids. Skinless salmon cooked simply in olive oil produces zero abrasive roughage, soothing mucosal irritation.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake or pan-sear simply with olive oil and salt. Discard grey bloodline or skin if fat sensitivity is high.

items.name: Member's Mark Premium Chunk Chicken Breast in Water (6 x 12.5 oz Cans)
items.whyItWorks: White chicken breast chunks cooked in water and salt. The meat is tender, flaky, and breaks down effortlessly with minimal mastication, supplying clean protein during low-residue recovery.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain broth. Mix with a little olive oil or light mayo, or stir directly into warm white rice or chicken noodle broth.

items.name: Peeps Yellow Marshmallow Chicks
items.whyItWorks: Fluffy whipped marshmallow coated with sparkling sugar crystals. Completely fat-free, gluten-free, and residue-free. Melts into liquid sugar in the mouth.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Fun, gentle seasonal treat that poses zero mechanical friction in the intestine.
watchOuts: Pure refined sugar; enjoy in moderation.

items.name: Post-Holiday Leftover Roast Turkey, White Rice & Bone Broth Soup
items.whyItWorks: The ultimate post-holiday digestive recovery meal! Simmering the holiday turkey carcass creates rich collagen and glycine bone broth. Combined with tender shredded white turkey meat and soft white rice, it heals inflamed mucosa.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer turkey bones with celery and carrots, strain clear broth, and add shredded turkey breast and cooked white rice with sea salt.
watchOuts: None; premier therapeutic flare-safe dish

items.name: Quaker Plain Salted Puffed Rice Cakes
items.whyItWorks: Puffed white rice cakes are ultra-light, naturally gluten-free, and practically dissolve on contact with saliva. With zero fat and minimal fiber (0.5g), they provide clean, non-irritating calories.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat plain as a crunchy flare snack, or spread lightly with smooth creamy peanut butter or seedless jelly.
watchOuts: Avoid multi-seed or multigrain rice cakes with whole sesame or flax seeds.

items.name: Quaker Quick Grits (Smooth White Hominy)
items.whyItWorks: Made from dried white corn that has been nixtamalized to completely shed the tough outer kernel hull before being ground into fine hominy grits. Creamy, comforting, and 100% free of sharp corn skins.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil 1/4 cup grits in 1 cup salted water for 5 minutes until thick. Stir in 1 tsp butter or ghee.

items.name: San-J Organic Gluten-Free Tamari Soy Sauce (Wheat-Free)
items.whyItWorks: Authentic Japanese Tamari brewed with 100% whole soybeans and zero wheat. The extended fermentation breaks down complex proteins into simple, soothing amino acids with richer umami and zero gluten.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: The gold-standard savory seasoning for IBD and celiac patients. Season white rice, chicken, or scrambled eggs.
watchOuts: Certified gluten-free and low-FODMAP in 2-tablespoon servings.

items.name: Skinless Roast Turkey Breast with Smooth Yukon Gold Mashed Potatoes
items.whyItWorks: The quintessential flare-safe holiday plate. Tender roasted white meat turkey breast is low in fat, ultra-high in protein, and completely gentle on the gut. Paired with peeled, smoothly whipped potatoes with a splash of broth or butter, it delivers guilt-free festive nourishment.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Carve white meat without the seasoned outer skin. Enjoy with skinless mashed potatoes lightly salted. Bypass celery-packed stuffing, fried onions, and whole-berry cranberry relish.

items.name: Smarties Candy Rolls (Powdered Dextrose Wafers)
items.whyItWorks: Made almost entirely of pure dextrose (glucose). Unlike complex sugars or lactose, pure dextrose requires zero enzymatic breakdown and is absorbed directly through the intestinal wall, providing instant cellular energy.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Dissolve on tongue. Frequently used by diabetic and IBD patients for rapid, clean blood sugar support.
watchOuts: Very high glycemic index; rapid absorption.

items.name: Steamed or Boiled Tender Baby Carrots
items.whyItWorks: Cooking carrots until fork-tender dissolves the tough pectin and hemicellulose cell walls, turning a hard fibrous root into an ultra-gentle, easily digested puree of beta-carotene and soluble nutrients. Completely safe even in strictures when soft.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Steam or boil baby carrots for 12–15 minutes until easily mashed with the back of a fork. Season with a pinch of sea salt and a touch of butter or olive oil.
watchOuts: Must be cooked until thoroughly soft; never eat raw or crunchy carrots during an active flare.

items.name: TownePlace Suites (Draper, UT) Chilled Hard-Boiled Eggs (Pure Protein Travel Hack)
items.brandOrRestaurant: TownePlace Suites Salt Lake City Draper
items.whyItWorks: Individual peeled hard-boiled eggs from the cold breakfast cooler. 100% bioavailable egg albumin and yolk healthy fats with zero fiber, zero lactose, and zero additives.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab two hard-boiled eggs, sprinkle with table salt and black pepper, and enjoy with a slice of white bread.
watchOuts: None; perfect zero-residue travel protein

items.name: Vital Proteins Marine Collagen Peptides Powder
items.whyItWorks: Extracted from wild-caught white fish scales; hydrolyzed into tiny, rapidly absorbed bioactive peptides. Completely dairy-free, beef-free, and pescatarian-friendly with 0g residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mix 1 scoop into water, tea, or broth. Stir thoroughly for 20 seconds.

items.name: Wonder Classic White Sandwich Bread (Ultra-Soft)
items.whyItWorks: Refined enriched wheat flour with all bran and germ removed. Wonder bread has a cloud-soft texture that turns to smooth mush upon chewing, presenting zero abrasive roughage to the GI tract.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: The ideal vehicle for flare-safe deli turkey sandwiches or light cinnamon toast.
watchOuts: Low in fiber by design (0.5g); perfect for low-residue flare protocols.

items.name: Barilla Classic White Semolina Spaghetti (Cooked Tender)
items.whyItWorks: 100% durum wheat semolina with the outer bran polished off. When boiled tender, white pasta is an elite flare-safe carb: simple, low-residue, non-bloating, and easy to digest.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil in salted water for 9–10 minutes until tender (cook slightly past al dente during acute inflammation for softer chewing). Toss with butter or light olive oil.
watchOuts: Never choose whole wheat pasta during flares; whole wheat pasta has coarse insoluble bran.

items.name: Butterball 93/7 All Natural Lean Ground Turkey (Simmered Crumbles)
items.whyItWorks: Pre-ground poultry meat eliminates tough meat fibers, creating soft, easily chewed crumbles that digest rapidly. Low in saturated fat and high in bioavailable zinc and iron.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Brown in a skillet with a splash of olive oil and salt. Simmer with a little chicken broth to keep meat juicy and soft. Mix with white rice or mashed potatoes.
watchOuts: Choose 93/7 lean ground turkey rather than high-fat 85/15 varieties.

items.name: Costco Wholesale (Logan & Draper, UT) Famous Rotisserie Chicken (Peeled Skin Hack)
items.whyItWorks: An absolute staple in Crohn's and colitis meal prep! Plump 3-lb whole chicken rotisserie-roasted until juicy and tender. Peeling off the salty skin leaves pure, unseasoned, tender white chicken breast that requires minimal digestive breakdown.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Carve warm breast meat and discard the seasoned outer skin. Pair with white rice or mashed potatoes.
watchOuts: Discard the seasoned outer skin to avoid excess grease and spice rub

items.name: Del Monte Canned Sliced Carrots (Fork-Soft)
items.whyItWorks: Peeled, sliced, and fully pressure-cooked in the can. These carrots mash with gentle pressure from a fork, requiring zero digestive chewing energy and providing abundant soothing beta-carotene.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Heat briefly in a saucepan or microwave. Mash into white rice or eat as an easy side with baked chicken breast.
watchOuts: Safe for all phases of IBD, including active flares and strictures.

items.name: DripDrop ORS Electrolyte Powder (Watermelon)
items.whyItWorks: Physician-developed oral rehydration formula with half the sugar of sports drinks and 3x the electrolytes. Its low osmolarity (220 mOsm/L) prevents osmotic fluid shifts into the bowel lumen, delivering rapid relief from flare dehydration.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stir 1 packet into 8 oz cold water and sip steadily over 20 minutes.

items.name: Fody Foods Low-FODMAP Tomato Ketchup (No Onion, No Garlic)
items.whyItWorks: Certified Low-FODMAP by Monash University. Formulated specifically for IBD and IBS patients: made from tomato puree and organic cane sugar with ZERO onion, ZERO garlic, and ZERO high-fructose corn syrup.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Use freely on burgers, scrambled eggs, and baked potatoes even during sensitive digestion phases.
watchOuts: Mild natural tomato acidity; generally well-tolerated by almost all IBD patients.

items.name: General Mills Rice Chex Cereal (Crisp Puffed Rice Lattice)
items.whyItWorks: Delicate woven lattices of puffed white rice and sugar with zero gluten and only 1g fiber. They absorb milk rapidly and disintegrate into a soft, non-abrasive mash with minimal chewing.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve with lactose-free milk or eat dry straight from the box as a clean finger-food snack.
watchOuts: Certified gluten-free; safe for both active flares and remission.

items.name: Haribo Goldbears Original Gummy Bears
items.whyItWorks: Original Haribo Goldbears are made of pure pork skin gelatin, glucose syrup, and sugar. They contain 0g fiber and 0g fat. Chewed gummy candy dissolves smoothly into gelatinous liquid in the stomach, providing safe quick energy.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Chew gummies thoroughly before swallowing. Safe treat during low-residue diets and flare recovery.
watchOuts: Crucial safety distinction: Always choose REGULAR SUGAR Haribo; never eat sugar-free gummy bears!

items.name: Heinz Homestyle Roasted Chicken Gravy (Smooth Velouté)
items.whyItWorks: A classic hospital comfort sauce: simmered chicken broth thickened smoothly with wheat flour and cornstarch. Contains 0g fiber, no gritty spices, and no whole alliums. Moistens dry chicken breast and mashed potatoes, making them effortless to swallow and digest.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm in a small saucepan or microwave for 45 seconds. Spoon generously over white rice, baked chicken, or mashed potatoes.
watchOuts: Contains wheat flour (gluten); safe for all IBD flare diets.

items.name: Holiday Scratch Turkey Bone Broth Gravy over Steamed White Rice
items.whyItWorks: Simmered holiday turkey drippings, rich turkey bone stock, and light flour roux ladled over soft, fluffy steamed white rice. Ultra-gentle on the gut, soothing, and packed with bioavailable collagen.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ladle warm, smooth strained turkey gravy over freshly steamed white jasmine or basmati rice with a pinch of sea salt.
watchOuts: None; exceptional flare-safe recovery meal

items.name: Kate Farms Standard 1.4 Nutritional Formula (Plain)
items.whyItWorks: Plant-based complete medical nutrition drink formulated with hydrolyzed organic pea protein and MCT oil, completely free from dairy, gluten, soy, corn, and artificial sweeteners. Widely tolerated during active Crohn's flares and EEN protocols without provoking bowel distress.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Shake carton vigorously and serve chilled or room temperature. Sip slowly over 30 to 45 minutes to optimize osmotic absorption and avoid rapid GI transit.

items.name: Kirkland Signature Solid White Albacore Tuna in Water (Canned 8-Pack)
items.whyItWorks: Solid loins of albacore tuna packed in water without added vegetable oils or broths. Packs over 30g of pure, easily digested protein per can with zero carbohydrates or insoluble fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain water thoroughly. Eat plain or seasoned with a touch of salt and olive oil. Avoid mixing with raw onions, celery, or relish.

items.name: Life Savers Hard Candy 5 Flavors Roll
items.whyItWorks: Classic ring-shaped hard candy that dissolves slowly in the mouth via saliva. Zero fiber, zero fat, and gentle on the stomach while stimulating saliva production.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Dissolve slowly on the tongue; do not crunch with teeth.
watchOuts: Safe for all IBD dietary stages.

items.name: Member's Mark Wild Alaska Pink Salmon (Canned in Water 6-Pack)
items.whyItWorks: Wild-caught pink salmon packed in water with natural marine omega-3s. High in natural vitamins and clean lean protein without harsh roughage or inflammatory additives.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain and flake with a fork. Enjoy over white toast or alongside steamed potatoes.

items.name: Nabisco Nilla Wafers (Original Vanilla)
items.whyItWorks: Crisp, airy vanilla cookies that soften immediately when dipped in tea, milk, or pudding. With 0g fiber and low fat, they are a hospital-diet staple that provides gentle comfort.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy plain or layer into vanilla pudding with sliced ripe bananas.
watchOuts: Contains wheat flour; zero fiber.

items.name: Nabisco Ritz Crackers (Original Flaky Butter)
items.whyItWorks: Famous for their delicate, flaky crumb that dissolves almost instantly on the tongue. Made of refined flour with minimal fiber (0.5g), making them completely gentle on inflamed bowel mucosa.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pair with a slice of mild deli turkey or eat plain when nausea strikes.
watchOuts: Contains vegetable shortening; chew slowly.

items.name: Plain Baked Russet Potato (Fluffy Flesh Only — Discard Skin!)
items.whyItWorks: The fluffy white interior of a baked Russet potato is one of the most biocompatible starches on earth for IBD patients. It delivers easily digestible complex carbs, potassium, and comfort with zero mechanical gut irritation.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake or microwave whole potato until soft to the touch. Slice open and scoop out ONLY the fluffy white interior. Completely discard the leathery, fibrous outer potato skin.
watchOuts: Crucial stricture safety rule: NEVER eat the baked potato skin! Potato skins are insoluble cellulose that cannot be digested.

items.name: Promix Unflavored Grass Fed Whey Isolate
items.whyItWorks: Contains just two ingredients: native cold-filtered grass-fed whey isolate and 0.75% sunflower lecithin for mixing. Completely devoid of gums, emulsifiers, artificial flavors, stevia, and lactose.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Shake 1 scoop with cool water or lactose-free milk in a blender bottle for 15 seconds.

items.name: Rice Dream Classic Original Rice Drink (Shelf Stable)
items.whyItWorks: One of the most hypoallergenic milk alternatives on the planet. Naturally sweet from partially milled brown rice, free from dairy, soy, nuts, and gluten, with very low fat and minimal residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pour cold over breakfast cereal or drink plain. The gold standard plant milk during acute flare recoveries.

items.name: Sam's Club (Logan & Riverdale, UT) Member's Mark Fresh Rotisserie Chicken
items.whyItWorks: Pure whole rotisserie-roasted chicken. The white breast meat is tender, moist, and free of tough fibers or seeds when the seasoned skin is removed.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Remove and discard seasoned outer skin; shred tender chicken breast over steamed white rice.
watchOuts: Discard seasoned skin during flares

items.name: Snyder's of Hanover Mini Salted Pretzels / Pretzel Sticks
items.whyItWorks: Hard-baked pretzels are naturally virtually fat-free and made from easily digested enriched flour. They satisfy the desire for salty crunch without the greasy vegetable oils of potato chips.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy a handful of mini pretzels or pretzel sticks between meals. Brush off excessive coarse salt crystals if you are on a restricted-sodium medication regimen (e.g., prednisone).
watchOuts: Brush off excess large salt grains if taking systemic steroids like Prednisone to avoid water retention.

items.name: Takara Sushi (Logan, UT) Grilled Yellowtail Collar (Hamachi Kama) & White Rice
items.whyItWorks: A chef's secret gem! Grilled Hamachi collar is extraordinarily tender, juicy, and packed with anti-inflammatory omega-3 fatty acids without any breading, dairy, or harsh spices.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Hamachi Kama grilled with sea salt, served with steamed white sticky rice (hold citrus ponzu sauce upon request).
watchOuts: None; pristine flare-safe Japanese seafood entree

items.name: Wendy's Plain Baked Potato (Flesh Only)
items.whyItWorks: A true road trip lifesaver for IBD patients across North America! A steaming hot, oven-baked Idaho russet potato served plain with zero butter, dairy, or bacon. The fluffy interior flesh is 100% gentle starch and potassium that calms inflamed bowels.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order "One Plain Baked Potato, nothing on it." Slit open the top, scoop out the soft white potato flesh with a fork, and DISCARD the fibrous outer skin entirely.

items.name: Bakery Angel Food Cake (Fat-Free White Sponge Cake)
items.whyItWorks: Unlike butter-laden standard cakes, traditional angel food cake is made strictly from whipped egg whites, refined sugar, and cake flour. It contains 0g of fat, melts upon chewing, and creates virtually zero digestive burden.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Cut a thick slice with a serrated knife. Top with smooth pureed applesauce, sliced ripe bananas, or a dollop of lactose-free whipped topping.
watchOuts: Contains egg whites and wheat flour; avoid if allergic to eggs or gluten.

items.name: BambooHR Café (Thomas2Go) Morning Rolled Oatmeal, Banana & Hard-Boiled Eggs
items.brandOrRestaurant: Thomas2Go / Thomas Cuisine Café at BambooHR (Lindon, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Warm kettle-cooked rolled oats topped with a sliced ripe banana and a touch of honey or brown sugar plus two peeled hard-boiled eggs from the Thomas2Go grab-and-go cooler give you steady soluble fiber and clean protein at the office.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Scoop plain hot oatmeal and top with sliced banana and honey/brown sugar—skip dried cranberries, raw walnuts/almonds, and chia/flax seeds.
watchOuts: If grabbing a Greek yogurt parfait from the cooler, take a lactase tablet and pick around any nut/seed granola

items.name: Canned Bartlett Pear Halves in 100% Juice or Water
items.whyItWorks: Canned pears have the abrasive skins and fibrous cores completely removed, and the heat-canning process breaks down hemicellulose into tender, easily digested fruit flesh. They are exceptionally low in acid and gentle on ulcerated intestines.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain the packing juice or water to reduce free liquid sugars. Eat pear halves with a spoon; they require virtually zero digestive mechanical effort.
watchOuts: Avoid canned pears packed in heavy corn syrup; opt for pear juice, light juice, or water pack.

items.name: Cooper's Restaurant (Fish Haven, ID) Pan-Seared Atlantic Salmon & Idaho Baked Potato
items.brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's Restaurant & Sports Bar (Fish Haven / Bear Lake West, ID)
items.whyItWorks: An elite flare-safe dinner overlooking Bear Lake. Fresh pan-seared Atlantic salmon is rich in anti-inflammatory omega-3 fatty acids, paired with smooth, easily digested Idaho baked potato flesh.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Pan-Seared Salmon with sea salt and olive oil, accompanied by an Idaho baked potato (eat the soft interior with butter, leave the tough potato skin uneaten).
watchOuts: Discard tough baked potato skin during flare periods

items.name: Creamy Mashed Potatoes (Peeled Russet or Yukon Gold)
items.whyItWorks: Boiling peeled potatoes and mashing them into a silky smooth consistency eliminates all physical chewing demands and provides soothing, easily absorbed calories. Highly recommended during flare recovery.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel potatoes thoroughly before boiling. Mash with chicken broth or lactose-free milk and a touch of butter or olive oil. Avoid skins, raw garlic, or heavy cream.
watchOuts: Ensure no skin fragments remain in the mash. If lactose intolerant, use lactose-free milk or broth.

items.name: DCA Aunt Cass Café / Boudin Bakery Warm San Francisco Sourdough Loaf or Bread Bowl Soup
items.brandOrRestaurant: Aunt Cass Café & Boudin Bread Cart (San Fransokyo Square · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: Baked fresh on-site inside DCA using Boudin's 1849 wild-yeast mother dough: strictly unbleached flour, water, salt, and long fermentation that pre-digests gluten and fructans (100% dairy-free, egg-free, nut-free, and oil-free!).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Buy a warm Baymax/Mickey Boudin Sourdough Loaf from the cart for flare-safe tearing all day, or order a Sourdough Bread Bowl at Aunt Cass Café with soup on the side (take lactase if choosing Clam Chowder or Mac & Cheese).
watchOuts: The sourdough bread itself is 9.5/10 flare-safe and dairy-free; Clam Chowder and Mac & Cheese fillings contain dairy and require lactase

items.name: Ensure Clear Mixed Berry Nutrition Drink
items.whyItWorks: A 100% fat-free, zero-fiber clear liquid nutritional supplement delivering 8g clean whey protein isolate and 180 calories. Leaves virtually zero digestive residue, making it ideal during acute flare bowel rest and clear liquid preparations.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Chill in refrigerator and drink over ice. (Verify with your endoscopy team if colored dyes like berry are permitted for your specific colonoscopy prep window).

items.name: Heinz Homestyle Savory Turkey Gravy (Low-Fat)
items.whyItWorks: Smooth turkey broth velouté with only 1g of fat per serving and zero fiber. Provides savory holiday roast flavor without heavy pan drippings or greasy butter.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Heat and pour over sliced roast turkey and white bread.
watchOuts: Gentle comfort food for sensitive recovery periods.

items.name: Herb-Roasted Sliced Turkey Breast with Steamed Rice
items.whyItWorks: Lean, freshly carved roasted turkey breast from the BambooHR hot entrees station is low in fat and free of lactose. Paired with fluffy steamed white rice, it forms an ideal workplace lunch during Crohn's management.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Request turkey breast without rich buttery gravy or skin, and ask for a side of steamed white rice or well-cooked squash.

items.name: Holiday Chilled Jumbo Boiled Shrimp Ring (No Lemon / Mild Dip Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Holiday Home Cooking & Costco Deli (Thanksgiving & Christmas)
items.whyItWorks: Poached jumbo tail-on shrimp is nearly 100% pure, lean protein with 0g fat and 0g fiber—making it the safest appetizer on any holiday buffet table as long as you skip the lemon wedges and fiery horseradish cocktail sauce.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the chilled poached shrimp plain, with a tiny dab of mild ketchup/mayo rose sauce, or melted butter—do NOT squeeze the included lemon wedges and skip the pungent horseradish cocktail sauce.
watchOuts: Discard the included lemon wedges (citrus trigger) and avoid heavy horseradish-chili cocktail sauce

items.name: Keebler Club Crackers (Original Light & Flaky)
items.whyItWorks: Even lighter and more tender than standard table crackers. Club crackers have a melt-in-the-mouth texture that minimizes any mechanical digestive demand.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drop into warm chicken noodle soup or eat plain during flare-up days.
watchOuts: Contains wheat gluten; completely low residue.

items.name: Kerrygold Pure Irish Salted Butter (Grass-Fed)
items.whyItWorks: Real creamery butter is virtually all butterfat (82%) with less than 0.1g lactose per tablespoon. Grass-fed butter provides natural butyrate and fat-soluble vitamins A, D, and K2, nourishing the colonic epithelium.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Spread onto warm sourdough toast or melt into mashed potatoes and white rice.
watchOuts: Contains trace dairy solids; use clarified ghee if severely allergic to dairy proteins.

items.name: Kirkland Signature Chilled Cooked Tail-On Shrimp Cocktail Platter
items.whyItWorks: Peeled, deveined, perfectly steamed tail-on shrimp ready to eat from the deli case. Shrimp is virtually fat-free, completely fiber-free, and delivers clean bioavailable marine protein that places zero strain on inflamed bowel segments.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the chilled shrimp plain or with a light pinch of salt. Avoid dipping into the included horseradish cocktail sauce during active symptoms.

items.name: Kirkland Signature Sliced Oven-Roasted Turkey Breast (3 x 14 oz)
items.whyItWorks: Whole-muscle turkey breast roasted and sliced thin without casing, dairy binders, or high fat fillers. It is gentle on the GI tract, offering fast protein for quick sandwich lunches.
