items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer slices onto plain sourdough or white bread. Pair with potato chips or applesauce.

items.name: Knott's Berry Market (California Marketplace) Take-Home Jar of Strained Seedless Boysenberry Jelly (Skip Preserves!)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Knott's Berry Market (California Marketplace · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: At the Knott's Berry Market gift shop, you can buy jars of **Knott's Seedless Boysenberry Jelly** (or Boysenberry Syrup)—which is 100% strained of all berry seeds so you can enjoy authentic boysenberry on sourdough toast and buttermilk biscuits at home with 0g fiber!
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Look closely at the jar label in Berry Market: buy **"Seedless Boysenberry Jelly"** or **"Boysenberry Syrup"**—do NOT buy regular "Boysenberry Preserves" (which is full of whole seeds).
watchOuts: Always check that the label says "Jelly" or "Seedless"—never "Preserves" with seeds

items.name: Lactaid 100% Lactose-Free Whole / 2% Milk
items.whyItWorks: Real farm-fresh dairy milk pre-treated with natural lactase enzymes that convert all lactose disaccharides into simple, easily absorbed glucose and galactose. Delivers 8g of complete protein, calcium, and vitamin D with zero lactose bloating or diarrhea.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drink cold, pour over cereal, or use 1:1 in any recipe calling for milk.
watchOuts: Contains real dairy milk protein (casein and whey); safe for lactose intolerance, but not for severe IgE milk allergies.

items.name: Mission Super Soft White Flour Tortillas (Taco Size)
items.whyItWorks: Pliable, tender, and made of refined bleached wheat flour. They wrap smoothly without cracking and contain only 1g fiber, providing a far safer taco/burrito wrap than abrasive fried corn shells.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm on a dry skillet for 15 seconds per side to make them extra soft and pliable. Fill with shredded chicken breast and mild cheese.
watchOuts: Far easier to digest during flares than crunchy hard taco shells.

items.name: Pirate's Booty Aged White Cheddar Baked Rice & Corn Puffs
items.whyItWorks: Baked from milled rice and corn flour without any hard hulls or kernels. The airy puffs melt in the mouth, delivering savory white cheddar flavor with zero abrasive fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat straight from the bag. A beloved staple for sensitive stomachs and school lunches.
watchOuts: Contains real cheese; virtually lactose-free in standard single-serving bags.

items.name: Rao's Homemade Sensitive Formula Marinara (No Onion, No Garlic)
items.whyItWorks: Crafted specifically for sensitive digestion: slow-simmered whole Italian peeled tomatoes, olive oil, basil, and sea salt with ABSOLUTELY NO ONION and NO GARLIC. The skins and seeds are strained out, leaving pure velvety tomato comfort.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm gently in a saucepan and ladle over white pasta, grilled chicken, or baked polenta.
watchOuts: Top recommendation for gut-safe Italian pasta meals.

items.name: San Gennaro Traditional Plain Polenta Roll (Pre-Cooked)
items.whyItWorks: Pre-cooked organic yellow cornmeal rolled into a firm cylinder. Slices smoothly into rounds that can be seared on a nonstick skillet. Zero kernels, zero hulls, 100% smooth digestible starch.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Slice into 1/2-inch rounds and pan-sear in a skillet with olive oil for 4 minutes per side until lightly golden. Top with sensitive marinara.

items.name: Schär Artisan Baker Gluten-Free White Bread
items.whyItWorks: Baked in Europe using a traditional gluten-free sourdough starter with fine rice and millet flours. Natural fermentation pre-digests starches, resulting in a tender, gut-friendly crumb that does not require toasting to stay soft.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ready to eat straight out of the packaging. Store leftover slices in an airtight bag.

items.name: Snyder's of Hanover Gluten-Free Pretzel Sticks
items.whyItWorks: Crafted from potato starch, tapioca starch, and cellulose gum, baked into crisp golden sticks with coarse salt. Certified gluten-free, dairy-free, and seedless. Digests smoothly and provides reliable sodium during dehydration.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat straight from the bag or dip into smooth peanut butter or mild cheddar dip.

items.name: Swedish Fish Original Red Chewy Candy
items.whyItWorks: Swedish Fish are made from sugar, invert sugar, corn syrup, and modified corn starch. They are 100% fat-free, gelatin-free, nut-free, and contain 0g fiber. Soft chew breaks down cleanly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Chew well. A great movie theater alternative to chocolate and popcorn.
watchOuts: Pure sugar; enjoy in moderation.

items.name: Thomas2Go @ BambooHR (Lindon, UT) Chef's Scratch Chicken Noodle Soup & Sourdough Roll
items.whyItWorks: Golden chicken bone broth simmered with tender shredded chicken, soft egg noodles, and cooked carrots. Hydrating, electrolyte-rich, and therapeutic for inflamed intestines.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ladle a bowl of chicken noodle soup at the hot soup bar; pair with a soft sourdough dinner roll.
watchOuts: None; ultimate work-day recovery lunch

items.name: TJ's Grill (Montpelier, ID) Grilled Chicken Breast Dinner & Idaho Baked Potato
searchKeywords: grilled chicken baked potato bear lake
items.whyItWorks: Clean, wholesome Idaho roadside dinner! Boneless skinless chicken breast grilled with light seasoning, served with a fluffy Idaho baked potato. Pure protein and potassium-rich soft starch.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Grilled Chicken Breast with a baked Idaho potato (eat the soft inside flesh with butter, skip tough potato skin).
watchOuts: Discard tough baked potato skin during flare periods

items.name: Traditional Medicinals Organic Peppermint Herbal Tea
items.whyItWorks: Rich in volatile menthol essential oils that act as natural calcium-channel blockers in gastrointestinal smooth muscle, rapidly easing painful colonic spasms and dispelling trapped abdominal gas.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Steep 1 bag covered for 10 minutes to capture the therapeutic volatile oils. Drink after meals.
watchOuts: Peppermint relaxes the lower esophageal sphincter; avoid if you suffer from severe GERD or active acid reflux.

items.name: Tsunami Restaurant & Sushi Bar (South Jordan / Lehi) Salmon Nigiri, Sunshine Roll & Chicken Udon Soup
items.brandOrRestaurant: Tsunami Restaurant & Sushi Bar (South Jordan / Lehi / Sugar House, UT)
items.whyItWorks: With locations in South Jordan (106th S / District area near Herriman) and Lehi (Traverse Mountain near BambooHR), Tsunami offers ultra-fresh Salmon Nigiri, steamed white rice with teriyaki salmon/chicken, and soothing dashi-broth Chicken Udon noodle soup.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Salmon Nigiri, a plain California or Salmon Avocado Roll, or Chicken/Tempura-Free Udon Soup—avoid rolls topped with thin lemon slices (like the Sunshine Roll unless you request "no lemon slices") or spicy jalapeno/sriracha sauces.
watchOuts: IMPORTANT: Tsunami's popular "Sunshine Roll" is topped with thin raw lemon slices (citrus trigger)—always order it with "NO lemon" or stick to Salmon Nigiri & Avocado Rolls

items.name: Vessel Kitchen (Sandy/Draper & Orem) "The Everyday" Roasted Chicken, Mashed Sweet Potatoes & Jasmine Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: Vessel Kitchen (Sandy/Draper, Midvale & Orem near BambooHR, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Located both near BambooHR (Orem) and near TownePlace Suites Draper (Sandy/9400 S), Vessel Kitchen builds scratch-made bowls with herb-roasted chicken breast, slow-braised beef, or roasted salmon paired with steamed jasmine rice, whipped sweet potato mash, and warm focaccia.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Build a Market Plate or Bowl with Roasted Chicken Breast (or Braised Beef / Salmon), steamed white jasmine rice, and whipped sweet potato mash—ask for dressings on the side (many contain lemon/citrus).
watchOuts: Ask for sauces/dressings on the side so you can skip citrus vinaigrettes and spicy chipotle crema

items.name: Vita Coco 100% Pure Coconut Water
items.whyItWorks: The clear liquid from young green coconuts is naturally packed with potassium, sodium, and magnesium—replenishing vital intracellular electrolytes lost to acute diarrhea. Contains 0g fiber and 0g fat.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drink chilled in 8-oz glasses between meals. Do not confuse with high-fat coconut milk or shredded coconut meat.
watchOuts: Drink slowly; drinking large volumes quickly can have a mild laxative effect due to natural potassium.

items.name: Anaheim Harbor Blvd (Across from Disneyland Main Entrance) Panera Bread Chicken Noodle Soup, Sourdough & IHOP Pancakes/Eggs
items.brandOrRestaurant: Panera Bread & IHOP (S. Harbor Blvd · Directly Across from Disneyland Esplanade)
items.whyItWorks: Literally a 3-minute walk across the Harbor Blvd crosswalk from the Disneyland & DCA turnstiles, Panera Bread (Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup, Sourdough Bread Bowl, Turkey Sandwich) and IHOP (Scrambled Eggs & Pancakes) give you a 24/7 flare-safe safety net on arrival or late at night.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stop at Panera on Harbor Blvd for a bowl of Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup with Country Sourdough bread or a Deli Turkey Sandwich on Sourdough to bring right into the parks (Disneyland allows outside food!).
watchOuts: Avoid Panera's Charged Lemonades/Citrus Refreshers and broccoli cheddar soup (unless taking lactase)

items.name: Angie's Restaurant (Logan, UT) Open-Face Roast Turkey Sandwich & Mashed Potatoes
items.whyItWorks: One of the most restorative comfort meals in Logan! Lean roast turkey breast, soft bread, smooth mashed potatoes, and mild gravy require minimal digestive effort.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Hot Turkey Sandwich with mashed potatoes and gravy; request no cranberry sauce if avoiding fruit seeds.
watchOuts: None; premier flare-safe comfort dinner

items.name: BambooHR Café (Thomas2Go) Daily Hot Entrée Station: Baked Salmon or Herb Chicken with Steamed Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: Thomas2Go / Thomas Cuisine Café at BambooHR (Lindon, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Thomas Cuisine's hot line at BambooHR focuses on scratch-made whole proteins; asking the server for just the plain roasted chicken breast or baked salmon fillet with steamed white rice or roasted potatoes (skipping the composed sauce) gives you a clean 9+/10 workday lunch.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: At the Thomas2Go hot entrée counter, ask for the plain grilled/roasted protein (chicken, turkey, or salmon) with steamed rice or mashed/roasted potatoes and cooked carrots—ask to hold any citrus glaze, chimichurri, or spicy crema.
watchOuts: Check the placard at the station for lemon-herb or garlic-cream sauces and ask for an un-sauced piece from the pan

items.name: Boost Breeze Fruit Nutritional Drink (Orange/Peach/Wild Berry)
items.whyItWorks: Fruit-flavored clear liquid medical beverage offering 250 calories and 9g high-quality whey protein isolate per 8 fl oz carton. Fat-free, cholesterol-free, and fiber-free for frictionless bowel transit.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Best served very cold over ice or frozen into digestive-safe popsicles for sore mouth or flare hydration.

items.name: Canyon Bakehouse Heritage Style White Bread (Gluten-Free)
items.whyItWorks: Certified gluten-free white bread baked with fine tapioca and brown rice flours into full, sandwich-sized slices. Free from dairy, soy, nuts, and sesame seeds, with only 1g fiber per slice. Gentle and pliable when toasted or fresh.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Lightly toast to enhance texture and aroma. Excellent for deli turkey sandwiches or light buttered toast.

items.name: DCA Carthay Circle Restaurant Sustainable Fish or Filet Mignon & Warm Cheddar Parker House Rolls
items.brandOrRestaurant: Carthay Circle Restaurant (Buena Vista Street · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: As DCA's signature fine-dining kitchen, the chefs at Carthay Circle will prepare any sustainable fish fillet, chicken breast, or beef tenderloin completely plain with olive oil and potato puree—plus their famous Warm Cheddar Parker House Rolls.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Tell your server about your citrus and spice guardrails: request the Sustainable Fish or Filet Mignon prepared simply with olive oil, salt, and potato puree, and ask for the Warm Cheddar Parker House Rolls without the spicy calabrian chili/apricot butter.
watchOuts: Eat the warm Parker House Rolls plain without the spicy chili butter spread

items.name: Del Monte Canned Cut Green Beans (Ultra-Soft)
items.whyItWorks: Commercial canning pressure-cooks green beans until completely soft, breaking down the tough outer pod fibers into a tender, easily masticated side. Very low residue and well-tolerated on low-FODMAP and low-residue diets.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm on stovetop in their liquid, then drain. Season with a pinch of salt and a dab of butter or olive oil.
watchOuts: Look for no-salt-added varieties if monitoring blood pressure on corticosteroid therapy.

items.name: Disney's Grand Californian Storytellers Cafe Carved Turkey, Prime Rib, Salmon, Rice & Mickey Waffles
items.brandOrRestaurant: Storytellers Cafe (Disney's Grand Californian Hotel & Spa · Disneyland Resort)
items.whyItWorks: With its private entrance right into Disney California Adventure, Storytellers Cafe's carving station and made-to-order omelet bar let you eat clean carved turkey breast, prime rib (trim outer fat), baked salmon, mashed potatoes, white rice, scrambled eggs, and allergy-friendly Mickey waffles.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Head to the carving station for lean roasted turkey or center-cut prime rib with mashed potatoes and cooked carrots, or ask your server for freshly made dairy-free/gluten-free Mickey waffles and a plain ham & cheddar omelet.
watchOuts: Skip creamy horseradish sauce, raw salad bar veggies, and seeded berry desserts

items.name: Disneyland Bengal Barbecue Chieftain Chicken Skewer (Polynesian Teriyaki)
items.whyItWorks: Lean cubed chicken breast flame-grilled to order in a mild, sweet Polynesian teriyaki glaze with zero dairy, zero breading, and zero insoluble fiber—one of the highest-protein, gentlest snacks in all of Disneyland.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mobile-order the Chieftain Chicken Skewer (Polynesian teriyaki) and pair with a side of steamed white rice (Spring Roll Plate rice side) or a plain Tiger Tail breadstick.
watchOuts: Do not confuse with the spicy Banyan Beef Skewer—always choose Chieftain Chicken or sweet Bengal Beef

items.name: Fody Foods Low-FODMAP Classic BBQ Sauce (Sweet & Smoky)
items.whyItWorks: Formulated without onion or garlic fructans. Sweetened with cane sugar and organic blackstrap molasses with natural smoke flavor. Delivers authentic pit BBQ flavor without gastrointestinal colic.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Brush onto grilled chicken breast, pulled pork, or ground turkey crumbles.
watchOuts: Gentle and non-bloating; safe for active disease and recovery.

items.name: Harmons Neighborhood Grocer (Draper / Daybreak / Bangerter) Kitchen Rotisserie Chicken, Sushi & Soup Bar
items.brandOrRestaurant: Harmons Neighborhood Grocer (Draper / South Jordan / Daybreak, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Minutes from both TownePlace Suites Draper (Bangerter Crossing) and Holiday Inn Express Herriman/South Jordan (Daybreak/District), Harmons has a scratch kitchen offering hot Chicken Noodle Soup, plain Rotisserie Chicken, fresh-made California/Salmon sushi rolls, and authentic long-fermented Artisan Sourdough bread.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab a cup of hot Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup, a fresh Salmon Avocado Roll or Rotisserie Chicken breast, and a loaf of Harmons Artisan Sourdough bread to keep in your hotel room toaster.
watchOuts: Avoid spicy chili, broccoli cheddar soup (unless taking lactase), and seeded multigrain breads

items.name: Holiday Leftover Roasted Turkey, Jellied Cranberry & Sourdough Sandwich ("The Moist Maker")
items.whyItWorks: Sliced leftover turkey breast, a thin ribbon of seedless jellied cranberry sauce, and soft white-bread stuffing on toasted sourdough is a top-tier day-after-Thanksgiving meal with minimal fat and zero roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer sliced white-meat turkey breast, smooth canned jellied cranberry sauce (not whole-berry orange relish), and a spoonful of plain herb stuffing or light mayo between lightly toasted sourdough slices.
watchOuts: Use canned seedless jellied cranberry sauce only—never use homemade orange-zest whole-berry cranberry relish (citrus + skin triggers)

items.name: Kellogg's Corn Flakes Original Cereal
items.whyItWorks: Milled from degermed corn grit (which completely strips away the dangerous indigestible outer corn hull). The paper-thin toasted flakes soften within seconds of touching liquid, leaving no roughage behind.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pour cold lactose-free milk over the flakes and let them soak for 30 seconds for a gentle, easy-to-swallow breakfast.
watchOuts: Completely hull-free; safe for strictures unlike whole sweet corn.

items.name: Liquid I.V. Hydration Multiplier (Lemon Lime)
items.whyItWorks: Engineered on the World Health Organization (WHO) Oral Rehydration Solution guidelines, using Cellular Transport Technology (CTT). The precise 2:1 ratio of glucose to sodium activates the SGLT1 transporter in the small bowel, pulling water into the bloodstream without demanding digestive exertion.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mix 1 packet into exactly 16 oz of cool water. Do not over-dilute or concentrate, as precise osmolarity maximizes rapid intestinal absorption.

items.name: Member's Mark Steamed Tail-On Shrimp Cocktail Tray
items.whyItWorks: Fresh steamed tail-on shrimp ready to eat cold. It delivers clean lean protein with zero saturated fat, zero gluten, and zero insoluble fiber, resting the lower digestive tract completely.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the chilled shrimp plain or with a light squeeze of lemon. Skip the included spicy cocktail sauce during active gut symptoms.

items.name: Mrs. Knott's Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup & Warm Buttermilk Biscuits with Seedless Boysenberry Jelly
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (California Marketplace · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Mrs. Knott's scratch-made chicken broth with tender egg noodles and shredded chicken paired with hot buttermilk biscuits and **strained seedless Boysenberry Jelly** (not whole-berry jam) is soothing and free of berry seeds.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Bowl of Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup with an order of Warm Buttermilk Biscuits (also sold at the Chicken-To-Go counter next door) and use only the smooth, seedless Boysenberry Jelly.
watchOuts: Use smooth Boysenberry Jelly (strained juice + pectin) rather than whole-berry Boysenberry Preserves (which contain gritty seeds)

items.name: NOW Sports Pure Egg White Protein Powder (Unflavored)
items.whyItWorks: 100% pure pasteurized egg white powder with zero added flavors, sweeteners, or dairy. Provides 16g of complete, easily absorbed protein that is completely dairy-free and low-FODMAP.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Blend with a banana, splash of pure maple syrup, and water or rice milk for a gentle smoothie.

items.name: Oscar Mayer Deli Fresh Oven Roasted Turkey Breast Slices
items.whyItWorks: Thinly shaved, skinless, lean turkey breast slices. It requires virtually zero chewing effort, delivers 10g protein per 2-oz serving with under 1g fat, and has no roughage or spicy pepper coatings.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Roll slices up for a quick protein snack, or layer between white bread with mild cheddar.
watchOuts: Contains added sodium for preservation; drink water alongside deli meats.

items.name: Peeled & Steamed Zucchini (Courgette)
items.whyItWorks: Once the dark green outer peel is shaved off, the pale tender interior of zucchini is over 94% water with soft, immature seeds that melt during cooking. It produces virtually zero digestive residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Use a vegetable peeler to peel off all green skin. Slice into rounds and steam or simmer in broth for 8–10 minutes until translucent and fork-soft.
watchOuts: Always peel the outer green skin during flares, as raw unpeeled zucchini skin is tough insoluble fiber.

items.name: Pepperidge Farm Goldfish Original / Cheddar Crackers
items.whyItWorks: Small, bite-sized baked wheat crackers with a tender, hollow structure that breaks down rapidly in saliva. Low in fat and fiber, providing gentle carbs and sodium.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: A great pocket snack during long drives, flare days, or errands when blood sugar drops.
watchOuts: Chew small handfuls thoroughly before swallowing.

items.name: PopCorners Sea Salt Popped Corn Crisps
items.whyItWorks: The ultimate movie-night popcorn replacement! Made with non-GMO yellow corn, sunflower oil, and sea salt, air-popped under heat and pressure into crispy triangular crisps. Contains ZERO sharp hulls, ZERO unpopped kernels, and melts smoothly under saliva.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat straight from the bag during movie night or travel. Satisfies the crunchy popcorn craving without the risk of emergency bowel obstruction.

items.name: Primal Kitchen Avocado Oil Mayo (Clean Egg & Avocado Emulsion)
items.whyItWorks: Uses 100% pure avocado oil (rich in anti-inflammatory monounsaturated oleic acid) rather than refined soybean or canola oil. Contains organic cage-free eggs, vinegar, and salt without added sugars or artificial gums.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: An ideal anti-inflammatory mayonnaise for salads, canned salmon, and wraps.
watchOuts: Rich in healthy fats; consume in standard 1-tablespoon servings.

items.name: Silk Unsweetened Plain Almond Milk (Ultra-Filtered)
items.whyItWorks: Finely ground blanched almonds filtered through micro-mesh, removing all solid particles and hulls. It is 100% dairy-free, lactose-free, low-calorie, and fortified with 50% more calcium than dairy milk without any digestive friction.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Shake carton well before pouring. Excellent base for smoothies or morning cereal.
watchOuts: Low in protein (1g per cup); combine with eggs or poultry if seeking protein density.

items.name: Snack Factory Pretzel Crisps Original (Flat Pretzels)
items.whyItWorks: Flat, thin, and lightly toasted without the dense interior dough of thick pretzels. They break down effortlessly in the mouth with very little chewing effort and deliver light sodium for electrolyte support.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy straight from the bag or dip into smooth cream cheese, mild hummus (if tolerated), or creamy peanut butter.
watchOuts: Avoid garlic-parmesan or spicy buffalo varieties during sensitive digestive periods.

items.name: The Break Sports Grill (Daybreak / South Jordan, UT) Grilled Atlantic Salmon & Steamed Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: The Break Sports Grill (Daybreak / South Jordan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Fresh Atlantic salmon fillet seasoned lightly with olive oil and sea salt, served with steamed white rice and tender carrots. Packed with anti-inflammatory omega-3 fatty acids.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Grilled Salmon with steamed rice and steamed carrots (hold spicy citrus glazes).
watchOuts: None; premier flare-safe dinner

items.name: Thomas' Original Plain English Muffins (Fork-Split)
items.whyItWorks: A light, yeast-leavened flat bread with 'nooks and crannies' made from refined white flour. When toasted, it becomes pleasantly crisp on the edges while remaining tender inside, absorbing butter with minimal fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Split open gently with a fork and toast until golden. Spread with butter or seedless strawberry jelly.
watchOuts: Avoid whole wheat or multigrain English muffin varieties.

items.name: Thomas2Go @ BambooHR (Lindon, UT) Scratch Scrambled Egg & Turkey Sausage Breakfast Bowl
items.whyItWorks: Thomas Cuisine's real-food scratch kitchen standard! Fresh cage-free scrambled eggs, lean turkey sausage crumbles, and well-steamed diced potatoes with light cheddar. Soft, zero-roughage corporate fuel.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Morning Scramble Bowl with scrambled eggs, turkey sausage, and breakfast potatoes (hold salsa and jalapeños).
watchOuts: None; premier corporate office breakfast

items.name: Trader Joe's Mini Silver Dollar Pancakes (Frozen 36-Pack)
items.whyItWorks: Tiny, bite-sized fluffy pancakes made from refined flour, buttermilk, and sugar. They heat in 60 seconds and dissolve into tender, easily digested carbs. Low in fiber (under 1g).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Microwave 6 mini pancakes for 45 seconds or toast lightly. Drizzle with pure maple syrup.
watchOuts: Refined white flour pancake; gentle comfort food for morning nausea.

items.name: Twizzlers Strawberry Licorice Twists
items.whyItWorks: Twizzlers are formulated from enriched wheat flour, corn syrup, and sugar with less than 0.5g fat and 0g fiber. They provide satisfying chewy sweetness without chocolate, seeds, dairy, or nuts.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pull twists apart and chew thoroughly. A reliable cinema or road trip sweet for IBD patients.
watchOuts: Contains wheat flour; not suitable for individuals with celiac disease.

items.name: Werther's Original Caramel Hard Candies
items.whyItWorks: Crafted with real cream and butter into a smooth, glass-like hard candy. Dissolves entirely into sweet liquid without chewing or digestive residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Savor one piece slowly for comforting caramel flavor without nuts or chocolate.
watchOuts: Choose original hard candies, not sugar-free polyol varieties!

items.name: "All Hands on Deck" Room Service Cheese & Cracker Platter
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · 24-Hour Room Service
items.whyItWorks: Famous complimentary 24-hour room service staple: aged cheddar, Swiss, Gouda/Babybel (~0g lactose) with plain water/Ritz-style crackers for zero-effort stateroom calories.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Dial Room Service any time day or night and order "All Hands on Deck" (ask for extra plain crackers). Eat the aged hard/semi-soft cheeses and crackers; skip the red grape skins or blue cheese wedge if flaring.
watchOuts: Whole grape skins on the platter
Blue cheese wedge if sensitive to mold/soft cheeses

items.name: 1923 Filet Mignon (Request No Peppercorn Crust)
items.whyItWorks: Center-cut beef filet mignon is the most tender, low-residue steak on the ship once you ask the kitchen to hold the cracked peppercorn crust.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for the Filet Mignon cooked medium-rare to medium WITHOUT the cracked black/pink peppercorn crust and without the café au lait (coffee) butter. Pair with peeled mashed potatoes or the soft Yukon potato fondant from the chicken dish.
watchOuts: Coarse cracked peppercorn crust
Café au lait butter (contains coffee)
Fingerling potato skins and whole green beans

items.name: 24-Hour Room Service Roasted Turkey Breast Sandwich
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · 24-Hour Stateroom Dining
items.whyItWorks: Lean sliced roasted turkey breast on plain white or sourdough bread is ultra-low-fat, dairy-free, citrus-free, and easy to pack for port excursions.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the Roasted Turkey Sandwich on plain white bread (no seeds), dry or with mayo on the side, and remove any raw lettuce or tomato slices.
watchOuts: Verify bread is unseeded white/sourdough
Remove raw lettuce and tomato slices

items.name: Angie's Restaurant (Logan) Grilled Turkey Steak or Roast Turkey Dinner with Mashed Potatoes
items.whyItWorks: A classic Cache Valley diner staple: tender grilled turkey steak or carved roast turkey with whipped mashed potatoes, dinner roll, and chicken noodle soup.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Steak or Roast Turkey Dinner with mashed potatoes (gravy on the side), a baked dinner roll with honey butter, and a cup of Chicken Noodle Soup instead of tossed salad.
watchOuts: Choose Chicken Noodle Soup over the raw iceberg dinner salad

items.name: Anna's Honey-Mustard-Marinated Wild Salmon with New Potatoes (Wonder Alaska)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Freezing the Night Away Menu (Alaska Sailings)
items.whyItWorks: Baked omega-3 salmon glazed with mild honey-mustard and paired with tender boiled new potatoes is a flagship Alaska-sailing flare meal.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order with the aquavit sour cream sauce on the side and skip the sautéed spinach stems if flaring.
watchOuts: Sour cream sauce (order on side)
Sautéed spinach stems

items.name: BambooHR Thomas2Go Café: Clean-Ingredient Grilled Chicken or Salmon & White Rice / Potato Bowl
items.brandOrRestaurant: Thomas2Go / Thomas Cuisine Café at BambooHR (Lindon / Draper, UT)
items.whyItWorks: At the Thomas2Go hot entrée/bowl station, you can build a clean protein plate with herb-grilled chicken breast or salmon over steamed white rice or roasted potatoes with cooked carrots/squash.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the chef at the hot line for plain grilled chicken or salmon over white rice or mashed/roasted potatoes—skipping fibrous quinoa/wheat-berry bases and raw chimichurri/citrus dressings.
watchOuts: Sub white rice or potatoes in place of quinoa, farro, or wheat berries
Confirm sauces are citrus-free and chili-free

items.name: BambooHR Thomas2Go Café: Scratch Chicken Noodle, Potato, or Curried Pumpkin Soup
items.brandOrRestaurant: Thomas2Go / Thomas Cuisine Café at BambooHR (Lindon / Draper, UT)
searchKeywords: thomas cuisine thai curried pumpkin soup
items.whyItWorks: Thomas Cuisine makes scratch bone-broth soups daily—their homestyle Chicken Noodle/Rice and smooth puréed Butternut/Pumpkin soups are gentle office-day staples.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Check the daily soup Kettle for Chicken Noodle, Chicken & Rice, Potato Soup, or smooth Pumpkin/Butternut Squash Soup (and skip high-fiber Lentil Dal or Black Bean soup days).
watchOuts: Skip lentil dal, minestrone, or spicy tortilla soup rotations during a flare

items.name: BambooHR Thomas2Go Café: Scratch Roasted Turkey, Havarti/Cheddar & Avocado Sandwich or Panini
items.brandOrRestaurant: Thomas2Go / Thomas Cuisine Café at BambooHR (Lindon / Draper, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Thomas Cuisine's "REAL Food" corporate café standard uses clean-label roasted turkey breast (no nitrates/carrageenan), aged cheese, and fresh avocado on unseeded sourdough or ciabatta.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a made-to-order or grab-and-go Turkey, Avocado & Cheddar/Havarti sandwich or panini on sourdough or flour wrap—holding raw red onions, tomatoes, and spicy aioli.
watchOuts: Choose unseeded sourdough or white wrap over multigrain wheat berry bread
Hold raw onions and spicy chipotle spreads

items.name: BambooHR Thomas2Go Micro-Kitchen & Smart Cooler: Hard-Boiled Eggs, String Cheese, Yogurt & Pretzels
items.brandOrRestaurant: Thomas2Go / Thomas Cuisine Micro-Kitchen at BambooHR (Lindon / Draper, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Safe office micro-kitchen staples when you need a quick snack between meetings: peeled 2-pack hard-boiled eggs, aged cheddar/mozzarella string cheese, ripe bananas, pretzels, and Greek yogurt.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab peeled hard-boiled eggs, string cheese, a banana, or plain pretzels from the cooler; if eating a yogurt parfait, eat the yogurt and leave the nutty/seeded granola layer behind.
watchOuts: Skip the raw crudité veggie cups, trail mix, and seeded granola layers

items.name: Bear Trapper Fresh Broiled Idaho Trout & Baked Potato
items.brandOrRestaurant: Bear Trapper Steakhouse (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Fresh broiled Idaho rainbow trout is flaky, lean, and rich in anti-inflammatory omega-3s; paired with the soft interior of a baked Idaho potato and plain dinner roll, it is one of the safest sit-down dinners in Garden City.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Fresh Idaho Trout broiled (not breaded or fried) with no lemon wedge, paired with a plain baked potato (eat the fluffy interior, leave the skin) and skip the house salad.
watchOuts: Ask for no lemon garnish (citrus trigger)
Leave the thick baked potato skin and skip the raw dinner salad

items.name: Benihana (Mountain View Village · Herriman/Riverton) Teppanyaki Hibachi Chicken, Filet Mignon & Steamed Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: Benihana (Mountain View Village · Riverton / Herriman / South Jordan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Because the Benihana chef cooks your meal right in front of you on the flat-top grill, you can ask for your Hibachi Chicken, Filet Mignon, or Salmon cooked in plain oil with soy sauce and paired with steamed white rice and clear onion/mushroom broth.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the teppanyaki chef to cook your Filet Mignon, Chicken, or Shrimp with oil and soy sauce only (no garlic butter and no lemon squeeze), enjoy the clear Benihana soup broth and steamed white rice, and skip the raw salad.
watchOuts: Ask the chef for no lemon squeeze and no garlic butter on your portion

items.name: Biscoff Cookie Butter on Ritz Crackers
items.whyItWorks: Smooth Biscoff spread has the thick, rich mouthfeel of peanut butter with a spiced cinnamon-graham flavor and zero nut fragments. Ritz crackers turn to soft paste almost instantly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Spread smooth Biscoff (never crunchy) between two Ritz crackers for quick, high-calorie energy.

items.name: Black Truffle Pasta Purseittes
items.whyItWorks: Signature Disney Cruise Line delicacy: delicate, ultra-thin white pasta purses filled with smooth truffle cheese in a light champagne cream sauce — zero fibrous skins or chunks.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order as your starter (or ask for an entrée-sized double portion!) at Animator's Palate. Take a Lactaid enzyme if sensitive to cheese/cream.
watchOuts: Dairy cheese filling and cream sauce if lactose sensitive

items.name: Broulim's Fresh Foods (Montpelier, ID) Hot Deli Rotisserie Chicken, Mashed Potatoes & Rolls
items.brandOrRestaurant: Broulim's Fresh Foods Deli & Bakery (Montpelier, ID)
items.whyItWorks: The #1 flare-safe rescue on the Idaho side of Bear Lake: hot roasted chicken breast and scratch-baked soft white dinner rolls from the Montpelier Broulim's deli.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick up a hot rotisserie chicken (eat the skinless breast meat), a bag of famous Broulim's soft white bakery rolls, and bananas/broth for the cabin.
watchOuts: Remove seasoned chicken skin if flaring
Skip fried potato wedges ("JoJos") in favor of mashed potatoes or rolls

items.name: Buffet Fresh Cut Melon, Ripe Bananas & Mango vs. Bircher Muesli
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
items.whyItWorks: Fresh-cut cantaloupe, honeydew, seedless watermelon, and ripe bananas hydrate and supply potassium with almost zero insoluble roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Fill your fruit bowl with cantaloupe, honeydew, watermelon, and whole bananas. Strictly skip the grapefruit trays, orange segments, fibrous pineapple, and raw apple/nut Bircher muesli.
watchOuts: Grapefruit and orange trays next to the melon bar (strict avoid)
Raw grated apple skins and nuts in Bircher Muesli

items.name: Cabanas & Marceline Market Classic Golden Mickey Mouse Waffles (Standalone)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
items.whyItWorks: Light, airy refined-flour Mickey Mouse waffles with zero seeds or roughage—an iconic, easily digested DCL morning staple.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy warm with a light drizzle of maple syrup or honey and scrambled eggs; skip the seeded strawberry/berry compote vat next to the waffle station.
watchOuts: Skip the strawberry compote topping (seeds)
Take a Lactaid if sensitive to milk in batter

items.name: Canned Yellow Cling Peaches in 100% Juice or Water
items.whyItWorks: Peeled and steam-softened canned peaches provide smooth hydration, vitamin C, and gentle soluble fiber without the harsh fuzzy skin that causes mechanical irritation in Crohn's and Colitis.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain excess packing liquid and eat the soft peach slices. Excellent paired with plain white rice, oatmeal, or plain lactose-free yogurt.
watchOuts: Always verify that skins have been completely removed during processing.

items.name: Captain's Gala Oven-Baked Lobster Tail
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure, Wonder & Magic · 1923 / Rotational Dining (Captain's Gala)
items.whyItWorks: Warm baked lobster tail dipped in drawn butter (virtually ~0g lactose) is pure, zero-fiber marine protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Your server will happily remove the lobster tail from the shell for you. Ask for plain mashed potatoes or white rice instead of the sun-dried tomato lemon-pesto mash, and eat only the tender tips of the asparagus.
watchOuts: Sun-dried tomato & lemon-pesto in the default mash (citrus + tomato skins)
Woody bottom stems of asparagus

items.name: Char Siu Bao (Steamed BBQ Pork Buns) or Har Gow
items.whyItWorks: Fluffy steamed white flour buns and translucent tapioca/wheat starch dumpling wrappers digest easily with zero fried grease.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose steamed buns and steamed dumplings over pan-fried potstickers during flares.

items.name: Cheese or Meat Ravioli with Brown Butter
items.whyItWorks: Refrigerated fresh pasta uses finely milled white flour and smooth filling that digests rapidly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil refrigerated cheese, chicken, or beef ravioli for 4 minutes. Toss in melted browned butter, salt, and grated parmesan (skip acidic tomato marinara during flares).

items.name: Chicken or Salmon Teriyaki Rice Bowl
items.whyItWorks: Skinless grilled chicken thigh or salmon glazed in sweet soy-mirin reduction over steamed white rice digests cleanly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order white rice only and skip the side cabbage salad, sesame seeds, and fibrous broccoli stalks.

items.name: Christmas Roasted Beef Tenderloin (Chateaubriand) — Center-Cut Filet
items.whyItWorks: Beef tenderloin (filet mignon) is the leanest, most tender muscle on the cow, free of the heavy intramuscular fat seams and gristle found in standing rib roast (prime rib).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Roast with olive oil, kosher salt, and fresh rosemary/thyme sprigs (skip coarse cracked black peppercorn crusts and creamy horseradish sauce) and slice thin alongside whipped potatoes.
watchOuts: Avoid coarse peppercorn-crusted outer edges and pungent creamy horseradish sauce

items.name: Complimentary Hot Scrambled Eggs & White Toast with Jelly
items.whyItWorks: Standard hotel breakfast steam-table scrambled eggs (prepared without whole milk or cream) alongside a couple of lightly toasted white bread slices with seedless grape jelly provide easily digestible, safe protein and gentle fuel on the road.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Take freshly replenished scrambled eggs from the buffet. Toast white bread, add a dab of butter or seedless jelly, and bypass spicy sausage links, bacon, and breakfast burritos.

items.name: Cooper's Restaurant (Fish Haven, ID) Bear Lake West Classic Two-Egg Breakfast
items.brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's Restaurant & Sports Bar (Fish Haven / Bear Lake West, ID)
items.whyItWorks: A tranquil golf-course morning overlooking Bear Lake with pure, bioavailable protein. Soft scrambled or poached eggs and shredded potato hash browns are zero-roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order two scrambled eggs, lean ham or bacon, well-cooked hash browns, and white or sourdough toast with butter.
watchOuts: None; gentle low-residue breakfast

items.name: Costco Kirkland Signature Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup (Deli Tub)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Costco Fresh Deli (North Logan, Draper, South Jordan & Nationwide)
groceryIngredients: Kirkland Signature Chicken Noodle Soup (Deli Refrigerator Tub)
items.whyItWorks: Loaded with big chunks of Kirkland rotisserie chicken breast, soft egg noodles, and tender cooked carrots in savory chicken broth—a 9/10 flare-safe refrigerator staple.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm gently in a saucepan on the stove (no microwave needed) and pair with sourdough toast or saltines.
watchOuts: Contains soft cooked celery pieces; easily picked around if ultra-sensitive

items.name: Crispy Toaster-Oven Chicken or Beef Flautas (Flour Tortilla)
items.whyItWorks: Rolling finely shredded chicken or ground beef inside a soft white flour tortilla and baking it gives a loud crunch without sharp corn chip hulls.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Roll shredded rotisserie chicken (skin removed) and Monterey Jack inside a white flour tortilla, brush lightly with oil or butter, and bake in the toaster oven at 375F for 7-8 minutes. Dip in lactose-free sour cream or smooth avocado mash.

items.name: Crumb Brothers Bakery (Logan) Long-Fermented Sourdough Loaf, Turkey Sandwich & Soup
items.brandOrRestaurant: Crumb Brothers Artisan Bread & Cafe (Logan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Crumb Brothers is famous across Utah for true slow-fermented artisan country white sourdough, where wild yeast fermentation pre-digests gluten and fructans for effortless Crohn's digestion.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick up a sliced Country White Sourdough loaf or butter croissants for home/cabin toast, or order a hot Turkey & Cheese sandwich on white sourdough (skip seeded multi-grain loaves).
watchOuts: Choose unseeded Country White Sourdough or French Baguette over seeded whole-grain loaves

items.name: Daisy's De-Lites Deli Panini, Soup & Fresh Melon
items.whyItWorks: Daisy's De-Lites serves warm pressed deli paninis, rotating smooth soups, and freshly cut cantaloupe, honeydew, and watermelon (>90% hydrating water, ~0g insoluble fiber).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab a bowl of ripe cantaloupe, honeydew, and banana slices, plus a turkey/ham and Swiss/cheddar panini or wrap (pull out any leafy greens or tomato slices). Skip the quinoa/raw kale grain bowls and seeded berries during flares.
watchOuts: Quinoa, raw kale, and chickpea salad bowls
Pineapple acidity and berry seeds at the fruit bar

items.name: DCA Boudin Bakery Fresh San Fransokyo Sourdough Bread Loaf (Baymax Shape)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Aunt Cass Café / Boudin Bakery (Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: Scratch-baked sourdough made with the original 1849 San Francisco mother dough. Long natural wild yeast fermentation digests wheat fructans, making this one of the most gut-friendly carbs in the resort.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick up a fresh warm sourdough loaf (Mickey or Baymax shape); tear pieces to eat plain or with butter.
watchOuts: None; premier flare-safe theme park carbohydrate

items.name: DCA Carthay Circle Lounge — Alfresco Dining: Kids' Teriyaki Salmon/Chicken & Rice or Artisanal Cheese Board
items.brandOrRestaurant: Carthay Circle Lounge — Alfresco Dining (Buena Vista Street · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: Carthay Circle Lounge (easier walk-up waitlist than the main dining room!) has a Kids' Orecchiette Pasta or Grilled Salmon/Chicken Breast with steamed white rice that any guest can order.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Join the walk-up list in the Disneyland App and order the Grilled Salmon or Chicken Breast with steamed white rice (or plain butter/Parmesan pasta), or graze on the aged hard cheeses and crackers from the Artisanal Cheese Board.
watchOuts: Skip whole nuts, olives, and spicy harissa/chili appetizers on the lounge menu

items.name: DCA Fiddler, Fifer & Practical Cafe (Buena Vista Street) Turkey Sandwich, Egg Bites, Oatmeal & Cinnamon Roll
items.brandOrRestaurant: Fiddler, Fifer & Practical Cafe (Buena Vista Street · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: DCA's Buena Vista Street café serves Starbucks Sous-Vide Bacon & Gruyère Egg Bites, Classic Rolled Oatmeal, Butter Croissants, Bananas, and deli Turkey/Ham sandwiches.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab Bacon & Gruyère Egg Bites (naturally lactose-safe aged Gruyère), plain Oatmeal (no nut packet), or a Butter Croissant.
watchOuts: Discard the mixed-nut packet from the oatmeal and avoid citrus refreshers

items.name: DCA Lucky Fortune Cookery Teriyaki Chicken & Steamed White Rice Bowl
items.brandOrRestaurant: Lucky Fortune Cookery (San Fransokyo Square · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: Grilled chicken thigh/breast glazed in sweet soy teriyaki over a generous bed of steamed white jasmine rice with soft cooked carrots is 100% dairy-free, non-fried, and one of DCA's safest hot meals.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mobile-order the Teriyaki Chicken (adult or kids' portion) with steamed white rice and push aside any fibrous snap peas or cabbage.
watchOuts: Skip the Karaage-inspired crispy fried chicken sandwich (spicy slaw) and spicy Birria ramen when flaring

items.name: DCA Wine Country Trattoria Pan-Seared Salmon, New York Steak & Mashed Potatoes or Plain Pasta
items.brandOrRestaurant: Wine Country Trattoria (Performance Corridor · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: DCA's relaxed Tuscan table-service patio serves pan-seared salmon, grilled chicken breast, New York strip steak with mashed potatoes, and pasta tossed simply in olive oil and Parmigiano-Reggiano.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pan-Seared Salmon or Bistecca Steak with mashed potatoes/white rice (no citrus or peppercorn sauce), or spaghetti with olive oil, broth, and grilled chicken.
watchOuts: Skip the Grapefruit Salad (1.0 hard citrus avoid!), Fried Calamari, and spicy red pepper flakes

items.name: Disney Wonder Alaska Regional Specials: Steamed King Crab Legs, Halibut & Glacier Day Salmon/Chowder
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Taste of Alaska Regional Specials & Dawes Glacier Deck BBQ
items.whyItWorks: Steamed Alaskan King Crab Legs ("Steamed Crab Royal"), pan-seared Alaskan Halibut, and Dawes Glacier Day grilled Wild Alaskan Salmon are zero-fiber, ultra-pure marine proteins.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Request plain drawn butter (no lemon juice added) for the Steamed King Crab Legs and Alaskan Halibut; on Glacier Day on deck, enjoy the grilled Wild Salmon or Clam Chowder in a sourdough bread bowl (with a Lactaid).
watchOuts: Verify drawn butter has no lemon juice mixed in
Dairy cream in Glacier Day clam chowder

items.name: Disney's Grand Californian GCH Craftsman Grill Grilled Salmon & Rice, Brioche Burger or Egg Breakfast
items.brandOrRestaurant: GCH Craftsman Grill (Disney's Grand Californian Hotel · Steps from DCA)
items.whyItWorks: A 2-minute walk out the Grizzly Peak gate of DCA (no hotel stay required!), GCH Craftsman Grill is quiet, shaded, and serves freshly grilled Atlantic Salmon with steamed white rice, sourdough avocado toast, smoked salmon bagels, and plain brioche burgers.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Take a midday break from DCA crowds and mobile-order the Grilled Salmon Plate with steamed white rice (no lemon), the American Breakfast (eggs, bacon, potatoes, sourdough toast), or Kids' Grilled Chicken Skewer & Rice.
watchOuts: Skip the giant Loaded Double-Baked Nachos during flares

items.name: Disneyland Blue Bayou Restaurant Center-Cut Filet Mignon or Sustainable Fish & Mashed Potatoes (Plain Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Blue Bayou Restaurant (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Blue Bayou's kitchen readily accommodates dietary requests—ordering the Center-Cut Filet Mignon or Market Sustainable Fish seasoned simply with salt and olive oil alongside mashed potatoes or white rice lets you enjoy the Pirates of the Caribbean ambiance safely.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for the Filet Mignon or Sustainable Fish prepared "plain grilled with olive oil and kosher salt only—no Cajun blackening spice and no citrus/cream sauce," paired with mashed potatoes or steamed white rice and warm dinner rolls.
watchOuts: Skip the spicy Jambalaya, dark-roux Gumbo, and deep-fried Monte Cristo during flares

items.name: Disneyland Blue Bayou Restaurant Herb-Roasted Chicken Breast & Mashed Potatoes (Plain Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Blue Bayou Restaurant (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Oven-roasted chicken breast (available on both the adult entrée menu and kids' menu) served with whipped potatoes or steamed white rice and warm bread rolls is one of the gentlest sit-down meals in the park.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for the Roasted Chicken Breast with no Creole/pepper sauce, paired with mashed potatoes or steamed white rice and cooked carrots.
watchOuts: Ask for pan jus/sauce on the side and skip any raw arugula garnish

items.name: Disneyland Plaza Inn Herb-Baked Salmon Fillet with Mashed Potatoes or White Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: Plaza Inn (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Plaza Inn's counter rotation routinely includes a tender baked salmon fillet alongside the fried chicken and pot roast—giving you a 9.0/10 non-fried omega-3 meal with whipped potatoes and a warm biscuit.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the Baked Salmon with mashed potatoes (no gravy) and a biscuit, holding any lemon-caper sauce.
watchOuts: Take a lactase tablet for the mashed potatoes and skip any lemon garnish

items.name: Downtown Disney Din Tai Fung Kurobuta Pork / Chicken Xiao Long Bao Soup Dumplings & Egg Fried White Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: Din Tai Fung (Downtown Disney District · Disneyland Resort)
items.whyItWorks: The new Din Tai Fung in Downtown Disney is a Crohn's paradise: delicate steamed thin-skin Xiao Long Bao (Chicken or Kurobuta Pork soup dumplings), clear Chicken Noodle Soup, and Wok-Tossed Shrimp/Chicken Egg Fried White Rice are 100% dairy-free, non-fried, and ultra-digestible.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Chicken or Kurobuta Pork Xiao Long Bao, Steamed Shrimp & Pork Shao Mai, Chicken Noodle Soup, or Shrimp/Chicken Fried White Rice (ask for no green onions on the rice, and skip the spicy chili oil and raw ginger vinegar dip).
watchOuts: Skip the Spicy Wontons in chili oil, cucumber salad, and raw ginger shreds in the vinegar dish

items.name: Downtown Disney Wetzel's Pretzels Original Soft Pretzel or Wetzel Bitz (Unbuttered / Light Salt)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Wetzel's Pretzels (Downtown Disney District · Disneyland Resort)
items.whyItWorks: Freshly kneaded and baked on-site from simple white wheat flour, yeast, water, and salt—asking for "no butter" makes it 100% dairy-free, nearly fat-free, and 9.0/10 flare-safe.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Original Wetzel Bitz or a Original Pretzel with **"No Butter"** (or light butter if tolerated) and skip the jalapeño cheese dip.
watchOuts: Skip Jalapeño Bitz, Pepperoni Twist, and frozen lemonades (citrus trigger)

items.name: Egg & Havarti Tortilla Melt
items.whyItWorks: Soft eggs and white flour tortillas are near-zero residue; Havarti is naturally lactose-free (~0g lactose) and melts cleanly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Soft-scramble 2 eggs, wrap in a warm white flour tortilla with a slice of plain Havarti, and press in a dry skillet for 60 seconds per side until crispy.

items.name: Elements Restaurant & Beehive Grill (Logan) Pan-Seared Salmon, Halibut & Filet Mignon
items.whyItWorks: Logan's premier sit-down grills at the Riverwoods and Main Street offer clean pan-seared Atlantic salmon, fresh halibut, and beef tenderloin with Yukon mashed potatoes or white rice.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Grilled Salmon, Halibut, or Filet Mignon cooked in olive oil with mashed potatoes or white rice and steamed carrots/squash (strictly hold any lemon-butter or citrus glaze).
watchOuts: Request no lemon wedge or citrus beurre blanc on fish

items.name: Enchanté Champagne Brunch Poached Halibut with Creamy Scrambled Eggs
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Enchanté by Chef Arnaud Lallement (Brunch)
items.whyItWorks: Soft French bain-marie scrambled eggs and butter-poached white halibut have zero fiber and melt in the mouth.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Confirm with your server that no lemon juice is added to the herb butter emulsion and take a Lactaid.
watchOuts: Butter/cream in French scrambled eggs

items.name: Enchanté Poached Blue Maine Lobster & Wild Turbot with Champagne Velouté
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Enchanté by Chef Arnaud Lallement
items.whyItWorks: Three-Michelin-starred French culinary technique: butter-poached Maine lobster and flaky wild turbot have zero insoluble fiber and melt on the fork.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Inform the Enchanté maître d' of your strict zero-citrus requirement (Chef Lallement uses lemon/citrus acidity as a signature motif and the kitchen will custom-poach your lobster and turbot in pure butter/shallot-free stock).
watchOuts: Signature Lallement sauces often use lemon/citrus acidity unless requested citrus-free
Rich French butter/cream (take a Lactaid)

items.name: Eye Scream Treats Dairy-Free Tropical Mango Soft-Serve Twist (Standalone)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Eye Scream Treats (Pool Deck)
items.whyItWorks: 100% dairy-free, lactose-free, fat-free, seedless, and citrus-free fruit sorbet soft-serve available on tap at Eye Scream.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the cast member at Eye Scream for a cup or cone of the dairy-free Mango/Tropical sorbet soft-serve.
watchOuts: Avoid eating too fast if cold temperatures trigger stomach cramping

items.name: Flower Child & Aubergine Kitchen (Herriman / Draper) Grilled Chicken or Salmon with Mashed Sweet Potato & Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: Flower Child (Mountain View Village · Herriman) / Aubergine Kitchen (Draper & South Jordan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: The easiest clean-eating spots in Herriman and Draper: build a plate with anti-inflammatory grilled salmon, chicken breast, or grass-fed steak plus steamed jasmine/brown rice, gluten-free mac & cheese, or whipped sweet potatoes.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: At Flower Child or Aubergine, order a custom Plate with Grilled Chicken, Salmon, or Steak + Steamed Rice and Whipped Sweet Potatoes or Gluten-Free Cheddar Mac & Cheese (skipping raw kale salads and lemon vinaigrette).
watchOuts: Skip raw kale/Brussels sprout salads and citrus vinaigrettes

items.name: Fody Foods Low-FODMAP Vegan Caesar & Ranch Dressings
items.whyItWorks: Made with extra virgin olive oil and organic herbs without any dairy, buttermilk, garlic, or onion. Delivers creamy, savory herb dressing flavor with zero lactose and zero fructan distress.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drizzle over tender steamed chicken breast, baked potatoes, or soft cooked zucchini.
watchOuts: Gentle, dairy-free emulsion certified safe by Monash University.

items.name: Fresh Yellowtail (Hamachi) Nigiri (2 Pieces)
items.whyItWorks: Pristine raw yellowtail over lightly seasoned white rice provides clean protein and anti-inflammatory omega-3 fatty acids without any roughage, dairy, or harsh spices.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for nigiri without wasabi smeared underneath. Dip lightly in regular or low-sodium soy sauce.

items.name: Fruity or Cocoa Dyno-Bites
items.whyItWorks: Puffed rice base with zero roughage. The marshmallow version adds great mouthfeel that melts completely without adding fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pour lactose-free or almond milk and let sit 60 seconds before eating.
watchOuts: Food dyes and high sugar can slightly speed up transit in ultra-sensitive guts during a severe flare

items.name: Glutino Gluten-Free Pretzel Twists
items.whyItWorks: Certified gluten-free corn and potato starch pretzel twists. Crisp, snappy texture without wheat proteins or coarse bran.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Great portable snack for flights and road trips.

items.name: Gossner Foods Cheese Factory Aged Baby Swiss & Cheddar Curds/Slices
items.brandOrRestaurant: Gossner Foods Cheese Factory Store (Logan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Gossner's world-famous Cache Valley Aged Swiss and Aged Sharp Cheddar have virtually 0g remaining lactose because the whey is drained and bacterial cultures consume all milk sugar during aging.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick up sliced or cubed Gossner Baby Swiss or Aged Cheddar from the Logan factory store to pair with saltine/sourdough crackers for road trips up to Bear Lake.
watchOuts: Stick to aged block cheeses (Swiss, Cheddar, Muenster) rather than fresh unaged squeaky curds or flavored jalapeno cheeses; Gossner shelf-stable UHT milk still contains lactose unless labeled lactose-free

items.name: Grilled Ahi Tuna Steak (Plain Sear Mod)
items.whyItWorks: Seared ahi tuna steak has zero gristle and 0g fiber, delivering 35g+ of ultra-clean protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the tuna steak seared plain with olive oil/butter and served with mashed potatoes or steamed white rice instead of the eggplant caponata, sun-dried tomato pesto, and skin-on fingerling potatoes.
watchOuts: Eggplant caponata and sun-dried tomato skins
Fingerling potato skins

items.name: Grilled Sourdough Ham & Cheese
items.whyItWorks: Long-fermented white sourdough and naturally aged Swiss, Havarti, or sharp cheddar (~0g lactose) melt into a low-residue, high-protein hot sandwich with ~1g fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer thin-sliced deli ham and plain Swiss, Havarti, or aged cheddar between buttered white sourdough slices. Grill in a skillet or bake in the toaster oven at 375F until crisp and melted.
watchOuts: Whole-grain or seeded sourdough
Unaged American cheese if lactose sensitive

items.name: Grilled Tuna or Teriyaki Salmon (Worlds of Marvel)
items.whyItWorks: Flaky salmon or seared tuna with mild soy-teriyaki glaze digests effortlessly and provides anti-inflammatory omega-3s.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pair with plain steamed white rice (or soft noodles) and skip any raw scallions, sesame seeds, edamame, or fibrous bok choy stalks.
watchOuts: Sesame seeds and raw green onions
Whole edamame/soybeans and bok choy stems

items.name: Harmless Harvest Organic Coconut Water (Pink)
items.whyItWorks: Micro-filtered and bottled unheated; the natural antioxidants (polyphenols) interact with light to turn the water pink. Pure, sweet, crisp, zero added sugars, and zero pulp.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Keep refrigerated and drink chilled for clean, rejuvenating hydration.

items.name: Heinz Homestyle Classic Savory Beef Gravy
items.whyItWorks: Rich, smooth brown beef gravy made with beef stock. It has zero gristle, zero seeds, and zero insoluble fiber, providing comforting savory richness without chewing fatigue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm and ladle over mashed potatoes or tender pot roast.
watchOuts: Low in fiber and residue; enjoy warm.

items.name: Holiday Classic Deviled Eggs (Mayo & Yellow Mustard — No Relish/Cayenne)
items.whyItWorks: Hard-boiled egg whites and mashed yolks whipped with a touch of mayo and yellow mustard provide 6g of pure, zero-fiber, dairy-free protein per two halves.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose classic deviled eggs made without crunchy pickle relish, bacon bits, or spicy cayenne pepper (a light dusting of mild sweet paprika is fine).
watchOuts: Avoid deviled eggs topped with pickled jalapeño slices, cayenne pepper, or chunky dill pickle relish

items.name: Holiday Classic Smooth Deviled Eggs (Paprika & Dijon — No Relish)
items.whyItWorks: While everyone else snacks on raw veggie trays and mixed nuts before holiday dinner, smooth deviled eggs give you zero-fiber, dairy-free protein that won't hurt your stomach.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Make with mashed egg yolks, mayo, a touch of mustard, and sweet paprika (not cayenne), and leave out chopped pickle relish or jalapenos.
watchOuts: Skip deviled eggs topped with jalapeño slices or cayenne pepper

items.name: Holiday Honey-Maple Glazed Soft Cooked Carrots & Roasted Butternut Squash
items.whyItWorks: The safest vegetable sides on the holiday table: peeled carrots and peeled butternut squash cooked until fork-mashable provide 100% gut-soothing soluble fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Roast or simmer peeled carrots and peeled cubed butternut squash with olive oil/ghee and maple syrup or honey until completely soft.
watchOuts: Skip Brussels sprouts, raw kale/cranberry salads, and whole corn at the holiday table

items.name: Holiday Warm Lion House / Rhodes White Yeast Dinner Rolls with Honey Butter
items.brandOrRestaurant: Lion House / Rhodes Bake-N-Serv / Thanksgiving & Christmas Table
groceryIngredients: Rhodes Dinner Rolls or Lion House Rolls
items.whyItWorks: Feather-light refined white flour yeast rolls are the ultimate gut-safe starch sponge alongside holiday turkey and gravy.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy warm with a light touch of butter or honey, or use them to make leftover turkey-and-gravy sliders the next day.
watchOuts: Stick to white yeast rolls rather than seeded multigrain rolls

items.name: Honey-Roasted Butternut Squash
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Cruise Line · Main Dining & Cabanas / Marceline Market
items.whyItWorks: Peeled winter squash flesh cooks down into a velvety, mashable puree rich in soothing soluble pectin with zero stringy husks or skins.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ensure squash is completely peeled with seeds removed, and roast at 375F with butter and a touch of honey until fork-mashable soft. On cruise menus, ask to hold any toasted pepitas/pumpkin seeds or coarse herbs.
watchOuts: Pumpkin seeds / pepita garnishes
Unpeeled squash skin edges

items.name: Japanese Taiyaki (Custard Filled) or Mochi Ice Cream
items.whyItWorks: Taiyaki is a warm waffle fish filled with smooth vanilla custard; Mochi is pounded glutinous sweet rice flour (0g fiber).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Crisp frozen custard taiyaki in the toaster oven for 5 minutes. Skip red bean (anko) fillings that contain bean skins during flares.

items.name: Knott's Cave Inn Snacks (Camp Snoopy) Warm Soft Pretzel, Fresh Banana & Apple Sauce
items.brandOrRestaurant: Cave Inn Snacks (Camp Snoopy · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Quick walk-up window inside Camp Snoopy stocking warm soft pretzels, whole bananas, applesauce pouches, and bottled water.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab a plain warm pretzel (no cheese dip) and a banana for a quick flare-safe snack.
watchOuts: Skip nacho cheese cups and sour slushies

items.name: Knott's Charleston Circle Coffee / Marketplace StarbucksSous-Vide Egg Bites, Rolled Oatmeal & Banana
items.brandOrRestaurant: Charleston Circle Coffee & California Marketplace Starbucks (Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Available inside Knott's (Charleston Circle / Marketplace), Disneyland (Market House), and DCA (Fiddler, Fifer & Practical Cafe): Bacon & Gruyère Egg Bites, plain Classic Rolled Oatmeal, and a ripe banana are a universal 9.0/10 theme-park safety net.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Classic Oatmeal (no nut packet), Bacon & Gruyère Sous-Vide Egg Bites (Gruyère is aged and naturally lactose-safe), or a Turkey Bacon Egg-White Sandwich on an English muffin.
watchOuts: Discard the mixed-nut packet that comes with the oatmeal; avoid citrus refreshers/lemonades

items.name: Knott's Fireman's Brigade BBQ (Ghost Town) Roasted Quarter/Half Chicken & Giant Baked Idaho Potato
items.brandOrRestaurant: Fireman's Brigade BBQ (Ghost Town · Knott's Berry Farm)
searchKeywords: ghost town bbq chicken baked potato
items.whyItWorks: Open-pit roasted bone-in chicken paired with a whole foil-baked Idaho Russet potato (instead of fries or beans) is included on the Knott's Dining Plan and gives you clean protein and soluble potato starch once you peel off the spiced chicken skin.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the **Roasted Chicken & Baked Potato** combo with BBQ sauce on the side—peel off the peppery chicken skin and eat the fluffy interior of the baked potato with a touch of butter/salt.
watchOuts: Peel off the outer herb/pepper chicken skin, leave the baked potato skin behind, and skip the BBQ baked beans

items.name: Knott's Mrs. Knott's Country Scrambled Eggs, Ham Steak & Crispy Hash Browns
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Served daily in Mrs. Knott's historic restaurant. Fluffy soft-scrambled eggs, lean country ham steak, and golden peeled potato hash browns. Zero-roughage, pure bioavailable protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Country Breakfast with scrambled eggs, ham steak, hash browns, and white toast with butter.
watchOuts: None; premier flare-safe theme park breakfast

items.name: Kozy Shack All Natural Tapioca Pudding
items.whyItWorks: Tapioca starch pearls (from cassava root) cook until gelatinous, translucent, and silky soft. Tapioca is hypoallergenic, gluten-free, and one of the easiest starches to digest in human biology.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat chilled. Take a lactase tablet if you have primary dairy lactose intolerance.
watchOuts: Contains real milk and eggs; take lactase enzyme if sensitive to lactose.

items.name: Loaded Baked Potato Bowl (Strictly No Skins)
items.whyItWorks: Peeled russet, Yukon gold, or sweet potatoes provide soluble potassium and soothing starch without roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake or microwave potato until tender, scoop out the inside (discard the fibrous skin), and mash with butter, lactose-free sour cream, melted sharp cheddar, and browned ground turkey.

items.name: Maddox Ranch House Center-Cut Filet Mignon & Throwback Crown Turkey Steak
items.brandOrRestaurant: Maddox Ranch House (Perry / Brigham City — Hwy 89 to Logan & Bear Lake)
items.whyItWorks: Never wrapped in fatty bacon, Maddox's center-cut beef filet mignon and grilled Crown Turkey Steak are ultra-lean, zero-fiber proteins.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Filet Mignon, Tender Roast Beef, or Crown Turkey Steak with a plain baked potato (eat the fluffy inside) and warm dinner rolls.
watchOuts: Skip the raw green salad starter and fried shrimp

items.name: Mickey's Smokestack BBQ Carved Smoked Chicken Breast (Standalone)
items.whyItWorks: The #1 flare-safe protein at the Disney Treasure pool deck BBQ counter: tender carved white chicken breast meat.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel off the spiced outer skin and enjoy the tender white chicken breast meat with a white roll or Baked Mac & Cheese.
watchOuts: Remove the spiced/peppery outer chicken skin

items.name: Mo' Bettahs Hawaiian Style Food (Logan / Draper / Herriman) Teriyaki Chicken & White Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mo' Bettahs Hawaiian Style Food (Logan, Draper, Herriman & Utah)
items.whyItWorks: One of the best fast-casual Crohn's meals in Utah: chargrilled boneless teriyaki chicken or slow-roasted Kalua pork served over two scoops of sticky steamed white rice—zero fiber, zero dairy, zero citrus.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Regular or Mini Plate with Teriyaki Chicken (or Kalua Pig) and ask for "All White Rice" (two scoops of white rice instead of mayonnaise macaroni salad).
watchOuts: Sub extra white rice in place of the heavy mayo macaroni salad during flares
Skip breaded deep-fried Katsu chicken

items.name: Mrs. Knott's Broiled Atlantic Salmon Fillet with Mashed or Baked Potato (No Lemon Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (California Marketplace · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Tender broiled salmon fillet paired with a plain baked potato (eat the fluffy interior) and chicken noodle soup is a 9.0/10 flare-safe sit-down meal right outside the Knott's main gate.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Broiled Salmon plain (no lemon butter sauce and no lemon wedge) with a plain baked potato or mashed potatoes.
watchOuts: Ask for no lemon garnish (citrus trigger)

items.name: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant Country-Roasted Half Chicken & Mashed Potatoes (Non-Fried Option!)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (California Marketplace · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Most visitors don't realize Mrs. Knott's lets you order their complete Full Chicken Dinner with **Oven-Roasted Half Chicken** instead of fried chicken—giving you tender, non-fried poultry, homemade chicken noodle soup, mashed potatoes, and warm buttermilk biscuits!
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the **Country-Roasted Chicken Dinner** (instead of fried), choose **Chicken Noodle Soup** (skip the rhubarb starter and raw cabbage slaw), ask for gravy on the side, and swap the seeded boysenberry pie slice for vanilla ice cream or boysenberry sherbet (if strained).
watchOuts: Take a lactase enzyme for the mashed potatoes and biscuits, and remove the seasoned chicken skin if sensitive

items.name: Near East Original Plain Couscous (100% Semolina)
items.whyItWorks: Tiny pearls of precooked durum wheat semolina. When covered in boiling broth, it steams fluffy and soft in just 5 minutes. Exceptionally gentle on digestion with minimal chew required.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bring 1 cup chicken bone broth to a boil, stir in 1 cup couscous, remove from heat and cover for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.

items.name: New Year's Eve Gala Menu: Surf & Turf Beef Tenderloin & Lobster Tail and Midnight Chocolate Dome
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · New Year's Eve Gala Dinner Menu
items.whyItWorks: Center-cut roasted beef tenderloin paired with broiled lobster tail and mashed potatoes is a 9/10 flare-safe celebration meal.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Surf & Turf with drawn butter and béarnaise/demi-glace on the side (no lemon on lobster), and choose the Midnight Chocolate Dome for dessert.
watchOuts: Order sauces on the side and discard any lemon wedge

items.name: Oven-Baked Salmon Royale
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's
items.whyItWorks: Oven-baked Atlantic salmon and silky truffled cauliflower purée flake and dissolve effortlessly with high anti-inflammatory omega-3s.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server to bake the salmon without the horseradish crust if flaring, enjoy the smooth cauliflower purée (or swap for mashed potatoes/white rice), and skip the sautéed Swiss chard leaves.
watchOuts: Horseradish crust if stomach is sensitive
Leafy Swiss chard stems
Butter/cream in beurre blanc if lactose sensitive

items.name: Oven-Roasted Tom Turkey Breast with Mashed Sweet Potatoes & Gravy (Night 2)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table (Snuggly Duckling Night 2)
items.whyItWorks: Skinless carved white turkey breast and smooth mashed sweet potatoes are among the safest, highest-protein flare meals on the ship.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the carved white turkey breast and mashed sweet potatoes; ask for gravy on the side and skip the whole-berry cranberry relish and green beans.
watchOuts: Whole cranberry skins/seeds in relish
Green bean fiber

items.name: Palo / Palo Steakhouse Center-Cut Beef Tenderloin, Prime Striploin & Japanese A5 Wagyu
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Dinner)
items.whyItWorks: The 6 oz or 8 oz Center-Cut Beef Tenderloin Filet is ultra-lean, buttery-tender, and zero-fiber; A5 Wagyu is melt-in-your-mouth in small 2–3 oz tasting portions.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: During a flare or everyday dining, order the Center-Cut Beef Tenderloin Filet (medium-rare, salt only, Barolo/Gorgonzola sauce on the side) with Truffle-Free Mashed Potatoes or Cavatelli.
watchOuts: Japanese A5 Wagyu has very high intramuscular fat (keep to a small tasting portion if fat-sensitive)
Order rich sauces on the side

items.name: Palo Brunch Made-to-Order Three-Cheese Omelet & Ham/Cheese Frittata
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
items.whyItWorks: Fluffy whipped eggs with aged Italian cheeses and diced lean ham provide zero-fiber, high-bioavailability protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Three-Cheese Omelet or Ham & Cheese Frittata (skip the Tomato & Onion omelet option to avoid onion fructans) and swap crispy potato hash for a soft white roll if flaring.
watchOuts: Skip the onion/tomato omelet variant
Take a Lactaid if unaged fontina/ricotta is included

items.name: Palo Brunch Roasted Red Snapper Filet with Saffron Fondant Potato
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
items.whyItWorks: Flaky pan-roasted red snapper and peeled saffron fondant potato are lean, dairy-light, citrus-free, and flare-safe once the caponata relish is held.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Roasted Red Snapper with the saffron fondant potatoes only—ask the kitchen to hold the Sicilian eggplant/olive caponata relish.
watchOuts: Eggplant/olive/tomato caponata garnish if not held

items.name: Palo Brunch Signature Parmesan-Crusted Chicken Breast over Arborio Risotto
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
items.whyItWorks: Arguably the single most famous dish on Disney Cruise Line: tender pounded chicken breast in a light 24-month Parmigiano-Reggiano crust over creamy white Arborio rice risotto.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order as your centerpiece Palo Brunch entrée; aged Parmigiano-Reggiano is naturally lactose-free, though take a Lactaid for the butter/cream in the risotto.
watchOuts: Butter/cream finish in risotto

items.name: Palo Dinner Slow-Braised Veal Osso Buco & Pan-Seared Mediterranean Branzino / Dover Sole
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Dinner)
items.whyItWorks: Tableside-filleted Dover Sole / Mediterranean Branzino and slow-braised Veal Osso Buco over saffron risotto are tender, high-protein Italian classics.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: On the Veal Osso Buco, ask the kitchen to hold the lemon-peel gremolata garnish; on the Dover Sole or Branzino, request olive oil and caper-free butter with zero lemon juice.
watchOuts: Lemon zest in traditional Osso Buco gremolata (ask to hold)
Lemon juice in tableside fish butter (ask to hold)

items.name: Pan-Seared Barramundi / Roasted Red Snapper with Crushed Potatoes (Captain's Gala Night 2)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · 1923 / Disney Wonder & Magic · Captain's Gala Menu
items.whyItWorks: Mild, flaky white barramundi or red snapper over crushed olive-oil potatoes is ultra-lean, low-residue, and easy to digest.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the fish pan-seared in olive oil with salt only (sauce on the side, no lemon) over crushed or mashed potatoes.
watchOuts: Confirm sauce on the side contains no citrus

items.name: Pan-Seared Snapper or Sea Bass (Plain Mod · Plaza de Coco)
items.whyItWorks: Flaky red snapper and sea bass are ultra-gentle proteins; pairing them with smooth refried beans and white rice makes a flare-safe Mexican dinner.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the snapper or sea bass seared plain (no adobo spice or chimichurri/pico de gallo) and served with plain white rice, peeled rainbow carrots, and a small side of smooth refried pinto beans.
watchOuts: Default adobo spice rub and herb chimichurri
Raw tomato pico de gallo and lime squeeze

items.name: Peeled & Steamed Yellow Summer Squash
items.whyItWorks: Yellow summer squash has a delicate, naturally sweet flavor and silky pulp. When peeled and steamed, it breaks down into a soft, non-abrasive vegetable side that provides hydration, potassium, and vitamin C.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel away yellow exterior skin, slice into thin half-moons, and steam or microwave with 2 tablespoons of water until completely soft and tender.
watchOuts: Discard oversized squashes with large, hard mature seeds.

items.name: Plain Baked Sweet Potato (Peeled Flesh Only)
items.whyItWorks: Sweet potato flesh is packed with beta-carotene, vitamin C, and predominantly soluble fiber. When baked until caramel-sweet and tender, it provides gentle anti-inflammatory nourishment for the intestinal lining.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pierce sweet potato with a fork and microwave for 6–8 minutes or bake at 400°F for 45 minutes until soft. Scoop out only the orange flesh; completely discard the tough outer skin.
watchOuts: Always discard the tough, fibrous outer peel.

items.name: Prosciutto & Provolone Croissant Roll-Up
items.whyItWorks: Refined white pastry flour and aged cheese dissolve fast; thin cured meat gives high protein and sodium without tough muscle fibers.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer thin prosciutto and plain provolone or Havarti inside a bakery croissant. Toast in the toaster oven at 350F for 4-5 minutes until flaky, never soggy.

items.name: Queen Arianna's Grilled Turbot / Pan-Seared Sea Bass
items.whyItWorks: Delicate, snow-white turbot and Chilean sea bass flake at the touch of a fork with virtually zero connective tissue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pair with creamy mashed potatoes or white rice and ask to hold any whole green peas, beans, or citrus-herb garnish.
watchOuts: Whole pea or fava bean skins on the plate

items.name: Rapunzel's Warm Pretzel Bread Service
items.whyItWorks: Pillow-soft Bavarian pretzel rolls made from refined white flour and yeast digest effortlessly with near-zero roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the warm pretzel bread with plain butter (or smooth cheese dip) and skip the whole-grain mustard seed dip if flaring.
watchOuts: Whole mustard seeds in the mustard dip
Coarse salt crystals if mouth ulcers are present

items.name: Red Vines Original Red Licorice Twists
items.whyItWorks: Red Vines are fat-free, made from simple wheat flour and cane syrup without artificial preservatives. Gentle on the stomach with zero residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Chew well. A great fat-free sweet alternative to chocolate bars.
watchOuts: Contains wheat flour (gluten).

items.name: Riverside Roasted Green Circle Chicken & Potato Fondant
items.whyItWorks: Roasted free-range chicken breast, butter-braised peeled Yukon Gold potato fondant, and cooked apple pectin chutney are naturally low-residue and citrus-free.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy the roasted chicken, peeled Yukon potato fondant, and cooked Honeycrisp apple chutney while pushing the Brussels sprouts to the side.
watchOuts: Whole Brussels sprouts on the plate

items.name: Roasted Chicken Breast & Sour Cream Mashed Potatoes
items.whyItWorks: Tender roasted chicken breast atop smooth, peeled mashed potatoes and fork-soft roasted root carrots is one of the gentlest main dining meals onboard.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: If you have a strict citrus guardrail, ask for the plain "Lighter Note" roasted chicken breast paired with the sour cream mashed potatoes, and hold the whole-grain mustard jus.
watchOuts: Lemon-thyme marinade (citrus guardrail — request plain roasted breast)
Whole mustard seeds in the jus
Sour cream in mashed potatoes if lactose sensitive

items.name: Room Service Door-Hanger Continental Breakfast (Bagels, Toast, Banana, Cereal)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · 24-Hour Stateroom Dining
items.whyItWorks: Hang the breakfast card on your stateroom door before 3 AM for complimentary early-morning delivery of plain bagels, white toast, Rice Krispies/Corn Flakes, and whole bananas.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Check off Plain Bagel, White Toast, Honey/Jelly, Rice Krispies or Corn Flakes (with soy/almond milk), and Whole Banana. Do not check Grapefruit Juice or Orange Juice.
watchOuts: Never check Grapefruit Juice or Orange Juice on the door card
