items.name: Rule 1 R1 Naturally Flavored Whey Isolate (Vanilla)
items.whyItWorks: 100% whey isolate and hydrolysate blend with 0g sugar, 0g fat, 0g fiber, and negligible lactose. Gentle on digestion without causing gas or heaviness.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mix 1 scoop with 8 oz cold water or unsweetened almond milk.

items.name: Sabores Vietnamese Beef Pho Rice Noodle Soup (No Lime/Jalapeño Mod)
items.whyItWorks: Clear aromatic beef bone broth with soft rice noodles and thin-sliced lean beef is hydrating, dairy-free, wheat-free, and gentle on an inflamed gut.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Beef Pho and skip the raw garnish plate (do not squeeze the lime wedge, and skip raw bean sprouts, sliced jalapeños, and sriracha).
watchOuts: Do NOT add the lime wedge (citrus trigger), raw bean sprouts (insoluble fiber), or sriracha/jalapeños

items.name: Seared Verlasso Salmon & Honey Parsnip Purée
items.whyItWorks: Sustainably raised Verlasso salmon is buttery and rich in omega-3s, and the wild honey parsnip purée is whipped completely smooth.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: If you have a strict citrus guardrail, ask to hold the orange-fennel essence reduction (serve plain with butter or olive oil) and skip the fibrous black garlic rapini stems.
watchOuts: Orange-fennel reduction (citrus guardrail — request plain)
Fibrous rapini / broccoli rabe stems

items.name: Silky Cream Cheese or Ricotta English Muffin
items.whyItWorks: White English muffins have zero whole-grain husks and toast up crisp without sharp edges.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast light-to-medium in the toaster oven, spread with lactose-free cream cheese (or whole-milk ricotta in remission) and a drizzle of honey.

items.name: Simple Whipped Guacamole (No Onion, No Garlic, Seedless)
items.whyItWorks: Ripe Hass avocado whipped with a fork until creamy, seasoned only with extra virgin olive oil and fine sea salt. Packed with anti-inflammatory monounsaturated fats and soluble potassium, with zero onion fructans or spicy jalapeño seeds.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mash 1 ripe avocado with 1 tsp olive oil and 1/4 tsp salt. Dip with Fritos corn chips or spread onto soft flour tortillas.

items.name: Simply Cheetos Puffs (White Cheddar, Non-GMO)
items.whyItWorks: Baked with organic non-GMO cornmeal and real aged white cheddar cheese, with zero artificial colors or preservatives. The puffs disintegrate rapidly in the mouth into smooth starch, leaving zero sharp fragments.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat straight from the bag. Safe for flare recoveries when seeking salty savory flavor.

items.name: Sit-Down Breakfast Smoked Salmon (Lox), Toasted White Bagel & Cream Cheese
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
items.whyItWorks: Cold-smoked Atlantic salmon over a toasted plain white bagel provides anti-inflammatory omega-3s and zero-residue carbs.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Use a light smear of cream cheese (with a Lactaid) or plain butter, and leave the raw red onion rings, capers, and lemon wedge untouched.
watchOuts: Discard lemon wedge, raw red onions, and capers
Cream cheese lactose

items.name: Sliced Serrano Ham & Aged Manchego
items.whyItWorks: Paper-thin cured Serrano ham and aged sheep's-milk Manchego cheese (~0g lactose) dissolve cleanly and deliver savory protein and sodium.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the Serrano ham and Manchego cheese with a soft white dinner roll, and skip the coarse olive tapenade if flaring.
watchOuts: Olive tapenade skins

items.name: Smoked Salmon Tartare
items.whyItWorks: Cured, finely chopped smoked salmon is butter-soft and packed with anti-inflammatory omega-3 fats with 0g plant fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: At Animator's Palate, order without whole capers, raw red onion, or lemon zest, and go light on the dill-caper sour cream (or pair with plain white dinner rolls).
watchOuts: Whole capers and raw minced red onion
Sour cream/crème fraîche if lactose sensitive
Lemon juice/zest garnish

items.name: Smooth Peanut Butter & Seedless Jelly Sandwich
items.whyItWorks: Creamy peanut butter and clear pectin jelly (grape or apple) on refined white or potato bread provide dense, zero-roughage calories with no nut shards or berry seeds.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Use strictly creamy/smooth peanut butter (never crunchy) and seedless jelly (grape or apple — never raspberry/blackberry jam with seeds or orange marmalade) on soft white or potato bread.
watchOuts: Crunchy peanut butter nut shards
Berry preserves with seeds (strawberry/raspberry/blackberry)
Citrus marmalade or pectin with grapefruit extract

items.name: Smooth Peanut Satay Noodle & Chicken Sauce
items.whyItWorks: Smooth creamy peanut butter thinned with warm chicken broth delivers rich calories and savory flavor with zero nut shards.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 2 tbsp smooth peanut butter with 1/4 cup warm chicken bone broth, 1 tsp soy sauce, 1 tsp maple syrup, and a pinch of ground ginger.

items.name: Snack Pack Vanilla Pudding Cup
items.whyItWorks: Silky smooth, completely non-abrasive comfort food. Snack Pack vanilla pudding requires zero chewing, provides quick sugar calories, and contains 0g fiber. It coats the esophagus and stomach comfortably.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel foil lid and eat with a spoon. Contains nonfat milk—take a lactase enzyme tablet if you have primary lactase deficiency.
watchOuts: Contains nonfat milk; individuals with severe lactose intolerance should take a lactase enzyme tablet.

items.name: Stauffer's Original Animal Crackers
items.whyItWorks: Traditional animal crackers are semi-sweet, low in fat, and low in sugar compared to standard cookies. Their dense, tender crumb softens rapidly, making them gentle on sensitive intestines.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: A nostalgic, comforting snack when craving something slightly sweet without dairy butter or chocolate.
watchOuts: Avoid frosted animal cookies with heavy hydrogenated fat glazes.

items.name: Sweet Lake Biscuits (Draper, UT) Two Scrambled Eggs with Sliced Avocado Toast
items.whyItWorks: Soft scrambled farm eggs paired with fresh mashed ripe avocado on toasted sourdough bread with light sea salt. Healthy monounsaturated fats, bioavailable protein, and potassium.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order two scrambled eggs with sourdough toast and sliced avocado (hold tomato slices and red pepper flakes).
watchOuts: None; gentle flare-safe brunch

items.name: Takara Sushi (Logan) Grilled Chicken or Salmon Teriyaki Rice Bowl & Udon Noodle Soup
items.whyItWorks: Thick, soft wheat udon noodles in clear dashi broth or grilled chicken/salmon teriyaki over steamed white rice—warm, cooked, and soothing on rough gut days.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken or Salmon Teriyaki with steamed white rice (skip the raw cabbage side salad) or the plain Chicken/Nabeyaki Udon (tempura on the side).
watchOuts: Skip the raw cabbage salad with citrus/ginger dressing

items.name: Takara Sushi Cooked Unagi (Freshwater Eel) & Avocado Roll or Unagi Don
items.whyItWorks: Broiled freshwater eel (unagi) is fully cooked, ultra-soft, rich in omega-3s and vitamins A/E, and glazed with a gentle sweet soy tare over white sushi rice and creamy avocado.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Eel & Avocado Roll (or Unagi Don rice bowl) with no cucumber strips and light sesame seeds.
watchOuts: Skip spicy mayo and pickled ginger if sensitive

items.name: Tamari & Honey Glazed Salmon Filet with Soboro Rice (Groot Remix Night 2)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Worlds of Marvel (Celebration of Heroes: Groot Remix Night 2)
items.whyItWorks: Wheat-free tamari soy and honey glaze over baked omega-3 salmon and steamed white rice is dairy-free, citrus-free, and flare-friendly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask to hold any sesame seed or raw scallion garnish and request steamed white rice alongside.
watchOuts: Sesame seeds or raw green onion garnish if not held

items.name: Tandoori Oven (Logan, UT) Tandoori Chicken Tikka Skewers (Dairy-Free / Mild)
items.whyItWorks: Clay oven roasting seals in moisture while letting excess fat drip away. Lean chicken breast with aromatic spices like turmeric is extraordinarily digestible and gut-friendly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Chicken Tikka skewers with plain basmati rice; request no spicy mint chutney and no raw onion rings.
watchOuts: None when eaten with plain rice and no spicy chutney

items.name: Thanksgiving & Christmas Whipped Sweet Potato Casserole with Toasted Marshmallows (No Pecans)
items.whyItWorks: Peeled, mashed sweet potatoes are packed with prebiotic soluble fiber and beta-carotene, and gelatin-based marshmallows melt into a zero-fiber sweet crust.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Always choose the Marshmallow-topped half of the casserole (or bake yours with marshmallows and brown sugar only)—strictly avoiding any chopped pecan streusel topping.
watchOuts: Strictly avoid chopped pecan toppings on sweet potato casserole

items.name: Thanksgiving at Sea Menu: Governor Bradford's Roast Turkey & Pumpkin Cheesecake/Pie
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Thanksgiving Day Dinner Menu
items.whyItWorks: Skinless carved Thanksgiving turkey breast with mashed potatoes/sweet potatoes and smooth spiced pumpkin pie or pumpkin cheesecake are soluble-fiber stars.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Governor Bradford's Roast Turkey with mashed potatoes and gravy on the side (skip whole-berry cranberry relish and onion-celery stuffing), and finish with Pumpkin Cheesecake/Pie (skip Pecan Pie).
watchOuts: Onion/celery in turkey stuffing
Skip Pecan Pie and Hot Spinach-Artichoke Dip

items.name: TownePlace Suites (Draper, UT) Hot Scrambled Eggs & Lean Turkey Sausage Patties
items.brandOrRestaurant: TownePlace Suites Salt Lake City Draper
items.whyItWorks: Hot buffet staple providing lean, easily absorbed protein. Turkey sausage has significantly less grease and saturated fat than pork links. Soft scrambled eggs are practically zero-residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve two scoops of fluffy scrambled eggs and two lean turkey sausage patties with white toast.
watchOuts: None; premier gentle travel breakfast

items.name: TownePlace Suites Salt Lake City Draper Breakfast: Plain Bagel, Oatmeal, Banana & Yogurt
items.brandOrRestaurant: TownePlace Suites by Marriott Salt Lake City Draper (Draper, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Every TownePlace Suites breakfast bar stocks toasted plain white bagels, hot plain oatmeal, ripe bananas, Rice Chex/Corn Flakes, and individual Chobani Greek yogurts—plus every room has a full kitchen!
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast a plain white bagel or English muffin with peanut butter or cream cheese, grab a ripe banana, or top plain hot oatmeal with brown sugar and banana slices (skipping the walnuts and dried cranberries).
watchOuts: Skip the walnut, almond, and dried raisin/cranberry toppings at the oatmeal bar
Skip the orange and grapefruit juice dispensers

items.name: Traditional Medicinals Organic Ginger Herbal Tea
items.whyItWorks: Contains 100% organic ginger rhizome rich in active gingerols and shogaols. Accelerates gastric emptying, reduces intestinal nausea and cramping, and inhibits pro-inflammatory eicosanoids without irritating the bowel.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Steep covered for 10-15 minutes. Add 1 teaspoon of pure clover honey if desired for comforting warmth.

items.name: Tsunami Restaurant & Sushi Bar (Draper / South Jordan) Salmon Nigiri, Teriyaki Bowl & Udon
items.brandOrRestaurant: Tsunami Restaurant & Sushi Bar (Draper & South Jordan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Minutes from TownePlace Suites Draper and South Jordan: Tsunami serves top-grade sashimi/nigiri, soy-paper sushi rolls, steamed white rice bowls with grilled chicken or salmon, and soothing udon noodle soup.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Salmon or Tuna Nigiri, any roll wrapped in Soy Paper (holding lemon slices, ponzu, and spicy mayo), or the Grilled Chicken/Salmon Teriyaki Bowl with white rice and miso soup.
watchOuts: CITRUS WARNING: Tsunami rolls like the "Sunshine Roll" include thin lemon slices—always order rolls without lemon or ponzu!

items.name: Tuna or Salmon Salad Cracker Stacks
items.whyItWorks: Canned fish is pre-cooked to complete softness and loaded with anti-inflammatory omega-3s.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mash drained canned tuna or pink salmon smooth with mayo and a pinch of garlic powder (skip celery or pickle relish chunks). Spoon onto Ritz crackers or Saltines.

items.name: Turkey & Havarti Toaster-Oven Melt
items.whyItWorks: Lean deli protein + zero-lactose Havarti on soft refined bread gives you a proper hot sandwich with zero friction.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer thin-sliced deli turkey and plain Havarti on potato bread or soft pita. Toast open-faced at 375F for 5 mins until crisp, never microwave-soggy.

items.name: Udi's Gluten-Free Delicious Soft White Sandwich Bread
items.whyItWorks: Made from a smooth blend of tapioca starch, brown rice flour, and egg whites. Light and airy with zero seeds, zero nuts, and negligible fiber. Highly digestible for compromised intestinal linings.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Best served toasted in a toaster oven for 2 minutes to bring out warmth and softness without crumbling.

items.name: Very Merrytime Christmas Menu: Carved Holiday Turkey & Horseradish Standing Rib Roast
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Very Merrytime "Happy Holidays" Dinner Menu
items.whyItWorks: Carved white Holiday Turkey Breast with mashed sweet potatoes and center-cut Standing Rib Roast (Prime Rib) are ultra-safe festive centerpieces.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: On the Holiday Turkey, ask the kitchen to hold the crushed pecans on the mashed sweet potatoes and skip the herb stuffing/cranberries; on the Standing Rib Roast, scrape off the horseradish crust and order claret sauce on the side.
watchOuts: Crushed pecans on holiday sweet potato mash (ask to hold)
Pungent horseradish crust on rib roast

items.name: Very Merrytime Christmas Seafood Sampler (Shrimp, Jonah Crab Claw & Smoked Salmon)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Very Merrytime ("Happy Holidays" Menu)
items.whyItWorks: Chilled poached shrimp, sweet Jonah crab claw meat, and smoked salmon provide pure, zero-fiber, ultra-lean protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Request the chilled shrimp, Jonah crab claw, and smoked salmon plain with cocktail/horseradish sauce and lemon wedges on the side.
watchOuts: CITRUS WARNING: Request without lemon juice or citrus marinade on the shrimp
Skip spicy horseradish cocktail sauce

items.name: Warm Bavarian Soft Pretzel & Smooth Cheese Dip
items.whyItWorks: Soft Bavarian pretzels are made from refined white flour and yeast - much safer than hard, jagged pretzel sticks or corn tortilla chips.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake a frozen soft pretzel in the toaster oven at 375F for 4-5 minutes (crisp outside, pillow-soft inside, never microwave-rubbery). Dip in warm melted cheddar.

items.name: Warm Mexican Bolillo Bread (Skip Corn Chips & Salsa)
items.whyItWorks: Mexican bolillo rolls have a pillow-soft white-flour interior that digests cleanly, unlike the sharp corn tortilla chips served alongside them.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the warm white bolillo bread with plain butter and strictly skip the fried corn tortilla chips and chunky tomato-chili salsa.
watchOuts: Fried corn tortilla chips (sharp corn kernel hulls)
Spicy tomato salsa skins and seeds

items.name: Westbound Panama Canal "Land & Sea" Beef Tenderloin & Lobster Medallions Surf & Turf
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Westbound Panama Canal (Land and Sea Menu)
items.whyItWorks: Center-cut filet mignon paired with sweet poached lobster medallions is the ultimate zero-fiber, ultra-tender protein combination on the 14-night WBPC.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the beef tenderloin medium-rare to medium with plain olive oil and the lobster medallions steamed plain (drawn butter and béarnaise on the side) with baked potato or white rice.
watchOuts: Skip rich béarnaise and heavy drawn butter during flares

items.name: Whisps 100% Real Aged Parmesan Cheese Crisps
items.whyItWorks: Made with 100% copper-kettle aged parmesan cheese baked into crispy wafers. Aged cheese bacteria consume virtually all lactose, while containing 0g carbohydrates and 0g fiber. Pure protein and calcium crunch.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat straight from the pouch or crumble over smooth butternut squash soup.

items.name: WildFin Pan-Seared Pacific Halibut with Jasmine Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: WildFin American Grill (Mountain View Village · Riverton, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Halibut is an ultra-lean, mild white fish with delicate flaky flesh that is effortless for an inflamed intestine to absorb. Paired with steamed jasmine rice, it is one of the safest high-end dinners in Riverton.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Request halibut pan-seared with olive oil and salt only. Pair with plain steamed jasmine rice and skip asparagus spears or charred broccolini.

items.name: Zao Asian Cafe Seared Chicken Breast & Jasmine Rice Bowl
items.brandOrRestaurant: Zao Asian Cafe (Draper / Lehi / South Jordan)
items.whyItWorks: Seared lean chicken breast served over warm steamed white jasmine rice with light teriyaki glaze. Naturally dairy-free, low in fat, and devoid of tough vegetables or irritating seeds.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Build a custom bowl: Base of jasmine white rice, protein of seared chicken breast, light teriyaki sauce. Skip raw carrots, wok vegetables, edamame, and spicy dragon sauce.

items.name: 100% Pure Canned Pumpkin Puree (Unspiced)
items.whyItWorks: Pure canned pumpkin is steam-cooked and pureed into an ultra-smooth consistency. It is rich in soluble fiber that absorbs excess fluid in watery diarrhea without scraping inflamed tissue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Buy 100% pure pumpkin (such as Libby's), NOT sweetened pumpkin pie mix. Stir into oatmeal, blend into a gentle soup with chicken broth, or mix with white rice.
watchOuts: Do not confuse with Canned Pumpkin Pie Mix, which contains added sugar, cloves, allspice, and irritating spices.

items.name: Airheads Bars Original Fruit Chewy Taffy
items.whyItWorks: Stretchy fruit taffy made from sugar, corn syrup, maltodextrin, and modified food starch. Free of gluten, dairy, nuts, and gelatin, yielding zero fiber residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Chew slowly. A fun, fat-free sweet.
watchOuts: Avoid sour varieties during acute mouth or stomach ulcers.

items.name: Aubergine Kitchen (Orem & Lehi, UT) Warm Mediterranean Chicken & Rice Bowl
items.whyItWorks: Clean, anti-inflammatory Mediterranean cooking! Grilled antibiotic-free chicken breast, turmeric brown rice, roasted sweet potato cubes, and smooth hummus. Zero refined seed oils or artificial additives.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Warm Chicken Bowl with brown rice, roasted sweet potatoes, and hummus (hold raw cabbage, raw onions, and spicy tahini).
watchOuts: Hold raw cabbage and pickled onions

items.name: Canyon Bakehouse Gluten-Free Plain Bagels
items.whyItWorks: 100% whole grain brown rice, tapioca, and potato flour blend; free from gluten, dairy, nuts, and soy. Delivers the classic chewy boiled bagel experience without provoking immune or gluten sensitivities.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Slice and toast in a toaster oven for 3 minutes until crisp on the edges.

items.name: DCA Bayside Brews (Paradise Gardens) Warm Bavarian Soft Pretzel (No Cheese Sauce)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Bayside Brews (Paradise Gardens Park · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: Soft baked refined white-flour pretzel right along the Paradise Bay waterfront—100% dairy-free and low-residue when ordered without cheese.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the plain Bavarian Pretzel (no jalapeño/beer cheese sauce) and brush off excess coarse salt.
watchOuts: Skip the garlic-herb or spicy cheese Pretzel Bites when rotated in

items.name: Disneyland & DCA Warm Mickey-Shaped Soft Pretzel (Brush Off Coarse Salt, Skip Jalapeño Cheese)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Refreshment Corner & Pretzel Carts (Disneyland & California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: Warm baked refined white-flour pretzel dough has zero dairy, negligible fat, and zero insoluble fiber—making it the #1 emergency carb snack across both Disneyland and California Adventure.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a plain Classic Mickey Pretzel WITHOUT the plastic cup of jalapeño/processed cheese sauce (or try the sweet Cream Cheese-Filled Pretzel in Tomorrowland/Frontierland with a lactase tablet).
watchOuts: Skip the processed cheese dipping cup; keep a bit of pretzel salt for walking hydration

items.name: Downtown Disney Splitsville Luxury Lanes: Fresh Salmon Nigiri, California Roll & Grilled Chicken Rice Bowl
items.brandOrRestaurant: Splitsville Luxury Lanes (Downtown Disney District · Disneyland Resort)
items.whyItWorks: Splitsville actually has one of the best sushi bars and scratch kitchens in Downtown Disney: fresh Salmon Nigiri, plain California/Avocado Rolls, and a Grilled Chicken & White Rice bowl (ordered with mild teriyaki on the side, no broccoli/peppers).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the California Roll, Salmon Nigiri, or Grilled Chicken & White Rice Bowl (ask for plain grilled chicken and white rice only, no spicy volcano/sriracha mayo and no ponzu citrus sauce).
watchOuts: Skip Volcano Roll (spicy mayo) and any rolls with ponzu/lemon slices

items.name: Fody Foods Low-FODMAP Mild Salsa (Garlic & Onion-Free)
items.whyItWorks: Certified low-FODMAP salsa made with diced tomatoes, roasted jalapeño peppers (mild flavor without seeds), cumin, and cilantro, completely free from garlic and onions. Allows salsa lovers to enjoy tacos without painful fructan fermentation.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Spoon over grilled chicken, white rice bowls, or dip with plain Fritos corn chips.

items.name: Fresh Grilled Atlantic Salmon with Steamed Jasmine Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's at Bear Lake West (Fish Haven, ID)
items.whyItWorks: Flaky grilled salmon delivers easily digestible marine protein packed with gut-healing EPA/DHA omega-3 fatty acids. Served with fragrant steamed jasmine rice, it is exceptionally gentle on the digestive tract.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Request the salmon simply grilled with olive oil and salt, no blackened spices or creamy garlic sauces. Pair with steamed rice and skip steamed broccoli.

items.name: Frigo Cheese Heads String Cheese (Part-Skim Mozzarella)
items.whyItWorks: Natural part-skim mozzarella cheese undergoes curd separation during production, which removes nearly all whey and lactose (less than 0.1g lactose per stick). It delivers 6–7g of pure bioavailable protein and calcium without digestive strain.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel into fine thin strings to encourage slow eating and rapid enzymatic digestion. Safe for virtually all lactose-sensitive individuals.
watchOuts: High in casein protein; avoid if you have an IgE allergy to dairy protein.

items.name: Gatorade Thirst Quencher (Glacier Freeze or Cool Blue)
items.whyItWorks: Formulated with the optimal glucose-to-sodium ratio (sodium-glucose cotransport mechanism in the small intestine) to force water absorption through the intestinal wall even during active diarrhea.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Dilute 50/50 with cold water if the full-strength sugar concentration feels too sweet or stimulates stomach emptying.
watchOuts: Contains simple sugars; dilute 1:1 with water for ideal osmolarity during rapid diarrhea.

items.name: Gorton's Simply Bake Haddock Filets (Bake-in-Bag Mild White Fish)
items.whyItWorks: 100% wild haddock fillets seasoned lightly and sealed in parchment bake-bags. The fish steams gently in its own juices in the oven, with ZERO fried breading, under 2g fat, and zero fiber. Extremely light and flaky on sensitive intestines.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake in bag at 375°F for 24 minutes. Cut bag open and serve tender fish over white rice or mashed potatoes.
watchOuts: Zero fried batter; an exceptional, effortless lean seafood meal.

items.name: Kellogg's Eggo Homestyle Frozen Waffles (Toasted)
items.whyItWorks: Made from refined enriched wheat flour with a light, airy grid texture that crisps on the outside and stays fluffy inside. With just 1g fiber and low fat, it is a comforting, low-residue morning carb.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast until lightly golden (not dark or charred). Top with a dab of butter and 100% pure maple syrup.
watchOuts: Contains wheat and egg ingredients; chew well.

items.name: Kikkoman Less Sodium Soy Sauce (Naturally Brewed)
items.whyItWorks: Naturally brewed and aged, which breaks down soybean proteins into savory free glutamates. The 37% lower sodium level protects against dehydration and fluid retention, providing clean savory flavor over plain white rice.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drizzle 1–2 teaspoons over hot steamed Jasmine or Basmati white rice and poached eggs.
watchOuts: Contains wheat and soy; choose Tamari if following a gluten-free diet.

items.name: Kirkland Signature Wild Smoked Sockeye Salmon Lox (2 x 12 oz)
items.whyItWorks: Thinly sliced, cold-smoked wild Alaskan salmon melts in the mouth with zero chewing effort. High in natural omega-3 fats with zero rough fiber, making it an excellent topping for sourdough or plain bagels.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat chilled right from the pack. Note: High in natural salt; drink plenty of water alongside.

items.name: Knott's Boardwalk BBQ Rotisserie Half Chicken, Smoked Turkey or Pulled Pork with Mashed Potatoes & Cornbread
items.brandOrRestaurant: Boardwalk BBQ (The Boardwalk · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Boardwalk BBQ is arguably the cleanest quick-service kitchen inside Knott's Berry Farm: slow-roasted rotisserie half chicken, smoked turkey breast, or pulled pork served with whipped mashed potatoes and a soft cornbread muffin!
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the **Rotisserie Half Chicken** (remove the seasoned skin) or **Smoked Pulled Pork / Turkey** (no BBQ sauce) with **Mashed Potatoes** and the warm **Cornbread Muffin** (verify no whole corn kernels).
watchOuts: Take a lactase tablet for the mashed potatoes and ask for all BBQ sauces on the side

items.name: Knott's Ghost Town Grill Sliced Smoked Turkey Breast & Mashed Potatoes
items.whyItWorks: Thick slices of tender smoked turkey breast served with real mashed Idaho potatoes and poultry gravy. Very lean, bioavailable protein that requires minimal digestive breakdown.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Smoked Turkey Dinner with extra mashed potatoes; request gravy on top (hold cranberry relish).
watchOuts: Hold whole cranberry relish if served

items.name: Knott's Hotel Thirty Acres Kitchen Scrambled Eggs, Sourdough Toast, Roasted Chicken & Salmon
items.brandOrRestaurant: Thirty Acres Kitchen at Knott's Hotel (Buena Park · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Right at the Knott's Hotel steps from the park entrance, Thirty Acres Kitchen serves a calm sit-down breakfast (eggs any style, bacon, sourdough toast, oatmeal, pancakes) and dinner (herb-roasted chicken, salmon, mashed potatoes).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Start your park day here with two scrambled eggs, bacon/turkey sausage, and sourdough toast or buttermilk pancakes before entering the park.
watchOuts: Ask for noboysenberry seeded compote on pancakes/waffles

items.name: Knott's Panda Express (Boardwalk / Marketplace) Grilled Teriyaki Chicken & Double Steamed White Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: Panda Express (The Boardwalk · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Inside Knott's Boardwalk area, Panda Express's un-breaded Grilled Teriyaki Chicken thigh over 100% steamed white rice is dairy-free, citrus-free (unlike Orange Chicken!), and high in protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Bowl or Plate with **100% Steamed White Rice** (no Chow Mein cabbage/onions and no Fried Rice) and **Grilled Teriyaki Chicken** with the sweet teriyaki sauce packet on the side.
watchOuts: NEVER order Panda Express Orange Chicken (citrus orange peel + chili flakes + deep-fried breading) or Beijing Beef during flares

items.name: Kozy Shack All Natural Original Rice Pudding
items.whyItWorks: Simmered white rice in sweet milk and eggs creates a comforting, low-residue dessert. White rice provides easily absorbed complex carbs and soothing bulk.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy chilled or warm up in the microwave for 20 seconds. Take a lactase pill if sensitive.
watchOuts: Contains whole milk; ensure cooked rice grains are tender.

items.name: Mrs. Knott's Chicken-To-Go: Roasted or Fried Chicken Bucket, Pint of Mashed Potatoes, Soup & Hot Biscuits
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken-To-Go (California Marketplace · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Skip the 90-minute sit-down wait at Mrs. Knott's: the dedicated **Chicken-To-Go** counter right next door lets you walk up and buy individual pieces of Roasted or Fried Chicken, a quart of Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup, Mashed Potatoes, and a half-dozen hot Buttermilk Biscuits with seedless Boysenberry Jelly in 5 minutes!
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Roasted Chicken pieces (or peel the breading off the Fried Chicken), a pint of Mashed Potatoes (gravy on the side), Chicken Noodle Soup, and hot Buttermilk Biscuits to eat at the outdoor patio or take back to your hotel.
watchOuts: Ask for gravy on the side and take a lactase tablet for the mashed potatoes and biscuits

items.name: Organic Sweet Fennel Seed Herbal Infusion Tea
items.whyItWorks: Crushed sweet fennel seeds (*Foeniculum vulgare*) contain volatile oils rich in anethole, fenchone, and estragole. These compounds relax the smooth muscle tissue of the intestinal wall, helping trapped gas dissipate gently without spasms.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Steep 1 tea bag in freshly boiled water for 10 minutes. Sip slowly after meals to release painful postprandial gas.

items.name: Starbucks Marshmallow Dream Bar
items.whyItWorks: Certified gluten-free crispy puffed rice cereal bound with marshmallow fluff and butter. Contains 0g fiber, zero seeds, zero nuts, and zero citrus. One of the safest sweet snacks when traveling through airports or interstate rest stops.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab from the pastry case. Split in half if looking for a smaller sugar portion.

items.name: Steamed Peeled Parsnip Puree (Fork-Mashed)
items.whyItWorks: Parsnips are naturally sweet root vegetables. Once peeled and simmered until soft, they mash into a velvety puree that acts as a gentle, low-residue alternative to mashed potatoes.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel skin with a peeler, cut out any tough woody center core, and boil for 15 minutes. Mash with olive oil or broth.
watchOuts: Discard the central woody core of large mature parsnips before boiling.

items.name: Thomas' Original "Nooks & Crannies" English Muffins
items.whyItWorks: A beloved digestive staple! The airy, open-cell structure toasts up light and crisp. Contains only 1g fiber, 0g dairy, and zero seeds; dusted lightly with degerminated yellow cornmeal that does not trigger strictures.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Split with a fork (never cut with a knife) to preserve the crevices. Toast well and top with butter or a poached egg.

items.name: Tillamook Medium Cheddar Cheese (Naturally 0g Lactose)
items.whyItWorks: Traditional cheddar cheese undergoes natural aging and bacterial fermentation that completely consumes all lactose sugars (testing at 0g lactose per serving). Provides calcium and satisfying fat with zero lactose distress.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Melt over white bread for a gentle grilled cheese, or eat a slice with plain saltine crackers.
watchOuts: Rich in natural dairy fat; limit to 1–2 slices during active flare recovery.

items.name: Trader Joe's Steamed Chicken Soup Dumplings (Xiao Long Bao)
items.whyItWorks: One of the gentlest convenience meals at Trader Joe's. Steamed thin wheat dough pouches filled with ground chicken breast and gelatinized chicken broth. The meat is soft, the broth provides warm hydration, and the steamed wrapper is non-greasy and low in fiber (1g).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Microwave in the provided tray for 1 minute 45 seconds or steam on the stovetop. Poke a small hole to let hot soup cool slightly before eating. Dip in coconut aminos or low-sodium tamari.
watchOuts: Contains mild green onion and ginger in the filling; well-tolerated in remission and mild recovery.

items.name: Viva Chicken (Herriman / Mountain View Corridor) Peruvian Rotisserie Chicken & White Rice
items.whyItWorks: Right near Holiday Inn Express Herriman, Viva Chicken slow-roasts tender Peruvian rotisserie chicken over charcoal; pairing a quarter white-meat chicken (skin removed) with cilantro-free white rice and warm chicken tortilla-free soup or ripe sweet fried plantains (maduros) is delicious and flare-friendly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Quarter White Meat Rotisserie Chicken (remove the spiced skin if sensitive) with steamed white rice and sweet plantains (maduros)—skip the spicy Huacatay/Rocoto chili sauces and lime juice.
watchOuts: Skip all three Peruvian dipping sauces (Yellow Aji, Green Huacatay, and Red Rocoto—all contain chili peppers and/or lime juice)

items.name: Altoids Curiously Strong Peppermints
items.whyItWorks: Natural peppermint oil has clinically demonstrated antispasmodic properties on gastrointestinal smooth muscle, helping to alleviate painful intestinal cramping and trapped gas.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Dissolve 1 mint on the tongue after a meal to reduce postprandial intestinal spasms.
watchOuts: Peppermint relaxes the lower esophageal sphincter; avoid if you suffer from severe GERD or acid reflux.

items.name: Anaheim GardenWalk (Near Disneyland) P.F. Chang's Steamed Chicken/Shrimp Dumplings, Wonton Soup & White Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: P.F. Chang's & Cheesecake Factory (Anaheim GardenWalk · 1 Block East of Disneyland)
items.whyItWorks: One block from Disneyland at Anaheim GardenWalk, P.F. Chang's prepares Steamed Shrimp/Pork Dumplings, Wonton Soup, and Gluten-Free/Mild Ginger Chicken or Salmon with steamed white rice (and Cheesecake Factory next door has a huge SkinnyLicious Grilled Salmon/Chicken & White Rice menu).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: At P.F. Chang's, ask for Steamed Dumplings (no chili sauce), Wonton Soup, or Grilled/Steamed Chicken Breast & White Rice with sauce on the side.
watchOuts: Skip Chang's Spicy Chicken, Orange Peel Chicken (citrus!), and crispy green beans

items.name: Angie's Restaurant (Logan, UT) Angie's Diced Ham & Egg Scramble with Hash Browns
items.whyItWorks: Diced lean country ham scrambled gently into fresh eggs, served with well-browned shredded hash browns and sourdough toast. Simple, pure nutrition.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Angie's Scramble with hash browns and sourdough toast with butter.
watchOuts: None; classic low-residue breakfast

items.name: Angie's Restaurant Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup & Roast Beef French Dip
items.whyItWorks: Angie's tender egg-noodle chicken soup and thin-sliced roast beef French Dip on a soft hoagie roll dipped in warm au jus soften in the mouth and digest cleanly with minimal fat or fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a cup or bowl of Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup paired with a half or full Roast Beef French Dip (plain beef and Swiss cheese on the roll, dipped in warm au jus).
watchOuts: Au jus is high in sodium, which is helpful for hydration during flares, but skip creamy soups like broccoli cheddar unless taking lactase

items.name: Aubergine Kitchen (Mountain View Village Herriman / Lehi) Grilled Salmon or Chicken Bowl on White/Brown Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: Aubergine Kitchen (Mountain View Village / Riverton-Herriman & Lehi, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Aubergine Kitchen cooks 100% seed-oil-free (using only extra-virgin olive oil and avocado oil) with zero refined sugars; a build-your-own bowl with roasted salmon or grilled chicken, sweet potatoes, avocado, and rice is clean and anti-inflammatory.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Build a warm bowl with Grilled Salmon or Free-Range Chicken, roasted sweet potatoes, avocado, and rice—skip raw kale, raw red onions, and lemon-tahini dressing (use plain olive oil and sea salt).
watchOuts: Many house dressings contain lemon juice (citrus trigger)—dress with plain extra-virgin olive oil instead; skip raw kale and chickpea salads

items.name: Bibigo Steamed Chicken & Vegetable Dumplings (Tray with Dipping Sauce)
items.whyItWorks: Thin, delicate steamed wrappers filled with minced white chicken breast, cabbage, and soy sauce. The filling is pre-ground fine and steamed tender, requiring virtually zero digestive effort.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Tear corner of steam bag and microwave for 1 minute 45 seconds. Dip in low-sodium tamari or coconut aminos.
watchOuts: Filling contains mild alliums; well-tolerated in remission and mild symptoms.

items.name: Birds Eye Steamfresh Cut Green Beans (Microwave Steam Bag)
items.whyItWorks: Flash-frozen tender green beans that steam inside the sealed bag under gentle pressure. Steaming softens the outer cellulose pod walls, rendering them fork-tender, low-FODMAP, and non-bloating.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Microwave unopened bag for 4.5 minutes. Toss with a dab of butter and salt.
watchOuts: 100% pure green beans without added butter sauces or alliums.

items.name: Cheez-It Original Baked Snack Crackers
items.whyItWorks: Baked with real skim milk cheese and enriched flour. With only 1g fiber and light salt, they offer savory satisfaction without grease or roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy a single 1-oz serving (about 27 crackers). Chew until soft.
watchOuts: Contains wheat and dairy; moderate fat content (8g) is safe for remission and mild recovery.

items.name: Chick-fil-A Grilled Nuggets (8 or 12 count)
items.whyItWorks: Bite-sized boneless chicken breast grilled with a mild herb seasoning rather than deep-fried in peanut oil with heavy wheat batter. Delivers 25g pure protein, 1g fat, zero dairy, and zero insoluble fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order standard 8 or 12 count grilled nuggets. Request no dipping sauce or dip lightly in honey or yellow mustard rather than garlic-rich CFA sauce or spicy sriracha.

items.name: Claim Jumper Steakhouse (Buena Park — Across from Knott's) Rotisserie Chicken, Tri-Tip & Giant Baked Idaho Potato
items.brandOrRestaurant: Claim Jumper Steakhouse & Bar (Beach Blvd, Buena Park · Across from Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Directly across Beach Blvd from Knott's Berry Farm, Claim Jumper slow-roasts tender herb Rotisserie Chicken, Grilled Salmon, and Slow-Roasted Tri-Tip served with a 1-lb Baked Idaho Russet Potato or Mashed Potatoes.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Roasted Chicken Breast, Salmon, or Tri-Tip (BBQ sauce on the side) with a plain Baked Potato (eat the fluffy inside) and warm sourdough/honey bread.
watchOuts: Portions at Claim Jumper are huge—eat half and pack the rest for your hotel fridge

items.name: Colavita / Nonna Pia's Aged Balsamic Glaze (Smooth Reduction)
items.whyItWorks: Slow-simmered balsamic vinegar and cooked grape must reduced to a thick, syrupy glaze. Simmering burns off the sharp volatile acetic acid vapors that cause stomach burning in raw vinegar, leaving smooth, gentle sweet-tart flavor.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drizzle lightly over baked chicken breast, roasted carrots, or sourdough toast.
watchOuts: Contains cooked grape sugars; a light drizzle provides ample flavor.

items.name: DCA Aunt Cass Café Roasted Turkey Sandwich on Fresh Boudin Sourdough (No Pesto/Tomato Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Aunt Cass Café (San Fransokyo Square · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: Slices of oven-roasted turkey breast, bacon, and Havarti/provolone cheese on fresh-baked Boudin sourdough bread make one of the cleanest lunches in California Adventure.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Club on Sourdough (or the Kids' Turkey Sandwich on Sourdough) and ask for no pesto mayo, no raw tomato, and no shredded lettuce.
watchOuts: Standard adult sandwich includes garlic basil pesto aioli—request plain or order the Kids' Turkey Sandwich on Sourdough

items.name: DCA Carthay Circle Restaurant Thick-Cut Kurobuta Pork Chop & Polenta
items.whyItWorks: Fine dining at its peak in California Adventure! Kurobuta pork is intensely marbled, tender, and juicy. Paired with soft, creamy corn polenta and jus.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Kurobuta Pork Chop with polenta; request light sauce.
watchOuts: None; exceptionally tender heritage pork

items.name: DCA Lamplight Lounge Kids' Grilled Chicken/Burger Sliders or Plain Elbow Pasta with Butter & Parmesan
items.brandOrRestaurant: Lamplight Lounge (Pixar Pier · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: Even when Lamplight Lounge's adult menu leans spicy, any adult can order off the Kids' menu (or ask the kitchen for an adult portion): plain mini burger sliders on Hawaiian rolls, grilled chicken tenderloin, or elbow pasta with butter and Parmesan.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for the Kids' Burger Slider (plain cheddar & bun) or Pasta with butter and grated Parmesan (hold the cheese sauce if lactose-sensitive).
watchOuts: Zero spice or roughage—a great fallback when dining with friends at Pixar Pier

items.name: DCA Pym Test Kitchen Giant "Quantum Pretzel" (453.8g Warm Bavarian Sourdough Pretzel)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Pym Test Kitchen (Avengers Campus · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: A massive, pillowy-soft Bavarian-style pretzel baked with refined wheat flour—naturally dairy-free and very gentle on the gut when eaten plain without the sharp beer-cheese and mustard dips.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Share the giant Quantum Pretzel with your group, brush off excess coarse salt crystals, and leave the sharp beer-cheese sauce and whole-grain mustard in their cups.
watchOuts: Skip the beer-cheese sauce (dairy + onion/garlic) and coarse mustard seed dip

items.name: Del Monte Fruit Cocktail in 100% Juice or Water
items.whyItWorks: A classic hospital soft-diet item: diced peeled peaches, pears, seedless grapes, and cherry halves packed in light juice. Every fruit piece is skinless, seedless, and cooked until soft.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain packing juice. Eat with a spoon for easy, no-effort fruit calories.
watchOuts: Verify light juice or water pack rather than heavy corn syrup.

items.name: Disney's Grand Californian Hearthstone Lounge Prime Rib Dip on Brioche Roll or Pan-Seared Salmon
items.brandOrRestaurant: Hearthstone Lounge (Disney's Grand Californian Hotel & Spa · Steps from DCA)
items.whyItWorks: Just inside the Grand Californian lobby off DCA's Grizzly Peak exit, Hearthstone Lounge serves a tender shaved Prime Rib French Dip with provolone/Swiss and warm au jus (hold horseradish) plus pan-seared salmon and kids' plain pasta.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Prime Rib Dip with **NO horseradish cream** and **NO caramelized onions**, dipped in warm au jus so the roll melts in your mouth.
watchOuts: Always ask for no horseradish cream and no grilled onions

items.name: Disneyland Bengal Barbecue Bengal Beef Skewer (Sweet Zulu Glaze) & Steamed White Rice
items.whyItWorks: Tender marinated sirloin beef cubes glazed in a mild, non-spicy sweet Zulu sauce over fluffy steamed white rice give you warm, fryer-free energy for walking the park.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Bengal Beef Skewer (Sweet Zulu sauce—NOT the spicy Banyan sauce) with a side of plain steamed white rice, skipping the raw pickled citrus slaw on the plate.
watchOuts: Skip the raw pickled slaw on the Bengal Rice Plate (contains raw cabbage and citrus vinegar)

items.name: Disneyland Carnation Cafe Classic Mickey-Shaped Waffles & Scrambled Eggs
items.whyItWorks: Crisp, golden malted Mickey-shaped waffles paired with soft scrambled eggs and pure maple syrup. Completely seed-free, zero roughage, and highly digestible park fuel.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Mickey Waffles breakfast with scrambled eggs and bacon (or fruit cup with peeled melon).
watchOuts: None; gentle iconic Disney breakfast

items.name: Disneyland Hotel Goofy's Kitchen Character Buffet: Carved Prime Rib, Turkey, Mickey Waffles & Smooth PB&J Pizza
items.whyItWorks: Goofy's Kitchen has a dedicated omelet station, carving station (prime rib, roasted turkey breast, salmon), plain pasta, mashed potatoes, Mickey waffles, and even Goofy's famous creamy Peanut Butter & Seedless Grape Jelly Pizza.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Build your plate from the omelet bar (plain eggs or ham & cheddar), carving station, mashed potatoes, bananas, and allergy-friendly Mickey waffles.
watchOuts: Skip raw salad bar items, bacon-wrapped jalapeños, and soft-serve toppings with nuts/seeds

items.name: Disneyland Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe Oven-Roasted Turkey Breast Sandwich
items.brandOrRestaurant: Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Lean sliced turkey breast on soft white/brioche bread is non-greasy, dairy-free, and easy to pack in your park bag for a mid-day meal.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Oven-Roasted Turkey Sandwich (or the Kids' Turkey Sandwich with applesauce/banana) and remove any raw lettuce or tomato slices before eating.
watchOuts: Remove raw lettuce and tomato slices; ask for mustard/mayo packets on the side

items.name: Drink Wholesome Egg White Protein Powder (Vanilla)
items.whyItWorks: Formulated specifically for individuals with IBD, IBS, and sensitive stomachs. Made with only egg whites, chickpeas/coconut, monk fruit, and vanilla bean—zero gums, emulsifiers, artificial flavors, or sugar alcohols.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Shake or blend 1 scoop with 8-10 oz water or plant milk.

items.name: Ensure Compact Therapeutic Nutrition (4 fl oz)
items.whyItWorks: Condenses 220 calories and 9g protein into just 4 fluid ounces (half the normal volume). Ideal for patients who experience rapid fullness, nausea, or abdominal distention when consuming standard 8 oz liquid cans.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Chill and drink in just a few sips with meals or medications.

items.name: Fluffy Scrambled Eggs with Toasted Sourdough & Jam
items.whyItWorks: Farm fresh eggs scrambled soft in a non-stick pan provide top-tier bioavailable protein. Combined with toasted artisan sourdough bread and seedless strawberry or grape jam, it is ideal for Crohn's flare recovery.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Request eggs cooked soft with light cooking spray or oil, plain sourdough toast lightly buttered, and seedless jelly.

items.name: Fresh Honeydew Melon Slices
items.whyItWorks: Honeydew melon is over 90% water and provides naturally soft, smooth flesh with almost zero insoluble fiber when ripe. It is completely seedless in the edible portion and non-acidic, making it very gentle on inflamed intestines.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick ripe, fragrant melon with a slight give at the stem end. Cut away the rind generously and chew the pale green flesh thoroughly.
watchOuts: Avoid unripe, hard, crunchy melon that requires excessive mechanical digestive processing.

items.name: Fresh Ripe Papaya Slices
items.whyItWorks: Ripe papaya naturally contains papain, a proteolytic digestive enzyme that helps break down proteins and soothe gastric discomfort. The vibrant orange flesh is buttery soft and very easy on compromised intestines.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Scoop out and completely discard all black peppery seeds. Peel the skin cleanly and slice the buttery flesh into tender bite-sized cubes.
watchOuts: Never eat the black seeds, which are peppery and mechanically abrasive.

items.name: General Mills Original Cheerios (Toasted Oat O's)
items.whyItWorks: Made from finely milled whole grain oat flour, pureed and toasted into crisp rings that dissolve immediately in milk. Unlike raw oats, the beta-glucan soluble fiber is smooth and helps bind stool without scratching inflamed tissue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pour into a bowl with cold lactose-free milk, almond milk, or oat milk. Let sit for 60 seconds to soften before eating.
watchOuts: Contains soluble oat fiber; enjoy in standard 1-cup portions.

items.name: Grilled Marinated Chicken Breast with Steamed Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's at Bear Lake West (Fish Haven, ID)
items.whyItWorks: Tender skinless chicken breast marinated lightly in herbs and olive oil, grilled over open flame and served with fluffy white rice. Extremely gentle on sensitive intestinal mucosa.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for chicken simply grilled without blackened spices or heavy butter sauces. Pair with steamed rice and skip raw salad.

items.name: Hellmann's / Best Foods Real Mayonnaise
items.whyItWorks: Made from soybean oil, water, whole eggs and egg yolks, vinegar, and salt. It is an ultra-smooth emulsion containing 0g fiber, zero dairy, and zero lactose. Provides easy, calorie-dense fats to prevent weight loss during recovery without irritating the bowel.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Spread 1 tablespoon onto white bread for turkey sandwiches, or mix with drained canned tuna. Limit to 1–2 tablespoons if experiencing active bile acid malabsorption.
watchOuts: High in fat (10g per tablespoon); enjoy in moderate portions to avoid rapid gastric emptying.

items.name: Holiday Inn Express (Herriman, UT) Fluffy Folded Egg & Cheddar Cheese Omelet
items.brandOrRestaurant: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Herriman - South Jordan
items.whyItWorks: Individual folded egg omelet filled with melted cheddar cheese. Soft, zero-fiber, and delivers 12g of protein with no mechanical digestion required.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve warm with an English muffin or white toast with butter.
watchOuts: Contains melted cheddar cheese; order plain eggs if dairy-sensitive

items.name: Homemade Toaster-Oven Cinnamon Sugar Pita Chips
items.whyItWorks: Soft white pita bread sliced into triangles, brushed with light coconut oil or melted butter, dusted with cinnamon and sugar, and baked until crisp. Low in residue, seedless, and comforting.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake pita triangles at 375°F in a toaster oven for 6–8 minutes until crisp and golden.

items.name: Jelly Belly Assorted Gourmet Jelly Beans
items.whyItWorks: Jelly Belly beans use corn syrup, sugar, modified food starch, and natural flavorings. They are fat-free, gluten-free, peanut-free, and dissolve smoothly in the digestive tract.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Chew small handfuls slowly. Avoid super-sour flavors if you experience mouth ulcers or acid reflux.
watchOuts: Skip acidic citrus flavors (e.g., Sunkist lemon/lime) if sensitive to citric acid.

items.name: Kellogg's Rice Krispies Treats Original Marshmallow Square
items.whyItWorks: Combines toasted puffed white rice cereal with melted marshmallows and a small amount of butter. The puffed rice has virtually zero insoluble fiber and the marshmallow base is soft, chewable, and comforting.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: A fantastic on-the-go snack or lunchbox dessert when you need quick energy without digestive irritation.
watchOuts: Contains a tiny amount of milk whey in the butter flavor; safe for almost all lactose intolerances.

items.name: Kirkland Signature Organic Pure Maple Syrup (Grade A Amber)
items.whyItWorks: 100% pure maple syrup with zero high-fructose corn syrup, artificial colors, or chemical preservatives. It is balanced in glucose and sucrose, making it far gentler on small intestine absorption than artificial sweeteners or excessive raw honey.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drizzle moderately over plain oatmeal, pancakes, white toast, or waffles. Contains zero fat and zero rough fiber.

items.name: Knott's Calico Saloon & Pretzel Carts Warm Bavarian Soft Pretzel (Plain, No Cheese)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Calico Saloon & Ghost Town Pretzel Carts (Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Warm baked refined white-flour pretzel inside Calico Saloon or at the Ghost Town carts—zero dairy, zero citrus, and easy to snack on while watching the saloon show.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a plain Salted Pretzel (no cheese cup) and brush off excess coarse salt; if ordering Calico Saloon's famous Sarsaparilla, let the fizz settle if carbonation bloats you.
watchOuts: Avoid Boysenberry Punch/Lemonade if cut with lemon juice (citrus trigger)

items.name: Knott's Fireman's BBQ Open-Pit Flamed Half Chicken & Baked Potato
items.whyItWorks: Roasted over giant open-air wood pits right in Ghost Town. Half chicken seasoned with mild herbs, paired with an Idaho baked potato. Unbreaded, lean, and high in protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Flamed Half Chicken with a plain baked potato (eat the soft inside flesh with butter, skip potato skin).
watchOuts: Discard tough outer potato skin

items.name: Mo' Bettahs (Utah Locations) Tender Kalua Pig with Steamed White Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mo' Bettahs Hawaiian Style Food (Utah Locations)
items.whyItWorks: Slow-steamed smoked pork shoulder that falls apart with a fork. Lightly salted with Hawaiian sea salt, zero acidic sauces, and paired with fluffy white jasmine rice.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Kalua Pig plate with double white rice (substitute extra white rice for macaroni salad).
watchOuts: Substitute white rice for macaroni salad if gluten or mayo sensitive

items.name: Mo' Bettahs Hawaiian Style Food (Draper / Herriman / Lehi) Mini Teriyaki Chicken & Double White Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mo' Bettahs Hawaiian Style Food (Draper / Herriman / Lehi / Logan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: With locations in Draper, Herriman, Orem/Lindon, and Logan, Mo' Bettahs charbroiled Teriyaki Chicken Breast (or slow-roasted Kalua Pig) over two scoops of sticky steamed white rice is dairy-free, low-residue, and ready in minutes.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Mini or Regular Plate with Teriyaki Chicken Breast or Kalua Pig and ask for "all steamed white rice" (or half white rice, half soft macaroni salad if you tolerate mayo) with teriyaki sauce on the side.
watchOuts: Skip the breaded deep-fried Katsu Chicken and spicy Sriracha/volcano sauces during flares

items.name: Nature's Own Butterbread (Thick Sliced)
items.whyItWorks: Baked with real butter for rich flavor and tender crumb, completely free of high-fructose corn syrup and artificial preservatives. Low in dietary fiber (1g per slice) and seed-free.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy fresh from the loaf or toasted with a light smear of honey.

items.name: Pan-Roasted Sustainable Salmon with Glazed Carrots
items.whyItWorks: Pristine salmon filet pan-seared with olive oil delivers anti-inflammatory omega-3 fatty acids and gentle protein inside Pirates of the Caribbean. Tender braised carrots provide digestible beta-carotene without tough cell walls.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for salmon cooked with light olive oil and sea salt, skipping any spicy Cajun blackening rubs or heavy butter emulsion sauces.

items.name: Penny Ann's Two Eggs Any Style with Grilled Ham & White Toast
items.whyItWorks: Fresh eggs scrambled soft, a slice of grilled lean ham, and toasted white bread with seedless jelly. A quintessential flare-safe breakfast combo providing high-quality protein without grease.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Request eggs scrambled soft with light cooking spray, grilled ham steak, and plain white toast with jelly. Skip grilled hashbrowns.

items.name: PopCorners Kettle Corn Popped Corn Crisps
items.whyItWorks: Combines pure yellow corn, sunflower oil, cane sugar, and sea salt. Crisp and airy with zero pericarp hulls, providing gentle sweet-salty crunch with low residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy in portion-controlled bowls to keep simple sugars moderate.

items.name: Quaker Lightly Salted Gluten-Free Rice Crisps
items.whyItWorks: Bite-sized discs of puffed white and brown rice seasoned with sea salt. Gluten-free, zero dairy, zero trans fat, and melts in the mouth.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Great portable snack for work desks or road trips.

items.name: Roasted Butternut Squash Puree (Peeled & Blended)
items.whyItWorks: Roasted butternut squash yields sweet, velvety flesh loaded with vitamin A. Blending it into a silky soup or puree breaks down any remaining fiber strands, making it soothing and completely low-residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel tough tan rind and scoop out all seeds before roasting. Roast chunks until fork-tender and puree in a blender with warm broth and a pinch of salt.
watchOuts: Ensure all fibrous stringy seed pith and seeds are completely removed prior to blending.

items.name: Rold Gold Tiny Twists Original Pretzels
items.whyItWorks: Oven-baked from enriched wheat flour with only 1g of fat per serving. Free from seeds and whole grains; provides a light, salty crunch that is low in residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Chew thoroughly. Excellent salty snack when recovering from stomach upset.

items.name: Silk Unsweetened Plain Almond Milk
items.whyItWorks: Creamy, filtered, blanched almond milk that contains 0g lactose, 0g added sugar, and only 30 calories per cup. Fortified with calcium and vitamin D to protect bone density in IBD without the digestive burden of dairy fat.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve chilled. Pour over Cream of Rice, Cheerios, or blend into gentle fruit smoothies.

items.name: Teeccino Dandelion Caramel Nut Herbal Tea (Chicory-Free)
items.whyItWorks: Specifically blended for sensitive stomachs and IBD patients who must avoid prebiotic chicory root inulin. Made with roasted dandelion root, carob, and natural nut flavors; entirely alkaline and non-acidic.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Brew in a standard coffee maker or steep tea bag in boiling water for 5 minutes. Stir in unsweetened oat or almond milk.

items.name: Thomas2Go @ BambooHR (Lindon, UT) Build-Your-Own Grain Bowl (Grilled Chicken & White Rice)
items.whyItWorks: Build a custom flare-safe bowl: steamed white jasmine rice, warm grilled chicken breast cubes, and tender steamed zucchini/carrots with mild tamari sauce. Zero raw roughage or spicy dressings.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Select white rice base, double grilled chicken breast, steamed vegetables, and light olive oil or mild vinaigrette (avoid raw broccoli, beans, and spicy dressings).
watchOuts: Avoid raw cabbage, whole beans, and spicy sriracha dressings

items.name: Traditional Vanilla Caramel Flan / Egg Custard
items.whyItWorks: Baked egg, milk, and caramel sugar custard. Silky smooth, requiring zero mechanical chewing and melting into liquid. Free from nuts, seeds, and chocolate.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: A wonderful restaurant or home dessert. Take a lactase enzyme tablet for the condensed/evaporated milk base.
watchOuts: Contains dairy milk and eggs; take lactase if sensitive.

items.name: Trident Seafoods Wild Alaskan Salmon Burgers (Costco Frozen 12-Pack)
items.whyItWorks: Formed from 100% wild-caught Alaskan salmon with light seasoning and zero dairy or fillers. Rich in natural omega-3 fatty acids that dampen intestinal inflammation, serving as an easy burger alternative.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Cook directly from frozen on a lightly oiled skillet for 4-5 minutes per side. Serve on a plain white bun with light mayo or plain white rice.

items.name: Vita Coco Pure Coconut Water (Original)
items.whyItWorks: Pure natural coconut water with zero pulp, delivering 470mg of potassium and essential trace minerals per cup. Helps restore intracellular potassium lost through frequent loose stools without artificial dyes or syrups.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drink cold. If unaccustomed to coconut water, start with half a carton to ensure your colon adapts comfortably to natural potassium loads.

items.name: WildFin Cedar Plank King Salmon with Yukon Mashed Potatoes
items.brandOrRestaurant: WildFin American Grill (Mountain View Village · Riverton, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Wild salmon gently roasted on a natural cedar wood plank with sea salt and light glaze. High in marine omega-3s and paired with skinless, smooth Yukon Gold mashed potatoes.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for salmon prepared simply with light olive oil and salt, skipping any spicy rubs or rich butter sauces. Pair with peeled mashed potatoes.

items.name: Athenas Traditional White Pita Bread Pockets
items.whyItWorks: Traditional Middle Eastern flatbread baked at high heat from unbleached enriched flour. The puff forms a gentle pocket with under 1g fiber and zero seeds or whole grains.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm in a toaster or microwave for 15 seconds. Stuff with shredded chicken breast and cucumber slices.

items.name: Bam Bam's BBQ Central Texas Smoked Turkey Breast, Lean Brisket & Garlic Mashed Potatoes
items.brandOrRestaurant: Bam Bam's BBQ (Orem / Near BambooHR Lindon, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Just minutes from the BambooHR Lindon campus, Bam Bam's Central Texas-style post-oak-smoked Turkey Breast and Lean Brisket ("lean cut") are tender, un-sauced, and gluten-free.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Smoked Turkey Breast or Lean-Cut Brisket by the quarter/half pound with BBQ sauce on the side; scrape off any heavy coarse black-pepper bark edges and pair with a soft roll or potato salad/mashed potatoes.
watchOuts: Ask for "lean brisket" rather than "moist/fatty point cut" during sensitive days, and skip jalapeño cheddar sausage and raw coleslaw

items.name: Brach's Classic Candy Corn
items.whyItWorks: Despite its name, candy corn contains ZERO real corn kernels or corn hulls! It is pure honey, sugar, corn syrup, and marshmallow fondant that melts down completely into simple liquid sugars.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Safe seasonal Halloween treat for Crohn's patients who must avoid real sweet corn.
watchOuts: High glycemic index; limit portion size if managing steroid-induced hyperglycemia.

items.name: Breyers Lactose-Free Vanilla Ice Cream
items.whyItWorks: Made with 100% real cream and milk treated with the lactase enzyme to break down 99.9% of lactose disaccharides into simple glucose and galactose. Delivers authentic ice cream creaminess with zero dairy bloating or cramps.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Scoop a modest bowl (1/2 cup) for a cool, soothing throat and stomach treat.
watchOuts: Cold temperatures can trigger mild gastrocolic reflex spasms in hyper-motile individuals; eat slowly.

items.name: Chobani Plain Whole Milk Greek Yogurt (Strained Probiotic)
items.whyItWorks: Traditional Greek yogurt is triple-strained, which washes away most of the liquid whey and lactose. The active live yogurt cultures (S. thermophilus and L. bulgaricus) produce their own lactase, aiding digestion and supporting colonic mucosal healing in remission.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stir in a teaspoon of pure maple syrup or smooth seedless honey. Avoid varieties packed with chunky fruit seeds or acidic citrus purees.
watchOuts: Choose plain varieties to avoid added high-fructose corn syrup and seeded fruit compotes.

items.name: Cupbop Korean BBQ (Draper / Herriman / Lindon / Logan) "KKO KKO Bop" Chicken or "B Bop" Beef (Spice Level 1)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Cupbop Korean BBQ in a Cup (Draper / Herriman / Lindon / Logan, UT)
searchKeywords: korean bbq bowl draper herriman logan
items.whyItWorks: Cupbop's base of steamed white rice and sweet-potato glass noodles (japchae) topped with grilled chicken (KKO KKO Bop) or bulgogi beef (B Bop) at Spice Level 1 (0% chili heat, sweet-savory soy only) and "no cabbage" is an ultra-digestible Utah fast-casual staple.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order KKO KKO Bop (Grilled Chicken) or B Bop (Bulgogi Beef) at **Spice Level 1** (Sweet & Mild, no spicy sauce) and ask for **"No Cabbage"** so your bowl is strictly white rice, glass noodles, and meat.
watchOuts: Always specify "No Cabbage" (shredded raw cabbage is default) and stick to Spice Level 1 or 2—never order Level 5+ during a flare

items.name: Cutler's Cookies & Sandwiches (Draper / Salt Lake Area) Hot Roasted Turkey & Swiss on Soft White Bread
items.brandOrRestaurant: Cutler's Cookies & Sandwiches (Salt Lake / Draper Area, UT)
searchKeywords: roasted turkey sandwich salt lake draper
items.whyItWorks: Thick-sliced bakery white bread piled with real slow-roasted turkey breast and aged Swiss cheese alongside a cup of chicken noodle soup makes a gentle, home-cooked lunch.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Roasted Turkey Breast Sandwich on homemade white bread with Swiss cheese and light mayo (no lettuce or tomato); if grabbing a famous frosted cookie, share half a plain Sugar or Snickerdoodle cookie.
watchOuts: Skip broccoli cheese soup unless taking lactase, and avoid multi-grain seeded breads

items.name: Dandy Blend Instant Herbal Beverage with Dandelion (Coffee Alternative)
items.whyItWorks: Water-soluble extract of roasted barley, rye, dandelion, and chicory roots. Because it is a water extract, all gluten proteins and harsh insolubles are eliminated (<5 ppm gluten). Delivers a rich coffee flavor with zero acidity and zero caffeine.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stir 1 rounded teaspoon into hot water or warm almond milk. Dissolves instantly without brewing or grounds.

items.name: Disneyland Carnation Café Custom Ham & Aged Cheddar Omelet (Skip Walt's Chili Topping!)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Carnation Café (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Carnation Café cooks three-egg omelets to order; ordering yours with just aged cheddar and diced ham (holding Walt's spicy bean-and-beef chili) turns a trigger dish into a 8.7/10 protein breakfast.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for a plain Cheddar & Ham Omelet (or Egg-White Omelet) with NO chili topping, paired with breakfast potatoes and sourdough toast.
watchOuts: Never order Walt's Chili-Cheese Omelet with the chili on top during flares (beans + chili powder + tomatoes)

items.name: Disneyland Hotel Tangaroa Terrace Tonkotsu Ramen, Teriyaki Chicken & White Rice or Macadamia-Free Pancakes
items.brandOrRestaurant: Tangaroa Terrace Tropical Bar & Grill (Disneyland Hotel · Disneyland Resort)
items.whyItWorks: Right by the Disneyland Hotel pool (next to Trader Sam's), Tangaroa Terrace serves soothing Tonkotsu Ramen with soft wheat noodles, slow-roasted Kalua Pork or Teriyaki Chicken over steamed white rice, and thick fluffy Japanese-style soufflé pancakes.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: For lunch/dinner, order the Teriyaki Chicken/Kalua Pork & White Rice or Tonkotsu Ramen (no green onions or chili oil); for breakfast, order the American Breakfast (eggs, bacon, potatoes) or Thick Fluffy Pancakes with **NO macadamia nuts**.
watchOuts: Always ask for NO macadamia nuts on the Japanese pancakes and skip the spicy Poke Bowl

items.name: Disneyland Plaza Inn Penne Pasta with Plain Butter, Olive Oil & Parmesan (No Marinara Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Plaza Inn (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Refined semolina penne pasta served plain or with a touch of butter/olive oil and aged Parmesan cheese gives you a completely tomato-free, spice-free sit-down meal on Main Street.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: At the pasta station, ask for plain un-sauced penne pasta (available on both the adult and kids' station) topped only with grated Parmesan and a warm breadstick.
watchOuts: Skip both the acidic marinara sauce and the heavy garlic pesto cream sauce during flares

items.name: Disneyland Tiana's Palace Oven-Roasted Half Chicken & Plain Steamed White Rice (Hold Cajun Spice)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Tiana's Palace (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Tiana's Palace slow-roasts tender bone-in chicken and has plain steamed white rice behind the counter (used as the base for gumbos and kids' meals); peeling the spiced chicken skin reveals juicy, flare-safe white meat underneath.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Oven-Roasted Chicken (or the Kids' Roasted Chicken & White Rice plate), ask for plain steamed white rice instead of red beans/Carolina spicy rice, and remove the Cajun-seasoned chicken skin before eating.
watchOuts: Always swap out the red beans and spicy rice for plain steamed white rice, and remove the seasoned skin

items.name: Disneyland Troubadour Tavern (Fantasyland) Classic Butter, Cheddar & Bacon Baked Russet Potato
items.whyItWorks: Troubadour Tavern is Disneyland's dedicated baked-potato stand! A hot foil-baked Idaho Russet potato with butter, aged cheddar, and bacon bits (or pulled pork/chicken when featured) is an inexpensive, gluten-free, soluble-fiber gem.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Classic Baked Potato with butter, cheddar, and bacon—ask to hold the sour cream and raw green onions, and scoop out the soft potato interior while leaving the skin.
watchOuts: Leave the fibrous outer potato skin behind and ask for no raw green onions or spicy sauces

items.name: Dymatize ISO100 Hydrolyzed Whey Protein Powder (Gourmet Vanilla)
items.whyItWorks: Pre-hydrolyzed whey protein isolate that breaks long polypeptide chains into smaller peptide fractions for lightning-fast enzymatic assimilation. Contains <0.5g lactose and zero fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mix 1 scoop into 6-8 oz water or lactose-free milk using a handheld frother or shaker.

items.name: Ensure Original Nutrition Shake (Vanilla)
items.whyItWorks: Readily accessible oral nutritional supplement providing 220 calories, 9g protein, and essential micronutrients with minimal residue. Tested suitable for lactose intolerance (<0.5g lactose) and free of raw seeds or harsh insoluble fibers.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve chilled from the fridge. Drink in small sips rather than chugging to prevent osmotic fluid shifts in the small bowel.

items.name: Fresh Cantaloupe Slices (Rockmelon)
items.whyItWorks: Cantaloupe is rich in beta-carotene and potassium (replenishing electrolytes lost to diarrhea) while featuring tender, silky flesh that breaks down rapidly in gastric acid. The interior seeds are easily scooped out completely.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ensure seeds and stringy center core are fully discarded. Slice the soft orange flesh into bite-sized cubes and eat chilled.
watchOuts: Eat in modest portions (1 cup) to keep total fructose load comfortably balanced.

items.name: Freshly Baked San Francisco Sourdough Bread Loaf (Sliced)
items.whyItWorks: Authentic long-fermented sourdough made with flour, water, salt, and wild yeast culture. The fermentation process partially breaks down wheat proteins and starches, making it easier to tolerate than non-fermented commercial breads.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick up a fresh loaf or bread slices. Enjoy plain or with a light smear of butter. Discard any overly hard crust pieces.

items.name: Goodwood Barbecue Company (Draper) Slow-Smoked Turkey Breast or Rotisserie Chicken & Baked Idaho Potato
items.whyItWorks: Right down the street from TownePlace Suites Draper, Goodwood BBQ slow-smokes lean turkey breast and spit-roasts herb chicken; paired with a hot baked Idaho potato (eat the fluffy inside) and warm dinner roll, it is a very safe sit-down meal.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Hickory-Smoked Turkey Breast or Rotisserie Chicken (remove the skin, BBQ sauce on the side) with a plain Baked Potato (butter on the side) and skip the house salad/coleslaw.
watchOuts: Leave the baked potato skin behind and skip BBQ baked beans and raw slaw

items.name: Honey Maid Original Graham Crackers
items.whyItWorks: Graham crackers use finely milled graham flour and real honey. They provide gentle complex carbohydrates and melt into a soft porridge when dipped in warm tea, water, or lactose-free milk.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Break along the perforated lines into 4 rectangles. Dunk in warm peppermint or chamomile tea for an ultra-soothing stomach comfort snack.
watchOuts: Contains mild wheat bran; chew thoroughly.

items.name: King's Hawaiian Original Hawaiian Sweet Rolls
items.whyItWorks: Iconic pillowy soft rolls baked from enriched wheat flour, real butter, and pure cane sugar. The cloud-like texture dissolves easily upon chewing, leaving virtually zero digestive residue in the small bowel.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve warm by placing rolls in a 350°F oven for 2–3 minutes. Perfect for leftover turkey or roasted chicken sliders.

items.name: Kneaders Hearty Chicken Noodle Soup with Fresh Bakery Roll
items.whyItWorks: Tender pulled chicken breast, thick egg noodles, and soft cooked carrots in a soothing chicken broth alongside a freshly baked soft white roll. Ideal warm comfort food for sensitive digestive days.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a cup or bowl of chicken noodle soup with a plain soft white dinner roll. Highly comforting and low-residue.

items.name: Knott's Mrs. Knott's Oven Herb-Roasted Half Chicken (Gluten-Friendly Alternative)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: The smart IBD alternative to heavy fried chicken! Half chicken seasoned with herbs and slow-roasted in the oven until tender and juicy. Pure unbreaded protein with smooth mashed potatoes.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Herb-Roasted Chicken Dinner with real mashed potatoes and poultry gravy (sub extra potatoes for whole kernel corn).
watchOuts: Substitute extra mashed potatoes for the whole kernel sweet corn

items.name: Lean Cuisine Favorites Glazed Chicken with White Rice & Green Beans
items.whyItWorks: One of the cleanest frozen meals in the grocery store: tender white meat chicken tenderloins in a sweet lemon-tarragon glaze, served over white rice and soft green beans. Very low in fat (under 4g) and low in sodium.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Microwave for 4 minutes. Stir chicken and rice into the glaze before eating.
watchOuts: A gentle, low-fat frozen meal ideal for fatigue days.

items.name: Lee Kum Kee Premium Oyster Flavored Sauce
items.whyItWorks: Made from true oyster extracts simmered until caramelized and thickened with modified corn starch. It has a silky smooth consistency with zero fiber, providing rich savory flavor for plain rice and noodles.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stir 1 tablespoon into cooked white rice, soft noodles, or steamed baby carrots and chicken.
watchOuts: Rich in flavor; a small spoonful goes a long way.

items.name: Lundberg Family Farms Organic Thin Stackers (Lightly Salted Rice Cakes)
items.whyItWorks: Puffed brown and white rice crisped into ultra-thin stackable crackers. Puffed starch expands cell walls making them fragile and quick to dissolve upon chewing, satisfying crunch cravings without stricture danger.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat straight from the pack or spread with smooth sunflower seed butter or honey.

items.name: Member's Mark Artisan Sourdough Sandwich Bread (2-Pack)
items.whyItWorks: Pre-sliced sourdough bread made with fermented starter. The fermentation process lowers gluten elasticity and fructan content, easing digestion compared to standard sandwich white bread.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast lightly for breakfast toast or sandwiches. Soft crumb is very easy to chew.

items.name: Member's Mark Atlantic Salmon Burgers (Frozen 8-Pack)
items.whyItWorks: Atlantic salmon patties ground with light seasoning. They cook up moist and flaky, providing bioavailable anti-inflammatory marine fats without tough meat fibers.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pan-sear in a nonstick skillet with a little olive oil. Serve on a plain brioche or white hamburger bun.

items.name: Mrs. Knott's Open-Faced Hot Roast Turkey Sandwich with Mashed Potatoes
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (California Marketplace · Knott's Berry Farm)
searchKeywords: hot roast turkey knotts berry farm
items.whyItWorks: Thick-sliced roasted turkey breast over soft white bread with whipped mashed potatoes is lean, un-fried, and low-residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the turkey gravy on the side so you can keep the bread and mashed potatoes as light as you like.
watchOuts: Mashed potatoes contain milk/butter—take a lactase enzyme

items.name: Post-Holiday Turkey & Mashed Potato Shepherd's Pie Casserole
items.whyItWorks: Diced leftover roast turkey breast simmered in mild turkey gravy with soft cooked carrots, topped with fluffy mashed potatoes and baked golden. Soft, satisfying comfort.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake until golden and bubbly; ensure no whole corn kernels or peas are added to the filling.
watchOuts: Omit whole corn kernels and peas during flareups

items.name: Ritz Crisp & Thins Oven-Baked Potato and Wheat Chips
items.whyItWorks: Ultra-thin, oven-baked crisps made from potato and wheat flour with 50% less fat than standard chips. Fragile structure dissolves quickly upon chewing.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat straight from the bag. A gentle alternative to greasy fried potato chips.

items.name: Sensible Portions Garden Veggie Straws (Sea Salt)
items.whyItWorks: Despite the 'veggie' marketing, these straws are primarily potato starch and corn flour tinted with tomato and spinach powders. They have a hollow airy tube shape that collapses easily upon chewing with zero whole vegetable fibers.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: A light, crunchy, gluten-free snack with 30% less fat than standard potato chips.
watchOuts: Safe for remission and recovery; ensure adequate hydration.

items.name: Starburst Original Fruit Chews
items.whyItWorks: Soft, chewy fruit-flavored squares made with corn syrup, sugar, and fruit juice. They are naturally gluten-free, fat-free, and contain 0g fiber, breaking down cleanly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Unwrap and chew thoroughly. A great portable sweet for pockets or backpacks.
watchOuts: High in sugar; eat in moderation.

items.name: Subway Oven-Roasted Turkey Breast on Artisan Italian White
items.whyItWorks: Sliced lean oven-roasted turkey breast served on soft Artisan Italian white bread (refined white flour, low in fiber and seedless). Ordered plain or with light olive oil and salt, it is dairy-free, citrus-free, and remarkably soothing.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: "6-inch Turkey on Artisan Italian white bread. Not toasted. No cheese, no onions, no jalapeños, no peppers. Add light olive oil and a dash of oregano or salt."

items.name: Thai Kitchen Organic Lite Coconut Milk (Canned)
items.whyItWorks: Made from pure pressed coconut meat blended with filtered water (60% less fat than regular coconut milk). Contains easily assimilated Medium Chain Triglycerides (MCTs), zero lactose, and zero fiber. Makes creamy soups and rice bowls flare-safe.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Shake can well before opening. Simmer with chicken bone broth and jasmine rice for an ultra-gentle comforting dinner.

items.name: Thomas2Go @ BambooHR (Lindon, UT) Grab-and-Go Hard-Boiled Egg & Cheddar Snack Pack
items.whyItWorks: Peeled hard-boiled egg paired with cubes of naturally low-lactose sharp cheddar cheese. Convenient office snack that stabilizes blood sugar without roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick up from the grab-and-go cooler for a midday desk snack.
watchOuts: None; clean protein snack

items.name: TJ's Grill (Montpelier, ID) Charbroiled Flat Iron Steak & Baked Idaho Potato
