items.whyItWorks: Flat iron steak is naturally uniform, tender, and lean with no tough connective gristle. Charbroiled with sea salt and paired with fluffy baked Idaho potato flesh.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Flat Iron Steak cooked medium with a baked potato (eat the soft inside flesh with butter, skip potato skin).
watchOuts: Discard tough potato skin

items.name: TownePlace Suites (Draper, UT) Warm Oatmeal Station with Brown Sugar & Fresh Banana
items.brandOrRestaurant: TownePlace Suites Salt Lake City Draper
items.whyItWorks: Warm rolled oats provide gut-soothing soluble fiber (beta-glucan) that forms smooth stool bulk without scratching. Sliced fresh banana provides natural potassium.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ladle hot oatmeal into a bowl, stir in a spoonful of brown sugar, and slice a fresh ripe banana on top (pass on almonds and dried cranberries).
watchOuts: Skip whole almonds, walnuts, and granola toppings if stricturing

items.name: Tucanos Brazilian Grill (Orem, UT) Churrasco Grilled Picanha (Top Sirloin) & White Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: Tucanos Brazilian Grill (Orem / University Place, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Traditional Brazilian top sirloin roasted on rotisserie skewers with coarse sea salt. Pure, unbreaded, high-iron beef paired with Brazilian white rice and black bean broth.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Request slices of Picanha medium with sea salt; pair with steamed white rice (pass on spicy marinated cuts and raw salad bar onions).
watchOuts: Eat slowly to avoid gastric volume distension from endless skewer service

items.name: Zao Asian Cafe (Draper & South Jordan, UT) Seared Flank Steak & Jasmine Rice Bowl
items.brandOrRestaurant: Zao Asian Cafe (Draper & South Jordan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Tender wok-seared flank steak slices served over fluffy white jasmine rice with steamed carrots. Mild teriyaki glaze adds flavor without chili heat or seeds.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Select white jasmine rice base, seared steak, steamed carrots, and mild teriyaki sauce (hold raw cabbage slaw, jalapeños, and chili paste).
watchOuts: Avoid raw cabbage slaw and spicy chili sambal sauces

items.name: Amy's Kitchen Gluten-Free Dairy-Free Rice Mac & Cheeze (Vegan Cheeze)
items.whyItWorks: The ultimate dual-allergy comfort meal: certified gluten-free rice macaroni combined with dairy-free cheddar-style cheeze. Contains zero milk, zero lactose, zero wheat, and minimal fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Microwave for 4–5 minutes until piping hot and bubbly. Stir well before eating.
watchOuts: Safe for individuals with severe primary lactose intolerance or cow's milk protein allergies.

items.name: BambooHR Café (Thomas2Go) Grill Station: Plain Smashburger or Grilled Chicken Sandwich
items.brandOrRestaurant: Thomas2Go / Thomas Cuisine Café at BambooHR (Lindon, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Ordering a fresh-off-the-grill herb-free chicken breast or single beef patty with aged cheddar or Swiss on a soft brioche/potato bun at the BambooHR café grill station avoids the hidden garlic, citrus dressings, and spicy sauces in daily specials.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the grill cook for a plain Grilled Chicken Breast or Single Cheeseburger with cheddar or Swiss on a soft bun—skip raw red onion, tomato, pickles, and chipotle/garlic aioli.
watchOuts: Skip seasoned curly/waffle fries if coated in paprika/onion batter; pair with a banana or plain kettle chips

items.name: Black Bear Diner (Draper / American Fork) Slow-Cooked Pot Roast, Roasted Turkey Dinner or Sweet Cream Pancakes
items.brandOrRestaurant: Black Bear Diner (Draper / American Fork / Ogden, UT)
searchKeywords: black bear diner pot roast turkey
items.whyItWorks: Located right off I-15 in Draper near TownePlace Suites, Black Bear Diner serves homestyle Roasted Turkey Breast Dinner, fork-tender Old-Fashioned Pot Roast with mashed potatoes and cooked carrots, and "Little Less" smaller-portion Sweet Cream Pancakes & Scrambled Eggs all day.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order from the "Little Less" smaller-portion menu so you aren't overwhelmed by giant diner portions: choose Roasted Turkey or Pot Roast with mashed potatoes (gravy on the side) and a soft biscuit, or 2 Scrambled Eggs with 1 Sweet Cream Pancake.
watchOuts: Standard Black Bear portions are massive—order from the smaller "Grizzly/Cub/Little Less" section and ask for gravy on the side

items.name: Boost Original Complete Nutritional Drink (Rich Chocolate)
items.whyItWorks: Nutritionally complete meal drink with 240 calories and 10g protein. Suitable for lactose intolerance, gluten-free, and delivers 27 key vitamins and minerals including zinc and vitamin D.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve cold. Shake carton well prior to opening.

items.name: Broulim's Supermarket Fresh Deli California Roll & Steamed Rice
items.whyItWorks: Seasoned white sushi rice, cooked imitation crab (white fish surimi), and creamy avocado in a grab-and-go tray from Broulim's deli make a clean, non-greasy road-trip meal.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab a plain California Roll or Cooked Shrimp Roll from the deli case (avoid spicy mayo, tempura crunch, and cream cheese rolls).
watchOuts: Skip wasabi and spicy mayo drizzle; remove cucumber strips if strict low-residue

items.name: Café Rio Seasoned Cilantro Lime Rice Side Bowl
items.brandOrRestaurant: Café Rio Mexican Grill (Utah County / Salt Lake)
items.whyItWorks: Steamed long-grain white rice infused with mild vegetable broth, light oil, and finely chopped cilantro. It is low in residue and very soothing to hyperactive bowels.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for a side bowl of cilantro lime rice without cheese topping.

items.name: Café Zupas (Draper / Riverton-Herriman / Orem / Logan) Turkey Bacon Avocado Sandwich & Chicken Noodle Soup
items.brandOrRestaurant: Café Zupas (Draper / Riverton / Orem / Logan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Located across Logan, Orem (near BambooHR), Draper, and Riverton/Herriman, Café Zupas' Turkey Bacon Avocado Sandwich on soft white cottage bread paired with Chickpea & Vegetable-free Chicken Noodle Soup and a soft white bread roll is an easy, repeatable Try-2 combo.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Try-2 Combo with a Turkey Bacon Avocado Sandwich on white bread (ask for no tomatoes or sprouts) and a cup of Chicken Noodle Soup (Plus the complimentary soft white roll; give away or save the chocolate-dipped strawberry if avoiding berry seeds).
watchOuts: The complimentary chocolate-covered strawberry has tiny insoluble seeds on the outside—eat just the chocolate tip or skip during flares

items.name: Canned Mandarin Oranges in Light Juice or Water
items.whyItWorks: Unlike fresh oranges with tough fibrous white pith and membranes, commercial canned mandarins undergo an enzymatic peeling process that dissolves all exterior stringy membranes. The soft juicy vesicles slip down easily with minimal fiber (1g).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain packing juice to reduce excess simple sugars. Enjoy chilled as a light refreshing fruit side.
watchOuts: Contains mild natural citric acid; avoid during acute gastritis or active flare-ups.

items.name: Chick-fil-A Chicken Noodle Soup
items.whyItWorks: A classic road-trip soothing bowl made with tender shredded chicken breast, soft egg noodles, and diced carrots simmered in chicken broth. Gentle on an irritated digestive tract and easily digested.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for a bowl with a spoon. Skip the saltine crackers if sensitive to gluten, or crush a few into the broth.

items.name: Cooper's Restaurant (Fish Haven, ID) Charbroiled New York Strip Steak & Idaho Potato
items.brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's Restaurant & Sports Bar (Fish Haven / Bear Lake West, ID)
items.whyItWorks: Lean hand-cut New York strip steak charbroiled with sea salt and cracked pepper. Rich in bioavailable iron and zinc, paired with fluffy Idaho potato flesh.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the New York Strip medium with a plain baked Idaho potato (eat the soft inside flesh with butter, skip tough potato skins).
watchOuts: Chew steak thoroughly and discard tough outer potato skin

items.name: Costco Kirkland Deli Fresh Atlantic Salmon Milano (Scrape Off Half Herb Butter)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Costco Wholesale Deli (Logan / Lehi / South Jordan / Sandy, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Thick, skinless Atlantic salmon fillets in Costco's take-and-bake deli case are packed with anti-inflammatory omega-3 fatty acids; removing half of the basil pesto butter puck keeps fat and garlic mild while baking up tender in 25 minutes.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Before baking at 400°F, remove half or two-thirds of the basil-pesto butter rounds on top of the salmon (or bake the fillets with just olive oil and salt) and serve over white jasmine rice.
watchOuts: The basil pesto butter medalions contain dairy butter and garlic—use only a small slice of the butter during sensitive periods

items.name: Custom Deli Turkey & Provolone on Sourdough Bread
items.whyItWorks: At the made-to-order deli station, slicing lean oven-roasted turkey and aged provolone (low lactose) onto soft artisan sourdough bread creates an easily digested, protein-rich meal with zero irritating raw vegetables.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order turkey and provolone on sourdough. Skip raw onions, tomatoes, lettuce, hot peppers, and spicy mustard. Mayonnaise or light olive oil is usually tolerated.

items.name: DCA Lamplight Lounge Pan-Seared Salmon BLT on Grilled Sourdough Bread
items.whyItWorks: Pan-seared Atlantic salmon fillet, crispy bacon, and roasted garlic aioli on toasted fermented sourdough bread. Salmon delivers therapeutic anti-inflammatory omega-3 fatty acids.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Salmon BLT on sourdough; ask to hold sliced tomatoes and raw greens if sensitive.
watchOuts: Hold raw tomato slices during sensitive phases

items.name: DCA Pym Test Kitchen "Calculated Breakfast = E x 2 + (B + P)/T" (Scrambled Eggs, Bacon, Tots & Focaccia)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Pym Test Kitchen (Avengers Campus · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: The best rope-drop breakfast in Disney California Adventure: two warm scrambled eggs, smoked bacon, crispy potato bites, and soft focaccia toast with zero dairy, zero citrus, and zero spice.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mobile-order the "Calculated Breakfast" (or Kids' Spoonful of Cereal / Cinnamon French Toast) before 10:30 AM in Avengers Campus.
watchOuts: Avoid the Cinna-Pym Toast if sensitive to heavy cinnamon-sugar syrup and fried bacon crumble toppings

items.name: DCA Sonoma Terrace & Mendocino Terrace Warm Bavarian Pretzel & Aged Cheese Plate
items.brandOrRestaurant: Sonoma Terrace & Mendocino Terrace (Performance Corridor · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: Shaded winery patios offering warm Bavarian pretzels and Mediterranean snack boxes with aged cheeses and crackers.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Bavarian Pretzel plain, or eat the aged cheeses and crackers from the snack plate (skipping olives, almonds, and dried apricots).
watchOuts: Skip whole nuts, olives, and dried fruit on the charcuterie tray

items.name: Disneyland Cafe Orleans Roasted Chicken or Petite Steak with Potatoes/Rice (No Blackening Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Cafe Orleans (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Ordering the roasted chicken breast or steak entrée (or the Kids' Grilled Chicken & Rice) without Cajun pepper seasoning gives you a lean, freshly cooked table-service meal.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Request your chicken or steak prepared plain without Creole/Cajun pepper rub, and swap garlic-parmesan Pommes Frites for plain fries, mashed potatoes, or white rice.
watchOuts: Standard Pommes Frites are tossed in minced raw garlic and herbs—ask for plain fries or rice instead

items.name: Disneyland Carnation Café Mickey-Shaped Waffle or Buttermilk Pancakes with Scrambled Eggs
items.brandOrRestaurant: Carnation Café (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Golden Mickey waffle or fluffy buttermilk pancakes paired with two scrambled eggs and turkey/pork bacon gives you a relaxed table-service breakfast with zero roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Mickey-Shaped Waffle with scrambled eggs and maple syrup (skip the seeded berry compote topping; allergy-friendly dairy-free waffles available on request).
watchOuts: Ask for maple syrup instead of spiced apple or seeded berry toppings

items.name: Disneyland Carnation Café Roasted Turkey Club Sandwich on Toasted Sourdough
items.brandOrRestaurant: Carnation Café (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Stacks lean roasted turkey breast, bacon, and creamy avocado on toasted sourdough bread for a reliable sit-down lunch.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Club on sourdough with mayo on the side and ask to hold the raw tomatoes and shredded iceberg lettuce.
watchOuts: Skip the fried pickles starter and ask for no raw tomato/lettuce on the sandwich

items.name: Disneyland Red Rose Taverne Morning Buttermilk Pancakes, Scrambled Eggs & Bacon Platter
items.whyItWorks: One of the easiest mobile-order hot breakfasts in Disneyland: soft buttermilk pancakes, fluffy scrambled eggs, and bacon with zero spicy sauces or roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pancake Platter with scrambled eggs and bacon (skip the seasonal berry compote if it has seeds and use plain maple syrup).
watchOuts: Pancakes contain buttermilk—take a lactase enzyme if needed

items.name: French's Classic Yellow Mustard (Smooth Stone-Ground)
items.whyItWorks: Made from finely milled #1 grade mustard seeds, distilled vinegar, water, salt, and turmeric. The seeds are stone-ground into a silky paste with zero whole seeds or abrasive grit, and natural turmeric provides gentle curcumin.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Squirt 1–2 teaspoons onto roasted chicken breast, turkey sandwiches, or soft pretzel sticks.
watchOuts: Contains distilled vinegar; if you have severe active stomach ulcers, use sparingly.

items.name: Fresh Ripe Hass Avocado (Mashed or Sliced)
items.whyItWorks: Rich in calorie-dense monounsaturated oleic fatty acids and potassium, ripe avocado provides crucial calories and micronutrients when weight loss has occurred. Its fiber is mostly soluble, yielding a silky, non-abrasive puree.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat 1/4 to 1/2 ripe avocado mashed onto white sourdough toast, white rice, or sliced alongside eggs. Mash with a fork to ensure smooth breakdown.
watchOuts: Contains sorbitol and high healthy fat; limit portion to 1/4 or 1/2 avocado at a time to prevent rapid bile dumping.

items.name: Goetze's Caramel Creams (Bullseyes Chewy Caramels)
items.whyItWorks: Unlike sticky tooth-pulling caramels, Goetze's Caramel Creams are made with wheat flour, giving them a soft, cake-like chew with a creamy vanilla center. Low residue and gentle.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Chew slowly. A wonderful old-school comfort candy that avoids chocolate and nuts.
watchOuts: Contains wheat flour and milk.

items.name: Holiday Charcuterie Grazing Plate — Aged White Cheddar, Gruyère, Prosciutto & Water Crackers
items.whyItWorks: Lets you graze safely at holiday parties by picking aged cheeses (2-year White Cheddar, Gruyère, Parmigiano-Reggiano, Gouda—all naturally lactose-safe), paper-thin prosciutto or turkey breast, and plain water or Ritz crackers.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Build your plate from the aged hard cheeses, thin prosciutto or deli turkey, and plain refined-wheat crackers—skip whole nuts, dried apricots/cranberries, seeded crackers, and peppercorn salami.
watchOuts: Avoid raw crudité veggies, whole almonds/pistachios, seeded multigrain crackers, olives, and spicy calabrese salami

items.name: Holiday Inn Express (Herriman, UT) Automated One-Touch Warm Pancakes
items.brandOrRestaurant: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Herriman - South Jordan
items.whyItWorks: The famous Holiday Inn Express one-touch pancake machine dispenses warm, fluffy, evenly cooked pancakes in under 60 seconds. Soft, seed-free, and easy on digestion.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Press the button for 2 warm pancakes; drizzle with warm syrup and butter.
watchOuts: None; reliable and soft travel carbohydrate

items.name: Homemade Smooth Garlic-Free Hummus (Blended Chickpea Puree)
items.whyItWorks: Made by boiling canned chickpeas with a pinch of baking soda so the skins slip off, then blending the inner flesh velvety smooth with extra-virgin olive oil, cumin, and sea salt with ZERO raw garlic. High protein and gentle.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer canned chickpeas for 10 minutes, pinch off loose skins, and puree in a food processor with 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp warm water, and 1/2 tsp salt until ultra-creamy.

items.name: Kikkoman Sweet Teriyaki Glaze & Marinade (Strained)
items.whyItWorks: A smooth reduction of brewed soy sauce, sugar, wine, and vinegar with all seeds and coarse ginger/garlic chunks strained out. Delivers sweet savory glaze flavor that adheres to lean chicken breast.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Brush a light tablespoon over chicken or salmon during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
watchOuts: Contains sugar and mild wine vinegar; avoid drowning food in sauce.

items.name: Kirkland Signature Artisan Country French Sourdough Bread
items.whyItWorks: Made with wild sourdough starter, water, flour, and salt. The slow 24-hour lactobacillus fermentation degrades fructans and wheat phytates, making authentic sourdough exceptionally gentle on sensitive IBD bowels.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Slice and toast lightly. Discard overly hard or charred outer crust edges if dealing with active strictures.

items.name: Knott's Boardwalk BBQ Hickory-Smoked Half Chicken Platter
items.whyItWorks: Slow-smoked half chicken with tender white and dark meat. Unbreaded, naturally lean, and low-residue. Great protein source during long park walking days.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Smoked Half Chicken with baked macaroni & cheese or white bread; peel off crispy skin if feeling sensitive.
watchOuts: None; lean, satisfying protein

items.name: Knott's Ghost Town Grill Slow-Roasted Tri-Tip Platter or Turkey Club on Sourdough
items.brandOrRestaurant: Ghost Town Grill (Ghost Town · Knott's Berry Farm)
searchKeywords: knotts sit down restaurant inside park
items.whyItWorks: Knott's best full-service restaurant inside the park gates (and accepts the Dining Plan!): offers a classic Roasted Turkey Club on toasted sourdough, grilled chicken breast, or Tri-Tip with mashed/baked potatoes in air-conditioned comfort.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Club on Sourdough (no tomato or lettuce) with fries or mashed potatoes, or the Tri-Tip/Grilled Chicken entrée with sauce on the side.
watchOuts: Skip the raw coleslaw and ask for boysenberry BBQ glaze on the side

items.name: Knott's Miner's Mac & Spuds Giant Baked Idaho Potato with Butter, Cheddar & Grilled Chicken/Pulled Pork
items.brandOrRestaurant: Miner's Mac & Spuds (Ghost Town · Knott's Berry Farm)
searchKeywords: giant baked potato knotts berry farm
items.whyItWorks: Right across from GhostRider, Miner's Mac & Spuds bakes massive fluffy Idaho Russet potatoes—ordering yours topped simply with butter, shredded cheddar, and diced chicken or pulled pork (no sauce/slaw) is one of the best gluten-free meals in the park.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for a Giant Baked Potato topped ONLY with butter, shredded cheddar cheese, and plain diced chicken or pulled pork—hold the green onions, sour cream, chili, broccoli stems, and crispy fried onion strings, and eat the soft potato flesh.
watchOuts: Leave the fibrous outer potato skin behind, and avoid the Chili & Fritos potato

items.name: Le Nonne (Logan, UT) Handcrafted Potato Gnocchi in Butter & Parmigiano
items.whyItWorks: Logan's fine dining Italian gem! Pillowy handcrafted potato dumplings gently simmered and tossed in browned butter and aged Parmigiano Reggiano. Aged parmesan is naturally lactose-free.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Potato Gnocchi with butter and parmesan cheese (hold rich gorgonzola or heavy garlic sauces).
watchOuts: None; pillow-soft low-residue pasta

items.name: Lee's Marketplace Deli Rotisserie Chicken, Mashed Potatoes & Famous Glazed Donut
items.brandOrRestaurant: Lee's Marketplace (Logan / North Logan / Smithfield, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Lee's Marketplace hot deli offers plain herb-roasted rotisserie chicken and whipped mashed potatoes or Hawaiian rolls for an easy grocery meal, plus their famous airy glazed potato donuts in remission.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab a hot Plain or Traditional Rotisserie Chicken (remove the skin) and soft rolls from Lee's deli counter.
watchOuts: Remove seasoned chicken skin; save Lee's fried glazed donuts for remission and pair with protein

items.name: Maddox Drive-In Lean Bison Burger or Roasted Turkey Burger
items.brandOrRestaurant: Maddox Ranch House & Drive-In (Perry / Brigham City, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Maddox's famous Drive-In griddles freshly ground lean ranch bison and roasted Utah turkey burgers on house-baked soft white buns—offering far less saturated grease than standard fast-food burgers on the drive between Salt Lake and Logan.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Bison Burger or Turkey Burger on a house white bun with aged cheddar only (hold raw onion, lettuce, pickles, and heavy fry sauce).
watchOuts: If ordering Maddox's famous homemade Root Beer, let the carbonation settle or sip slowly so gas bubbles don't cause bloating

items.name: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant Country Breakfast: Scrambled Eggs, Buttermilk Pancakes & Hot Biscuits
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (California Marketplace · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Mrs. Knott's opens early for breakfast before the park gates open: fluffy scrambled eggs, bacon, country potatoes, buttermilk pancakes, and hot buttermilk biscuits with seedless Boysenberry Jelly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Two-Egg Breakfast or Buttermilk Pancakes with bacon and hot biscuits—use smooth Boysenberry Syrup or Seedless Boysenberry Jelly (skip whole-berry preserves).
watchOuts: Skip the Boysenberry Pork Sausage if spiced sausage bothers you, and choose bacon or ham instead

items.name: Oatly Low-Fat Oatmilk (Chilled Carton)
items.whyItWorks: Crafted with enzymatic hydrolysis of gluten-free oats, containing only 0.5g of fat per serving and zero dairy lactose or nuts. The soluble oat beta-glucan is gentle and silky on tender intestines.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Shake carton well and keep refrigerated. Excellent for baking or stirring into decaf coffee.

items.name: Pan-Roasted King Salmon with Herb Mashed Potatoes
items.whyItWorks: Fresh king salmon cooked gently with extra virgin olive oil provides top-grade omega-3 fats that soothe gut inflammation. Soft mashed potatoes provide easily absorbed carbohydrates.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order salmon prepared simply with olive oil and salt. Request smooth mashed potatoes and skip crispy capers or tough broccolini.

items.name: Pepperidge Farm Farmhouse Hearty White Bread
items.whyItWorks: Thick, slow-baked white bread with a dense, comforting crumb that holds together well without tough crusts or abrasive seeds. Under 1g fiber per slice.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast until golden; pairs wonderfully with scrambled eggs or gentle seedless jams.

items.name: Pillsbury Grands! Flaky Layers Buttermilk Biscuits (Oven-Baked)
items.whyItWorks: Baked from refined enriched flour into soft, peelable, buttery layers. The interior crumb is delicate, moist, and low in fiber (1g), melting on the tongue without rough edges.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake in oven or toaster oven at 375°F for 13–15 minutes until golden brown. Drizzle with pure honey or maple syrup.
watchOuts: Soft, refined white dough; chew each bite well.

items.name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park — Near Knott's) Medianoche Roasted Pork, Ham & Swiss on Sweet Egg Bread or Turkey Sandwich
items.brandOrRestaurant: Porto's Bakery & Cafe (Beach Blvd, Buena Park · Steps from Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Porto's **Medianoche** uses pillowy-soft, crustless-style sweet egg brioche bread pressed warm with slow-roasted pork, ham, and naturally lactose-safe Swiss cheese (or order their Roasted Turkey Breast Sandwich or Morning Egg-Ham-Swiss Croissant)— paired with sweet fried plantains (maduros) or banana chips.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the **Medianoche** or **Pan con Lechon** with **NO pickles** and **NO mustard/onions**, or the **Slow-Roasted Turkey Sandwich**, paired with sweet plantains (maduros).
watchOuts: Ask to hold pickles and raw onions on sandwiches; skip the black bean soup

items.name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park, CA) "Pan Suave" Traditional Cuban Sweet Egg Bread
items.whyItWorks: Golden, pillowy soft sweet yeast roll enriched with eggs and a light glaze. Ultra-soft texture requires zero chewing strain and absorbs smoothly in the stomach.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a fresh Pan Suave roll with light sweet cream butter.
watchOuts: None; premier gentle bakery bread

items.name: Quaker Lightly Salted Corn Cakes (Large Puffed Discs)
items.whyItWorks: Made from milled puffed corn where heat expansion disintegrates the kernel matrix, leaving zero hard hulls or unpopped seeds. A safe popcorn substitute for movie nights.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat plain or with a light slice of mild cheddar.

items.name: Quaker Quick 1-Minute Oats (Cooked Creamy Oatmeal)
items.whyItWorks: Quick oats are rolled thinner and cut finer than old-fashioned oats. Boiling them in water breaks down the oat starch into a creamy colloidal suspension rich in soluble beta-glucan, which nourishes the gut microbiome and forms a protective coating.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer 1/2 cup quick oats in 1 cup water or lactose-free milk for 1–2 minutes until completely smooth and creamy. Top with pureed applesauce or sliced ripe bananas.
watchOuts: Must be thoroughly cooked until mushy; do not eat undercooked, dry, or raw rolled oats.

items.name: Saffron Valley (South Jordan / Mountain View Village) Steamed Rice Idli, Plain Dosa & Mild Chicken
items.brandOrRestaurant: Saffron Valley East India Café (South Jordan / Herriman Area, UT)
searchKeywords: indian food herriman mountain view village
items.whyItWorks: Right next to Herriman/South Jordan in the District/Mountain View corridor, Saffron Valley specializes in South Indian steamed fermented rice cakes (Idli) and crispy fermented rice-and-lentil crepes (Plain/Potato Dosa) that are naturally gluten-free, dairy-free, and pre-digested by fermentation.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Steamed Rice Idli, a Plain or Masala Potato Dosa (skip the spicy red chutney and dip in mild broth or eat with plain basmati rice), or Mild (Spice Level 1) Chicken Tikka Skewers with basmati rice and garlic-free plain naan.
watchOuts: Skip spicy vindaloo, green chili chutneys, and heavy coconut-shred chutneys

items.name: Sensible Portions Sea Salt Garden Veggie Straws
items.whyItWorks: Made from potato starch, potato flour, and corn starch colored gently with spinach and beet powder. The hollow extruded straw structure collapses immediately when chewed, offering satisfying crunch with negligible roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Great lunchbox or travel snack. Low in fat and seedless.

items.name: Skittles Original Bite Size Chewy Candies
items.whyItWorks: Crisp sugar shell surrounding a chewy center of sugar, corn syrup, and hydrogenated palm kernel oil. They are gelatin-free, gluten-free, and nut-free with 0g fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Chew well. A popular cinema candy that Crohn's and Colitis patients can tolerate safely without nuts or seeds.
watchOuts: Contains tart fruit flavors; chew thoroughly.

items.name: Slow-Smoked Sliced Turkey Breast with White Roll
items.whyItWorks: Carved tender smoked turkey breast provides lean, clean protein without greasy skin or spicy rub. Paired with a soft white dinner roll, it offers a gut-friendly meal in the Boardwalk section.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for carved lean turkey breast without outer heavy spice crust. Enjoy with a plain white roll and avoid spicy barbecue sauce.

items.name: Stacked! Quality Pancakes "The Purist" Stack (Buttermilk or Gluten/Dairy-Free Mod)
searchKeywords: gluten free dairy free pancakes logan utah
items.whyItWorks: Downtown Logan's dedicated pancake house can make "The Purist" plain pancake stack either classic buttermilk or both gluten-friendly and dairy-free upon request, paired with scrambled eggs for easy morning fuel.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order "The Purist" pancake stack (request the dairy-free / gluten-friendly batter if lactose-sensitive) with warm maple syrup and a side of scrambled eggs.
watchOuts: Standard buttermilk batter and whipped butter contain dairy unless you request the dairy-free preparation; skip lemon curd or seedy berry compotes

items.name: Taco Bell Cheesy Roll-Up
items.whyItWorks: A warm, soft flour tortilla rolled around melted three-cheese blend (cheddar, mozzarella, and pepper jack in tiny proportion). Completely free from hot peppers, onions, beans, crunchy shells, or greasy beef.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: "Cheesy Roll-Up, no sauce, nothing extra." A simple, gentle emergency road snack.

items.name: Toscano / Terza / Local Italian (Draper & Herriman) Grilled Chicken or Salmon with Olive Oil Capellini & Potato Gnocchi
items.whyItWorks: At Toscano in Draper, ordering grilled chicken breast or Atlantic salmon over delicate angel-hair capellini or soft potato gnocchi tossed simply in extra-virgin olive oil, broth, and aged Parmigiano-Reggiano avoids heavy cream and acidic tomato marinara.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for Grilled Chicken Breast or Salmon with capellini pasta or potato gnocchi tossed in light olive oil, chicken broth, and grated Parmigiano-Reggiano (no lemon butter, no red chili flakes, and no heavy cream Alfredo).
watchOuts: Skip lemon-caper piccata sauce (citrus trigger) and spicy arrabbiata tomato sauce

items.name: Traditional Bakery Madeleines (French Sponge Cakes)
items.whyItWorks: Delicate shell-shaped French sponge cakes made of whipped eggs, butter, flour, and sugar. They have an ultra-tender crumb that dissolves effortlessly when dipped in warm tea.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Dunk into chamomile or peppermint tea for an afternoon treat.
watchOuts: Contains butter and eggs; enjoy 1–2 madeleines per serving.

items.name: Welch's 100% White Grape Juice
items.whyItWorks: A 100% fruit juice made from Niagara grapes with zero added sugar, zero fiber, and notably low titratable acidity compared to citrus juices. Clear and non-staining, making it universally acceptable during clear liquid protocols.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Dilute 50/50 with water or ice during active flares to lower the osmolarity and prevent rapid dumping.

items.name: 1923 Warm Cinnamon Donut Holes & Hot Fudge Sundae
searchKeywords: hollywood hills hot chocolate fudge sundae
items.whyItWorks: Warm cinnamon-sugar doughnut holes with salted chocolate ganache and the Hollywood Hills Hot Fudge Sundae have near-zero fiber and zero citrus or nuts.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the Warm Cinnamon Donut Holes, Hollywood Hills Hot Fudge Sundae, or Warm Chocolate Lava Cake. Strictly AVOID the Californian Grapefruit Cake and Burbank Blueberry-Lemon Bavarian Cream (citrus guardrail).
watchOuts: Californian Grapefruit Cake (HARD AVOID grapefruit)
Burbank Blueberry-Lemon Bavarian Cream (lemon rocks/citrus)
Rolled oats in Apple Cheesecake Tart crumble

items.name: 8 oz Center-Cut Filet Mignon with Plain Baked Potato
items.brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's at Bear Lake West (Fish Haven, ID)
items.whyItWorks: Center-cut beef tenderloin is the leanest, most tender cut of beef with minimal gristle or connective tissue. Paired with a soft baked Idaho potato (without rough skin), it provides premium nutrient-dense recovery fuel.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for filet prepared medium-rare or medium without heavy black pepper crust. Scoop out the fluffy interior of the baked potato and top with a small pat of butter.

items.name: Ahi Tuna Tartare
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table / Disney Wonder · Triton's
items.whyItWorks: Finely diced sushi-grade raw ahi tuna and creamy mango/avocado require zero mechanical grinding and deliver clean, lean omega-3 protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server to hold any chili oil, radish slices, or sesame seeds, and verify the soy-ginger dressing if you are on strict citrus-exclusion medications. Pair with white rice or soft bread instead of hard taro/wonton crisps if flaring.
watchOuts: Citrus/ponzu extracts in dressing
Sharp fried wonton or taro chips
Sesame seeds

items.name: Angie's Restaurant (Logan, UT) Open-Face Roast Beef Sandwich with Brown Gravy
items.whyItWorks: Tender slow-braised sliced roast beef served over soft white bread with smooth mashed Idaho potatoes and savory brown gravy. Soothing and easy to break down.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Hot Roast Beef Sandwich with mashed potatoes and brown gravy.
watchOuts: None; soft comfort meal

items.name: Angie's Restaurant (Logan) All-Day Diced Ham & Egg Scramble, Sourdough Toast & Pancakes
items.whyItWorks: Served all day on Main Street: fluffy scrambled eggs with diced lean ham, cheddar cheese, and buttermilk pancakes or toasted sourdough bread.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Angie's Scramble (eggs, diced ham, and cheddar only—no onions, peppers, or salsa) with sourdough toast or pancakes instead of greasy hash browns.
watchOuts: Avoid the Santa Fe Scramble (peppers, onions, and salsa)
Take a Lactaid for buttermilk pancakes

items.name: Applegate Naturals Gluten-Free Chicken Breast Tenders
items.whyItWorks: Whole white meat chicken breast tenders coated in a light, gluten-free rice and corn flour crust. They bake golden and crispy in the oven with far less grease than fast-food fried tenders and zero wheat roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake at 425°F for 18–20 minutes until crispy. Dip in honey mustard or low-FODMAP ketchup.
watchOuts: Bake in oven or air fryer; do not deep fry.

items.name: Baked Potato & Cheddar Cheese Soup
groceryIngredients: Peeled Russet or Yukon Gold Potatoes
items.whyItWorks: Peeled potatoes simmered and blended with aged sharp cheddar create a rich, soothing starch base with minimal mechanical friction.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order at Animator's Palate with no raw green onions/chives on top. If flaring, ask for no bacon bits and take a Lactaid pill for the cream base.
watchOuts: Raw sliced scallions / chives on top
Dairy cream base if lactose sensitive
Potato skin fragments if unpeeled

items.name: BambooHR Thomas2Go Café: Morning Egg, Potato, Bacon & Cheddar Flour Burrito or Scramble Bowl
items.brandOrRestaurant: Thomas2Go / Thomas Cuisine Café at BambooHR (Lindon / Draper, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Scratch-cooked eggs, tender diced potatoes, crisp bacon/ham, and aged cheddar wrapped in a warm flour tortilla (or served in a bowl) with zero artificial additives.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the morning Egg, Potato, Bacon/Ham & Cheddar Burrito or Scramble Bowl with no pico de gallo, no bell peppers, and salsa on the side.
watchOuts: Skip the spicy salsa verde, chorizo, and raw pico de gallo

items.name: Banana-Free Pudding Parfait (Fudge or Butterscotch)
items.whyItWorks: Smooth calories that require zero mechanical chewing.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer chocolate fudge, vanilla, or butterscotch pudding cups with lactose-free whipped cream and crushed graham crackers or Nilla wafers (let sit 5 mins to soften into cake texture).

items.name: Beef Ravioli in Broth (Rapunzel's Royal Table)
items.whyItWorks: Tender fresh pasta filled with finely braised beef in a savory thyme broth requires almost no mechanical work.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Push aside any whole garnished mushroom slices and enjoy the soft beef ravioli and savory broth.
watchOuts: Whole sautéed mushroom garnish

items.name: Black Bear Diner (Draper) Sweet Cream Pancakes, Scrambled Eggs & Carved Roast Turkey Dinner
items.brandOrRestaurant: Black Bear Diner (12300 S · Draper & South Jordan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Right across from TownePlace Suites Draper: Black Bear's famous Sweet Cream Pancakes, scrambled eggs, and slow-roasted Carved Turkey Dinner with mashed potatoes and a homemade biscuit are classic comfort food.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: For breakfast, order the " Bear's Choice" with Sweet Cream Pancakes, scrambled eggs, and ham/bacon; for dinner, order the Roasted Turkey Dinner or Pot Roast with mashed potatoes and a cup of Chicken Noodle Soup.
watchOuts: Portions are huge—eat half and save the rest so you don't overload a sensitive stomach

items.name: Buffet Bakery Station: Plain Croissants, White Bagels, Muffins & Donuts
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
items.whyItWorks: Toasted plain white bagels, flaky butter croissants, and banana/blueberry muffins provide low-residue carbohydrates.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stick to plain white bagels (skip everything-bagel seeds), butter croissants, or plain glazed donuts; avoid bran muffins and seeded multigrain toast.
watchOuts: Poppy/sesame seeds on Everything bagels
Cream cheese lactose (use butter, peanut butter, or Lactaid)

items.name: Buffet Mac & Cheese, Plain Pasta & Chicken Tenders
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
items.whyItWorks: The kids' buffet station always stocks ultra-mild white-flour mac & cheese, plain penne pasta (with butter/parmesan nearby), and golden chicken breast tenders with zero spice.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab plain pasta with butter/parmesan or smooth mac & cheese from the kids' counter, plus steamed white rice and ripe cantaloupe/honeydew melon from the fruit station.
watchOuts: Dairy milk in mac & cheese sauce if lactose sensitive
Fryer oil on chicken tenders during an active flare

items.name: Café Zupas (Draper / Riverton / Logan) Turkey Bacon Avocado or Ultimate Grilled Cheese Panini
items.brandOrRestaurant: Café Zupas (12300 S Draper, Riverton/Herriman & Logan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Warm pressed white panini bread layered with roasted turkey breast, creamy avocado, bacon, and provolone/cheddar—one of Utah's most reliable fast-casual lunches.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Bacon Avocado Sandwich (no tomato or sprouts) or the Ultimate Grilled Cheese (Muenster & Cheddar on white bread) with a soft white roll.
watchOuts: Order on white bread rather than multigrain, and hold raw tomato slices

items.name: Camp West (Garden City, UT) Grilled Chicken Breast on Soft Potato Bun
items.brandOrRestaurant: Camp West Burgers & Shakes (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Pure grilled chicken breast on an ultra-soft potato flour bun with light mayo. Potato buns are exceptionally tender, and unbreaded chicken is easy on digestion.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Grilled Chicken Sandwich plain or with mayo only (hold lettuce, tomato, and onion).
watchOuts: None when ordered plain

items.name: Campfire Grill at Conestoga Ranch Seared Salmon, Ribeye Steak or Farmhouse Omelet
items.brandOrRestaurant: Campfire Grill at Conestoga Ranch (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Bear Lake's best scratch sit-down kitchen: pan-seared sustainable salmon, steaks, and morning egg omelets cooked to order with whole ingredients.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: For dinner, order the Pan-Seared Salmon or Steak with plain potatoes; for breakfast, order the Farmhouse Omelet or Wrangler Egg Sandwich with eggs, meat, and aged cheese only.
watchOuts: Request sauces and compound butters on the side

items.name: Canned Sliced Beets in Water or Light Pickle
items.whyItWorks: Canned beets are steam-peeled and cooked until silky tender. They are rich in nitrates and soluble pectin, breaking down smoothly in the upper digestive tract.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain liquid and slice into tender bite-sized half-moons. Great paired with soft goat cheese or in a bland grain bowl.
watchOuts: Harmless beeturia: Betacyanin pigments will turn stool and urine deep pink or red. Do not mistake for active gastrointestinal bleeding!

items.name: Caribbean Carrot & Cilantro Cream Soup with Banana Bread Croutons (Pirate Night)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
items.whyItWorks: Puréed cooked carrots and soft banana bread croutons are rich in soothing soluble pectin with zero rough skins or seeds.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Take a Lactaid enzyme for the cream base and enjoy warm.
watchOuts: Dairy cream in soup base

items.name: Caribbean Cruise Slow-Roasted Pork Loin (Pernil) & Grilled Red Snapper with Yucca
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure, Magic & Wonder · Caribbean Cruise Rotational & Cabanas/Marceline
items.whyItWorks: Flaky Caribbean red snapper and tender slow-roasted pork loin paired with starchy boiled yucca (cassava) or white rice.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the red snapper or center-cut pork loin plain with olive oil and steamed white rice or boiled yucca—requesting no sour-orange/lime mojo marinade.
watchOuts: CITRUS WARNING: Traditional Caribbean pernil and fish marinades use sour orange or lime juice—order plain

items.name: Castaway Cay Banana Bread, Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Soft-Serve & Melon Bar
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Castaway Cay · Cookie's BBQ, Cookie's Too & Serenity Bay
items.whyItWorks: Moist nut-free island banana bread, fresh cantaloupe/honeydew/watermelon, and soft-serve ice cream are Castaway Cay staples.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab slices of the famous Castaway Cay Banana Bread, fresh cut melon/bananas (skip pineapple and oranges), and enjoy soft-serve with a Lactaid.
watchOuts: Skip fibrous pineapple upside-down cake and orange wedges
Soft-serve lactose

items.name: Center Street Grill (Logan) Egg & Cheese Breakfast Croissant or Grilled Turkey Melt
items.whyItWorks: Casual downtown Logan grill offering flaky butter croissants with scrambled eggs and cheese in the morning and simple grilled turkey or club sandwiches on sourdough at lunch.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Egg, Ham/Bacon & Swiss/Cheddar Breakfast Croissant or the Grilled Turkey Sandwich on sourdough without raw onions or tomatoes.
watchOuts: Skip deep-fried onion rings and heavy pastrami melts during flares

items.name: Chateaubriand-Roasted Filet Steak
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's
items.whyItWorks: Chateaubriand is cut from the most tender center portion of beef tenderloin — virtually zero gristle or connective tissue, making it the easiest steak cut to digest.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order medium-rare to medium at Triton's or Lumiere's with the crushed new potatoes (eat the soft insides, skip any skins) and mild red wine jus on the side. Ask to swap green beans for peeled carrots or extra mashed potatoes during a flare.
watchOuts: Potato skins on crushed new potatoes
Whole green beans if flaring
Rich Béarnaise sauce if high fat triggers urgency

items.name: Chicken Marsala or Piccata (Strained Savory Gravy)
items.whyItWorks: Thinly pounded chicken cutlets dredged in white flour and pan-seared in butter and broth.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Use mushroom powder or strain the gravy to get rich umami flavor without rubbery, indigestible whole mushroom pieces or capers. Serve over angel hair pasta or mashed potatoes.

items.name: Christmas & Thanksgiving Honey-Baked Spiral Sliced Glazed Ham
items.brandOrRestaurant: Holiday Table / The Honey Baked Ham Co. / Costco Kirkland Spiral Ham
items.whyItWorks: Tender spiral-sliced cured ham with a sweet honey-brown-sugar glaze has zero fiber, zero dairy, and zero citrus—great warm at dinner or cold on leftover Hawaiian roll sliders.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose lean center-cut slices and pair with mashed potatoes and soft dinner rolls.
watchOuts: Verify no orange juice or pineapple-citrus glaze was used if homemade

items.name: Christmas Morning Egg, Sausage & Cheese Breakfast Casserole vs. Orange Rolls (Citrus Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Overnight egg, bread/hashbrown, ham, and aged cheddar breakfast strata ("Wife Saver") and classic cinnamon rolls are warm, low-fiber Christmas morning traditions.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake your Christmas morning casserole with eggs, ham/turkey sausage, bread/hashbrowns, and cheddar (no bell peppers or onions), and bake Classic Cinnamon Rolls instead of Utah Orange Rolls (which contain orange zest/juice in the frosting).
watchOuts: CITRUS AVOID: Traditional Utah Christmas Orange Rolls use grated orange peel/zest and orange juice—stick to Cinnamon Rolls!

items.name: Christmas Standing Prime Rib Roast (Center Eye) & Yorkshire Pudding / Popovers
items.whyItWorks: Slow-roasted medium-rare prime rib is melt-in-your-mouth tender with zero plant fiber, and egg-rich Yorkshire puddings puff into airy refined-flour popovers.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Trim away the outer fat cap and peppercorn crust, eat the lean center "eye" of the ribeye dipped in clear au jus, and skip the spicy creamy horseradish sauce.
watchOuts: Trim the heavy ribeye fat cap and black peppercorn crust
Skip pungent horseradish cream

items.name: Chuck-A-Rama Buffet (Logan & Utah) Carved Roast Turkey, Pot Roast, Mashed Potatoes & Rolls
items.whyItWorks: Utah's iconic homestyle buffet features a dedicated carving station with slow-roasted turkey breast, fork-tender pot roast, baked/mashed potatoes, chicken noodle soup, and famous warm rolls with honey butter.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Head straight to the carving station for sliced roast turkey breast and pot roast, pair with mashed or baked potato, chicken noodle soup, and warm baked dinner rolls with honey butter (skip the raw salad bar).
watchOuts: Skip the raw salad bar and deep-fried frontier chicken during flares

items.name: Cooper's Restaurant (Fish Haven, ID) Morning Eggs Breakfast or Grilled Fish & Steak
items.brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's Restaurant & Sports Bar (Bear Lake West · Fish Haven, ID)
items.whyItWorks: Overlooking the Idaho side of Bear Lake, Cooper's serves classic two-egg breakfasts with toast/potatoes and simple grilled fish or steaks at dinner.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order scrambled or poached eggs with sourdough toast and bacon/ham at breakfast, or plain grilled fish/steak with baked/mashed potato at dinner.
watchOuts: Ask for no lemon butter on fish to keep it citrus-free

items.name: Costco Bakery 12-Pack All-Butter Croissants & Soft Dinner Rolls
items.brandOrRestaurant: Costco Bakery (North Logan, Draper, South Jordan & Nationwide)
items.whyItWorks: Baked fresh daily with 100% refined wheat flour and real butter (very low lactose), making the ultimate soft sandwich base for turkey, ham, or scrambled eggs.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast lightly in a toaster oven and fill with sliced turkey breast, Havarti/Provolone, or scrambled eggs.
watchOuts: Moderate butterfat content; limit to 1 croissant during active flares

items.name: Crepes and Coffee (Garden City) Savory Ham, Egg & Cheese or Turkey-Avocado Crepe
items.brandOrRestaurant: Crepes and Coffee (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Paper-thin egg-and-flour French crepes folded around scrambled eggs, lean ham or turkey breast, avocado, and melted cheese—a huge gut relief from heavy Bear Lake burger grease.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Ham, Scrambled Egg & Cheese Crepe or the Turkey, Avocado & Cheese Crepe on standard white batter (or gluten-free buckwheat if tolerated).
watchOuts: Hold raw spinach or tomatoes if flaring

items.name: Crepes and Coffee (Garden City) Sweet Banana, Butter & Sugar or Nutella Crepe
items.brandOrRestaurant: Crepes and Coffee (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Warm thin crepe filled with sliced ripe bananas and butter/cinnamon-sugar (or smooth hazelnut-chocolate Nutella)—100% seedless unlike the Bear Lake Raspberry crepe.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the Classic Butter & Sugar with Banana or the Nutella-Banana crepe; skip the Bear Lake Raspberry crepe if avoiding berry seeds.
watchOuts: Skip the Bear Lake Raspberry crepe during flares (seeds)
Nutella contains skim milk powder (take a Lactaid if sensitive)

items.name: Crispy Rice Marshmallow Treats
items.whyItWorks: Uses the 9.5/10 Malt-O-Meal Crispy Rice base bound together with melted marshmallows and butter - zero insoluble roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Make a batch with Malt-O-Meal Crispy Rice or grab pre-packaged treats.

items.name: DCA Flo's V8 Cafe "Ramone's Low & Slow" Turkey Bacon Avocado Club on Brioche
items.brandOrRestaurant: Flo's V8 Cafe (Cars Land · Disney California Adventure)
searchKeywords: ramones low and slow club flos v8
items.whyItWorks: Lean roasted turkey breast, crispy bacon, and creamy avocado on toasted brioche bread—a lighter, non-fried alternative to burgers in Cars Land.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Club with no raw tomato or shredded lettuce and pair with steak fries or applesauce.
watchOuts: Remove raw tomato slices and lettuce before eating

items.name: Diner-Style Patty Melt on White Sourdough
items.whyItWorks: Finely ground beef patty + 2 slices of zero-lactose Swiss cheese on white sourdough bread.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pan-toast in butter with onion powder for classic patty melt flavor while skipping stringy caramelized whole onions.

items.name: Disneyland Plaza Inn Character Breakfast: Mickey Waffles, Scrambled Eggs & Banana
items.brandOrRestaurant: Plaza Inn "Minnie & Friends" Breakfast (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
searchKeywords: minnie and friends breakfast plaza inn
items.whyItWorks: The buffet lets you build a clean plate of fluffy scrambled eggs, made-to-order egg-white or ham/cheddar omelets, classic Mickey-shaped waffles, and ripe bananas.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Load your plate with scrambled eggs or a plain cheese omelet, Mickey waffles, turkey sausage/bacon, and a banana; ask the server for allergy-friendly/dairy-free Mickey waffles if lactose-sensitive.
watchOuts: Disney can make dairy-free/gluten-free Mickey waffles on request at any table-service or buffet breakfast!

items.name: Disneyland Royal Street Veranda / Stage Door Sourdough Bread Bowl (Eat Warm Bread, Skip Spicy Gumbo)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Royal Street Veranda & Harbour Galley (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)
searchKeywords: sourdough bread bowl on the side disneyland
items.whyItWorks: Pro Disneyland hack: at any location that serves Boudin Sourdough Bread Bowls (Harbour Galley, Royal Street Veranda, Pacific Wharf/Aunt Cass), you can ask for the soup "on the side" (or order just the warm Sourdough Bread Bowl!) to get a whole fresh-baked sourdough boule for a few dollars.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the Sourdough Bread Bowl with soup on the side so your family can eat the soup while you tear into the warm, un-soaked sourdough bread interior.
watchOuts: Zero triggers in the plain Boudin sourdough bread

items.name: Donald's Cantina Custom White Rice Bowl or Flour Burrito
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Donald's Cantina (Festival of Foods)
items.whyItWorks: Build-your-own line lets you combine a soft white flour tortilla or steamed rice base with slow-braised carnitas/chicken, shredded cheese, and smooth guacamole while skipping every trigger.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a white flour burrito or rice bowl with chicken or pork carnitas, shredded cheddar/Monterey Jack, plain sour cream, and smooth avocado mash. Strictly skip the hard corn taco shells, whole black/pinto beans, corn salsa, raw onions, and the hot sauce bar.
watchOuts: Corn tortilla shells/chips
Whole black/pinto beans and roasted corn salsa
Salsa bar chili heat and lime juice

items.name: Dutch Baby / Skillet German Pancake
items.whyItWorks: Egg-heavy, zero-fiber batter that puffs up like a Yorkshire pudding - feels fancy, costs pennies, and takes almost no digestive work.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 2 eggs, 1/2 cup white flour, 1/2 cup lactose-free milk, and a pinch of salt. Pour into a hot skillet with 2 tbsp melted butter. Bake at 425F for 15 mins until puffed and golden. Dust with powdered sugar and maple syrup.

items.name: Enchanté "Hommage à mon Papa" Blue Lobster Bisque & Black Truffle Sea Scallops
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Enchanté by Chef Arnaud Lallement (Passion & Collection Menus)
items.whyItWorks: Chef Lallement's signature tribute to his father: butter-poached blue lobster in strained velvety bisque and seared sea scallops with Coteaux Champenois reduction.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Request your tasting courses prepared without citrus reduction (Chef Lallement's brigade customizes every course for dietary restrictions) and pair with a Lactaid.
watchOuts: Rich French cream/butter reduction
Request zero lemon acidity when seated

items.name: Enchanté Artisan Aged French Cheese Cart (Comté, Beaufort & Tomme de Savoie)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Enchanté by Chef Arnaud Lallement
items.whyItWorks: Hard aged French alpine cheeses like 24-month Comté and Beaufort have ~0g residual lactose and zero fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the fromager for aged hard cheeses (Comté, Beaufort, aged Manchego/Mimolette) with plain white baguette slices; skip unripened triple-cream Brie and seeded/nut breads.
watchOuts: Skip soft unaged goat/triple-cream cheeses if lactose sensitive
Skip dried fig/nut garnishes

items.name: Enchanté Farm-Raised Poulette Chicken with Creamy Herb Ravioli
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Enchanté by Chef Arnaud Lallement
items.whyItWorks: Sous-vide poached farm chicken breast with delicate handmade pasta ravioli is ultra-tender and low-residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Request the chicken and ravioli with vin jaune / poultry velouté on the side and zero citrus zest.
watchOuts: Rich French cream/butter emulsion

items.name: Enchanté Oscietra Caviar with Smoked Haddock & Fondant Potatoes
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Enchanté by Chef Arnaud Lallement
items.whyItWorks: Peeled butter-simmered fondant potatoes, flaky smoked haddock, and omega-3 caviar pearls are completely free of plant roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the kitchen to prepare the cream reduction without lemon juice and pair with a Lactaid.
watchOuts: Dairy cream reduction
Request no lemon acidity in sauce

items.name: Enrique's Port Wine Braised Beef Short Rib
searchKeywords: enriques port wine braised center cut beef short rib
items.whyItWorks: Hours of slow braising turn center-cut beef short rib into fork-shredding, gelatinous strands with zero chew resistance.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask to swap the red-skin green-onion mash and long green beans for plain peeled mashed potatoes or steamed white rice so you get 100% of the tender braised beef without potato skins or raw scallions.
watchOuts: Red potato skins and green onions in the default mash
Whole long green beans and crispy fried shallots

items.name: Ensure Plus Nutrition Shake (Vanilla)
items.whyItWorks: Concentrates 350 calories and 16g protein into a compact 8 fl oz serving. An indispensable tool during Crohn's or colitis flare recovery when rapid weight loss and nutrient malabsorption occur.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Chill thoroughly. If rich sweetness causes nausea during a flare, split one bottle into two halves consumed 3 hours apart.

items.name: Eye Scream / Sweet Minnie's Soft-Serve Ice Cream
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Eye Scream Treats / Disney Treasure · Sweet Minnie's Ice Cream
items.whyItWorks: Complimentary pool-deck soft-serve has 0g fiber, lower milkfat than hard-scoop ice cream, and wafer cones dissolve into starch immediately.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Swirl vanilla, chocolate, or banana/mango soft-serve into a cup or wafer cone (take a Lactaid pill if sensitive to dairy, or ask a cast member for the dairy-free soy/oat frozen dessert kept behind the counter).
watchOuts: Lactose in standard soft-serve mix (dairy-free available on request)

items.name: Flame-Broiled Grilled Chicken Breast on Soft Brioche
items.whyItWorks: Flame-broiled marinated chicken breast served on a soft plain bun provides clean, lean protein without batter, grease, or heavy cheese, making it one of DCA's most reliable dining choices.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the chicken sandwich plain with no sauce. Skip the toppings bar (lettuce, tomato, raw onions, pickles) and choose sliced apples instead of waffle fries.

items.name: Freshwater Eel (Unagi) Nigiri with Sweet Glaze
items.whyItWorks: Broiled freshwater eel is rich, melt-in-your-mouth tender, and very easy to chew and digest over white sushi rice. The sweet kabayaki reduction contains no fiber or irritating spices.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Confirm no sesame seeds are sprinkled on top. Enjoy with a dab of sweet unagi glaze.

items.name: Ginger-Teriyaki Dusted Angus Beef Tenderloin
items.whyItWorks: Center-cut beef tenderloin (filet) has almost zero tough connective tissue, and the ginger-teriyaki crust adds savory umami without chili burn.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order medium-rare to medium for maximum tenderness at Animator's Palate. Ask to swap the wasabi mashed potatoes and bok choy for plain mashed potatoes or steamed white rice, and hold any coarse black peppercorn crust.
watchOuts: Wasabi in the standard mashed potato side
Fibrous bok choy stalks
Overcooking past medium (makes beef fibers tougher)

items.name: Grilled Chicken Breast Sandwich on Plain White Bun
items.whyItWorks: A tender, boneless grilled chicken breast served on a soft white burger bun provides high-quality lean protein without batter, grease, or high-fiber roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order plain (grilled chicken breast and bun only). Skip lettuce, tomato, raw red onion, pickles, and fry sauce.

items.name: Ham & Swiss Hawaiian Sliders
items.whyItWorks: King's Hawaiian rolls have virtually zero fiber and a pillow-soft texture.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Split 3-4 rolls, layer with thin deli ham and Swiss, brush tops with melted butter and garlic powder, and bake in the toaster oven at 350F for 6-8 minutes.

items.name: Hawkeye Baked Buttermilk Chicken & Huntsman Herb-Roasted Pork Tenderloin (Marvel Day at Sea)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Marvel Day at Sea Dinner Menu
items.whyItWorks: Both the buttermilk-marinated baked chicken breast and roasted pork tenderloin are lean, high-protein mains.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for plain mashed potatoes or sweet potatoes (without the bell pepper hash) and gravy on the side; kids' menu Thor's Baked Cod is also a 9.5/10 flare swap.
watchOuts: Diced bell peppers in the standard sweet potato hash (request plain potato)

items.name: Holiday Canned Jellied Cranberry Sauce (Seedless Strained) vs. Whole-Berry Sauce
items.brandOrRestaurant: Ocean Spray / Thanksgiving & Christmas Holiday Table
items.whyItWorks: Classic canned Jellied Cranberry Sauce is 100% strained of all tough cranberry skins and seeds, leaving only smooth pectin-rich fruit gel.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Always choose the smooth Canned Jellied Cranberry Sauce (the kind with the can ridges!) and skip homemade Whole-Berry Cranberry Sauce (which contains tough skins, seeds, and often orange zest).
watchOuts: Never eat homemade Whole-Berry Cranberry Relish (tough skins + frequent orange peel/zest)

items.name: Holiday Inn Express (Herriman - South Jordan) One-Touch Conveyor Pancakes, Eggs & Turkey Sausage
items.brandOrRestaurant: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Herriman - South Jordan (Herriman, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Pressing the button on the famous Holiday Inn Express conveyor pancake machine dispenses warm, oil-free, refined-flour silver-dollar pancakes in 60 seconds—paired with hot scrambled eggs, turkey sausage, and Chobani Greek yogurt.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Make 2–3 fresh conveyor-belt pancakes, pair with plain scrambled eggs (or a cheese omelet) and turkey sausage links, and grab a banana for the road.
watchOuts: Skip heavy peppery sausage gravy on the biscuits if flaring

items.name: In-N-Out Burger "Flying Dutchman" (Plain Meat & Cheese)
items.whyItWorks: Two fresh 100% ground beef patties (additive-free, ground in In-N-Out's own facilities) grilled plain with two slices of American cheese in between. Contains ZERO bread, ZERO seeds, ZERO fiber, and zero onion/spread irritants.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order at drive-thru: "Flying Dutchman, plain, no grilled onions, no spread, salt only." If lactose-sensitive, ask for "No cheese - just two plain beef patties in a box."

items.name: James's Roasted Pork Tenderloin
items.whyItWorks: Pork tenderloin is as lean and tender as chicken breast, and pairing it with smooth polenta or white rice keeps insoluble fiber near zero.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order with the smooth polenta or plain mashed potatoes/white rice, ask for the Cajun Andouille pork jus on the side, and skip any pickled onion or greens garnish.
watchOuts: Spicy Andouille reduction sauce
Collard greens or fibrous vegetable sides

items.name: Japchae (Korean Sweet Potato Glass Noodles)
items.whyItWorks: Dangmyeon noodles are made from purified sweet potato starch - 0g insoluble fiber, gluten-free, and super slippery.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order or make with thinly sliced beef and soy-sesame-sugar sauce, and pick around any tough onion, mushroom, or bell pepper skins.

items.name: Jif Creamy Smooth Peanut Butter (2 Tbsp)
items.whyItWorks: While whole peanuts are dangerous stricture hazards, commercial creamy peanut butter is micro-milled into a velvety emulsion. It provides calorie-dense fats, protein, and vitamin E without any jagged particles to scrape intestinal walls.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Spread a thin layer (1–2 tablespoons) onto white toast, saltines, or rice cakes. Avoid eating heaping thick spoonfuls at once to prevent esophageal sticking.
watchOuts: Must be 100% smooth/creamy; never purchase crunchy varieties.

items.name: Jimmy Dean Delights Turkey Sausage, Egg White & Cheese English Muffin
items.whyItWorks: Formulated with 50% less fat than standard pork sausage breakfast sandwiches: lean turkey sausage patty, fluffy egg white, and American cheese on an English muffin. Delivers 17g protein with minimal grease.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Wrap in a paper towel and microwave for 90 seconds. Let sit 1 minute for heat to equalize.
watchOuts: Contains mild American cheese; safe for remission and mild recovery.

items.name: Ken's Steak House Honey Mustard Dressing & Dip
items.whyItWorks: Smooth, sweet, and completely dairy-free. Uses finely ground mustard flour and pure honey, creating a creamy texture without cream, buttermilk, raw garlic, or heavy alliums. Very gentle chicken dip.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Dip plain baked or grilled chicken tenders into 1 tablespoon of honey mustard for comforting flavor.
watchOuts: Contains honey (fructose); enjoy in standard 1–2 tablespoon portions.

items.name: Kevin's Natural Foods Chicken Tikka Masala (Costco 2-Pack)
items.whyItWorks: Made with sous-vide cooked, ultra-tender chicken breast and a coconut-milk-based curry sauce instead of heavy cream or butter. Certified gluten-free and dairy-free with clean ingredients that avoid inflammatory dairy fats.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Sear chicken in a skillet for 1-2 minutes, drain juices, and simmer in the coconut tikka sauce. Serve over a bowl of plain steamed white basmati or jasmine rice.
