items.name: Sea-Day Sit-Down Lunch: Penne Alfredo, Grilled Chicken & Pan-Seared Salmon
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
items.whyItWorks: Every day in one open main dining room, a quiet sit-down lunch serves freshly cooked pasta, grilled chicken breast, salmon, and burgers away from buffet crowds.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the grilled chicken breast or pan-seared salmon with mashed potatoes/rice, or the Penne Pasta with light Alfredo/butter and aged Parmesan.
watchOuts: Heavy cream in full Alfredo sauce (take a Lactaid or request olive oil/butter)

items.name: Seared Pork Tenderloin Medallions over Creamy Polenta (Captain's Gala Night 2)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · 1923 / Disney Wonder & Magic · Captain's Gala Menu
items.whyItWorks: Pork tenderloin is as lean as skinless chicken breast, and finely ground degermed cornmeal polenta has zero intact corn hulls.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the wild mushroom/port wine reduction on the side so the pork medallions and creamy polenta stay clean.
watchOuts: Wild mushrooms in the reduction sauce (order on side)
Dairy cream/cheese in polenta

items.name: Shepherd's Pie Skillet Mash
items.whyItWorks: Finely ground meat takes 80% of the mechanical work away from your stomach.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Brown lean ground beef, lamb, or turkey with garlic powder, onion powder, Worcestershire sauce, and beef broth (thickened with 1 tsp cornstarch). Top with peeled mashed Yukon Gold potatoes and broil in the toaster oven for 3-4 minutes until golden.

items.name: Sit-Down Breakfast "DCL Express" & Two Eggs Any Style Platter
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
items.whyItWorks: Freshly cooked scrambled, poached, or over-well eggs with grilled turkey sausage and white toast is a clean, high-protein morning baseline.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Two Eggs Any Style with grilled turkey sausage and white toast or English muffin; skip the half-grilled tomato and heavy corned beef hash.
watchOuts: Skip the grilled tomato skin/seeds
Blot fried hash brown triangle

items.name: Sit-Down Lunch Sliced Roasted Beef Sirloin with Double-Baked Potato
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
items.whyItWorks: Tender carved beef sirloin and whipped double-baked potato filling make the best sit-down Embarkation/Sea-Day lunch entrée.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the thyme red-wine jus on the side, scoop the fluffy potato interior out of the skin, and skip the green beans.
watchOuts: Potato skin and green beans (leave on plate)
Dairy in double-baked potato

items.name: Sit-Down Lunch Sliced Smoked Salmon with Honey-Mustard Dill Sauce
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
items.whyItWorks: Silky cured smoked salmon slices are zero-fiber, dairy-free omega-3 protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Discard the lemon wedge garnish and use a light dab of the smooth honey-mustard dill sauce with soft white bread.
watchOuts: Discard lemon wedge garnish (citrus guardrail)

items.name: Smoked Salmon Carpaccio with Dill-Honey Mustard (Let the Magic Begin Menu)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Let the Magic Begin Menu
items.whyItWorks: Thinly sliced smoked salmon is zero-fiber, dairy-free omega-3 protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Brush off whole pink peppercorns, chopped shallots, and capers, and enjoy the salmon with soft white rolls.
watchOuts: Whole pink peppercorns and chopped raw shallots on top

items.name: Smooth Queso Blanco & Warm Flour Tortilla Strips
items.whyItWorks: Melted white American or Monterey Jack cheese with warm toasted white flour tortillas gives you the chips-and-queso experience without corn chip shrapnel.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip diced pickled jalapenos and tomatoes in the queso. Dip warm toasted flour tortilla triangles or soft pretzel bites instead of corn tortilla chips.

items.name: Soft Glazed Doughnut or French Cruller
items.whyItWorks: Pure refined white flour, sugar, and egg/fat. Melts into nothing and delivers fast, zero-fiber calories when struggling to keep weight on.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stick to plain glazed yeast rings or egg crullers; skip coconut, chopped nuts, or seed toppings.

items.name: Soft-Baked Vanilla Sugar Cookies
items.whyItWorks: Tender, soft-baked sugar cookies made with refined flour and vanilla have a pillowy texture that crumbles and breaks down rapidly without crunchy edges. They are free from nuts, seeds, and chocolate.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose plain soft sugar cookies without excessive colored sprinkles or thick fatty frostings during flare periods.
watchOuts: Limit portion to 1–2 cookies to avoid high refined sugar spikes.

items.name: Sokovian "Kartoffelsuppe" Creamy Potato Soup (Night 1)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Worlds of Marvel (Quantum Encounter Night 1)
items.whyItWorks: Smooth, comforting Central European potato soup rich in soluble potato starch with minimal roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask to hold any crispy bacon/sausage bits or raw chive garnish on top and pair with a Lactaid.
watchOuts: Dairy cream base
Smoked sausage/bacon garnish if not held

items.name: Soy-Paper Sushi Rolls (Salmon Avocado or Shrimp Tempura)
items.whyItWorks: Swapping dark green nori seaweed for soy paper eliminates the tough wrapper that can catch on inflamed tissue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order with soy paper and no sesame seeds. Safe fillings: salmon, tuna, cooked crab stick (kanikama), steamed shrimp, and smooth avocado. Skip raw cucumber sticks, jalapeno, or roe.

items.name: Stacy's Simply Naked Pita Chips
items.whyItWorks: Real sliced pita bread twice-baked to a golden crunch with sunflower oil and sea salt. Seedless, non-spicy, and low in fiber (1g).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Chew well before swallowing to ensure edges are fully softened. Pairs well with smooth garlic-free hummus.

items.name: Steamed Pork Bao Bun (Worlds of Marvel)
items.whyItWorks: Cloud-soft steamed white-flour lotus bun with tender braised pork digests easily once you pull out any pickled vegetables or jalapeno slices.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Remove any pickled daikon/cucumber, raw scallions, or chili garnish from inside the bun and enjoy the pillowy steamed bao and tender pork.
watchOuts: Pickled vegetable garnish and raw scallions
Hoisin/chili glaze if spiced

items.name: Subway Rotisserie-Style Chicken on Italian White
items.whyItWorks: Tender hand-pulled white and dark chicken meat that is seasoned simply and heated. Soft and easy to chew without the tough fibrous texture of whole fried cuts.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the chicken warmed on Artisan Italian bread. Skip all raw crunchy veggies during a flare, or add peeled cucumber slices in remission.

items.name: Sven's Creamy Carrot Soup (Disney Wonder Alaska / Frozen Night)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Freezing the Night Away Menu (Alaska Sailings)
items.whyItWorks: Velvety blended cooked carrot soup rich in soluble pectin fiber—soothing and 100% citrus-free.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask to hold any whole caraway seeds on top and pair with a Lactaid pill.
watchOuts: Whole caraway seed garnish if not held
Dairy cream base

items.name: Takara Sushi (Logan, UT) Steamed Pork & Scallion Gyoza Dumplings (No Chili Mod)
items.whyItWorks: Steamed gyoza are much easier to digest than deep-fried or pan-charred dumplings. The minced pork filling is tender and easy to break down.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order gyoza steamed (not fried) with mild soy dipping sauce (hold chili oil).
watchOuts: Avoid spicy chili dipping sauce

items.name: Takara Sushi (Logan) "Protein Roll" in Soy Paper (Salmon, Albacore, Crab & Avocado)
items.whyItWorks: Takara's signature Protein Roll wraps crab meat, albacore tuna, salmon, shrimp tempura, and avocado in soft soy paper instead of fibrous seaweed nori.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Protein Roll in soy paper (ask for light or no tempura shrimp inside if avoiding fried items, and request eel sauce instead of spicy mayo).
watchOuts: Ask to hold spicy mayo or ponzu sauce if drizzled on top

items.name: Tandoori Oven (Logan) Clay-Oven Chicken Tikka & Lamb Botti Kabob over Basmati Rice
items.whyItWorks: Boneless chicken breast cubes marinated in cultured yogurt (lactose broken down by live cultures and baking) roasted dry in the clay tandoor oven and served with basmati rice.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Mild Chicken Tikka (dry tandoor-roasted cubes) with steamed basmati rice and Plain Naan; skip the raw sliced red onions on the sizzling platter.
watchOuts: Push aside the raw sizzling onions and bell peppers underneath the meat

items.name: Thanksgiving & Christmas Smooth Spiced Pumpkin Pie (Costco or Homemade)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Costco Bakery / Thanksgiving & Christmas Dessert Table
items.whyItWorks: The #1 Crohn's-friendly holiday pie: puréed pumpkin custard baked in a refined white pastry crust is 100% smooth, seedless, nut-free, and rich in soluble fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy a slice of Pumpkin Pie with dairy-free CocoWhip/Cool Whip (or take a Lactaid for the evaporated milk in the custard and whipped cream).
watchOuts: Contains evaporated milk in the custard—pair with a Lactaid if lactose-sensitive

items.name: The Bluebird Restaurant (Logan) Historic Roast Beef / Turkey Dinner & Dinner Rolls
items.brandOrRestaurant: The Bluebird Restaurant (Downtown Main St · Logan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Operating on Logan Main Street since 1914, The Bluebird serves old-fashioned homestyle roast beef, turkey, mashed potatoes, and soft white dinner rolls that are gentle and unspiced.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the traditional Roast Beef or Turkey plate with mashed potatoes and soft rolls (or the Country Breakfast with scrambled eggs and toast); avoid the "Rajun Cajun" and "Bluebird Huevos" green chili dishes.
watchOuts: Avoid the Rajun Cajun Omelet (andouille sausage & lemon cream cheese) and green chili dishes

items.name: The Crack Shack (Lehi / Murray / SLC) Grilled Chicken Tenders ("Lil' Cluckers") & Mini Biscuits
items.brandOrRestaurant: The Crack Shack (Lehi / Murray / Salt Lake City, UT)
items.whyItWorks: The Crack Shack uses Jidori free-range, non-GMO chicken breast and offers Grilled Chicken Tenders alongside their famous warm mini buttermilk biscuits with miso-maple butter—giving you a clean option without spicy fried breading.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Grilled Chicken Tenders (or the "All-American Chick" swapping to a grilled chicken breast with cheddar on a brioche bun, no pickles) and a side of Mini Biscuits.
watchOuts: Avoid the "Firebird" spicy fried chicken sandwich and note that the schmaltz fries are cooked in rendered chicken fat

items.name: The French Dip (Roast Beef & Swiss Melt)
items.whyItWorks: Dipping the bread in warm broth pre-softens the entire meal before you even swallow.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm thin deli roast beef in a mug of beef broth/au jus. Pile onto a soft white French roll with melted Swiss cheese (toaster oven for 3 mins). Dip every bite.

items.name: Tiana's Lighter Note Grilled Grain-Fed Sirloin Steak
items.whyItWorks: Every main dining room offers a Lighter Note grilled sirloin steak with steamed white rice or baked potato and zero spicy Cajun rub.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order medium-rare to medium for tenderness, seasoned with salt only, paired with a plain baked potato or steamed white rice.
watchOuts: Coarse cracked black pepper if not requested plain
Chewier connective fibers than tenderloin if overcooked

items.name: TownePlace Suites (Draper, UT) Freshly Griddled Belgian Waffle & Maple Syrup
items.brandOrRestaurant: TownePlace Suites Salt Lake City Draper
items.whyItWorks: Made fresh in the hotel lobby waffle iron. Golden, fluffy, and tender interior with zero seeds, nuts, or roughage. Highly digestible carbohydrate energy for travel days.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pour batter into the rotating waffle maker until golden; top with pure maple syrup and a pat of butter (skip strawberry toppings with seeds).
watchOuts: Avoid fruit compote toppings containing whole berry seeds

items.name: TownePlace Suites Salt Lake City Draper Hot Breakfast: Waffles, Scrambled Eggs & Turkey Sausage
items.brandOrRestaurant: TownePlace Suites by Marriott Salt Lake City Draper (Draper, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Complimentary hot hotel buffet featuring DIY golden Belgian waffles, fluffy scrambled eggs, and lean turkey sausage links—warm, low-residue protein and refined carbs before work.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Make a fresh Belgian waffle topped with a light drizzle of maple syrup or butter, pair with scrambled eggs and turkey sausage (over greasy pork patties), and take a Lactaid if sensitive to milk in the waffle batter.
watchOuts: Choose turkey sausage over spicy/greasy pork sausage patties
Skip the seeded strawberry waffle compote

items.name: Turkish Eggs (Çılbır — Herb Oil Swap)
items.whyItWorks: Soft-poached eggs over strained Greek yogurt deliver high protein with 0g insoluble fiber; swapping Aleppo chili flakes for sweet paprika avoids capsaicin burn.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm plain strained Greek yogurt (or lactose-free yogurt) with a pinch of garlic powder and salt. Top with two soft-poached eggs and melted butter infused with sweet paprika or dill — strictly hold chili oil and red pepper flakes.
items.flareEmergencySwap: Use lactose-free Greek yogurt and skip the spiced butter in favor of a plain pat of butter or olive oil.
watchOuts: Aleppo pepper / chili oil
Raw minced garlic in the yogurt base
Unstrained high-lactose yogurt

items.name: Utah Holiday Jell-O Salad / Peach or Strawberry Gelatin Fluff (Citrus-Free)
groceryIngredients: Canned Diced Peaches or Pears (in juice)
items.whyItWorks: A staple on every Utah holiday table: gelatin, mini marshmallows, whipped topping, and canned peeled peaches or pears are virtually fiber-free and soothe the gut.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy Peach, Cherry, or Strawberry Jell-O fluff made with canned peaches/pears and marshmallows; avoid versions made with canned Mandarin oranges (citrus) or seeded raspberries.
watchOuts: CITRUS CHECK: Skip Jell-O salads containing canned Mandarin orange segments or crushed pineapple in citrus juice
Skip Raspberry Jell-O salads made with whole seeded frozen raspberries

items.name: Very Merrytime Pan-Roasted Chilean Sea Bass with Celeriac Purée & Parsnip Chips
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Very Merrytime ("Happy Holidays" Menu)
items.whyItWorks: Buttery, flaky Chilean sea bass over smooth celeriac purée is virtually fiber-free and melts in the mouth.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the sea bass pan-roasted in light olive oil over smooth celeriac purée (or plain white rice) and skip the fried parsnip chips.
watchOuts: Chilean sea bass is naturally high in healthy marine oils
Skip fried parsnip chips and dairy cream in the purée if sensitive

items.name: Warm Soufflé & Crème Brûlée (Triton's / Lumiere's)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's
items.whyItWorks: Whipped egg-and-sugar soufflé and baked vanilla custard have 0g fiber and melt on the tongue with zero mechanical work.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: If you have a strict citrus/orange-peel guardrail, skip the Grand Marnier (orange liqueur) soufflé and order the Tahitian Vanilla Crème Brûlée (scrape off any berry garnish) or ask for plain vanilla bean sauce.
watchOuts: Grand Marnier contains orange peel extract (citrus guardrail)
Dairy cream/milk lactose — take a Lactaid pill

items.name: Warm Tres Leches Cake & Flan de Queso (Plaza de Coco)
items.whyItWorks: Milk-soaked sponge cake (Tres Leches), silky cream cheese flan, and Miguel's Cookies & Cream Sundae require zero mechanical digestion.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Warm Tres Leches, Tía Gloria's Flan de Queso (skip the dried apricot/pineapple snap), or Miguel's Remember Me Sundae with a Lactaid pill. Avoid the Margarita Lime Cheesecake (citrus) and Mexican Chocolate Tart (spiced + pecan nuts).
watchOuts: Margarita Lime Cheesecake (lime citrus)
Mexican Chocolate Tart (chili spice + whole pecans)
High dairy lactose — take a Lactaid enzyme

items.name: Westbound Panama Canal "Island / Tropical Dinner" Grilled Mahi-Mahi & Teriyaki Beef Tenderloin
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Westbound Panama Canal (Island / Tropical Menu)
items.whyItWorks: Exclusive long-voyage Island/Tropical rotation featuring flaky grilled mahi-mahi and sweet-savory teriyaki beef tenderloin over jasmine rice.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the grilled mahi-mahi or beef tenderloin plain with steamed jasmine rice and teriyaki glaze on the side; skip any chunky pineapple-jalapeño salsa.
watchOuts: Skip raw onion/jalapeño fruit salsas on the tropical menu

items.name: Westbound Panama Canal "Land & Sea" Roasted Venison Loin & Warm Olive Loaf
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Westbound Panama Canal (Land and Sea Menu)
items.whyItWorks: Venison loin is one of the leanest red meats available (even leaner than beef tenderloin), making it exceptionally easy on bile-acid digestion.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the roasted venison loin with jus on the side and mashed potatoes; pick around whole olives in the freshly baked bread loaf if flaring.
watchOuts: Skip red wine/berry reduction if it contains whole seeds or heavy black pepper

items.name: White Chocolate Bread Pudding (Vanilla Sauce)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Tiana's Place / Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table
searchKeywords: mama odies white chocolate bread pudding
items.whyItWorks: Soft brioche bread soaked in egg custard and baked until pudding-soft requires almost zero digestive grinding.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask to hold any crunchy almond florentine or whole pecan praline toppings, and enjoy with the smooth vanilla bean or butterscotch/praline sauce (take a Lactaid pill for the cream/ice cream).
watchOuts: Almond florentine / pecan nut garnish
Dairy cream and ice cream lactose

items.name: Yellow Moong Dal Khichdi (With Ghee)
items.whyItWorks: Unlike whole brown lentils or chickpeas, split yellow moong dal has the outer hulls completely removed and cooks into a velvety pudding with basmati rice and zero-lactose ghee.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pressure-cook or simmer equal parts white basmati rice and split yellow moong dal with water/broth, turmeric, salt, and a spoonful of clarified butter (ghee) until completely smooth.

items.name: Zipz Dairy-Free Dole Whip Soft-Serve Cup (Bear Lake Raspberry Shake Swap)
searchKeywords: bear lake dairy free ice cream
items.whyItWorks: While everyone else gets a seeded, high-lactose Bear Lake raspberry shake, Zipz serves 100% dairy-free, seedless, fat-free Dole Whip soft-serve.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a plain Dole Whip cup (not swirled with dairy vanilla soft-serve unless taking a Lactaid) for a zero-seed, zero-lactose Bear Lake treat.
watchOuts: Confirm flavor of the day is citrus-free (e.g., pineapple/mango vs lime/orange)

items.name: Amy's Kitchen Gluten Free Rice Macaroni & Cheese
items.whyItWorks: Organic tender white rice macaroni baked in a traditional aged cheddar cheese sauce. With only 1g fiber and no wheat gluten, it satisfies comfort food cravings without mechanical roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Microwave for 4 minutes or bake in oven. Take a lactase tablet if sensitive to dairy cheese.
watchOuts: Contains real cheddar cheese and butter; take lactase if lactose intolerant.

items.name: Amylu Organic Apple & Gouda Fully Cooked Chicken Sausage (Costco)
items.whyItWorks: Fully cooked skinless chicken sausages made with coarse-ground chicken breast and dried apple bits. Contains far less grease and nitrates than pork sausage links, offering gentle breakfast protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm gently in a skillet or toaster oven without charring. Gouda is aged and naturally low in lactose, but enjoy in moderate portion (1 link).

items.name: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City, UT) Arroz con Pollo (Tender Chicken & Rice)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Arroz con Pollo is one of the safest traditional Mexican restaurant dishes. Well-cooked Spanish white rice and tender chicken breast strips with mild melted cheese digest smoothly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Arroz con Pollo with warm flour tortillas; ask for mild ranchero sauce light or on the side (hold sour cream and guacamole upon request).
watchOuts: Mild tomato sauce has slight acidity; order sauce light during sensitive phases

items.name: Christmas Morning Brioche French Toast Bake or Egg, Cheddar & Turkey Sausage Strata
items.brandOrRestaurant: Holiday Home Cooking (Christmas Morning & Thanksgiving Brunch)
items.whyItWorks: Soaking cubed sourdough or brioche bread overnight in eggs and lactose-free milk with aged sharp cheddar and lean turkey sausage (or cinnamon-vanilla for French toast bake) turns the bread into a soft, soufflé-like custard that digests effortlessly on Christmas morning.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Make with cubed crustless brioche or sourdough bread, eggs, lactose-free milk (Fairlife), aged sharp cheddar, and diced ham or mild turkey sausage (no bell peppers, onions, or spicy pork chorizo).
watchOuts: Avoid adding diced green/red bell peppers, onions, or spicy sage sausage to the strata; skip orange zest in French toast bakes

items.name: Cooper's at Bear Lake West Roasted Chicken or Mashed Potato Side
items.brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's Restaurant & Sports Bar (Fish Haven / Bear Lake, ID)
items.whyItWorks: Simple roasted chicken breast or tenderloin paired with whipped mashed potatoes or a baked potato gives you a calm dinner option on the Idaho side of Bear Lake.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Roasted/Grilled Chicken with a baked potato (eat the inside) or mashed potatoes, holding any black pepper crust or raw salad.
watchOuts: Mashed potatoes contain butter and milk—choose a plain baked potato if strictly dairy-free

items.name: Costa Vida Grilled Chicken Tacos on Warm Corn Tortillas
items.brandOrRestaurant: Costa Vida Fresh Mexican Grill (Utah County / Salt Lake)
items.whyItWorks: Marinated, fire-grilled chicken breast served in soft warm corn tortillas without beans, sour cream, or fried shells. Clean, low-residue Mexican food.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order grilled chicken tacos on corn tortillas with chicken only. Skip beans, cheese, pico, and lettuce. Pair with white rice.

items.name: Crepes and Coffee (Garden City, UT) Gluten-Free Buckwheat Butter & Sugar Crepe
items.brandOrRestaurant: Crepes and Coffee (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Made with 100% gluten-free buckwheat flour batter (galette style). Folded with sweet butter and powdered sugar. Free of wheat gluten and fructans.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Request the gluten-free buckwheat batter for your sweet butter and sugar crepe.
watchOuts: None; gentle wheat-free breakfast

items.name: DCA Lamplight Lounge Weekend Brunch: Indulgent French Toast or Egg-White Frittata Bake & Potatoes
items.brandOrRestaurant: Lamplight Lounge (Pixar Pier · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: On weekend mornings (Fri–Sun), Lamplight Lounge serves incredible cinnamon-sugar sourdough French Toast and made-to-order egg dishes (or Kids' Scrambled Eggs, Bacon & Toast).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Indulgent French Toast with syrup on the side, or ask for plain Scrambled Eggs with breakfast potatoes, bacon, and sourdough toast (skip chilaquiles and spicy bloody marys).
watchOuts: Avoid the Chilaquiles (fried corn chips + spicy ranchero chili sauce) and Avocado Toast if topped with pickled onions/jalapeños

items.name: DCA Paradise Garden Grill Seasonal Grilled Chicken / Steak Plate with Steamed White Rice & Tortillas (Plain Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Paradise Garden Grill (Paradise Gardens Park · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: Paradise Garden Grill rotates seasonal menus (Plaza de la Familia, Lunar New Year, Festival of Holidays) but consistently keeps plain steamed white rice, warm flour/corn tortillas, and grilled chicken or steak on the line (especially on the Kids' menu).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Kids' Grilled Chicken or Steak Taco/Skewer Plate with plain steamed white rice—or ask for the adult grilled protein with all mole/chili/citrus sauces on the side and no beans.
watchOuts: Skip Al Pastor (marinated in chili & pineapple) and dark mole sauces (contain nuts, seeds, and chilies)

items.name: DCA Shawarma Palace Morning Egg, Cheddar, Bacon & Potato Breakfast Wrap (Skip Spicy Harissa!)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Shawarma Palace (Avengers Campus · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: Fluffy scrambled eggs, melted aged cheddar, crispy potato bites, and breakfast sausage/bacon wrapped in a warm pita—and because the fiery harissa sauce comes in a separate cup on the side, the wrap itself is completely mild!
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Breakfast Shawarma Wrap and **throw away or give away the side cup of spicy red Harissa sauce**.
watchOuts: NEVER pour the included side cup of red Harissa chili sauce onto the wrap

items.name: Disneyland Galaxy's Edge Milk Stand Blue Milk (100% Dairy-Free Coconut & Rice Milk Blend)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Milk Stand (Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Blue Milk is a 100% plant-based coconut and rice-milk frozen smoothie flavored with gentle dragonfruit, pineapple, and melon notes—giving you a cold theme-park shake with zero lactose (avoid Green Milk, which uses mandarin orange & passionfruit citrus).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order **Blue Milk** (skip Green Milk, which has citrus mandarin orange notes) and sip slowly so the icy temperature doesn't shock your stomach.
watchOuts: Avoid Green Milk if sensitive to citrus (contains mandarin orange blossom flavor); sip slowly

items.name: Disneyland Market House (Starbucks) Bacon, Gouda & Egg Breakfast Sandwich
items.whyItWorks: Warm artisan roll layered with a fluffy egg frittata, smoked bacon, and melted aged Gouda cheese. Gouda is aged and naturally low in lactose.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Bacon, Gouda & Egg sandwich warmed; grab a bottle of water for morning park hydration.
watchOuts: None; gentle reliable rope-drop breakfast

items.name: Disneyland Plaza Inn Slow-Cooked Pot Roast, Mashed Potatoes & Buttermilk Biscuit
items.brandOrRestaurant: Plaza Inn (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Slow-braised chuck roast is fork-tender with broken-down collagen fibers, served alongside creamy whipped potatoes and a warm buttermilk biscuit with zero deep-frying.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: At the Plaza Inn counter, ask for the Pot Roast with mashed potatoes and a buttermilk biscuit—ask for gravy on the side and swap the green beans for extra mashed potatoes or cooked carrots.
watchOuts: Mashed potatoes and biscuit contain dairy—take a lactase enzyme before eating; skip the fried onion strings on top

items.name: Downtown Disney Earl of Sandwich "The Original 1762" Roast Beef & Cheddar or Holiday Turkey
items.brandOrRestaurant: Earl of Sandwich (Downtown Disney District · Disneyland Resort)
items.whyItWorks: Baked to order on soft hearth-baked white artisan bread: "Holiday Turkey" (roasted turkey, cornbread stuffing, gravy, cranberry) or "The Original 1762" (warm roast beef & sharp cheddar, holding the horseradish sauce) are warm, soft, and budget-friendly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order "The Original 1762" with NO horseradish sauce, the "Holiday Turkey" (light cranberry), or the Morning Egg & Cheddar Breakfast Sandwich.
watchOuts: Always ask for NO horseradish sauce on the Original 1762 and skip raw tomato/lettuce on club sandwiches

items.name: Fairlife Ultra-Filtered 2% Reduced Fat Milk (Lactose-Free)
items.whyItWorks: Real dairy milk passed through patented soft filters that concentrate natural protein (13g/cup) and calcium while removing half the sugars, treated with lactase enzyme so it is 100% lactose-free. Easily absorbed nutrition.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drink cold from the fridge. Ideal for patients who crave the taste of real dairy without lactose bloating.

items.name: Grilled Chicken Breast Skewers with Sweet Glaze
items.whyItWorks: Tender chunks of boneless chicken breast grilled on bamboo skewers with a gentle sweet soy reduction. Lean protein without frying batter or roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Request skewers without spicy aioli drizzle or sesame seeds. Accompany with steamed rice or a plain soft roll.

items.name: Grilled Chicken Fajita Breast with White Rice (Customized)
items.whyItWorks: Marinated lean chicken breast seared without heavy charring provides ultra-lean protein. Customizing to skip the bell peppers and onions removes insoluble vegetable skins that provoke cramping in active IBD.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order chicken fajitas with chicken breast only (no onions or bell peppers), served with soft flour or corn tortillas and side white rice.

items.name: Guerrero White Corn Tortillas (Skillet-Warmed)
items.whyItWorks: Made from finely ground nixtamalized corn masa treated with lime (calcium hydroxide), which dissolves the outer fibrous corn husk. Naturally gluten-free, low in fat, and soft when heated.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm on a dry cast-iron skillet for 30 seconds per side until pliable and steaming. Never eat cold or stiff.

items.name: Herm's Inn (Logan, UT) "Jim's Hot Cereal" Steel-Cut Oats with Banana & Brown Sugar

items.name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park, CA) Famous Sweet Cream Cheese Roll (Porto's #1 Icon)

items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order 2-3 warm Cheese Rolls fresh from the bakery case; enjoy before walking over to Knott's Berry Farm.
watchOuts: Contains dairy cream cheese

items.name: Quaker Instant Oatmeal (Maple & Brown Sugar)
items.whyItWorks: Rolled oats cut fine and pre-steamed so they soften instantly with hot water. The soluble beta-glucan forms a soothing gel that bulks stool gently without abrasive roughness.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Empty packet into bowl, add 1/2 cup boiling water, stir and let sit for 1 minute.

items.name: Some Beaches (Laketown, UT) Kids Hand-Smashed Cheeseburger Slider
items.whyItWorks: Single smash patty slider with mild cheddar on a soft white bun. Small controlled portion prevents bloating.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Kids Cheeseburger plain on a soft bun with ketchup only.
watchOuts: None; gentle portion size

items.name: Stacked! Egg, Cheddar & Bacon Breakfast Sandwich or Smashburger on Potato Bun
items.whyItWorks: Served on a pillowy soft toasted potato bun with folded egg, aged cheddar, and bacon (or smashed beef patties), delivering savory protein without tough bread crusts or seeds.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Breakfast Sandwich or Stacked Burger on the toasted potato bun with egg, cheddar, and bacon/beef only (hold raw onions, pickles, and spicy sauce).
watchOuts: Skip extra-greasy hash browns if your stomach is sensitive to griddle oil

items.name: Starbucks Egg White & Roasted Red Pepper Sous Vide Bites
items.whyItWorks: Cooked sous-vide in a vacuum pouch to achieve a silken, custard-like texture that melts in the mouth without chewing effort. High in protein (12g) and low in fat, with sweet tender roasted red peppers that lack harsh skins.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for them warmed. Consume slowly with herbal tea or water.

items.name: Summit Pizza Co. (Garden City & Logan, UT) Gluten-Free Crust Plain Cheese Pizza
items.brandOrRestaurant: Summit Pizza Co. (Garden City & Logan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Summit Pizza offers a dedicated gluten-free crust that is thin, crispy, and free of wheat fructans. Excellent for gluten-sensitive IBD diners at Bear Lake.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a 10-inch Gluten-Free Cheese Pizza with light marinara sauce.
watchOuts: Contains dairy mozzarella; order light cheese if sensitive

items.name: Talenti Dairy-Free Roman Raspberry Sorbetto (Smooth Strained)
items.whyItWorks: A 100% dairy-free, egg-free frozen dessert made from pureed and finely micro-strained raspberry fruit. Unlike fresh raspberries, all harsh woody seeds have been completely filtered out.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: A refreshing, icy palate cleanser that satisfies berry cravings without dangerous seeds.
watchOuts: Contains natural raspberry tartness; avoid if sensitive to tart fruit acids during acute gastritis.

items.name: The Crepery (Logan, UT) Warm Butter & Powdered Sugar Sweet Crepe
items.whyItWorks: Paper-thin, delicate French crepe folded with sweet cream butter and dusted with powdered sugar. Completely seed-free, nut-free, and practically zero residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Classic Butter and Sugar crepe; enjoy warm.
watchOuts: None; gentle dessert or breakfast

items.name: Thomas' Plain Bagel (Toasted Half)
items.whyItWorks: Made with enriched bleached wheat flour, boiled and baked without seeds, onion flakes, or whole grains. Eating half a bagel toasted provides dense, easily absorbed carbohydrates without overloading bowel volume.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Slice in half and toast until lightly golden. Spread with pure butter, ghee, or lactose-free cream cheese.

items.name: Trader Joe's Frozen Chicken Tikka Masala with Cumin Basmati Rice
items.whyItWorks: Trader Joe's top-selling frozen meal: tender roasted chicken breast pieces simmered in a creamy, mild tomato-fenugreek curry paired with fluffy steamed white basmati rice. Basmati rice is an elite soothing starch, and the sauce is mild without fiery chili heat.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Microwave for 4–5 minutes until steaming. Take a lactase enzyme tablet for the cream in the tikka sauce.
watchOuts: Contains heavy cream and butter in the sauce; take lactase if dairy sensitive.

items.name: Zao Asian Cafe (Draper & South Jordan, UT) Mild Yellow Coconut Chicken Curry & Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: Zao Asian Cafe (Draper & South Jordan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Mild coconut milk curry with turmeric, diced chicken breast, and tender carrots served over white jasmine rice. Turmeric provides anti-inflammatory curcumin, and coconut milk is naturally lactose-free.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Yellow Curry Rice Bowl with chicken breast and white rice (hold raw jalapeños and spicy sambal).
watchOuts: Skip spicy red chili oil or jalapeño toppings

items.name: Amylu Roasted Garlic & Mozzarella Chicken Meatballs (Costco)
items.whyItWorks: Lean chicken breast and thigh meat rolled with mozzarella and herbs, fully cooked and gluten-free. Free of dense breadcrumb fillers and deep-frying grease found in standard beef meatballs.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer in smooth strained marinara sauce or warm in broth. Pair with tender penne or sourdough toast.

items.name: Angie's Restaurant (Logan, UT) "The Sampler" All-Day Country Breakfast
items.whyItWorks: Angie's legendary comfort breakfast! Lean ham steak and soft eggs are pure protein. Hash browns provide soft peeled potato starch with virtually zero roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order The Sampler with scrambled eggs, lean ham steak, well-done hash browns, and white toast with butter.
watchOuts: Skip spicy sausage links if feeling sensitive to greasier breakfast meats

items.name: Apollo Burger (Orem & PG, UT) Charbroiled Lemon-Herb Chicken Breast on Warm Pita
items.whyItWorks: Tender flame-broiled chicken breast wrapped inside a thick, soft Greek pita bread with light tzatziki cucumber yogurt. Pure lean protein and soft bread.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken Pita with light tzatziki (hold raw red onions and sliced tomatoes).
watchOuts: Hold raw red onions

items.name: Bear Lake Pizza Co. (Garden City, UT) Thin Gluten-Free Crust Mozzarella Pizza
items.brandOrRestaurant: Bear Lake Pizza Co. (Garden City, UT)
searchKeywords: bear lake pizza co gluten free
items.whyItWorks: Dedicated thin gluten-free crust topped with mild crushed tomato sauce and melted mozzarella. Digestible and free of wheat fructans.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the 10-inch Gluten-Free Cheese Pizza with light marinara sauce.
watchOuts: Contains dairy mozzarella

items.name: Bear Trapper Turkey Sandwich or Plain Cheeseburger (Skip Cowboy Onion Rings)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Bear Trapper Steakhouse (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Sliced roast turkey on white/sourdough bread or a plain charbroiled cheeseburger with aged cheddar gives you a reliable lunch option when skipping the fried onion rings and smoky BBQ sauce on the Cowboy Burger.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Sliced Turkey Sandwich on white or sourdough bread (no lettuce or tomato) or a plain Cheeseburger with cheddar—avoid the Cowboy Burger onion rings and BBQ sauce.
watchOuts: Skip deep-fried onion rings and raw tomato/lettuce

items.name: Black Bear Diner Slow-Cooked Pot Roast with Mashed Potatoes
items.brandOrRestaurant: Black Bear Diner (American Fork / Sandy, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Tender beef chuck roast slow-braised until fork-tender and served in savory brown beef gravy over smooth mashed potatoes. Low in fiber and highly comforting.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for extra tender meat and smooth mashed potatoes with light brown gravy. Skip whole baby carrots or green beans if adhering to strict low-residue.

items.name: Chick-fil-A Grilled Chicken Sandwich (Plain Bun)
items.whyItWorks: Boneless grilled chicken breast served on a toasted white multigrain bun (or white bun upon request) without butter or mayo. Mild, non-greasy, and high in lean protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order "Grilled Chicken Sandwich PLAIN - no lettuce, no tomato, no pickles." Ask for a standard toasted white bun if high-fiber multigrain irritates your gut.

items.name: Citrus-Fire Grilled Half Chicken with Mexican Rice
items.whyItWorks: Juicy fire-grilled chicken breast meat paired with well-steamed Mexican white or seasoned rice delivers lean protein and gentle carbs without greasy batter or inflammatory sauces.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel off and discard the charred spiced chicken skin. Eat tender white meat with seasoned rice and warm corn tortillas. Skip refried beans.

items.name: Cooper's Restaurant (Fish Haven, ID) Slow-Roasted Prime Rib with Au Jus & Mashed Potatoes
items.brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's Restaurant & Sports Bar (Fish Haven / Bear Lake West, ID)
items.whyItWorks: Slow roasting melts beef connective collagen into tender, easy-to-chew slices. Dipped in savory au jus and paired with smooth mashed Idaho potatoes, it is hearty and gut-friendly in remission.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the 10 oz Prime Rib with au jus and mashed potatoes; trim away the outer fat rim before eating.
watchOuts: Trim visible edge fat to keep meal moderate in grease

items.name: Crepes and Coffee (Garden City, UT) Sweet Cinnamon Sugar & Butter Crepe
items.brandOrRestaurant: Crepes and Coffee (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Thin, delicate French-style batter cooked soft on a round griddle. Folded with sweet cream butter and light cinnamon sugar. Completely seed-free, nut-free, and practically zero residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Cinnamon Sugar and Butter Crepe warm; enjoy as a gentle morning carb before a day on the lake.
watchOuts: None; gentle low-residue sweet crepe

items.name: DCA Bing Bong's Sweet Stuff (Pixar Pier) Mickey Rice Krispies Treat, Cake Pop & Caramel Marshmallow Wand
items.brandOrRestaurant: Bing Bong's Sweet Stuff (Pixar Pier · Disney California Adventure)
searchKeywords: bing bongs sweet stuff pixar pier
items.whyItWorks: Puffed rice cereal and marshmallow treats have zero insoluble fiber, zero nuts, and zero citrus—easy to split for an afternoon sugar boost.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose a plain or chocolate-dipped Mickey Crispy Treat or Vanilla Cake Pop (avoid sour rainbow belts and lemon drops).
watchOuts: Avoid sour citric-acid candies and Memory Refreshers made with lemonade

items.name: DCA Lucky Fortune Cookery Beef Bulgogi & Steamed Jasmine White Rice Bowl
items.whyItWorks: Thinly shaved tender ribeye marinated in sweet soy and garlic, wok-seared and served over fluffy steamed jasmine white rice. High in bioavailable heme iron and easily digested carbs.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Beef Bulgogi Bowl with steamed white rice; request vegetables soft or hold raw green onions.
watchOuts: Hold raw green onions

items.name: DCA Studio Catering Co. (Hollywood Land) Kids' Turkey Sandwich or Seasonal Mild Slider
items.brandOrRestaurant: Studio Catering Co. (Hollywood Land · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: Hollywood Land's walk-up catering truck consistently offers a simple Kids' Turkey Sandwich or mild slider alongside rotating seasonal items.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Check the current seasonal menu in the app; stick to the plain Turkey Sandwich or un-spiced slider and swap Mandarin Oranges for applesauce.
watchOuts: Avoid seasonal spicy buffalo/jalapeño loaded fries

items.name: Disneyland Bengal Barbecue Warm Tiger Tail Breadstick
items.whyItWorks: Soft, pillowy white bread dough baked fresh with zero seeds or roughage, making an easy carb pairing with a chicken or beef skewer.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Brush off any excess garlic-herb seasoning from the top crust if garlic-sensitive.
watchOuts: Brushed with light garlic-herb butter—wipe the top lightly with a napkin if sensitive to garlic

items.name: Disneyland Candy Palace, Pooh Corner & Trolley Treats Mickey Rice Krispies Treat or Marshmallow Wand
items.brandOrRestaurant: Candy Palace, Pooh Corner & Trolley Treats (Disneyland & DCA)
items.whyItWorks: Puffed white rice cereal bound with melted gelatin marshmallow (or three giant marshmallows on a stick dipped in caramel) has 0g insoluble fiber, 0g nuts, and is gentle on the digestive tract when eaten in halves.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab a plain or chocolate-ear Mickey Rice Krispies Treat (or handmade Caramel Marshmallow Wand) from the bakery case to keep in your backpack for low-blood-sugar moments.
watchOuts: Skip candy apples (tough raw apple skin + hard nuts) and M&M/peanut-crusted treats

items.name: Disneyland Carnation Cafe Charbroiled Turkey Burger on Brioche Bun
items.whyItWorks: Lean seasoned ground turkey patty charbroiled and served on a soft toasted brioche bun with provolone cheese and fries. Much lower in grease and saturated fat than beef chuck.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Burger plain or with mayo only (hold raw red onions, lettuce, and tomato).
watchOuts: Hold raw red onions

items.name: Disneyland Docking Bay 7 Kids' Ithorian Pasta Rings & Meatballs or Grilled Chicken
items.brandOrRestaurant: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo (Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Right-sized portion of soft pasta or chicken with steamed white rice/macaroni for when you want a gentle meal in Galaxy's Edge.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mobile-order from the Docking Bay 7 Kids' menu and swap the Mandarin Orange pack for applesauce or water.
watchOuts: Do not eat the included Mandarin Orange pack (citrus trigger)

items.name: Disneyland Galactic Grill Golden French Toast Sticks with Maple Syrup
items.whyItWorks: Soft, golden-fried thick white bread sticks dusted with cinnamon sugar and served with warm maple syrup. Finger-food breakfast that is seed-free and easy to digest.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order French Toast Sticks with warm syrup for dipping.
watchOuts: None; gentle breakfast carb

items.name: Disneyland Hotel Trader Sam's Enchanted Tiki Bar Tonkotsu Ramen, Kalua Pork Flatbread & Citrus-Free Coconut Mocktail
items.brandOrRestaurant: Trader Sam's Enchanted Tiki Bar (Disneyland Hotel · Disneyland Resort)
items.whyItWorks: Trader Sam's shares its kitchen with Tangaroa Terrace—so you can order warm Tonkotsu Ramen, Teriyaki Chicken & White Rice, or Hawaiian Cheeseburger Sliders on the patio, and ask the bartender for a custom **Pineapple-Coconut Cream Mocktail (No Lime/Lemon/Orange Juice!)**.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Almost all menu tiki drinks contain lime, lemon, or orange juice—tell the bartender "strictly no citrus (no lime, lemon, or orange)" and ask for a custom Pineapple Juice + Cream of Coconut smoothie!
watchOuts: CRITICAL CITRUS WARNING: Nearly every standard tiki cocktail/mocktail at Trader Sam's contains lime, lemon, or orange juice—order a custom Pineapple-Coconut blend only

items.name: Disneyland Tropical Hideaway Steamed Chicken/Pork Bao Bun vs. Pineapple DOLE Whip
items.whyItWorks: Fluffy, cloud-like steamed white-flour bao buns filled with savory chicken or char siu pork (skipping the spicy lime pork bao) are 100% dairy-free, non-fried, and gentle on the stomach; classic Pineapple or Mango DOLE Whip is also 100% dairy-free and lactose-free!
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Teriyaki/Spiced Vegetable-Free Chicken or Char Siu Bao Bun (avoid the Spicy Lime Pork Bao), and for dessert choose Dairy-Free Pineapple, Mango, or Strawberry DOLE Whip (avoid Lemon/Orange citrus swirls).
watchOuts: Avoid the Spicy Lime Pork Bao and Lemon DOLE Whip flavor (citrus triggers)

items.name: Downtown Disney Naples Ristorante e Bar Spaghetti with Olive Oil/Chicken or Light Mozzarella Pizza
items.brandOrRestaurant: Naples Ristorante e Bar (Downtown Disney District · Disneyland Resort)
items.whyItWorks: Naples uses long-fermented authentic Caputo "00" Italian wheat flour for its wood-fired pizza crust and will gladly prepare penne/spaghetti simply with extra-virgin olive oil, grated Parmigiano-Reggiano, and grilled chicken breast.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Spaghetti or Penne with Olive Oil, Parmigiano-Reggiano, and Grilled Chicken (no red marinara or chili flakes), or share a White/Margherita Pizza with a lactase enzyme.
watchOuts: Take lactase if ordering fresh mozzarella pizza, and skip spicy pepperoni/calabrian chili toppings

items.name: Fairlife Core Power Elite High Protein Shake (Strawberry)
items.whyItWorks: Made with ultra-filtered fairlife milk treated with lactase enzyme (0g lactose) delivering 42g of high-biological-value whey and casein protein with 0g fiber. Exceptionally creamy and easily digested by lactose-sensitive guts.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Chill ice-cold in the fridge and drink half or a whole bottle after workouts or as a morning protein boost.

items.name: Fire-Roasted Peeled Red Bell Peppers (Skin & Seeds Removed)
items.whyItWorks: Roasting blisteringly chars the tough outer skin so it slides off cleanly, leaving only the soft, sweet, vitamin-C-rich inner pepper flesh. With skins and seeds removed, it is smooth, non-acidic, and easily digested.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Buy jarred roasted red peppers packed in water (drain well) or roast whole peppers at home and peel completely. Add to sourdough sandwiches, rice, or mild pasta.
watchOuts: Verify all waxy skin shreds and seeds have been removed.

items.name: Freschetta Gluten Free Four Cheese Pizza (Thin Rice & Tapioca Crust)
items.whyItWorks: Crust crafted from milled rice flour, tapioca starch, and potato starch. It bakes into a crisp, delicate crust that breaks down easily without heavy gluten dough or rough grain flours. Mild mozzarella and provolone cheese.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake directly on oven rack for 11–13 minutes. Take a lactase tablet for the cheese topping.
watchOuts: Contains real cheese; take lactase enzyme if sensitive to dairy.

items.name: Fritos The Original Corn Chips
items.whyItWorks: Contains just three simple ingredients: corn, corn oil, and salt. The corn is cooked, finely ground, and extruded before frying, completely eliminating whole kernels and sharp hulls.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy in moderation during remission. Because of oil content, chew thoroughly and avoid eating on an empty stomach during active flares.

items.name: Gourmandise (Draper) Pan-Seared Salmon or Hand-Cut Butternut Squash Pasta (No Walnuts)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Gourmandise the Euro Bakery & Café (Draper, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Gourmandise's dinner menu in Draper features tender pan-seared salmon with mashed potatoes and fresh egg-pasta ribbons with sweet, soluble-fiber-rich roasted butternut squash.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pan-Seared Salmon with no lemon sauce, or the Butternut Squash Pasta asking to hold any toasted walnuts/pine nuts and take a lactase tablet for the sage cream.
watchOuts: Ask for no walnuts/pine nuts on the pasta and take lactase for the butter-sage sauce

items.name: Handmade Potato Gnocchi with Mild Pomodoro Sauce
items.whyItWorks: Handmade potato dumplings are tender, pillow-soft, and remarkably easy to chew and digest. Coated in a smooth, strained San Marzano tomato pomodoro sauce without chunky skins, it provides gentle Italian comfort.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the pomodoro sauce to be smooth without whole garlic cloves or crushed chili flakes. Add light grated Parmigiano Reggiano if tolerated.

items.name: Knott's Ghost Town Grill Applewood-Smoked Tri-Tip Sliders on Brioche Rolls (Sauce on Side Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Ghost Town Grill (Ghost Town · Knott's Berry Farm)
searchKeywords: ghost town grill tri tip sliders
items.whyItWorks: Tender thin-sliced smoked tri-tip sirloin on soft mini brioche buns gives you a smaller, easy-to-digest portion of steak and bread.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Tri-Tip Sliders with boysenberry BBQ sauce on the side and no crispy fried onion strings.
watchOuts: Ask for no fried onion strings on top

items.name: Knott's Grizzly Creek Lodge (Camp Snoopy) Grilled Chicken Sandwich, Snoopy Kids' Mac & Cheese or French Toast Sticks
items.brandOrRestaurant: Grizzly Creek Lodge (Camp Snoopy · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Camp Snoopy's lodge offers a plain Grilled Chicken Breast Sandwich on a soft bun, Snoopy's Kids' Mac & Cheese with applesauce, and warm morning French Toast Sticks.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Grilled Chicken Sandwich plain on the bun (no lettuce, tomato, or onion) with fries or applesauce.
watchOuts: Take lactase if ordering the Kids' Mac & Cheese or Cheese Pizza wedge

items.name: Langers 100% Pure Pear Juice
items.whyItWorks: Pure pear juice provides natural hydration and mild fructose/glucose balance with very low acid. Pear is known to be one of the least allergenic and least irritating fruits for the human gut.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pour 4 oz over a tall glass of ice and top with filtered cold water. Refreshing and gentle on sensitive stomachs.

items.name: Leatherby's Family Creamery (Draper) Hot Oven-Roasted Turkey & Swiss Croissant
items.brandOrRestaurant: Leatherby's Family Creamery (Draper / Taylorsville / Orem, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Before everyone at the table orders giant ice cream sundaes at Leatherby's in Draper, their savory menu has a warm, flaky Turkey & Swiss Croissant (or Crab/Tuna Melt) that provides gentle, low-fiber protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Breast Sandwich on a flaky croissant with Swiss or cheddar cheese (no raw tomato or lettuce); if sharing ice cream afterward, take 2 lactase tablets and order a single scoop of Vanilla or Caramel (no nuts).
watchOuts: Leatherby's homemade ice cream and hot fudge/caramel sundaes are very high in lactose and sugar—keep ice cream portions tiny and use lactase

items.name: Mad Moose Cafe (Eden, UT) Angus Roast Beef French Dip with Melted Swiss & Au Jus
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mad Moose Cafe (Eden / Ogden Valley, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Thinly shaved tender Angus roast beef with melted low-lactose Swiss cheese on a toasted French roll. Dipped in savory, warm au jus broth that softens the bread.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the French Dip with au jus; ask to hold grilled onions if sensitive to cooked alliums.
watchOuts: Hold grilled onions to prevent fructan gas

items.name: Member's Mark USDA Choice Angus Beef New York Strip Steak
items.whyItWorks: High-grade Angus beef strip steak has fine marbling rather than coarse chewy gristle. Cooked medium-rare to medium, it breaks down cleanly in the stomach and provides dense zinc and iron.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Trim the outer strip of white fat before eating. Season with salt only and pair with a baked potato (skin removed).

items.name: Mrs. Knott's Old-Fashioned Chicken & Dumplings
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (California Marketplace · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Simmered tender white-meat chicken with pillowy soft steamed flour dumplings offers zero fried breading and soft, easily digested textures for sensitive digestion.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Old-Fashioned Chicken & Dumplings for the softest texture, and take a lactase tablet for the rich chicken-cream velouté broth.
watchOuts: Contains dairy in the velouté broth—take lactase enzyme if sensitive

items.name: Panera Bread Plain Bagel (Order Plain / Butter)
items.whyItWorks: Freshly baked artisan plain bagel made from unbleached enriched flour. Contains zero sesame or poppy seeds, zero onion flakes, and provides convenient, dense, low-residue calories when traveling.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order at Panera: "One Plain Bagel, sliced and toasted, with plain cream cheese or butter packet on the side."

items.name: Penny Ann's Famous "Heavenly Hotcakes" with Warm Syrup
items.whyItWorks: Award-winning light, fluffy sour cream pancakes. The cultured sour cream in the batter creates an exceptionally tender crumb that dissolves quickly in the stomach without tough fiber or heavy grease.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy with warm maple or pancake syrup. Order butter on the side and skip side bacon or sausage if fat-sensitive.

items.name: Porch Restaurant (Daybreak / South Jordan) Buttermilk Biscuits & Roasted Chicken or Shrimp & Grits
items.brandOrRestaurant: Porch Restaurant (Daybreak / South Jordan near Herriman, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Just minutes from Holiday Inn Express Herriman/South Jordan in Daybreak, Porch serves scratch-made warm buttermilk biscuits with honey butter, herb-roasted chicken with mashed potatoes, and creamy cheddar grits.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Roasted Chicken with whipped potatoes or the Buttermilk Biscuits; if ordering Shrimp & Grits, ask for mild seasoning (no spicy tasso/cayenne gravy).
watchOuts: Skip fried green tomatoes, collard greens, and spicy jalapeño cornbread

items.name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park — 1 Block from Knott's!) Famous Cheese Roll (Quesito), Chicken Croquette & Potato Ball
items.brandOrRestaurant: Porto's Bakery & Cafe (Beach Blvd, Buena Park · Steps from Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Located literally one block north of Knott's Berry Farm on Beach Blvd, Porto's Bakery is a Southern California legend: their flaky puff-pastry **Cheese Roll**, creamy **Chicken Croquette**, and whipped mashed-potato **Potato Ball (Papa Rellena)** have ultra-smooth textures and cost ~$1.50–$2.25 each!
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mobile-order ahead or grab a box of Cheese Rolls, Dulce de Leche Besitos, Chicken Croquettes, and plain Potato Balls (avoid the Spicy Pepper/Cheese Potato Ball!) before or after Knott's, and take a lactase enzyme.
watchOuts: Order the classic Beef Potato Ball or Chicken Croquette—skip the Jalapeño/Spicy Potato Ball and Guava Roll (if avoiding guava seeds, though Porto's guava paste is strained smooth!)

items.name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park, CA) Famous Papa Rellena (Mashed Potato Beef Ball)
items.whyItWorks: Porto's signature savory creation! Fluffy mashed potatoes stuffed with seasoned lean ground beef, lightly coated in panko breadcrumbs and fried golden. The mashed potato interior is soft and soothing.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order 2-3 warm Potato Balls fresh from the bakery case; eat slowly.
watchOuts: Light panko coating is fried; interior is pure soft mashed potato and beef

items.name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park, CA) Pan con Lechón (Slow-Roasted Pork on Cuban Bread)
items.whyItWorks: Slow-roasted citrus-garlic pork shoulder (mojo pulled pork) on warm, crusty Cuban bread. Shredded pork is tender and easy to break down. Hold raw mojo onions for lowest FODMAP impact.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pan con Lechón sandwich; request to hold pickled raw mojo onions.
watchOuts: Hold raw pickled onions to prevent allium gas

items.name: Pringles Original Potato Crisps (Uniform Stacked Crisps)
items.whyItWorks: Pringles are made from reconstituted dried potato flakes, rice flour, and wheat starch pressed into uniform parabolic curves. Because they are processed from fine potato flour, there are zero coarse potato skins or fibrous edges.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy a moderate serving of 12–15 crisps. Chew thoroughly.
watchOuts: Contains moderate vegetable oil; stick to original salted rather than sour cream & onion during flares.

items.name: Ranch Hand Trail Stop "Ranchers Omelet" (Ham, Swiss & Cheddar Mod)
items.whyItWorks: Fluffy three-egg omelet folded with diced ham and naturally low-lactose Swiss cheese paired with white or sourdough toast is a high-protein stop along US-89.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Ranchers Omelet with ham and Swiss/cheddar only (hold the greasy sausage links if sensitive to spice/fat) and pair with white or sourdough toast.
watchOuts: Ordering all three meats (ham, bacon, sausage) plus American cheese makes it high in fat—stick to ham & Swiss during recovery

items.name: Sabores Peruvian Lomo Saltado Beef Tenderloin & White Rice (No Onion/Pepper Mod)
items.whyItWorks: Sabores' signature Peruvian stir-fry uses ultra-tender strips of beef tenderloin served with steamed white jasmine rice and potato fries—naturally dairy-free and very easy to digest when you leave the red onions and tomatoes behind.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Lomo Saltado with steamed white rice, asking to hold the stir-fried red onions, bell peppers, and tomatoes (or push them aside and eat only the beef tenderloin and white rice).
watchOuts: Standard stir-fry includes thick-cut red onions and tomatoes—eat only the beef tenderloin strips and white rice during sensitive periods

items.name: Sara Lee All Butter Pound Cake (Thawed Slice)
items.whyItWorks: Sara Lee pound cake is famous for its dense, ultra-fine, velvety crumb that dissolves into a creamy paste with gentle chewing. It has no rough crust, nuts, or seeds.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Thaw a slice from the freezer. Delicious plain or topped with sliced ripe bananas and maple syrup.
watchOuts: Contains dairy butter and whole milk; take lactase if severely lactose sensitive.

items.name: Some Beaches (Laketown, UT) "South Eden" Plain Smashed Hamburger (Flare-Safe Mod)
items.whyItWorks: The gentlest burger at Laketown's Some Beaches! 1/4 lb 100% chuck smashed thin on the grill on a soft artisan bun without roughage, cheese, or harsh sauces.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the South Eden Hamburger plain on the artisan white bun with light ketchup or yellow mustard (hold lettuce, tomato, onion, and pickles).
watchOuts: None when ordered plain

items.name: Some Beaches (Laketown, UT) Kids BBQ Chicken Soft Wrap (Mild Portion)
items.whyItWorks: Tender shredded chicken, mild cheddar cheese, and sweet BBQ sauce wrapped in a soft flour tortilla. No raw vegetables or onions.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Kids BBQ Chicken Wrap with light sauce.
watchOuts: None; clean, mild poultry wrap

items.name: Stacked! Quality Pancakes Classic Thick-Cut Brioche French Toast
items.whyItWorks: Soft, crustless-style brioche soaked in egg custard and griddled golden brown digests easily with minimal fiber when topped with pure syrup or sliced bananas.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Classic Brioche French Toast with maple syrup (or banana topping)—skip raspberry/blackberry seedy syrups and lemon curd.
watchOuts: Contains egg and dairy in the brioche custard—take lactase if needed

items.name: Sweet Lake Biscuits (Draper, UT) Scratch Buttermilk Biscuit with Local Honey Butter
items.whyItWorks: Layered, flaky scratch-baked buttermilk biscuit served warm with whipped local Utah honey butter. Soft, comforting, and seed-free.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a warm scratch biscuit with honey butter on the side.
watchOuts: Rich in butter; eat moderate portion

items.name: Takara Sushi (Logan, UT) Dragon Roll (Cooked Eel, Crab & Avocado)
items.whyItWorks: All ingredients in the Dragon Roll are fully cooked! Unagi and avocado provide smooth, healthy fats. Ask to hold toasted sesame seeds if you have stricturing Crohn's.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Dragon Roll; ask to hold toasted sesame seeds.
watchOuts: Request no sesame seeds if stricture-prone

items.name: Tandoori Oven (Logan, UT) Warm Clay-Oven Baked Plain Naan Bread
items.whyItWorks: Plain tandoor naan is pillowy, soft, and easy to tear. Brushed lightly with ghee (clarified butter, virtually free of lactose and casein). Soothing carb companion in remission.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Plain Naan (not garlic naan) baked fresh in the clay tandoor oven.
watchOuts: Choose plain naan over garlic naan to avoid allium fructans

items.name: TownePlace Suites (Draper, UT) Individual Chobani Vanilla Greek Yogurt Cup
items.brandOrRestaurant: TownePlace Suites Salt Lake City Draper
items.whyItWorks: Strained Greek yogurt contains active live cultures (probiotics) that assist gut microbiome balance. Straining removes most whey lactose, making Greek yogurt much better tolerated than standard milk.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab an individual Chobani Vanilla cup from the breakfast cooler; pair with a fresh banana.
watchOuts: Strained Greek yogurt is naturally lower in lactose, but monitor individual dairy tolerance

items.name: Traditional Christmas Pork or Chicken Tamales (Steamed Corn Masa)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Holiday Mexican Tradition (Christmas Eve / New Year)
items.whyItWorks: A beloved Western holiday tradition! Steamed ground corn masa is soft, thoroughly cooked, and gentle on digestion. Shredded pork or chicken filling is tender and unbreaded.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Unwrap the corn husk and enjoy the warm steamed tamale with mild red chile sauce.
watchOuts: Ensure red chile sauce is mild and not overly spiced with jalapeños

items.name: 3 Musketeers Bar (Fluffy Whipped Chocolate Nougat — Nut-Free!)
items.whyItWorks: Famous for having 45% less fat than average candy bars. The interior is whipped fluffy egg-white nougat that dissolves like air, making it far lighter on digestion than dense fudge or nut bars.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: One of the best standard candy bars for IBD patients in remission craving chocolate.
watchOuts: Contains milk and egg whites; safe for remission.

items.name: Bear Trapper Slow-Cooked Hot Roast Beef & Mashed Potatoes
items.brandOrRestaurant: Bear Trapper Steakhouse (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
searchKeywords: garden city roast beef mashed potatoes
items.whyItWorks: Slow-cooked roast beef is fork-tender with broken-down connective tissue, served over soft white bread and whipped mashed potatoes with zero roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Hot Roast Beef Sandwich platter with mashed potatoes and ask for gravy on the side so you can control the richness.
watchOuts: Mashed potatoes and gravy contain dairy and roux—take lactase and ask for gravy on the side

items.name: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City, UT) Shredded Chicken Tamale with Mild Red Sauce
items.brandOrRestaurant: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Steamed stone-ground corn masa is soft, thoroughly cooked, and gentle on the intestines. Slow-cooked shredded chicken breast is lean and digestible.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken Tamale plate with mild sauce and Spanish rice (hold sour cream and cotija cheese if dairy-free).
watchOuts: Mild red chile sauce is safe, but verify it is not the spicy green chile

items.name: Cupbop Korean BBQ (Logan, Draper & Orem, UT) "B-Bop" BBQ Beef over Rice & Glass Noodles
items.whyItWorks: Thinly sliced marinated Korean ribeye beef (bulgogi style) served over steamed white rice and translucent sweet potato glass noodles (japchae). Sweet potato starch noodles are exceptionally gentle on digestion.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the B-Bop explicitly at 'Spice Level 1' (sweet mild soy glaze); request no spicy sauce and hold cabbage slaw.
watchOuts: Specify Spice Level 1 (mild); levels 4-10 contain intense chili oil and ghost pepper

items.name: DCA Cocina Cucamonga Pollo Asado Soft Corn Tacos (Rice & Hold Lime)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Cocina Cucamonga Mexican Grill (Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: Citrus-free achiote-marinated grilled chicken served in soft warm corn tortillas with cilantro and Spanish rice. Lean protein and gentle carbs without frying fat.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pollo Asado Tacos on soft corn tortillas; request no raw diced onions and discard the lime wedge.
watchOuts: Hold raw diced white onions and discard the lime wedge

items.name: Disneyland Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe Roast Beef & White Cheddar on Toasted Roll (Hold Horseradish!)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Thin-sliced roast beef and naturally low-lactose aged white cheddar on a soft toasted bakery roll make a high-protein meal once you skip the pungent horseradish aioli and caramelized onions.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Roast Beef & White Cheddar Sandwich and remove/hold the horseradish aioli, caramelized onions, and arugula.
watchOuts: Horseradish and arugula are pungent gut irritants—eat just the roast beef, aged white cheddar, and soft roll

items.name: Disneyland Plaza Inn Penne Pasta with Mild Tomato-Basil Marinara
items.whyItWorks: Tender semolina penne pasta tossed in smooth, mild tomato-basil marinara sauce and topped with parmesan cheese. Low-fat, low-residue, and soothing for tired stomachs.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Penne Pasta with mild marinara sauce; add a side breadstick or dinner roll.
watchOuts: None; mild strained marinara is gentle

items.name: Disneyland River Belle Terrace Grilled Pork Chop or Smoked Brisket & Mashed Potatoes
items.whyItWorks: Sit-down Southern comfort food overlooking the Rivers of America; tender smoked brisket or grilled pork chop with mashed potatoes and soft rolls avoids fryer oil when ordered with BBQ sauce on the side.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pork Chop, Brisket, or Sustainable Fish with mashed potatoes and ask for all sauces/gravies on the side.
watchOuts: Skip baked beans, raw slaw, and spicy Nashville hot chicken dishes

items.name: Disneyland Tiana's Palace Warm Buttermilk Cornbread Side
items.brandOrRestaurant: Tiana's Palace (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Fine-milled Southern buttermilk cornbread baked without whole corn kernels or jalapeños makes an easy, low-fiber side with roasted chicken.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a side of Buttermilk Cornbread alongside plain steamed white rice and roasted chicken.
watchOuts: Contains buttermilk and butter—take lactase if sensitive

items.name: Disneyland Troubadour Tavern Specialty Loaded Baked Potato (Chicken Pot Pie or Pulled Pork Mod)
items.whyItWorks: Troubadour Tavern tops giant fluffy baked Idaho Russet potatoes with rotating comfort fillings like creamy Chicken Pot Pie velouté or slow-smoked Pulled Pork.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for any raw slaw, crispy onions, or spicy sauces on the side, eat the soft potato flesh and tender meat, and leave the outer potato skin behind.
watchOuts: Leave the fibrous potato skin on the tray and take lactase if choosing a creamy topping

items.name: Downtown Disney Paseo & Céntrico Roasted Chicken (Pollo) or Carne Asada with Rice & Tortillas (Plain Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Paseo & Céntrico (Downtown Disney District · Disneyland Resort)
items.whyItWorks: Chef Carlos Gaytán's kitchens at Paseo and Céntrico will prepare plain wood-grilled chicken breast or filet steak with white rice and warm tortillas upon request.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for plain grilled chicken or steak with steamed rice and warm tortillas—hold all chili moles, raw onions, and lime juice.
watchOuts: Avoid complex moles (contain nuts, seeds, chilies, and spices) and citrus aguachile/ceviche

items.name: Even Stevens (Logan, UT) Slow-Braised Pot Roast Dip with Melted Provolone
items.whyItWorks: Tender, slow-braised chuck roast with melted provolone on a soft French baguette. Dipping in warm beef au jus softens the bread for easy chewing and gentle transit.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pot Roast Dip with au jus; request no pickled onions or horseradish.
watchOuts: Hold pickled onions and spicy horseradish sauce

items.name: Fresh Ripe Mango Slices (Soft & Peeled)
items.whyItWorks: Soft, fiberless varieties of mango (like Ataulfo / Honey mangoes) have a creamy, custard-like texture that provides vitamins A and C without stringy cellulose. Soluble fiber predominates.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose Ataulfo or fully ripe Tommy Atkins mangoes. Cut flesh away from the flat center pit and peel off the tough waxy skin completely.
watchOuts: Avoid stringy, fibrous fibrous mangoes where stringy hairs get caught in digestion.

items.name: Knott's Boardwalk BBQ Sweet Honey-Butter Cornbread Muffin
items.whyItWorks: Fine-ground stone cornmeal baked into a tender, moist muffin with whipped honey butter. Completely smooth texture with zero whole corn kernels or hulls.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a warm Cornbread Muffin with whipped honey butter as your side dish.
watchOuts: None; smooth, hull-free cornmeal side

items.name: Knott's Ghost Town Grill Hand-Carved Tri-Tip Steak Sandwich on Garlic Roll
items.whyItWorks: Thinly carved Santa Maria style grilled tri-tip steak on a soft toasted roll with mild barbecue sauce. Rich in bioavailable iron and protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Tri-Tip Sandwich with light BBQ sauce; request roll toasted with light butter (hold raw onions).
watchOuts: Hold raw onions

items.name: Knott's Mrs. Knott's Scratch Buttermilk Biscuits with Seedless Boysenberry Jam
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: World-famous scratch-baked buttermilk biscuits served warm with butter and Knott's seedless boysenberry jam. Pillowy, comforting, and completely seed-free.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask specifically for Knott's 'Seedless Boysenberry Jam' or pure honey to spread on your warm biscuit.
watchOuts: Verify you are served the Seedless Boysenberry Jam, not whole preserves with seeds

items.name: Knott's Prop Shop Pizzeria (Boardwalk) Penne Pasta with Grilled Chicken (Light Alfredo/Butter Mod) or Cheese Pizza
items.brandOrRestaurant: Prop Shop Pizzeria (The Boardwalk · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Prop Shop Pizzeria has a customizable pasta counter where you can get warm penne pasta topped with diced grilled chicken breast and light Alfredo or plain butter/Parmesan (skipping acidic red marinara) plus a soft breadstick!
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: At the pasta station, ask for Penne Pasta with Grilled Chicken and light Alfredo sauce on the side (or plain pasta with grated Parmesan and a warm breadstick); take a lactase tablet if using Alfredo or ordering a Cheese Pizza slice.
watchOuts: Skip Pepperoni/Meat Lovers pizza, spicy marinara, and Italian bean salad

items.name: McDonald's Fruit & Maple Oatmeal (Plain, No Cranberries)
items.whyItWorks: Whole grain rolled oats cooked with hot water and light cream (or water upon request). Rich in soothing soluble beta-glucan fiber that forms a gentle mucosal gel, bulking watery stools without abrasive roughness.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Fruit & Maple Oatmeal, asking to HOLD the dried cranberries and raisins (which present stricture risks). Stir in diced apples if tolerated.

items.name: Ore-Ida Golden Crinkle Cut French Fries
items.whyItWorks: Peeled russet potatoes cut into crinkles. Thick crinkle cuts retain a high proportion of soft, fluffy potato flesh relative to surface oil, providing gentle potassium and comforting carbs.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake on a parchment-lined baking sheet until crisp on tips. Dip in low-FODMAP ketchup.
watchOuts: Bake or air-fry; do not submerge in deep fryer oil.

items.name: Portillo's (Buena Park — Near Knott's) Charbroiled Cheeseburger, Grilled Chicken Brioche or Plain All-Beef Hot Dog
items.brandOrRestaurant: Portillo's Hot Dogs & Italian Beef (Beach Blvd, Buena Park · Near Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Flame-broiled burgers, tender grilled chicken breast on brioche, or a plain all-beef Vienna Beef hot dog on a steamed poppy-seed-free bun (request plain bun) with crispy crinkle-cut fries.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Plain All-Beef Hot Dog (no Chicago-style sport peppers, raw onions, relish, or celery salt—ask for a plain steamed bun without poppy seeds) or a Charbroiled Cheeseburger with American/cheddar only and crinkle fries.
watchOuts: Default Chicago-style hot dog comes on a poppy-seed bun with hot sport peppers and raw onions—always order "Plain" on a regular bun; save Portillo's Chocolate Cake Shake for deep remission

items.name: Sam's Club Cafe (Logan & Riverdale, UT) Warm Salted Soft Pretzel (Hold Mustard)
items.whyItWorks: Warm, fluffy baked yeast pretzel dough. Zero seeds, low-fat, and highly comforting for gut fatigue during warehouse shopping.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the warm soft pretzel with light salt; enjoy plain without spicy dipping sauces.
watchOuts: Brush off excess coarse salt if sodium-sensitive

items.name: Spitz Mediterranean (Draper / South Jordan / Lehi) Chicken or Beef Doner Rice Bowl / Pita (Mild Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Spitz Home of the Döner Kebab (Draper / South Jordan / Lehi, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Rotisserie-roasted chicken or beef/lamb doner over steamed basmati rice with warm soft pita triangles provides high protein when you skip the raw onions, spicy harissa/berbere, and fried garbanzo beans.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Customize-Your-Own Rice Bowl or Soft Pita with Chicken or Beef Doner, basmati rice, and tzatziki on the side—specifically ask for NO raw onions, NO green peppers, NO fried garbanzo beans, and NO spicy chili sauce.
watchOuts: Standard bowls include crunchy fried garbanzo beans, raw red onions, and garlic/harissa sauces—always request plain meat and rice

items.name: Stonefire Original Naan Flatbread
items.whyItWorks: Authentic tandoor-oven baked flatbread made with enriched flour, cultured buttermilk, and ghee. Soft, bubbly, and tender with zero coarse grains or seeds.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm in a 400°F oven for 2 minutes or skillet-warm with a tiny touch of butter.

items.name: 24-Hour Room Service Grilled Sirloin Steak & Provolone Panini
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · 24-Hour Stateroom Dining
items.whyItWorks: Warm pressed ciabatta panini with sliced sirloin steak and aged provolone cheese (~0g lactose).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Open the panini and scrape out any caramelized onions or bell peppers if sensitive to FODMAPs.
watchOuts: Caramelized onions inside panini if not removed

items.name: 24-Hour Room Service Warm Chocolate Chip Cookies & Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · 24-Hour Stateroom Dining
items.whyItWorks: Soft-baked refined-flour chocolate chip cookies are nut-free, citrus-free, and a beloved complimentary bedtime treat.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the warm Chocolate Chip Cookies (skip the Oatmeal Raisin cookies if plump raisins bother your gut) and pair with lactose-free/soy/oat milk.
watchOuts: Butter and chocolate chip sugar
Skip regular cow's milk if lactose sensitive

items.name: Alameda Burrata Mozzarella & Prosciutto di Parma with Crisp Crostini (Night 1)
items.whyItWorks: Paper-thin aged Prosciutto di Parma and creamy burrata cheese have virtually zero fiber and no citrus.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Take a Lactaid enzyme for the fresh burrata cream and leave any raw baby arugula garnish untouched.
watchOuts: Fresh cream inside burrata (lactose)
Salty cured prosciutto
Skip raw arugula garnish

items.name: Alameda Porcini-Spiced Ahi Tuna
items.whyItWorks: Thinly sliced seared ahi tuna dusted with umami mushroom powder (zero rubbery mushroom chunks!) is a textbook Crohn's-friendly protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the seared porcini-dusted ahi tuna slices Only — strictly skip the black sesame brittle (seed shrapnel), pickled lotus root, and yuzu-wasabi mayonnaise (citrus extract).
watchOuts: Yuzu mayonnaise (citrus guardrail)
Black sesame seed brittle (indigestible seeds)
Crunchy lotus root

items.name: Animator's Creamy Lobster Bisque (Night 2)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Animator's Palate (Animation Magic Night 2)
items.whyItWorks: Velvety strained shellfish stock and cream with tender lobster morsels—zero vegetable skins, seeds, or insoluble fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Take a Lactaid enzyme with the first spoonful of bisque.
watchOuts: Heavy cream lactose and butterfat

items.name: Bear Lake Pizza Co. (Garden City, UT) Wood-Fired Plain Mozzarella Pizza
items.brandOrRestaurant: Bear Lake Pizza Co. (Garden City, UT)
items.whyItWorks: High-temperature wood-fired thin crust pizza topped with strained marinara and melted mozzarella. Thin crust has lower dough density and digests quickly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a 12-inch Wood-Fired Cheese Pizza with light sauce.
watchOuts: Contains dairy mozzarella

items.name: Big Daddy's / Captain of the Guards Prime Rib of Beef
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Tiana's Place / Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table
searchKeywords: captain of the guards prime rib
items.whyItWorks: Slow-roasted prime rib is melt-in-your-mouth tender when you trim away the outer fat cap and peppercorn crust, pairing cleanly with the soft inside of a baked potato.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order medium-rare to medium, trim off the outer herb/peppercorn crust and heavy fat ribbon, scoop out the soft inside of the double-baked potato (discard the skin), and eat the well-cooked sweet carrots while skipping the fibrous broccolini stalks.
watchOuts: Outer black peppercorn crust and thick fat cap
Baked potato skin
Fibrous broccolini stems

items.name: Boost Very High Calorie Shake (Nestle)
items.whyItWorks: Packs a staggering 530 calories and 22g protein into just 8 fl oz. Essential for IBD patients battling severe catabolic weight loss or early satiety who cannot tolerate large volumes of solid food.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Because of high osmolarity and calorie density, sip very slowly or dilute 50/50 with unsweetened almond or oat milk to prevent cramping.
