items.name: Braised Oxtail Consommé Soup with Porcini Tortellini (Captain's Gala Night 2)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · 1923 / Disney Wonder & Magic · Captain's Gala Menu
items.whyItWorks: Clarified collagen-rich beef oxtail broth with tender shredded beef and soft pasta tortellini is soothing and low-residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Sip the clear beef broth and shredded oxtail meat; skip the tortellini only if mushroom mannitol bothers you.
watchOuts: Porcini mushroom filling inside the single tortellini

items.name: Buffet Daily Soup Kettle & Sourdough Bread Bowls (Lunch)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
items.whyItWorks: Each lunch features two rotating hot soups—often a smooth purée (butternut squash, potato leek, carrot ginger, or tomato) alongside chicken noodle or chowder.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the smooth puréed vegetable/potato soup or chicken noodle soup with a soft white roll; skip minestrone, lentil, or spicy gumbo rotations.
watchOuts: Dairy cream in bisques/chowders (take a Lactaid)
Check placards for chili or bean soups

items.name: Buttermilk Brioche French Toast
items.whyItWorks: Brioche and Challah have no whole grains or seeds and soak up egg custard completely.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Dip thick brioche slices in beaten egg + splash of vanilla + cinnamon. Pan-fry in butter until golden.

items.name: Cafe Rio / Costa Vida Style Sweet Pork Burrito (Gut-Safe Mod)
items.whyItWorks: Slow-braised pork shoulder falls apart into gelatinous, zero-friction strands wrapped in a soft white flour tortilla.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order white flour tortilla + white rice + sweet shredded pork + melted Jack cheese. Skip whole black/pinto beans, raw lettuce, and pico de gallo.

items.name: Café Sabor Grilled Chicken or Carne Asada with Warm Flour Tortillas & Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: Café Sabor (Garden City / Bear Lake & Logan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Charbroiled carne asada steak or grilled chicken breast wrapped in soft white flour tortillas with white/Spanish rice and fresh avocado slices.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Carne Asada or Chicken Fajitas (eat the meat, flour tortillas, rice, and guacamole/avocado; leave the sautéed bell peppers and onions on the skillet) and ask for no lime squeeze.
watchOuts: CITRUS WARNING: Request no lime wedge squeeze on carne asada or fajitas
Leave sautéed bell peppers and onions on the skillet

items.name: Café Zupas (Draper / Riverton / Logan) Wisconsin Cauliflower or Tomato Basil Soup & Soft Roll
items.brandOrRestaurant: Café Zupas (12300 S Draper, Riverton/Herriman & Logan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Right down the street from TownePlace Suites Draper on 12300 S (and in Riverton & Logan): Zupas blends their Wisconsin Cauliflower and Tomato Basil soups completely smooth and serves every meal with a soft white bread roll.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a bowl of Wisconsin Cauliflower Soup, Tomato Basil Soup, or Chickpea & Vegetable/Chicken Noodle Soup with the soft white roll (take a Lactaid for the cream/cheese base, and give away the seeded chocolate-dipped strawberry if flaring).
watchOuts: Every Zupas meal comes with a chocolate-dipped strawberry—skip the strawberry if avoiding achenes/seeds during a flare

items.name: Californian Riesling & Sweet Pea Risotto (Captain's Gala Night 2)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · 1923 / Disney Wonder & Magic · Captain's Gala Menu
items.whyItWorks: Slow-simmered white Arborio rice releases soluble amylopectin starch that coats and calms the gut.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask to hold the green peas if flaring and pair with a Lactaid for the butter/Parmesan finish.
watchOuts: Whole green peas if not held
Butter and cheese richness

items.name: Caribbean Cruise "Pearls of the Caribbean" (Crabmeat, Shrimp & Salmon in Pearl Couscous)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure, Magic & Wonder · Caribbean / Pirate Night Menu
items.whyItWorks: Chilled crabmeat, poached shrimp, and smoked salmon layered with soft refined-wheat Israeli pearl couscous—a lean, low-fiber seafood starter.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Request it without the lemon-grass infused vinaigrette (or with olive oil on the side) to keep it 100% citrus-safe.
watchOuts: CITRUS WARNING: Standard dressing is a lemon-grass/citrus vinaigrette

items.name: Caribbean Cruise Warm Guava Cream Cheese Pastelito / Tart & Tropical Mango Sorbet
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure, Magic & Wonder · Caribbean Cruise Dessert & Pastry Menus
items.whyItWorks: Seedless strained guava paste baked into flaky puff pastry and dairy-free mango/passionfruit sorbets are classic Eastern & Western Caribbean treats.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the dairy-free Mango Sorbet for a 9/10 flare-safe dessert, or take a Lactaid if enjoying a warm guava-and-cream-cheese pastelito.
watchOuts: Cream cheese lactose and puff pastry butterfat in the pastelito

items.name: Carnitas & Avocado Soft Flour Tacos
items.whyItWorks: Slow-cooked pork carnitas crisped briefly in a skillet, served on warm street-size white flour tortillas with mashed ripe avocado and cheddar.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Use white flour street tortillas instead of corn tortillas, and skip raw diced onions and hot salsa.

items.name: Castaway Cay Cookie's BBQ Chargrilled Mahi-Mahi with Jasmine Rice
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Castaway Cay · Cookie's BBQ, Cookie's Too & Serenity Bay BBQ
items.whyItWorks: Lean chargrilled mahi-mahi filet over steamed white jasmine rice is high-protein and dairy-free once the salsa is held.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the server behind the counter for a plain piece of grilled Mahi-Mahi without the tomato-red-onion-lime salsa or heavy Cajun rub, paired with steamed jasmine rice.
watchOuts: Tomato, raw red onion, and lime salsa on top (ask for fish with no salsa)

items.name: Castaway Cay Serenity Bay Adult BBQ Flame-Grilled Ribeye Steak
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Castaway Cay · Serenity Bay BBQ (Adults 18+)
items.whyItWorks: Exclusive to the 18+ Serenity Bay beach tram stop on Castaway Cay: freshly grilled-to-order ribeye steak paired with plain steamed jasmine rice.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the grill chef for a freshly cooked ribeye steak with light salt only (no heavy black pepper), trim visible edge fat, and pair with steamed jasmine rice and banana bread.
watchOuts: Trim ribeye marbling fat
Coarse grill pepper if not requested light

items.name: Chevalle's Slow-Braised Lamb Shank / Veal Osso Buco with Polenta (Pirate Night)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
items.whyItWorks: Hours of slow braising turn the shank meat fork-tender over smooth creamy polenta or mashed potatoes.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Trim away any thick exterior fat pockets, ask for the braising gravy on the side, and skip any citrus gremolata garnish.
watchOuts: Rendered lamb fat if not trimmed
Verify no lemon gremolata garnish

items.name: Chilled Mango & Papaya Soup with Passion Fruit (Let the Magic Begin Menu)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Let the Magic Begin Menu
items.whyItWorks: Blended smooth from ripe mango and papaya (papaya contains natural papain digestive enzymes) with zero seeds or citrus.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy chilled; take a Lactaid if yogurt/cream is blended into the base.
watchOuts: Fruit sugar load
Possible dairy yogurt/cream

items.name: Chilled Seafood Medley: Shrimp, Smoked Salmon Tartare & Bay Scallops ('Til We Meet Again)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · 'Til We Meet Again Menu
items.whyItWorks: Trio of lean marine proteins with zero plant fiber; only the lemon marinade on the shrimp needs swapping.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for plain poached shrimp alongside the smoked salmon tartare and bay scallops (no lemon dressing).
watchOuts: Lemon marinade on the shrimp portion if not ordered plain

items.name: Conchiglie Buttered Lobster Pasta
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's
items.whyItWorks: Soft white semolina shell pasta and tender buttered lobster meat provide a low-fiber, high-protein comfort dish.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: If you follow a strict citrus guardrail or are avoiding tomato acidity, ask for the lobster pasta tossed in plain garlic butter and parmesan instead of the tomato-tarragon-lemon brandy sauce.
watchOuts: Lemon basil garnish (citrus guardrail)
Tomato brandy cream sauce acidity

items.name: Corona Potato Cream Soup with Knockwurst & Croutons (Lantern Night)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table (Lantern Night)
items.whyItWorks: Velvety blended German potato soup provides soluble potato starch with zero roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask to hold the sliced knockwurst sausage garnish and raw chives for the cleanest, flare-friendly bowl, and take a Lactaid.
watchOuts: Smoked knockwurst sausage fat/casing
Dairy cream base

items.name: Costco Food Court Rotisserie Chicken Chef Salad (Meat Only) & Turkey/Chicken Ciabatta
items.brandOrRestaurant: Costco Food Court (North Logan, Draper, South Jordan & Nationwide)
items.whyItWorks: Thick sliced rotisserie chicken or turkey breast with aged provolone/cheddar on artisan ciabatta bread provides a high-protein, non-fried food court meal.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Remove any tomato slice or raw greens from the ciabatta sandwich and scrape off excess garlic mayo/aioli if flaring.
watchOuts: Scrape off heavy mayo/aioli and remove raw tomato slices

items.name: Cove Café Adult Lounge Complimentary Croissants, Cake Bites & Fruit
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Cove Café (Adults 18+)
items.whyItWorks: The pastry display case inside Cove Café is 100% complimentary all day: mini butter croissants, plain pound cake slices, and afternoon cheese cubes.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Help yourself to mini butter croissants, plain vanilla/chocolate cake bites, or aged cheddar/Swiss cubes in the afternoon; skip lemon bars and nut-topped tarts.
watchOuts: Skip lemon bars and orange-glazed pastries in the case
Dairy butter/cheese

items.name: Crispy Smashburger Tacos (Flour Tortilla)
items.whyItWorks: Pressing thin lean ground beef onto a small white flour tortilla gives crispy lacy edges with less bread bulk than a thick burger bun.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Smash a thin ball of ground beef onto a flour tortilla in a hot skillet for 2 mins, flip, top with Havarti or American cheese, and drizzle with gut-safe burger sauce (no pickle chunks).

items.name: Custom Gut-Safe Gimbap (Korean Rice Rolls)
items.whyItWorks: Seasoned with sweet toasted sesame oil and salt instead of vinegar, with fully cooked fillings.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Make or order Egg, Crab Stick, Bulgogi Beef, and American/Havarti Cheese Gimbap with peeled cucumber/zucchini ribbons. Skip burdock root, raw carrots, and spinach; use soy wrapper if flaring.

items.name: Dan's Drive-In Grilled Ham & Swiss / Cheddar Sandwich
searchKeywords: dans drive in montpelier grilled cheese
items.whyItWorks: Lightly griddled white bread with thin-sliced deli ham and melted cheese is lower in fat and smaller in volume than a double drive-in burger.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Grilled Ham & Cheese (or plain Grilled Cheese) on white bread, lightly buttered on the griddle.
watchOuts: Blot any excess griddle butter on the bread with a napkin

items.name: DCA Festival Marketplaces (Lunar New Year / Food & Wine / Holidays): Garlic Noodles, Char Siu Pork & Rice / Mac & Cheese
items.brandOrRestaurant: DCA Festival Marketplace Booths (Performance Corridor · Disney California Adventure)
searchKeywords: dca festival of holidays sip and savor
items.whyItWorks: DCA's Sip and Savor marketplace booths feature small-plate portions (ideal for Crohn's!); the safest tabs are always the soft noodle dishes (Longevity Noodles / Mac & Cheese with lactase), Char Siu BBQ Pork with White Rice, and Braised Beef Short Rib with Mashed Potatoes.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: On your Sip and Savor Pass, pick the Braised Short Rib & Potato Purée, Char Siu Pork & Rice, Roasted Turkey Slider, or Creamy Mac & Cheese (with lactase)—skip spicy Mala/Sichuan chili noodles and citrus-heavy mocktails.
watchOuts: Check booth placards for lemon/lime/grapefruit juices in festival mocktails and spicy chili oils

items.name: Disney Wonder Mexican Riviera Regional Specials: Baja Sea Bass, Braised Short Ribs & Kahlúa Flan
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Mexican Riviera / Baja Sailings
items.whyItWorks: On San Diego / Baja itineraries, pan-seared Baja white sea bass, slow-braised beef short ribs (without chili mole), and silky Kahlúa/caramel flan are top low-residue choices.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Baja Sea Bass or Mahi-Mahi pan-seared plain with olive oil and salt (hold citrus-mojo marinade and salsa) over white rice, and finish with Caramel/Kahlúa Flan or Tres Leches.
watchOuts: Citrus-mojo marinades and chipotle salsa on standard Mexican Riviera fish/pork (always order plain/sauce on side)

items.name: Disneyland Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe Toasted White Cheddar & Provolone Grilled Cheese (Skip Tomato Soup)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Made with naturally low-lactose aged white cheddar and provolone melted between toasted artisan sourdough slices—giving you a comforting Main Street classic once you skip the acidic tomato basil soup.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Toasted Cheese Sandwich and give the cup of Tomato Basil Soup to a family member (or swap for chips/plain bread), since concentrated cooked tomato + cream + garlic is a frequent flare trigger.
watchOuts: Skip dipping in the Tomato Basil Soup if nightshades or acidic tomato sauces trigger reflux or cramping

items.name: Disneyland Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe Warm Bacon, Egg & Gruyère Quiche
items.brandOrRestaurant: Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Silky baked egg custard with diced ham/bacon and cheese inside a tender flaky pastry crust—soft, warm, and completely free of roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pair with a fresh banana and take a lactase tablet for the cream in the egg custard.
watchOuts: Custard base contains cream/milk—take a lactase enzyme

items.name: Disneyland Oga's Cantina "Blue Bantha" Chilled Blue Milk with Vanilla-Butter Sugar Cookie & Five-Blossom Pretzel Bread
items.brandOrRestaurant: Oga's Cantina (Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Most drinks at Oga's Cantina are loaded with lemon/lime/grapefruit juice—the **Blue Bantha** (chilled dairy-free coconut/rice Blue Milk topped with a soft vanilla-butter Bantha-horn sugar cookie) and warm **Five-Blossom Pretzel Bread** (eat plain without mustard) are the two citrus-free winners!
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Inside Oga's Cantina, order the non-alcoholic **Blue Bantha** and warm **Five-Blossom Bread** (skip the spicy mustard cheese dip); strictly avoid Fuzzy Tauntaun, Jedi Mind Trick (grapefruit!), Bespin Fizz, and Oga's Obsession (lemonade!).
watchOuts: CRITICAL CITRUS WARNING at Oga's: Almost every other cocktail/mocktail in Oga's Cantina contains grapefruit, lemon, lime, or orange juice—stick to Blue Bantha or water!

items.name: Double-Baked Three-Cheese Soufflé with Gruyère Cream (Captain's Gala Night 2)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · 1923 / Disney Wonder & Magic · Captain's Gala Menu
items.whyItWorks: Airy whipped eggs and aged Gruyère/Parmesan baked until cloud-soft—zero fiber, zero seeds, and citrus-free.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Take a Lactaid enzyme for the cream sauce base and enjoy warm.
watchOuts: Rich cream sauce base (lactose + dairy fat)

items.name: Drive-Thru Plain Single or Double Cheeseburger
items.whyItWorks: White bun and finely ground beef patty require very little mechanical breakdown when stripped of raw roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order PLAIN (white bun, beef patty, cheese, ketchup/smooth mustard only). Strictly no pickles, raw onions, or lettuce.

items.name: Duck-In Diner / Pool Deck Spit-Roasted Chicken & Lamb Shawarma Pita (Disney Magic)
items.whyItWorks: Disney Magic's signature poolside exclusive: thinly shaved spit-roasted chicken shawarma wrapped in a warm soft white pita.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken Shawarma in a warm pita with meat only (or a light dab of garlic-free tahini/yogurt)—hold the raw red onions, tomatoes, lettuce, and pickles.
watchOuts: Hold raw onions, tomatoes, and pickles inside the pita
Choose lean chicken shawarma over fattier lamb during flares

items.name: El Toro Viejo (Logan, UT) Soft Corn Tortilla Carne Asada Tacos (Cilantro & Rice)
items.whyItWorks: Grilled marinated skirt steak served inside soft warm corn tortillas with Spanish rice. Unbreaded, lean, high in iron, and gentle when omitting raw diced onions.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Carne Asada Tacos with soft corn tortillas and Spanish rice (hold raw diced onions and spicy red salsa).
watchOuts: Hold raw diced white onions

items.name: Elsa's Coronation Scallops in Puff Pastry (Disney Wonder Alaska / Frozen Night)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Freezing the Night Away Menu (Alaska Sailings)
items.whyItWorks: Tender princess scallops and shrimp baked in a smooth cognac-tarragon cream sauce beneath a flaky puff pastry dome—zero roughage and citrus-free.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Take a Lactaid enzyme for the cream sauce and puff pastry butter.
watchOuts: Rich cream sauce and butter pastry

items.name: Fresh Seedless Watermelon Slices
items.whyItWorks: Watermelon delivers superior hydration and virtually zero insoluble fiber (only 0.6g per wedge). It is refreshing and replenishes intracellular fluid during hot weather or illness.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Buy strictly seedless watermelon. Discard any stray white or black seeds and do not chew down into the tough white rind.
watchOuts: High in free fructose; eating huge wedges at once can cause osmotic gas or loose stools in fructose-sensitive IBD patients.

items.name: Golden Mystic Pasta: Caramelized Scallops & Angel Hair in Chardonnay Cream (Night 1)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Worlds of Marvel (Quantum Encounter Night 1)
items.whyItWorks: Sweet seared sea scallops over fine refined angel hair pasta in a smooth saffron/Chardonnay cream sauce.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Take a Lactaid enzyme for the cream sauce and leave any blistered cherry tomatoes on the side of the plate.
watchOuts: Heavy cream lactose
Roasted cherry tomato skins

items.name: Golden Puffs / Honey Buzzers / Corn Bursts
items.whyItWorks: Puffed wheat and refined corn meal break down quickly (~1g fiber) in liquid.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve with lactose-free or almond milk.
watchOuts: High sugar content in Golden Puffs can pull water into the colon (osmotic effect) if eaten in huge bowls during an active flare

items.name: Grilled Angus Strip Loin Steak with Cheddar Smashed Potatoes (Let the Magic Begin)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Let the Magic Begin Menu
items.whyItWorks: Grilled strip loin steak is high in iron and zero-fiber; ask for plain mashed or baked potatoes to avoid onions in the cheddar smash.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the strip loin medium-rare with plain baked or mashed potatoes (the standard cheddar smashed potatoes contain diced onions) and skip the grilled tomato.
watchOuts: Onions mixed into standard cheddar smashed potatoes (swap for plain potato)

items.name: Grilled New York Strip Steak with Baked Potato (Prince & Princess Menu)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Prince & Princess Dinner Menu
items.whyItWorks: Grilled-to-order New York strip loin paired with mashed or baked potatoes offers high iron and zero plant roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order medium-rare with salt only (sauce on the side) and trim the outer strip of edge fat before eating.
watchOuts: Trim exterior strip fat cap
Coarse cracked black pepper if not ordered plain

items.name: Herm's Inn (Logan) Classic Buttermilk Pancakes, Eggs Benedict & Scramble
items.whyItWorks: Logan's favorite breakfast cottage: poached eggs over English muffins, fluffy buttermilk pancakes, and simple egg scrambles are gentle when you skip the spicy specials.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Classic Two-Egg Breakfast with sourdough toast, Buttermilk Pancakes, or classic Eggs Benedict (hollandaise on the side).
watchOuts: Hollandaise is high in egg-yolk/butter fat and a touch of lemon—request on the side

items.name: Holiday Martinelli's Sparkling Apple Cider & Lactose-Free Eggnog (Skip Citrus Wassail)
groceryIngredients: Martinelli's Sparkling Cider or Filtered Apple Cider
items.whyItWorks: 100% filtered apple cider and Lactaid/almond-milk eggnog let you toast the holidays with zero alcohol, zero fiber, and zero citrus.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Sip Martinelli's (let some fizz settle if carbonation bloats you), warm spiced apple cider (simmered with cinnamon sticks only—no orange slices!), or Lactaid Eggnog.
watchOuts: CITRUS WARNING: Traditional Holiday Wassail is simmered with orange juice, lemon juice, and orange peels—stick to pure Spiced Apple Cider!

items.name: Holiday Peeled Apple Pie or French Silk / Banana Cream Pie
items.whyItWorks: Peeled baked apples in a flaky white flour crust (or smooth chocolate French Silk / Banana Cream pie) offer seedless, nut-free holiday dessert options.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Confirm no lemon juice or walnuts were added to the apple pie, and take a Lactaid if topping with vanilla ice cream or eating cream pie.
watchOuts: Ensure apples are fully peeled and no walnuts/pecans are in the streusel

items.name: Hyperion Four-Cheese Tortelloni (Hold Lemon)
items.whyItWorks: Soft egg-pasta tortelloni filled with blended four cheeses melts cleanly and is easy on mechanical digestion.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: If you have a strict citrus guardrail, ask for the tortelloni served with plain melted butter/broth instead of the Meyer lemon sauce, and push the sun-dried tomato and baby spinach garnish to the side.
watchOuts: Meyer lemon broth (citrus guardrail)
Sun-dried tomato skins and artichoke bracts

items.name: Jack's Treasure-of-the-Seas Grilled Shrimp, Scallops & Pasta (Pirate Night)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
items.whyItWorks: Grilled shrimp and sea scallops over white pasta provide lean marine protein and low-residue carbohydrates.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the shrimp, scallops, and pasta tossed in plain butter or olive oil instead of the lemon-tomato cream sauce to stay 100% citrus-free.
watchOuts: Lemon-tomato cream sauce on standard build (swap for plain butter/olive oil)
Dairy cream

items.name: Jade Cricket Café & Heihei Café: Iced Matcha, Chai & Ube Oat Milk Lattes
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Jade Cricket Café & Heihei Café / Wonder & Magic · Cove Café
items.whyItWorks: Ceremonial matcha green tea or caffeine-free purple yam (ube) steamed with oat or almond milk avoids high-acid espresso and dairy lactose.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order an iced or hot Matcha Latte, Ube Latte, or decaf Oat Milk Latte with half-sweet syrup; strictly skip Earl Grey tea (bergamot citrus oil).
watchOuts: Never order Earl Grey / Lady Grey tea (bergamot citrus oil)
Cinnamon/clove spice in Chai if flaring

items.name: Jumbeaux's Sweets Pawpsicle Shortbread Cookie & Character Rice Crispy Treats
items.whyItWorks: Puffed white rice marshmallow treats and refined butter shortbread cookies have almost zero fiber and no citrus or nuts.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick a plain/chocolate-dipped Character Rice Crispy Treat or butter shortbread cookie (avoid raspberry jam filling if seeded).
watchOuts: Sugar load
Check shortbread sandwich filling for raspberry seeds

items.name: Kevin's Natural Foods Korean Style BBQ Steak (Costco 2-Pack)
items.whyItWorks: Tender strips of beef flank steak prepared sous-vide with coconut aminos, apple cider vinegar, and sesame oil instead of wheat soy sauce or heavy corn syrup. Very tender and easy to chew.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pan-sear beef for 2 minutes and pour sauce over. Serve with plain steamed white rice. Skip adding extra raw green onions or sesame seeds if avoiding roughage.

items.name: Kirkland Signature Plain Water Bagels (Bakery 2-Pack)
items.whyItWorks: Traditional boiled and baked plain bagels made from enriched unbleached flour without seeds, onion flakes, or whole grains. Provides easily digested complex carbohydrates that help bind the stool.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast lightly to soften the interior. Top with dairy-free spread, seedless jelly, or sliced turkey breast. Avoid everything bagels with seeds and garlic.

items.name: Kit Kat Crisp Wafers in Milk Chocolate
items.whyItWorks: Layers of ultra-thin, light baked wafers covered in smooth milk chocolate. The crisp wafers crush into fine crumbs with zero resistance, avoiding dense fudgy mass.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Snap off 2 fingers. Let chocolate melt in mouth before swallowing.
watchOuts: Contains milk and wheat gluten.

items.name: Knott's Baja Taqueria (Fiesta Village) Grilled Fish or Chicken Soft Tacos (No Cabbage Slaw / No Crema Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Baja Taqueria (Fiesta Village · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: In Fiesta Village, Baja Taqueria serves grilled fish or grilled chicken tacos that are light and digestible when you hold the raw shredded cabbage, pico de gallo, and lime crema.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the **Grilled** Fish or Chicken Tacos (not beer-battered fried) with **no cabbage slaw, no pico de gallo, no spicy crema, and no lime squeeze**.
watchOuts: Discard the lime wedge (citrus trigger) and skip the salsa bar

items.name: Knott's Boardwalk BBQ Smoked Tri-Tip Sirloin or Ribs with Creamy Mac & Cheese
items.brandOrRestaurant: Boardwalk BBQ (The Boardwalk · Knott's Berry Farm)
searchKeywords: boardwalk bbq mac and cheese knotts
items.whyItWorks: Tender carved tri-tip sirloin paired with Boardwalk BBQ's smooth baked cavatappi mac & cheese (or mashed potatoes) gives you a high-calorie, low-residue meal.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Smoked Tri-Tip with Mashed Potatoes or Mac & Cheese (take lactase for the cheese sauce) and skip the spicy Jalapeño Cheddar Sausage and coleslaw.
watchOuts: Avoid the spicy Jalapeño Cheddar Sausage and raw cabbage slaw

items.name: Knott's Calico Saloon Cold Old-Fashioned Sarsaparilla / Root Beer
items.whyItWorks: Knott's historic signature beverage served in a frosty mug. Made with real cane sugar and natural birch/sassafras extracts with 100% zero caffeine and zero citrus acids.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order an Old-Fashioned Sarsaparilla in a cup; sip slowly to allow carbonation to settle.
watchOuts: Carbonation can cause mild fullness; sip at a leisurely pace

items.name: Knott's Ghost Town Grill Sourdough Bread Bowl Clam Chowder or Chicken Noodle Soup
items.brandOrRestaurant: Ghost Town Grill (Ghost Town · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Warm sourdough bread bowl filled with comforting soup (or Chicken Noodle Soup in a bowl) gives you a gentle break from theme-park burgers—just avoid the spicy bean Chili Bread Bowl.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Chicken Noodle Soup with warm bread (or Clam Chowder in a Sourdough Bread Bowl with a lactase enzyme)—never order the Beef & Bean Chili bowl during flares.
watchOuts: Skip the Chili Bread Bowl (beans + chili powder); take lactase if choosing Clam Chowder

items.name: Knott's Mrs. Knott's Warm Boysenberry Scone with Whipped Butter
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Unlike the whole berry pie, Knott's famous breakfast scone is glazed with strained seedless boysenberry icing. Soft, crumbly, and comforting with zero abrasive whole berry seeds.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Boysenberry Scone warm with whipped sweet butter.
watchOuts: None; seedless glaze is safe

items.name: Le Nonne & Jack's Wood Fired Oven (Logan) Homemade Gnocchi/Fettuccine & Margherita Pizza
items.brandOrRestaurant: Le Nonne / Jack's Wood Fired Oven (Downtown Logan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Authentic downtown Logan Italian kitchens using 00-flour dough and handmade potato gnocchi or egg fettuccine that digest much cleaner than heavy American chain pasta.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: At Le Nonne, order handmade potato gnocchi or fettuccine with light butter/olive oil, Parmigiano-Reggiano, and grilled chicken/salmon; at Jack's, order a light-cheese Margherita or Prosciutto wood-fired pizza.
watchOuts: Ask for light garlic and take a Lactaid if ordering cream/mozzarella dishes

items.name: Lighter Note Mesquite-Spiced Salmon Salad (Night 1)
items.whyItWorks: The salmon filet itself is omega-3-rich and tender; ordering it plain over white rice instead of salad greens makes it a 9/10 meal.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the salmon filet seasoned with salt only (no smoky mesquite chili rub) served with steamed jasmine rice or baked potato instead of the raw salad bed.
watchOuts: Mesquite spice rub if not ordered plain
Raw salad greens in standard Lighter Note presentation

items.name: Lookout Cay Oven-Baked Sweet Plantains & Saffron Seafood Rice vs. Pigeon Peas
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Lookout Cay at Lighthouse Point · True-True BBQ & Serenity Bay BBQ
items.whyItWorks: Oven-baked ripe sweet plantains and saffron shrimp/scallop rice provide gentle soluble starch, whereas traditional Bahamian Pigeon Peas & Rice contains whole legume skins.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Load up on the soft Oven-Baked Sweet Plantains and plain/saffron rice with shrimp and scallops; skip the Pigeon Peas & Rice and fried okra during flares.
watchOuts: Whole pigeon pea hulls in Pigeon Peas & Rice
Seeds inside fried okra

items.name: Lookout Cay True-True BBQ: Grilled Salmon, Red Snapper & Mahi-Mahi Station
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Lookout Cay at Lighthouse Point · True-True BBQ & Serenity Bay BBQ
items.whyItWorks: Freshly grilled salmon and white snapper filets are high in omega-3s and lean protein when ordered without fruit/pepper salsas.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the Grilled Salmon filet plain without the pineapple salsa (avoid the lime-marinated snapper to protect the citrus guardrail) and pair with oven-baked sweet plantains or white rice.
watchOuts: Lime marinade on the snapper (choose plain salmon instead)
Pineapple and bell-pepper salsas

items.name: Luisa's Pollo Asado with Cilantro Rice & Sweet Plantains (Night 1)
items.whyItWorks: Roasted chicken breast/thigh with white rice and soft sweet maduro plantains offers high protein and soluble starch.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the Lighter Note plain roasted chicken breast (to avoid citrus-achiote marinade on the skin) with steamed white rice and sweet plantains.
watchOuts: Citrus-achiote marinade on standard Pollo Asado skin
Whole black beans if plated alongside

items.name: Main Dining "Very Very" Brioche French Toast & Cinnamon Sugar Dusted French Toast
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
items.whyItWorks: Thick egg-custard-soaked white brioche bread griddled golden—soft, seedless, and comforting.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Top with warm maple syrup or sliced bananas (skip seeded blackberry/raspberry compotes and pineapple) and take a Lactaid if needed.
watchOuts: Milk/cream in egg batter
High maple syrup sugar load if poured heavily

items.name: McDonald's Egg McMuffin (No Canadian Bacon / Plain)
items.whyItWorks: Uses a real Grade A egg freshly cracked into a circular cooking ring on the grill. Served on a toasted English muffin with light butter or American cheese, avoiding greasy pork sausages or processed bacon.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order an Egg McMuffin without Canadian bacon. If lactose intolerant, ask for "No cheese" as well.

items.name: Member's Mark Extra Lean Sliced Honey Ham (Deli 2 lb)
items.whyItWorks: Extra lean sliced deli ham with 97% fat-free profile. Thinly shaved with low gristle, it supplies easy protein without heavy cooking oils or tough connective tissue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer onto white bread or roll up plain for a quick high-protein snack. Discard visible outer edge fat.

items.name: Member's Mark Organic Whole Frozen Strawberries (Smoothie Hack)
items.whyItWorks: Strawberries are lower in FODMAP fructose than apples and mangos. Blending ripe frozen strawberries into smoothies completely pulverizes the delicate outer achenes (seeds), allowing antioxidant absorption without gut friction.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Puree smooth with water or plant milk and pure maple syrup for a gentle morning vitamin C boost.

items.name: Mickey's Smokestack BBQ Carved Texas Smoked Beef Brisket (Standalone)
items.whyItWorks: Slow-smoked for 12+ hours until collagen melts; the lean "flat" cut of brisket is zero-fiber, dairy-free, and citrus-free.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the carver for lean slices from the flat cut (not the fatty point), trim off the black-pepper outer bark edge, and eat without spicy BBQ sauce.
watchOuts: Coarse black pepper on outer bark edge
Fatty point cut if not requested lean

items.name: Morty's Cafe Morning Egg, Cheddar, Potato & Bacon/Steak Breakfast Burrito
items.whyItWorks: Scrambled eggs, melted cheddar, potatoes, and bacon or steak wrapped in a warm flour tortilla make a filling, portable breakfast before heading up Logan Canyon.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Bacon or Steak Breakfast Burrito with eggs, cheddar, and potatoes only—ask for no salsa, no raw pico de gallo, and no jalapeños.
watchOuts: Skip salsa verde/rojo and hot sauce packets

items.name: New England Clam Chowder with Potatoes & Sourdough Croutons (Let the Magic Begin Menu)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Let the Magic Begin Menu
items.whyItWorks: Creamy potato-and-clam broth with soft sourdough croutons is low-fiber and soothing.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pair with a Lactaid enzyme and skip any crispy bacon lardons if sensitive to cured fat.
watchOuts: Heavy cream lactose
Bacon lardons

items.name: North Italia (Mountain View Village · Herriman/Riverton) Fresh Pasta Bolognese & Margherita Pizza
items.brandOrRestaurant: North Italia (Mountain View Village · Riverton / Herriman / South Jordan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Minutes from Holiday Inn Express Herriman at Mountain View Village: North Italia makes fresh daily egg pasta in-house, and their braised Bolognese or plain butter/parmesan pasta is soft and low-fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Traditional Bolognese (or fresh trofie/tagliatelle pasta with butter/olive oil, Parmigiano-Reggiano, and grilled chicken/salmon) or the Margherita Pizza with a Lactaid.
watchOuts: Ask to hold spicy calabrian chilies on any pasta or pizza dish

items.name: Nuun Sport Electrolyte Hydration Tablets (Citrus Fruit)
items.whyItWorks: Dissolvable effervescent tablet with 300mg sodium, 150mg potassium, and only 1g sugar. Convenient for purse or backpack travel hydration without excessive sweetness.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drop 1 tablet into 16 oz water. Let it completely dissolve and stop fizzing before drinking to minimize swallowed air.

items.name: Oven-Roasted Half Cornish Hen with Israeli Couscous ('Til We Meet Again)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · 'Til We Meet Again Menu
items.whyItWorks: Tender roasted Cornish game hen and pearl Israeli couscous (refined toasted wheat pasta pearls) are soft and low-residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the lemon-herb sauce on the side (or remove the skin) and skip the roasted bell pepper/zucchini ratatouille.
watchOuts: Lemon-herb sauce on skin (order on side)
Vegetable skins in Mediterranean ratatouille

items.name: Palo Brunch Veal Saltimbocca with Prosciutto, Sage & Barolo Wine Jus
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
items.whyItWorks: Thinly pounded tender veal escalopes wrapped in prosciutto are zero-fiber protein; only the bitter rapini/broccoli rabe side needs swapping.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask to swap the fibrous black-garlic rapini side for creamy risotto or fondant potatoes, and order the Barolo jus on the side.
watchOuts: Fibrous rapini (broccoli rabe) side and black garlic (swap for risotto/potatoes)

items.name: Palo Brunch Warm Pastry Basket (Mini Cinnamon Rolls, Croissants & Pain au Chocolat)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
items.whyItWorks: Brought warm to your table at the start of Palo Brunch: soft glazed mini cinnamon rolls, flaky butter croissants, and pain au chocolat made from refined white flour.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy the warm glazed cinnamon roll, plain butter croissant, or chocolate croissant; skip the seeded multigrain bread sticks (grissini) and any almond/nut-crusted Danish.
watchOuts: Butter/milk in laminated pastry dough
Skip seeded breadsticks in the same basket

items.name: Pan-Seared Parmesan-Crusted Chicken Breast with Fettuccine (Captain's Gala Night 2)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · 1923 / Disney Wonder & Magic · Captain's Gala Menu
items.whyItWorks: Lean chicken breast coated in aged Parmesan breadcrumbs over soft white fettuccine ribbons is a hearty, low-fiber classic.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for light cream/butter on the fettuccine, hold any pancetta or mushroom garnish, and take a Lactaid.
watchOuts: Cream sauce lactose
Pan-seared breading oil

items.name: Pirate Night: King George's Roasted Strip Loin
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu

items.name: Disneyland Main Street & Grand Californian Holiday Soft Gingerbread Mickey Cookie & Sugar Cookie
items.brandOrRestaurant: Jolly Holiday, Market House & Grand Californian Lobby Cart (Disneyland Resort)
items.whyItWorks: Disney's famous plush-soft Mickey Gingerbread Cookie (sold at Jolly Holiday and the Grand Californian lobby cart during the holidays) is baked with refined flour, molasses, and gut-soothing ginger with zero nuts or seeds.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick up a soft Mickey Gingerbread Cookie with chocolate-dipped ears and share half with warm herbal tea or hot cocoa (with lactase).
watchOuts: High sugar in the royal icing—enjoy half a cookie at a time

items.name: Disneyland Rancho del Zocalo Pollo Asado or Carne Asada Soft Flour Tacos & Rice (Mild Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Rancho del Zocalo Restaurante (Frontierland · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Rancho del Zocalo offers generous portions of flame-grilled chicken or carne asada and a Kids' Bean-Free Chicken Taco & Rice plate—swapping to soft flour tortillas and holding raw onions/lime keeps it gentle.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pollo Asado or Carne Asada on soft flour tortillas (or the Kids' Taco Plate) with rice only—ask for no whole/refried beans, no raw onion/cilantro relish, no salsa, and no lime squeeze.
watchOuts: Standard plates include whole/refried pinto beans, pickled onions, and lime wedges—request plain meat, flour tortillas, and rice

items.name: Disneyland Refreshment Corner (Main Street) Plain Footlong / Regular All-Beef Hot Dog & Chips
items.brandOrRestaurant: Refreshment Corner (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: A plain all-beef frankfurter on a soft white bun with potato chips or applesauce is dairy-free, citrus-free, and quick to mobile-order on Main Street.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the plain **All-Beef Hot Dog** (or Kids' Hot Dog)—skip the Chili-Cheese Dog and Mac & Cheese Jalapeño Dog.
watchOuts: Never order the Chili Dog or Jalapeño Cheese Dog during sensitive periods

items.name: Disneyland Ronto Roasters "Ronto Morning Wrap" (Eggs & Cheddar on Pita)
items.whyItWorks: Scrambled eggs, grilled pork sausage, and melted cheddar cheese wrapped in a warm soft pita bread. Soft, filling, and high in morning protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Ronto Morning Wrap with light peppercorn sauce (or request no sauce for zero spice).
watchOuts: Request no peppercorn sauce if sensitive to black pepper

items.name: DP Cheesesteaks (Draper / South Jordan / Lehi) Grilled Chicken or Ribeye & Provolone ("Wiz Witout")
items.brandOrRestaurant: DP Cheesesteaks (Draper / South Jordan / Lehi, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Thinly shaved chicken breast or ribeye steak Chop-Griddled on an authentic soft Amoroso hoagie roll with mild aged provolone cheese ("witout" onions/peppers) is soft, low-fiber, and easy to chew.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Plain Chicken or Steak Provolone Cheesesteak "Witout" (NO grilled onions, NO bell peppers, NO jalapenos, and provolone instead of processed Cheez Whiz).
watchOuts: Choose aged Provolone cheese instead of liquid Cheez Whiz (high lactose + emulsifiers) and always order "witout" onions

items.name: Golden Thick-Cut French Toast with Syrup & Butter
items.whyItWorks: Soft thick Texas toast dipped in smooth beaten egg batter and cooked on a flat griddle provides easily absorbable carbohydrates and gentle protein with zero harsh roughage, making it a reliable warm breakfast choice.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for butter on the side and use pure maple syrup or pancake syrup in moderate amounts. Avoid ordering with powdered sugar dusting or side bacon if fat-sensitive.

items.name: Herm's Giant Buttermilk Pancakes with Pure Maple Syrup
items.whyItWorks: Herm's famous plate-sized pancakes made from sifted flour deliver smooth, easily broken-down carbohydrates. Zero rough fiber or irritating seeds make this comforting breakfast very gentle on sensitive intestines.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order with real pure maple syrup. Eat half or share due to the generous portion size, and ask for butter on the side.

items.name: Holiday Soft Frosted Vanilla Sugar Cookies (Christmas Trees & Stars)
items.whyItWorks: Soft, pillowy butter sugar cookie cutouts frosted with smooth royal icing. Completely seed-free, nut-free, and easy to chew during holiday gatherings.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy 1-2 soft frosted cookies with a warm cup of herbal tea.
watchOuts: None; gentle holiday sweet treat

items.name: JCW's (The Burger Boys) Grilled Turkey Bacon Swiss Sandwich or Plain Charbroiled Burger
items.brandOrRestaurant: JCW's The Burger Boys (Orem / Lehi / South Jordan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: A popular lunch spot near both BambooHR (Orem/Lehi) and South Jordan; ordering the Grilled Turkey Breast & Swiss Sandwich on sourdough or a plain single Cheeseburger keeps fat and spice manageable.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Grilled Turkey Bacon Swiss (no tomato or lettuce) or a plain single Hamburger/Cheeseburger with aged cheddar or Swiss—ask for JCW's special fry sauce on the side.
watchOuts: JCW's famous shakes are huge and extremely high in lactose/sugar—skip shakes during flares or share a mini cup with lactase

items.name: Knott's Cantina Del Sur (Fiesta Village) Carne Asada or Pollo Street Tacos (Plain Meat & Tortilla Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Cantina Del Sur (Fiesta Village · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Simple grilled steak or chicken street tacos on warm soft tortillas—ordering them "meat only" without raw diced onions, cilantro, or lime keeps them clean.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Carne Asada or Pollo Tacos plain (meat and tortilla only, no raw onion or cilantro) and do not use the lime wedges or hot salsa.
watchOuts: Skip the margaritas and citrus agua frescas at the cantina window

items.name: Mad Moose Cafe (Eden, UT) "Bruce the Moose" BLT with Sliced Avocado on Sourdough
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mad Moose Cafe (Eden / Ogden Valley, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Crispy applewood smoked bacon, creamy sliced avocado, and mayo on toasted fermented sourdough bread. Sourdough is naturally low in FODMAPs.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Bruce the Moose BLT on toasted sourdough; hold raw tomato slices during sensitive phases.
watchOuts: Hold tomato slices if acid-sensitive

items.name: Milky Way Bar (Milk Chocolate, Caramel & Malt Nougat — Nut-Free!)
items.whyItWorks: Unlike Snickers which has whole peanuts, Milky Way contains light whipped malt nougat and smooth caramel coated in milk chocolate. With zero nuts or seeds, it melts completely in the mouth.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy a fun-size bar or half a regular bar in remission. Chew slowly.
watchOuts: Contains milk, malted barley, and soy; enjoy in moderation due to sugar and fat content.

items.name: Murgh Tikka (Tandoori Boneless Chicken Breast)
items.whyItWorks: Lean chunks of boneless chicken breast marinated in yogurt and mild Indian spices, skewered and roasted in the dry heat of the tandoor. It is ultra-lean protein without heavy cream gravies.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for mild seasoning and skip the raw sliced red onion and lemon wedge garnish. Pair with plain basmati rice.

items.name: Ore-Ida Golden Tater Tots (Air-Fried or Oven-Baked)
items.whyItWorks: Finely shredded Idaho russet potatoes seasoned with salt and par-fried. When baked in the oven or air fryer without added oil, they crisp up on the outside while the interior melts into fluffy potato starch.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake at 425°F for 20 minutes until golden. Do not deep-fry in oil to keep fat levels manageable.
watchOuts: Contains par-fried oil; enjoy in standard 3-oz servings.

items.name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park, CA) Crispy Golden Ham Croquettes (Croquetas de Jamón)
items.whyItWorks: Minced smoked ham blended into smooth white sauce and fried until crisp outside and creamy inside. Savory, protein-packed, and low in fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order 2-3 warm Ham Croquettes; enjoy warm.
watchOuts: Smoked ham provides natural sodium

items.name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park, CA) Dulce de Leche "Besito" Butter Shortbread Cookie
items.whyItWorks: Tender, melt-in-your-mouth butter shortbread cookie filled with rich, caramelized dulce de leche and dusted with powdered sugar. Completely seed-free and nut-free.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a box of Besito cookies for snacking at Knott's Berry Farm.
watchOuts: None; gentle shortbread cookie

items.name: Sabores "The Havana" Roasted Pork, Smoked Turkey & Swiss on French Bread
items.whyItWorks: Slow-roasted pork, smoked turkey breast, ham, and naturally lactose-safe Swiss cheese pressed on soft white French bread offer a high-protein sandwich when ordered without spicy sauce or pickles.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order "The Havana" sandwich on French bread with Swiss cheese only—ask for no pickles, no raw onions, and sauce on the side.
watchOuts: Skip the side pasta salad if dressed with raw onions/peppers; swap for white rice or plain kettle chips

items.name: Silverlake Ramen Chashu Don Rice Bowl (Riverton)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Silverlake Ramen (Mountain View Village · Riverton, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Diced braised tender pork drizzled with sweet soy glaze over a large bowl of steaming white Calrose rice. Gentle on digestion without heavy soup oils.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Request NO green onion garnish and NO spicy mayo drizzle. Eat with plain white rice.

items.name: Starbucks Butter Croissant (Warmed)
items.whyItWorks: Traditional laminated pastry made with unbleached enriched flour and real butter. Low in residue and easy to chew when warmed.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for it warmed. Pair with a chamomile or mint herbal tea rather than espresso.

items.name: Steamed Tender Green Beans (Fork-Soft)
items.whyItWorks: Green beans are low-FODMAP and safe for most IBD patients when cooked thoroughly. Steaming breaks down the outer cellulose pod, rendering them soft and non-bloating.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Snap off woody stem ends and steam for 10–12 minutes until tender and easily pierced with a fork. Avoid al dente or crunchy snap beans during flare-ups.
watchOuts: Never eat raw or undercooked crunchy green beans during active inflammation.

items.name: Strawberry Greek Yogurt Parfait Cup (No Granola)
items.whyItWorks: Strained Greek yogurt provides rich protein and probiotic cultures, while soft ripe strawberries deliver antioxidants. Skipping hard seed-heavy oat granola protects narrowing gut lumen.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the parfait without granola topping (or discard granola packet). Safe if lactose tolerant or taking lactase.

items.name: Wendy's Jr. Hamburger (Plain on White Bun)
items.whyItWorks: Wendy's uses 100% fresh, never-frozen North American beef grilled without added marinades or fillers. Served plain on a soft white sandwich bun, it provides easy animal protein with zero dairy, onions, or spices.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order at the drive-thru: "Jr. Hamburger, totally PLAIN—meat and bun only. No pickles, no onions, no ketchup, no mustard."

items.name: Bear Lake Pizza Co. (Garden City, UT) Soft Dough Breadsticks with Marinara Dip
items.brandOrRestaurant: Bear Lake Pizza Co. (Garden City, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Freshly baked soft pizza dough brushed with light butter and herbs. Dipped in smooth, mild tomato sauce. Soft, filling, and seed-free.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Breadsticks with light garlic and marinara dipping sauce.
watchOuts: Request light garlic

items.name: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City, UT) Cheese Enchilada & Spanish Rice Plate
items.brandOrRestaurant: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Warm baked corn tortillas, mild red enchilada sauce, melted cheddar/jack cheese, and tender Spanish white rice make an easily tolerated Mexican staple in remission.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the 1-Entree Cheese Enchilada with Spanish rice and refried beans (or ask to substitute extra rice for the beans if sensitive to legumes).
watchOuts: Sub extra Spanish rice for refried beans if bean skins cause gas

items.name: Café Sabor Grilled Shrimp or Fish Soft Tacos (No Lime/Pico Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Café Sabor (Garden City / Bear Lake & Logan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Grilled shrimp or flaky white fish on soft flour tortillas with white rice is lean and easy to digest when ordered plain without raw cabbage slaw, spicy chipotle crema, or lime juice.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Grilled Shrimp or Fish Tacos on soft flour tortillas with plain seasoning (no blackened spice), no raw cabbage slaw, no pico de gallo, and no lime wedges; pair with white rice.
watchOuts: Standard preparation includes raw cabbage slaw, mango pico de gallo (raw onion/jalapeño/lime), and citrus—must request plain grilled fish/shrimp

items.name: Chick-fil-A Fresh Fruit Cup
items.whyItWorks: A mix of chopped red and green apples, mandarin orange segments, and blueberries. Provides natural hydration and soluble pectin; suitable for remission or mild symptoms when thoroughly chewed.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order chilled. If citrus triggers acid reflux or strictures, eat only the soft chopped apple pieces.

items.name: CHOM Burger "Lil Chom" Single Cheddar Smashburger & Plain Fries
items.brandOrRestaurant: CHOM Burger (Orem / Provo / South Jordan / Cottonwood Heights, UT)
items.whyItWorks: The "Lil Chom" single-patty burger on CHOM's soft house-baked potato bun gives you a right-sized portion of antibiotic-free beef and melted cheddar without the heavy grease of a double burger.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the "Lil Chom" Burger with cheddar cheese only on the potato bun (no lettuce, tomato, raw onion, pickles, or CHOM sauce) and pair with a small plain French fries.
watchOuts: Skip the spicy Jalapeño Chom, Guacamole Bacon Burger, and garlic-herb fries

items.name: Costa Vida (Draper / Herriman / Orem / Logan) Grilled Chicken or Sweet Pork Bowl (Cilantro-Free Rice, No Beans/Lime)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Costa Vida Fresh Mexican Grill (Draper / Herriman / Orem / Logan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Soft house-made flour tortillas, tender shredded sweet pork or grilled chicken, Monterey Jack cheese, and guacamole provide a comforting Utah Mexican meal when you skip whole black/pinto beans, raw lettuce, and salsa.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Small Sweet Pork or Grilled Chicken Quesadilla or Burrito (baked "enchilada style" without sauce, or dry) with rice and Jack cheese ONLY—hold black/pinto beans, shredded lettuce, pico de gallo, and lime wedges.
watchOuts: Costa Vida rice and marinades contain a hint of lime juice (citrusFree: false)—if strictly flaring from trace citrus, order a plain Flour Tortilla & Jack Cheese Quesadilla with plain shredded chicken

items.name: Costco Food Court (Logan & Draper, UT) Giant Plain Cheese Pizza Slice
items.whyItWorks: Enormous slice loaded with over 1.5 lbs of melted whole-milk mozzarella and mild tomato sauce. Soft dough digests easily in stable remission.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Dab the top with a paper napkin to absorb excess surface oil before eating.
watchOuts: High in dairy mozzarella; dab surface oil

items.name: DCA Award Wieners (Hollywood Land) Plain All-Beef Hot Dog on Potato Bun & Filmstrip Fries
items.brandOrRestaurant: Award Wieners (Hollywood Land · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: A skinless all-beef frankfurter served on a pillowy soft toasted potato roll with crispy ribbon-cut Filmstrip Fries is dairy-free, citrus-free, and low-fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the **All-Beef Hot Dog** (or Kids' Mini Hot Dog) plain with Filmstrip Fries—skip the Bacon Street Dog (bell peppers/onions) and Uptown Chili Dog.
watchOuts: Avoid Loaded Carne Asada Fries (spicy salsa de arbol + raw onions + cilantro) and Uptown Chili Dogs

items.name: DCA Flo's V8 Cafe "Ka-Cheeseburger" Plain Angus Burger on Sesame Bun
items.whyItWorks: Angus beef patty with melted cheddar cheese on a soft sesame bun with fries. When ordered plain without Thousand Island sauce, pickles, or raw onions, it is very easy on digestion.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Ka-Cheeseburger plain with ketchup only (hold Thousand Island dressing, raw onions, and pickles).
watchOuts: Hold raw onions, pickles, and Thousand Island sauce

items.name: DCA Lamplight Lounge (Pixar Pier) Signature Cheddar Burger on Toasted Brioche & Malted Fries
items.brandOrRestaurant: Lamplight Lounge (Pixar Pier · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: Grilled custom-blend beef patty with melted aged cheddar on a super-soft toasted Amish brioche bun; ordering it plain without the roasted green chile and raw tomato makes it a great waterfront meal.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Cheddar Burger medium-well with aged cheddar and bacon only—specifically ask for **NO roasted green chile** and **NO chipotle-cherry barbecue sauce**.
watchOuts: Default build includes a roasted green chile pepper—always ask your server to leave the green chile off!

items.name: Disneyland Alien Pizza Planet "Count Down Chicken Fusilli" (Pesto Cream Pasta)
items.whyItWorks: Spiral fusilli pasta tossed with tender grilled chicken breast, parmesan-pesto cream sauce, and sun-dried tomatoes. Pasta and chicken provide easily chewed, comforting energy.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Count Down Chicken Fusilli; ask for light sauce.
watchOuts: Pesto cream sauce contains dairy and finely pureed herbs

items.name: Disneyland Galactic Grill American Breakfast Burrito (Scrambled Eggs & Hash Browns)
items.whyItWorks: Fluffy scrambled eggs, diced bacon, sausage, breakfast hash browns, and cheddar cheese wrapped in a warm soft flour tortilla. Sits smoothly on the gut before Tomorrowland rope drop.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the American Breakfast Burrito with mild salsa on the side (hold spicy pico).
watchOuts: Salsa served on side lets you control acidity

items.name: Disneyland Galactic Grill Plain Angus Cheeseburger, Chicken Tenders or Morning Breakfast Burrito
items.whyItWorks: Tomorrowland's go-to counter for a plain American cheeseburger on a toasted bun, French fries, or a morning egg-bacon-cheddar breakfast burrito (ordered without salsa).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: For breakfast, order the Breakfast Burrito or French Toast Sticks with salsa on the side (do not use); for lunch/dinner, order a plain Cheeseburger with cheese only and fries.
watchOuts: Skip Galactic Grill's neon slushies and citrus-loaded specialty space lemonades

items.name: Disneyland Hungry Bear Barbecue Jamboree Smoked Brisket or Pulled Pork Sandwich & Fries (Plain Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Hungry Bear Barbecue Jamboree (Bayou Country · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: The newly reimagined Hungry Bear Barbecue Jamboree slow-smokes tender beef brisket and pulled pork; ordering on a soft bun with BBQ sauce on the side and plain french fries (skipping the baked beans and slaw) makes a hearty park meal.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Smoked Brisket Sandwich or Pulled Pork Sandwich with BBQ sauce on the side, no raw coleslaw/pickles, and swap the baked beans side for French fries or mandarin-free applesauce.
watchOuts: Skip the BBQ baked beans, jalapeño cornbread, and raw cabbage coleslaw; DO NOT order the specialty lemonades (citrus trigger)

items.name: Disneyland Jolly Holiday "Jolly Holiday Combo" Toasted Cheese & Tomato Soup
items.whyItWorks: Disneyland's signature rainy-day comfort meal! Melted cheddar and Swiss cheeses griddled on sourdough bread, paired with smooth, creamy tomato basil soup.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Jolly Holiday Combo; dip the warm grilled cheese into the smooth tomato soup.
watchOuts: Tomato soup has mild acidity; enjoy in moderation if acid-sensitive

items.name: Disneyland Ronto Roasters Classic Ronto Wrap (Roasted Pork & Sausage in Pita — No Slaw/Sauce Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Ronto Roasters (Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Sliced slow-roasted pork and grilled sausage in a warm, soft pita bread are dairy-free and high-protein once you hold the crunchy cabbage slaw and peppercorn "clutch" sauce.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Ronto Wrap with **NO slaw** and **NO peppercorn sauce** (just the roasted pork, sausage, and warm pita).
watchOuts: Standard wrap is topped with raw cabbage slaw and spicy Sichuan peppercorn sauce—must order plain

items.name: Disneyland The Golden Horseshoe & Gibson Girl Hand-Scooped Vanilla Bean Ice Cream (Lactase or Plant-Based Mod)
items.brandOrRestaurant: The Golden Horseshoe & Gibson Girl Ice Cream Parlor (Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Gibson Girl on Main Street carries **Plant-Based Non-Dairy Chocolate/Vanilla Ice Cream** (100% lactose-free!) as well as classic Dreyer's Vanilla Bean and Mint Chip (enjoyed with lactase enzymes).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: At Gibson Girl, ask for the Plant-Based Non-Dairy Scoop in a cup or wafer cone for zero lactose, or take 2 lactase tablets before ordering a classic Vanilla or Chocolate Chip Cookie Sundae.
watchOuts: Skip waffle bowls dipped in peanuts/almonds and avoid carbonated root beer floats during flares

items.name: Disneyland The Tropical Hideaway Steamed Pork & Lemongrass Bao Bun
items.whyItWorks: Soft, pillowy steamed yeast dough filled with savory minced pork, sweet soy, and a hint of lemongrass. Steamed buns are low-fat and easy to chew.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Steamed Pork Bao Bun; enjoy with mild soy dipping sauce (avoid spicy chili garlic sauce).
watchOuts: Avoid spicy chili dipping sauce

items.name: Disneyland Tiana's Palace Slow-Cooked Beef Po'Boy on New Orleans French Bread (Hold Pickles/Remoulade)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Tiana's Palace (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Slow-braised shredded beef tossed in savory beef gravy and melted cheddar on airy, soft New Orleans-style Leidenheimer French bread is very tender once you hold the tangy remoulade and pickles.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Beef Po'Boy with **NO remoulade**, **NO shredded lettuce**, and **NO pickles**, and swap the red beans & rice side for plain steamed white rice.
watchOuts: Default sandwich includes tangy/spicy remoulade, lettuce, and pickles—must order plain

items.name: Downtown Disney Black Tap Craft Burgers Plain "All-American" Burger or Grilled Chicken Sandwich
items.brandOrRestaurant: Black Tap Craft Burgers & Shakes (Downtown Disney District · Disneyland Resort)
items.whyItWorks: Black Tap grills tender prime beef burgers, turkey burgers, and buttermilk-free grilled chicken breast sandwiches on soft Martin's potato rolls!
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the All-American Burger, California Turkey Burger, or Grilled Chicken Sandwich on the Martin's potato roll with aged cheddar or Swiss only (no special sauce, pickles, or raw onions).
watchOuts: Black Tap's famous CrazyShakes contain 1,200+ calories of heavy dairy cream and sugar—skip or take 1–2 small spoonfuls with lactase in deep remission

items.name: Downtown Disney Salt & Straw Dairy-Free Coconut/Oat Flavors or Double Fold Vanilla (With Lactase)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Salt & Straw Scoop Shop (Downtown Disney District · Disneyland Resort)
searchKeywords: dairy free ice cream downtown disney
items.whyItWorks: Salt & Straw always keeps 20% of its menu 100% Vegan/Dairy-Free (made with coconut cream or oat milk) and offers Kids'/Single Split Scoops so you can enjoy a small portion without lactose.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask to sample the current non-citrus, nut-free Dairy-Free Coconut/Oat flavor (or order a Kids' scoop of Double Fold Vanilla / Sea Salt Caramel with 2 lactase tablets).
watchOuts: Avoid flavors with black pepper, habanero, citrus curd, or whole brittle nuts

items.name: Firehouse Pizzeria (Logan, UT) Stone-Baked Mozzarella Breadsticks with Marinara
items.whyItWorks: Stone-hearth baked dough brushed with light butter and melted whole-milk mozzarella. Served with smooth, mild marinara dipping sauce on the side.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Mozzarella Breadsticks with light garlic and mild marinara for dipping.
watchOuts: Request light garlic butter

items.name: French Dip Roast Beef Sandwich with Au Jus
items.whyItWorks: Thinly sliced, tender lean roast beef served on a soft French hoagie bun is naturally dairy-free and virtually free of rough fiber. Dipping lightly in warm au jus provides savory moisture without needing irritating condiments.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the French dip on a soft plain French roll with au jus on the side. Skip cheese and creamy horseradish sauce.

items.name: Fresh Apple Slices (Thoroughly Peeled)
items.whyItWorks: Peeling an apple completely strips away the insoluble cellulose skin that acts like sandpaper against raw intestine. The inner flesh consists predominantly of soluble pectin, which is well tolerated when chewed to a paste.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Use a vegetable peeler to peel away all red/green skin. Slice thinly and chew each slice thoroughly, or steam lightly for enhanced tenderness.
watchOuts: Never eat apple peels during flares or with known strictures; apple peels are notorious intestinal blockage culprits.

items.name: Frito-Lay Mild Cheddar Cheese Dip (Smooth Can)
items.whyItWorks: A completely smooth, seedless, non-spicy processed cheese dip. Contains 0g fiber and zero peppers or onions; provides comforting savory flavor for pretzels when in remission.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve slightly warm or room temperature. Take a lactase enzyme tablet if lactose sensitive.

items.name: Holiday Traditional Spiced Pumpkin Pie Slice with Whipped Cream
items.whyItWorks: Smooth pureed pumpkin custard baked in a tender flour crust. Pumpkin provides soluble fiber and beta-carotene that is gentle on mucosal linings. Completely seed-free.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy a slice of pumpkin pie warm or chilled with a dollop of whipped cream.
watchOuts: Contains dairy evaporated milk and egg custard

items.name: JCW's (American Fork & Lehi, UT) Charbroiled Plain Cheeseburger on White Bun
items.brandOrRestaurant: JCW's The Burger Boys (American Fork & Lehi, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Famous Utah Valley burger spot! High flame charbroiling allows excess fat to drip off the beef patty. On a plain bun with ketchup, it is very easy on digestion.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Charbroiled Cheeseburger plain with ketchup only (hold lettuce, tomato, onion, and pickles).
watchOuts: Skip raw onions and pickles

items.name: Kirkland Signature Organic Frozen Blueberries (Strained Smoothie Hack)
items.whyItWorks: Rich in anthocyanins and polyphenols shown to reduce gut inflammation. While eating whole raw berries passes insoluble skin flakes, high-speed blending or straining into a smooth beverage provides all the anti-inflammatory benefits without roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Blend completely in a high-powered blender with lactose-free almond milk or water until smooth. Strain through a fine mesh sieve if strictures are present.

items.name: Kneaders Chunky Cinnamon French Toast with Caramel Syrup
items.whyItWorks: Famous thick slices of Kneaders Chunky Cinnamon bread dipped in egg custard and griddled soft. Refined flour and egg provide easily broken-down carbohydrates and gentle protein without rough seed fibers.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for warm caramel syrup or maple syrup in moderation on the side. Skip whipped cream if lactose intolerant.

items.name: Knott's Coasters Diner (Boardwalk) Plain Cheeseburger, Grilled Chicken Club or Hot Dog Basket
items.brandOrRestaurant: Coasters Diner (The Boardwalk · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: 50s diner serving plain cheeseburgers, jumbo all-beef hot dogs, and grilled chicken sandwiches with French fries.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Cheeseburger, Grilled Chicken Sandwich, or Hot Dog plain on the bun (no raw onions, lettuce, tomato, or diner sauce) with fries.
watchOuts: Skip Chili Cheese Fries and deep-fried Onion Rings

items.name: Knott's Ghost Town Grill Calico Charbroiled Cheeseburger with Fries
items.whyItWorks: 1/3 lb charbroiled Angus chuck patty with melted cheddar cheese on a soft toasted bun with fries. Plain ordering makes this an easily digested theme park staple.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Calico Cheeseburger plain with ketchup only (hold lettuce, tomato, pickles, and raw onions).
watchOuts: Hold raw onions and pickles

items.name: Knott's Ghost Town Grill Plain Cheddar Burger on Brioche or Sourdough Patty Melt (No Grilled Onions)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Ghost Town Grill (Ghost Town · Knott's Berry Farm)
searchKeywords: patty melt ghost town grill knotts
items.whyItWorks: Cooked to order in a sit-down kitchen rather than kept under a heat lamp: a plain Cheddar Burger or Sourdough Patty Melt (ordered without grilled onions or thousand island) with fries.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Burger with aged cheddar only (or Patty Melt on sourdough with Swiss/cheddar and NO grilled onions).
watchOuts: Always request no grilled/raw onions on the Patty Melt

items.name: LaBeau's (Garden City, UT) Famous Golden Fried Halibut Basket & Fries
items.whyItWorks: LaBeau's famous golden halibut is tender and flaky. Halibut is naturally low-fat and easy to absorb. Tartar sauce served on the side.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Halibut Basket with tartar sauce on the side; peel off outer crispy batter if digestive sensitivity is active.
