items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask at the window for the Gluten-Friendly Cookie and scrape out the center jam if it contains berry seeds.
watchOuts: Center jam filling sometimes contains berry seeds—eat around the jam center if flaring

items.name: DCA Schmoozies! (Hollywood Land) Mango-Banana Smoothie vs. Mickey Shake (Check Citrus)
items.whyItWorks: Blended ripe banana and mango with low-fat yogurt provides soluble fiber and potassium on a hot afternoon in Hollywood Land.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Mango-Banana Smoothie (verify at the window that no orange/lemon juice base is used, and take a lactase tablet for the yogurt) or a warm Mickey Waffle when offered.
watchOuts: Skip Strawberry-Banana if strawberry seeds bother you, and avoid all Lemonade slushies (citrus trigger)

items.name: Disneyland Gibson Girl Hand-Scooped Vanilla Ice Cream Dish (Seed-Free Sweet)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Gibson Girl Ice Cream Parlor (Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Single scoop of smooth Dreyer's vanilla ice cream served in a cup. Completely seed-free, nut-free, and refreshing on a warm park afternoon.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a single scoop of vanilla or chocolate ice cream in a dish (pass on strawberry sundaes with berry seeds).
watchOuts: Contains dairy cream; take lactase enzyme tablet if lactose sensitive

items.name: Disneyland Milk Stand Legendary "Blue Milk" (Plant-Based Coconut & Rice Milk)
items.whyItWorks: 100% dairy-free and vegan! Blended frozen smoothie made from coconut and rice milks flavored with mild dragon fruit and berry notes. Completely free of lactose and heavy dairy fat.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the classic Blue Milk; sip slowly to avoid brain freeze.
watchOuts: Cold frozen beverage; drink at moderate pace to avoid cold-induced gut motility

items.name: Disneyland Plaza Inn World-Famous Fried Chicken Dinner (3-Piece Platter)
items.whyItWorks: Disneyland's most famous dinner! Three pieces of golden herb-seasoned fried chicken with smooth mashed potatoes, brown poultry gravy, and a soft dinner roll. High in bioavailable protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Fried Chicken Dinner with mashed potatoes and gravy; peel off part of the crispy skin if feeling digestive sensitivity.
watchOuts: Peel away seasoned fried skin during active symptoms

items.name: Disneyland Red Rose Taverne Cheeseburger, Chicken Tenders or Cheese Flatbread Pizza
items.whyItWorks: Offers straightforward Angus cheeseburgers on soft brioche buns, crispy chicken tenders, and kids' grilled chicken plates right in Fantasyland.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a plain Cheeseburger (no secret sauce/pickles) or Kids' Chicken meal with fries or banana; if sharing "The Grey Stuff" cookies-and-cream mousse dessert, take a lactase enzyme.
watchOuts: Skip the spicy/tangy sauces on the specialty burgers and take lactase for cheese flatbreads or Grey Stuff mousse

items.name: Disneyland Red Rose Taverne Tavern Double Angus Cheeseburger & Fries
items.whyItWorks: Two 1/3 lb Angus beef patties with melted cheddar cheese on a soft brioche bun. When ordered plain without Thousand Island sauce, pickles, or raw onions, it is very easy on digestion.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Tavern Double plain with ketchup only (hold tavern sauce, raw onions, and pickles).
watchOuts: Hold raw onions, pickles, and tavern sauce

items.name: Downtown Disney Jazz Kitchen Coastal Grill & Patio: Classic Café du Monde-Style Beignets & Plain Grilled Fish/Chicken
items.brandOrRestaurant: Jazz Kitchen Coastal Grill & Patio / Beignets Expressed (Downtown Disney District)
items.whyItWorks: At the table-service patio, you can request plain grilled Gulf fish or chicken breast with steamed white rice (no Cajun blackening), and at the walk-up **Beignets Expressed** window you can share classic warm New Orleans powdered-sugar beignets.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: For dinner, ask for Grilled Fish or Chicken with **NO Cajun spice** and steamed white rice (avoid the spicy Pasta Jambalaya and dark Gumbo); at Beignets Expressed, stick to classic Powdered Sugar Beignets.
watchOuts: Avoid Pasta Jambalaya (spicy Andouille sausage + cayenne) and glazed beignets with citrus/berry seeds

items.name: Grizzly Creek Classic Grilled American Cheese on Sourdough
items.whyItWorks: Melted American cheese griddled between two slices of white or sourdough bread provides gentle carbohydrates and warm comfort food in Camp Snoopy without fried batter, raw greens, or spicy seasoning.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the grilled cheese lightly griddled. Ask to swap french fries for a fruit cup or applesauce pouch.

items.name: Heinz Original Tomato Ketchup (Smooth Mild Condiment)
items.whyItWorks: Smooth, concentrated tomato paste cooked with vinegar, corn syrup, salt, and onion powder. It has zero seeds and zero tomato skins. Safe in remission in 1-tablespoon servings.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Dip baked potato fries or chicken tenders lightly. Avoid drowning foods in ketchup during flares.
watchOuts: Contains natural tomato acid, onion powder, and high-fructose corn syrup; avoid in acute gastritis or active flare-ups.

items.name: Herm's Inn (Logan, UT) "Herm's Hash" Crispy Corned Beef Hash & Two Eggs
items.whyItWorks: Scratch-made juniper-cured corned beef griddled with shredded potatoes and served with two eggs cooked to order. Flavorful and hearty.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Herm's Hash with scrambled or poached eggs and white toast (hold raw onions if sensitive).
watchOuts: Corned beef has sodium and spices; moderate portion advised

items.name: Hershey's Milk Chocolate Bar (Plain Slices)
items.whyItWorks: Plain milk chocolate has lower caffeine and theobromine than dark chocolate, and melts at body temperature without nuts or seeds. Provides quick comforting sweetness in deep remission.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Break off 2–3 rectangular pips (about 15–20g). Let melt slowly on the tongue rather than chewing rapidly.
watchOuts: Contains milk and cocoa butter; excessive amounts can trigger diarrhea in flare-ups.

items.name: Holiday Warm Baked Brie in Puff Pastry with Honey & Water Crackers (No Nuts/Cranberries)
items.whyItWorks: Ripened Brie is naturally very low in lactose (<0.5g per serving) because the mold cultures break down the milk sugars; drizzled with pure honey inside flaky puff pastry with plain water crackers, it is a safe holiday party starter.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Top the wheel of Brie with pure honey or seedless apricot preserves before wrapping in puff pastry—leave off chopped pecans/walnuts and whole cranberries.
watchOuts: Skip chopped pecans, walnuts, and whole cranberry-orange toppings; eat a modest portion as puff pastry is high in butterfat

items.name: Hot Ham & Swiss on Grilled White Bread
items.whyItWorks: Tender sliced deli ham served on plain griddled white bread provides gentle protein with low roughage. Swiss cheese is naturally very low in lactose, making this warm sandwich far gentler on Crohn's digestion than fatty burgers or fried items.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for it lightly grilled without extra butter or margarine on the griddle. Skip mustard, pickles, or tomato if sensitive to acids.

items.name: Just Bare Lightly Breaded Chicken Breast Chunks (Costco Cult Favorite)
items.whyItWorks: Made from solid whole-muscle chicken breast chunks with a very light flour dusting rather than a heavy, thick batter. Bakes up crispy in a toaster oven without absorbing deep fryer grease.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake in oven or air fryer until golden. Avoid dipping into spicy sauces or heavy mayonnaise if experiencing active symptoms.

items.name: Knott's Coasters Diner Classic Double Cheeseburger with French Fries
items.whyItWorks: Two griddled beef patties with melted American cheese on a soft sesame seed bun. When ordered without raw onions, pickles, or special sauce, it digests easily in remission.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Double Cheeseburger plain with ketchup only (hold special sauce, lettuce, tomato, onions, and pickles).
watchOuts: Hold raw onions and pickles

items.name: Knott's Ghost Town Bakery & Farm Bakery Snoopy Sugar Cookie, Plain Croissant or Warm Cinnamon Roll
items.brandOrRestaurant: Ghost Town Bakery & Farm Bakery (Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Fresh-baked butter croissants, soft Snoopy sugar cookies, and warm cinnamon rolls are 100% free of boysenberry seeds, nuts, and roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose a plain Butter Croissant, a Snoopy Shortbread/Sugar Cookie, or share the soft center of a warm Cinnamon Roll (avoid whole-berry Boysenberry Turnovers and Boysenberry Pie slices).
watchOuts: Skip turnovers and pies filled with whole seeded boysenberries

items.name: Knott's Mrs. Knott's Golden Chicken Pot Pie with Flaky Pastry Crust
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Tender shredded chicken breast and soft diced carrots simmered in rich chicken gravy under a golden, flaky pastry crust. Comforting and easy to break down in remission.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken Pot Pie; eat the tender chicken, soft carrots, and flaky top crust (leave whole green peas if pea skins cause gas).
watchOuts: Whole green peas can produce mild gas in sensitive intestines

items.name: Knott's Sutter's Grill (Ghost Town) Plain Charbroiled Cheeseburger or Chicken Tenders & Fries
items.brandOrRestaurant: Sutter's Grill (Ghost Town · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Simple American cheeseburger on a soft white bun or crispy white-meat chicken tenders with French fries.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a plain Cheeseburger (cheese and bun only, ketchup on the side) or Chicken Tenders (peel off thick breading edges if sensitive).
watchOuts: Skip raw onions, pickles, and spicy buffalo dips

items.name: Mad Moose Cafe (Eden, UT) Hot Grilled Pastrami Melt with Havarti on Sourdough
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mad Moose Cafe (Eden / Ogden Valley, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Thinly sliced hot pastrami with creamy, mild Havarti cheese on grilled sourdough. Rich and satisfying with bioavailable protein and gentle bread.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pastrami Melt on sourdough with yellow mustard or mayo; request no horseradish mustard and no sauerkraut.
watchOuts: Skip spicy horseradish mustard and fermented sauerkraut during flares

items.name: MayMoes Cajun Grill (Logan) Mild Grilled Chicken or Catfish & White Rice
items.whyItWorks: While Cajun spice is normally a flare trigger, MayMoes can grill catfish fillets or chicken breast with mild salt/herb seasoning (no cayenne blackening) over plain steamed white rice with soft French bread.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for Grilled Catfish or Grilled Chicken Breast with NO Cajun cayenne spice (plain butter/salt only) over steamed white rice with French bread.
watchOuts: Avoid blackened spice, spicy jambalaya, crawfish étouffée roux, and deep-fried okra during flares

items.name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park, CA) Light Mango & Passion Fruit Mousse Cake Slice
items.whyItWorks: Airy, cloud-like mango mousse layered with delicate vanilla sponge cake and smooth tropical glaze. Strained completely seed-free, melting effortlessly in the mouth.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a chilled slice of Mango Mousse Cake to celebrate a theme park trip.
watchOuts: Contains dairy cream in the mousse

items.name: Quick N Tasty (Garden City, UT) Crispy Golden Chicken Tenders & Fries Basket
items.brandOrRestaurant: Quick N Tasty (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Tender white meat chicken strips fried crisp, served with golden french fries and mild honey or ketchup. Simple, high-protein lake comfort food.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken Tenders basket with honey or ketchup for dipping.
watchOuts: Peel off crispy skin if experiencing active digestive sensitivity

items.name: Soft-Baked Old-Fashioned Sugar Cookie
items.whyItWorks: Soft, tender bakery sugar cookie made with refined white flour, sugar, and egg. Contains zero nuts, seeds, chocolate, or rough fiber, making it a safe gentle park treat.

items.name: Summit Pizza Co. (Garden City & Logan, UT) Bear Lake BBQ Chicken Pizza
items.brandOrRestaurant: Summit Pizza Co. (Garden City & Logan, UT)

items.name: Takara Sushi Pork or Chicken Katsu Don Egg & Rice Bowl
items.whyItWorks: Simmering the breaded chicken or pork cutlet with egg and sweet soy-dashi broth over steamed white sushi rice softens the breading and makes it much gentler than dry fried cutlets.

items.name: Warm Spiced Mulled Apple Cider with Cinnamon & Clove

items.name: 24-Hour Room Service Creamy Macaroni & Cheese & Breaded Chicken Tenders

items.name: 24-Hour Room Service New York Cheesecake & Chocolate Truffle Cake

items.name: 24-Hour Room Service Penne Bolognaise with Parmigiano-Reggiano

items.name: All-Beef Regular Hot Dog on Soft Warm Bun (Plain)

items.flareEmergencySwap: Order plain vanilla ice cream / Mickey Premium Ice Cream Bar or warm Crème Brûlée (without berries) instead.

Sugar alcohols / artificial sweeteners in no-sugar-added desserts
Whole berry seeds on top

Buttermilk/cream lactose

Garlic/onion aromatics

Whole almonds inside traditional biscotti

Skip the Cold Avocado Corn Soup during flares

items.name: Pool Deck Golden French Fries (Salted Potato Fries)

Rich Parmesan cream sauce

Fresh mozzarella lactose

items.whyItWorks: Thinly sliced prosciutto and aged Parmigiano chunks are low-residue, while soppressata contains whole black peppercorns and higher cured fat.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the thin prosciutto and aged cheese with white rolls; skip the peppercorn-studded soppressata, olives, and pickled peppers.
watchOuts: Whole black peppercorns in soppressata
High sodium and cured fat

items.name: Snuggly Duckling Charcuterie Platter
items.whyItWorks: Thinly sliced cured ham/prosciutto and aged cheeses offer low-carb protein, though dense pumpernickel bread and coarse sausages need careful selection.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stick to the thinly sliced prosciutto/ham and aged cheese paired with the table's soft white pretzel bread; skip the seeded pumpernickel, whole-grain mustard, and pickled garnish.
watchOuts: Dense whole-grain pumpernickel bread
Whole mustard seeds
Coarse sausage casings

items.name: Spiced Mexican Chocolate Tart with Cinnamon Ganache (Night 1)
items.whyItWorks: Smooth dark chocolate-cinnamon ganache in a pastry shell, though Mexican chocolate often includes a subtle pinch of cayenne/ancho.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Best saved for remission days; ask your server if there is chili heat in the ganache and pair with a Lactaid.
watchOuts: Subtle ancho/cayenne warmth in Mexican chocolate
High cocoa fat

items.name: Takara Sushi (Logan) Baked "Fire Ball" Roll, "Crazy Boy" Roll & Spicy "Baja" Roll
items.whyItWorks: The Baked Fire Ball Roll (California roll baked with crab and shrimp) is fully cooked and warm; safe on good days if you ask for eel sauce only and hold spicy mayo.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Fire Ball Roll baked with sweet eel sauce only (no spicy sriracha mayo), and strictly avoid the Baja California Roll (topped with raw jalapeño and spicy tuna).
watchOuts: Strictly avoid the Baja California Roll (raw jalapeño & spicy tuna)
Deep-fried Crazy Boy Roll is high in fryer oil

items.name: Troll Family's Rock Chocolate Bar with Pistachio Moss (Wonder Alaska)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Freezing the Night Away Menu (Alaska Sailings)
items.whyItWorks: Smooth chocolate-nougat mousse bar is rich and citrus-free; only the decorative green pistachio sponge/crumble needs trimming.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the smooth chocolate mousse bar with a Lactaid and leave any chopped pistachio garnish on the plate.
watchOuts: Pistachio garnish
Rich chocolate mousse dairy

items.name: USU Aggie Ice Cream (Aggie Blue Mint / Vanilla Bean — Lactase Required)
items.brandOrRestaurant: USU Aggie Ice Cream (Logan / Utah State University, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Iconic Utah State University creamery ice cream; smooth, nut-free, seedless flavors like Vanilla Bean, Cookies & Cream, or Aggie Blue Mint (white chocolate & cookies, no nuts) have zero insoluble fiber when paired with lactase enzymes in remission.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a single kiddie/small scoop of Vanilla Bean or Aggie Blue Mint in a cup, and take 2 lactase enzyme tablets before the first bite.
watchOuts: Extra-rich 16% butterfat dairy cream—strictly requires lactase enzymes and remission status; avoid Aggie Bull Tracks or Raspberry flavors with nuts/seeds

items.name: Very Merrytime Potted Chicken Liver Parfait with Apricot-Date Compote & Brioche
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Very Merrytime ("Happy Holidays" Menu)
items.whyItWorks: Whipped chicken liver parfait on warm toasted brioche is completely smooth and seedless, though rich in butterfat.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Spread a modest amount of the smooth parfait onto the toasted brioche and skip the fibrous dried date pieces in the compote.
watchOuts: High butterfat in the potted liver mousse
Fibrous dried date skins in the compote

items.name: Warm Bounty Peach & Berry Fruit Cobbler with Vanilla Ice Cream (Pirate Night)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
items.whyItWorks: Warm biscuit crumble and baked peaches are soft, though mixed blackberries/raspberries in the cobbler add tiny seeds.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the warm biscuit crumble, vanilla ice cream, and baked peach slices while avoiding seeded blackberries.
watchOuts: Blackberry/raspberry seeds mixed into cobbler fruit
Dairy ice cream

items.name: Warm Deep-Dish Apple-Cranberry Pie à la Mode (Wonder & Magic Farewell)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · 'Til We Meet Again Menu
items.whyItWorks: Baked peeled apples and pie crust are gentle, though whole tart cranberries have tough skins.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the soft baked apple slices, flaky crust, and vanilla ice cream (with Lactaid), pushing whole cranberry skins to the side.
watchOuts: Tough cranberry skins and acidity
Dairy ice cream

items.name: Westbound Panama Canal Chilled Creamy Avocado & Sweet Corn Soup
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Westbound Panama Canal (Panama Canal Menu)
searchKeywords: cold avocado and sweet corn soup
items.whyItWorks: Puréed smooth chilled avocado soup on the Panama Canal menu, though sweet corn and potential lime seasoning require caution.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Confirm whether lime juice is blended into the base before ordering, and ask for it without any whole roasted corn kernel garnish on top.
watchOuts: CITRUS CHECK: Chilled avocado soups often include lime juice
Skip whole corn kernel garnish

items.name: Wild Mushroom-Stuffed Pasta in Vegetable Broth
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's
items.whyItWorks: Soft egg pasta parcels in clear savory broth are gentle, though the minced wild mushroom filling is high in mannitol FODMAPs.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Suitable for remission if you tolerate finely chopped mushrooms; otherwise ask for plain pasta with butter and Parmesan.
watchOuts: Mushroom mannitol (FODMAP bloat)
Garlic/onion aromatics in broth

items.name: Holiday Chocolate Fudge, Peppermint Bark & English Toffee (Nut-Free Mod)
items.whyItWorks: Smooth walnut-free chocolate fudge has zero insoluble fiber, but concentrated sugar, cocoa fat, condensed milk, and peppermint oil (which relaxes the lower esophageal sphincter) make holiday candy plates a high-risk trigger.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: If enjoying in remission, choose a single small square of nut-free Vanilla or Chocolate Fudge after a protein-rich meal, and avoid almond/walnut toffee and heavy peppermint bark if prone to reflux.
watchOuts: Often hides chopped walnuts, pecans, or almonds
Peppermint oil can trigger reflux and concentrated sugar can cause osmotic cramping

items.name: Ranch Hand Trail Stop Homestyle Biscuits & Country Sausage Gravy
items.whyItWorks: Soft buttermilk biscuits have zero insoluble roughage, but the rich pork sausage milk gravy and black pepper make this a heavy dish best reserved for full remission or ordered as plain biscuits with honey.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: During flares or sensitive days, order a plain buttermilk biscuit with honey/jelly and scrambled eggs instead of the sausage milk gravy.
watchOuts: Country gravy is high in rendered pork fat, whole milk lactose, and coarse black pepper

items.name: Disneyland Jolly Holiday Matterhorn Coconut Macaron (Fiber Warning) vs. Mickey Shortbread Cookie
items.brandOrRestaurant: Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: While the Matterhorn Macaron is gluten-friendly, it is packed with dense shredded coconut (which is pure insoluble fiber that does not dissolve in the gut)—swap for a smooth Mickey Butter Shortbread or Sugar Cookie instead.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip the shredded-coconut Matterhorn Macaron and raspberry-seeded Rose Gold macarons during sensitive days; order a plain Mickey Shortbread Cookie or Chocolate Chip Cookie instead.
watchOuts: Shredded coconut in the Matterhorn Macaron is a deceptive insoluble-fiber trigger for Crohn's

items.name: Costco Food Court Vanilla Ice Cream Cup or Warm Double Chocolate Chunk Cookie
items.brandOrRestaurant: Costco Wholesale Food Court (Logan / Lehi / South Jordan / Sandy, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Both the plain Vanilla Soft-Serve Ice Cream and the all-butter Double Chocolate Chunk Cookie are 100% nut-free and seed-free, but the massive portion size, butterfat, and sugar load require splitting a portion in remission.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the plain Vanilla Ice Cream Cup (skip the seeded strawberry sundae topping) or split a warm Chocolate Chunk Cookie into quarters, taking lactase enzymes beforehand.
watchOuts: Very high sugar and dairy butterfat per full serving—never eat a whole food-court cup or cookie during a flare

items.name: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup in Sourdough Bread Bowl
items.whyItWorks: Tomato acidity combined with heavy cream, garlic, and basil can cause heartburn and gastric reflux, while the concentrated dairy triggers lactose sensitivity in prone guts.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Acid & Dairy Warning: Better suited for remission. Dip sourdough bread lightly into the soup rather than drinking the whole bowl.

items.name: DCA Flo's V8 Cafe Classic Vanilla, Chocolate or Strawberry Shake (Take Lactase, Skip Cookie "Gravel" if Sensitive)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Flo's V8 Cafe (Cars Land · Disney California Adventure)
items.whyItWorks: Classic diner shake topped with crushed Oreo cookie "road gravel"—nut-free, though very high in dairy cream and sugar.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose Vanilla or Chocolate (to avoid strawberry seeds), share a cup in remission, and take 2 lactase enzyme tablets.
watchOuts: High lactose and sugar load—save for steady remission

items.name: Fresh Strawberries (Achene Seed Warning)
items.whyItWorks: While sweet, hydrating, and packed with vitamin C, each strawberry is studded with dozens of tiny hard exterior seeds (achenes). While benign in remission, in active colitis or stricturing Crohn's, these tiny seeds irritate ulcers.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Best reserved for remission. If craving strawberries during a sensitive period, blend into a smoothie and strain through a fine-mesh sieve to remove all seeds, or use smooth seedless strawberry jam.
watchOuts: The tiny exterior seeds pass undigested and can physically abrade inflamed mucosal tissue.

items.name: Holiday Sweet Cornbread Soufflé vs. Whole-Kernel Corn Casserole
items.whyItWorks: Fine-ground cornbread baked with eggs is soft, but traditional Jiffy corn pudding folds in whole corn kernels and creamed corn whose indigestible cellulose hulls act like sandpaper on inflamed intestines.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: If making at home, bake plain smooth Jiffy Cornbread Muffins (no whole corn kernels added) with honey butter; at a potluck, skip whole-kernel corn pudding and take mashed potatoes or dinner rolls instead.
watchOuts: Whole corn kernels have tough insoluble cellulose hulls that do not break down in the GI tract

items.name: Knott's Coasters Diner Vanilla, Chocolate or Seedless Boysenberry Milkshake (Lactase Required)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Coasters Diner (The Boardwalk · Knott's Berry Farm)
items.whyItWorks: Spun with smooth vanilla ice cream and seedless boysenberry syrup (or vanilla/chocolate), avoiding whole berry seeds, though very high in dairy lactose and sugar.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Share a small shake in steady remission only after taking 2 lactase enzyme tablets.
watchOuts: Heavy dairy cream and sugar load can trigger osmotic cramping without lactase

items.name: LaCroix Sparkling Water (Pamplemousse / Grapefruit WARNING)
items.whyItWorks: Intense carbonic acid fizz expands in the stomach and small intestine, causing painful gaseous distension, hiccups, and bloating. Grapefruit oil essences can irritate tender esophagus and gastric linings.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID during active flares. If drinking in remission, pour over ice and let sit for 10 minutes to decarbonate.

items.name: Old-Fashioned Chicken Pot Pie with Flaky Crust
items.whyItWorks: While tender chicken breast and diced potatoes are gentle, the heavy cream roux sauce, buttery lard-shortened pastry crust, and whole peas/carrots can provoke cramping and diarrhea in active Crohn's disease.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Caution: If dining in remission, eat the soft chicken and potato interior while leaving the dense whole peas and greasy bottom crust behind.

items.name: Stacked! "Stacked Cristo" Deep-Fried Ham, Turkey & Swiss Pancake Monte Cristo
items.whyItWorks: Uses tender deli turkey, ham, and Swiss cheese, but dipping the entire sandwich in pancake batter and deep-frying it creates a heavy fryer-oil and sugar bomb that should be saved strictly for rock-solid remission.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: If ordering in deep remission, share half the sandwich and skip the seeded berry jam; during flares, order the grilled potato-bun breakfast sandwich instead.
watchOuts: Deep-fried pancake batter absorbs substantial fryer oil; raspberry jam dip contains insoluble berry seeds

items.name: Braised Beef Birria Empanada with Consommé (Night 2)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Plaza de Coco (Día de los Muertos Night 2)
items.whyItWorks: Shredded slow-braised beef is tender, but fried pastry crust and guajillo/ancho chili birria consommé can irritate active disease.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: If tasting in remission, eat the tender shredded beef from the center and skip the fried pastry corners and spicy dipping consommé.
watchOuts: Fried empanada pastry fat
Guajillo chili and onion/garlic in birria broth

items.name: Crisp Isle of Corona Fried Shrimp with Pea Purée (Lantern Night)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table (Lantern Night)
items.whyItWorks: Battered and deep-fried shrimp served with a lemon-remoulade tartar sauce; frying oil and lemon juice make this risky.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for grilled or poached shrimp cocktail with plain cocktail sauce (no lemon) instead of the deep-fried Corona shrimp.
watchOuts: Deep-fried breading oil
Lemon juice in tartar/remoulade sauce

items.name: Deep-Fried Calypso Crab Cake with Mango-Jalapeño Remoulade (Pirate Night)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
items.whyItWorks: Lump crab meat is lean protein, but deep-frying the breaded cake and plating it over spicy remoulade and coleslaw adds fat and heat.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: If ordering in remission, eat the soft interior lump crab meat only, scraping off the deep-fried crust, spicy remoulade, and raw slaw.
watchOuts: Deep-fried breading oil
Jalapeño/citrus in remoulade and raw cabbage slaw

items.name: Duke of Weselton's Favorites: Nordic Meats, Cheeses & Knäckebröd (Wonder Alaska)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Freezing the Night Away Menu (Alaska Sailings)
items.whyItWorks: Aged Nordic cheeses and cured meats are lactose-safe, but hard seeded rye crispbread (Knäckebröd) and pickled vegetables are rough.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the aged cheese and lean cured meat slices with a soft white dinner roll instead of the hard seeded rye crispbread.
watchOuts: Hard seeded rye Knäckebröd crispbread
Pickled garnish

items.name: Goat Cheese, Yellow & Red Beetroot Tower with Pistachios (Night 2)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table (Snuggly Duckling Night 2)
items.whyItWorks: Whipped goat cheese and cooked beets are soft, but crushed pistachios and beet fructans lower tolerance.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: If ordering in remission, scrape off all crushed pistachio nuts and eat a small portion of the goat cheese and roasted beets.
watchOuts: Crushed pistachio nuts
Beetroot fructans (FODMAPs)

items.name: Héctor Rivera's Sweet Shrimp Coctel with Tomato-Avocado Salsa (Night 2)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Plaza de Coco (Día de los Muertos Night 2)
items.whyItWorks: Poached shrimp and avocado cubes are great, but the Mexican coctel clamato/catsup sauce contains lime juice, raw onion, and jalapeño.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for plain poached shrimp and avocado slices on a clean plate without the citrus-spiked coctel sauce or raw onions.
watchOuts: Lime juice in coctel sauce (citrus guardrail)
Diced raw onion and jalapeño

items.name: Kingswell Duck Confit Pastilla in Spiced Phyllo Pastry (Night 1)
items.whyItWorks: Shredded duck in cinnamon-dusted phyllo is tender, but rendered duck fat, dried fruit, and almonds in traditional pastilla can trigger flares.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Save for remission and choose the Hyperion Four-Cheese Tri-Color Tortelloni or Burrata starter on sensitive days.
watchOuts: Rendered duck fat
Possible sliced almonds and dried fruit inside pastilla

items.name: Layered Garden Vegetable Lasagna (Prince & Princess Menu)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Prince & Princess Dinner Menu
items.whyItWorks: Soft lasagna noodles and cheese are layered with diced zucchini skins, bell peppers, mushrooms, and tomato sauce.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip during flares in favor of the Roasted Tom Turkey Breast or Grilled Pork Chop.
watchOuts: Mushrooms, bell pepper skins, and zucchini peels inside layers
Ricotta/mozzarella lactose

items.name: Pan-Seared Macadamia-Crusted Mahi-Mahi with Coconut Rice (Pirate Night)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
items.whyItWorks: The flaky white mahi-mahi and jasmine/coconut rice are 9/10 flare-safe, but the crushed macadamia nut crust is mechanically abrasive.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for the Mahi-Mahi pan-seared plain without the macadamia nut crust (or scrape the nut crust off completely) over coconut/white rice.
watchOuts: Chopped macadamia nut crust (order naked/plain)

items.name: Panama Canal Menu: Savory Spinach & Feta Phyllo Pie & Roasted Root Vegetables
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Panama Canal Dinner Menu
items.whyItWorks: Peeled roasted carrots, turnips, and parsnips are soft, but caramelized leeks, bulgur wheat, and chickpea-tomato slaw add FODMAPs and roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the peeled carrots/parsnips or choose the Lighter Note Oven-Baked Salmon or Roasted Chicken Breast with white rice instead.
watchOuts: Chickpea-tomato slaw on the spinach pie
Leeks and bulgur wheat with the root vegetables

items.name: Penne Arrabbiata with Garlic-Herb Shrimp (Let the Magic Begin Menu)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Let the Magic Begin Menu
items.whyItWorks: White penne pasta and shrimp are 9/10 flare-safe, but "Arrabbiata" means "angry" spicy chili-tomato sauce.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for the shrimp and penne pasta tossed in plain olive oil or butter with aged Parmesan instead of the spicy red Arrabbiata sauce.
watchOuts: Spicy chili-garlic Arrabbiata tomato sauce (swap for butter/olive oil)

items.name: Pinocchio's Pizzeria / Daisy's Pizza Pies: Pepperoni, Hawaiian & Veggie Slices
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Pinocchio's Pizzeria / Disney Treasure · Daisy's Pizza Pies
items.whyItWorks: While the plain Cheese/Margherita and Prosciutto pizzas score 7.5, Pepperoni adds spicy cured grease, Hawaiian adds fibrous pineapple, and Veggie adds bell pepper skins and mushrooms.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip Pepperoni, Hawaiian, and Veggie slices during flares and choose the plain Cheese Pizza (blotted with a napkin + Lactaid) instead.
watchOuts: Rendered spicy pepperoni grease
Fibrous pineapple chunks on Hawaiian
Bell pepper skins, onions, and mushrooms on Veggie

items.name: Pool Deck Crispy Fish Sandwich & Fish Tacos
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Pete's Boiler Bites / Disney Magic · Duck-In Diner / Disney Treasure · Donald's Cantina
items.whyItWorks: White cod/pollock fish inside is lean, but deep-fried batter, raw cabbage slaw, tartar sauce, and lime wedges make the default build risky.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel off the thick fried batter and skip the raw cabbage slaw and lime juice, or order the plain Grilled Chicken Breast Sandwich instead.
watchOuts: Deep-fried batter oil
Raw cabbage slaw and lime crema

items.name: Red Chicken Enchiladas in Guajillo Chile Sauce with Crema (Night 2)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Plaza de Coco (Día de los Muertos Night 2)
items.whyItWorks: Shredded chicken in soft corn tortillas is gentle, but the red guajillo chili sauce and raw onion garnish trigger symptoms.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for plain shredded chicken rolled in corn tortillas with melted cheese only (no red guajillo chili sauce, no raw onions).
watchOuts: Red guajillo chili sauce (capsaicin + garlic)
Dairy crema and cheese

items.name: Sit-Down Lunch Crispy Beef Empanadas with Red Chimichurri
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
items.whyItWorks: Savory ground beef filling inside pastry, though the fried shell and garlic-chili red chimichurri require remission tolerance.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip the red chimichurri sauce entirely and eat only the center beef filling if flaring.
watchOuts: Fried pastry oil
Garlic and chili flakes in red chimichurri

items.name: Spinach, Sweet Potato & Red Lentil Dhal with Coconut Rice (Let the Magic Begin)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Let the Magic Begin Menu
items.whyItWorks: Coconut rice and soft sweet potato cubes are gentle, but lentil GOS FODMAPs and Indian curry spices can trigger gas and urgency.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the coconut rice and sweet potato pieces in remission; skip during active flares.
watchOuts: High-FODMAP lentil GOS and curry spices

items.name: Warm Fig & Date Ciabatta Roll with Malt Butter (Snuggly Duckling Night 2)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table (Snuggly Duckling Night 2)
items.whyItWorks: Dried figs contain hundreds of tiny crunchy seeds and high fructans that can irritate an inflamed ileum.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip the fig roll and ask your server for plain white dinner rolls or pretzel bread (salt/seeds brushed off).
watchOuts: Crunchy fig seeds and dried fruit FODMAPs

items.name: Westbound Panama Canal Butter Pecan, Dulce de Leche & Meringue Kisses Sundae
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Westbound Panama Canal (Panama Canal Menu)
items.whyItWorks: Signature Panama Canal menu sundae; the airy egg-white meringue kisses and dulce de leche are fiber-free, but whole pecan pieces and dairy ice cream require modification.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server to build this sundae using plain Vanilla Bean ice cream (or dairy-free ice cream) with the dulce de leche and crisp meringue kisses—holding the whole butter pecans.
watchOuts: Whole pecan pieces in butter pecan ice cream
High lactose in ice cream and dulce de leche

items.name: Cooper's Restaurant (Fish Haven, ID) Creamy New England Clam Chowder (Heavy Cream Warning)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's Restaurant & Sports Bar (Fish Haven / Bear Lake West, ID)
items.whyItWorks: Rich with heavy whipping cream, butter roux, potatoes, and clams. High dairy fat content and shellfish can trigger rapid dumping or gas in dairy-sensitive IBD.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid during flareups. In remission, enjoy a small cup paired with sourdough bread.
watchOuts: High heavy cream lactose and butter fat speed intestinal transit

items.name: Costa Vida Chicken Tortilla Soup with Crispy Strips
items.brandOrRestaurant: Costa Vida Fresh Mexican Grill (Utah County / Salt Lake)
items.whyItWorks: Tomato and roasted pepper chicken broth loaded with pulled chicken, whole black beans, corn kernels, and topped with fried corn tortilla strips and melted cheese. Beans and fried strips irritate sensitive bowels.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Acid & Roughage Warning: Request soup without whole beans, corn, or crispy fried tortilla strips.

items.name: Costco Food Court (Logan & Draper, UT) Warm Double Chocolate Chunk Cookie (800 Cal Warning)
items.whyItWorks: An all-butter monster cookie served warm with nearly 800 calories and heavy butterfat. The sheer sugar and melted butter density cause rapid osmotic gastric dumping in sensitive guts.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid eating whole. In remission, break off a quarter to enjoy with milk and save the rest.
watchOuts: Extreme fat and sugar load provokes rapid diarrhea

items.name: Disneyland Cafe Orleans / Blue Bayou Deep-Fried Monte Cristo Sandwich (Remission Warning)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Cafe Orleans & Blue Bayou (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)
items.whyItWorks: Although filled with low-fiber sliced turkey, ham, and Swiss cheese, the entire sandwich is submerged in deep-fryer batter and served with seeded berry compote—making it a heavy fat bomb that can trigger cramping.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: If tasting in deep remission, split one order across 3–4 people, blot excess fryer oil with a napkin, and skip the seeded berry puree; otherwise order the grilled chicken or steak dish.
watchOuts: Deep-fried batter is extremely high in fryer oil fat; Three-Cheese version adds melted Brie/Mozzarella lactose

items.name: Kettle Brand Sea Salt Potato Chips (Thick Cut WARNING)
items.whyItWorks: Extra thick-cut potato slices kettle-cooked in oil to a hard, rigid crispness. The sharp, jagged chip shards can physically scratch inflamed bowel segments, and the high fat (9g per ounce) triggers rapid gastrocolic dumping.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid during active disease. Baked Lay's or plain thin crisps are far safer.

items.name: Kirkland Signature Organic Frozen Mango Chunks (FODMAP Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Mango contains excess free fructose over glucose. In patients with IBD or compromised brush-border absorption, unabsorbed fructose rapidly ferments in the colon, producing gas, bloating, and osmotic diarrhea.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: High Fructose Warning: Limit to a few small chunks in smoothies during stable remission. Avoid during active diarrhea.

items.name: Maurice's Warm Garlic Cheddar Pastry Twist
items.whyItWorks: Flaky puff pastry rolled with cheddar cheese and coated in concentrated garlic butter seasoning. Laminated puff pastry contains dense butter layers, which combined with alliums can provoke gas and rapid motility.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Dairy & Allium Warning: Nibble cautiously if in remission. Avoid during active inflammatory flare-ups.

items.name: Crinkle-Cut Golden French Fries
items.whyItWorks: Crinkle-cut potatoes offer deep grooves that trap significant cooking oil during deep-frying. For Crohn's and UC patients, deep-fried vegetable oil can irritate gut mucosa and stimulate bile dumping.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Fried Food Warning: Best reserved for stable remission. During flares, request soft white toast or a plain bun instead.

items.name: Jumbo Smoked Turkey Leg (High Sodium/Fat Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Though turkey is lean, Disney's giant cured dark-meat legs are brined in heavy sodium nitrate solutions, smoked with skin-on, and contain significant rendered subcutaneous grease that can trigger severe intestinal cramping.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Sodium & Grease Warning: Peel off and discard all outer dark skin and fat; consume only small portions of inner lean meat.

items.name: Thick-Cut Filmstrip Crispy French Fries
items.whyItWorks: Broad ribbon-cut potatoes fried to an extra-crispy exterior trap substantial frying shortening. The crunchy edges and high oil load can scrape inflamed intestinal mucosa and speed up bowel transit.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Fried Food Warning: Best kept to a few pieces during stable remission. Avoid during active symptom flares.

items.name: Aggie Ice Cream (USU Logan, UT) "Aggie Bull Tracks" (Peanut Butter Cup Warning)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Aggie Ice Cream (Utah State University, Logan, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Rich chocolate ice cream packed with peanut butter cups and caramel swirls. The heavy fat from chocolate, peanut butter, and cream can trigger rapid digestive motility.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid during flares or peanut sensitivity. Sample a bite in remission.
watchOuts: High fat density from peanut butter cups and dairy cream accelerates gastric emptying

items.name: Chick-fil-A Waffle Potato Fries (WARNING)
items.whyItWorks: Large skin-on waffle potatoes deep-fried in canola oil. Contains 24g fat and 5g fiber with tough skin edges that are difficult to chew smooth. High fat delays stomach emptying and triggers rapid gastrocolic dumping.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid during active flares. If in deep remission, eat only 3-4 soft inner wedges and chew thoroughly.

items.name: Costco Food Court (Logan & Draper, UT) Chicken Bake (Caesar & Green Onion Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Stuffed with chicken breast, bacon, melted cheeses, green onions, and creamy Caesar dressing inside a heavy pizza dough crust. Caesar dressing acidity, bacon grease, and green onions frequently trigger GI distress.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid during active flares. Choose the plain hot dog or cheese pizza slice instead.
watchOuts: Caesar dressing, bacon grease, and green onions produce stomach upset and gas

items.name: DiGiorno Rising Crust Four Cheese Pizza (Thick Dough & Grease Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Dense, thick yeast-rising dough loaded with concentrated mozzarella/cheddar grease and garlic-seasoned tomato sauce. A single serving delivers 18g fat and high sodium, creating prolonged gastric retention and bloating.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Flare Warning: Avoid thick rising crust pizzas during active IBD. Choose thin gluten-free cheese pizza or homemade sourdough flatbread in remission.
watchOuts: Dense yeast dough and heavy cheese grease trigger severe delayed gastric emptying and cramping.

items.name: Disneyland Milk Stand "Green Milk" (Tropical Blossom & Citrus Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Unlike Blue Milk, Green Milk has pronounced tropical citrus and floral notes with citric acid additives that can irritate sensitive stomachs and acid reflux.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: choose the gentle, non-citrus Blue Milk instead.
watchOuts: Contains citrus flavor extracts that can cause heartburn

items.name: Jumbo Loaded Baked Potato with Bacon, Sour Cream & Chives

Cumin/onion spice base

items.name: Steel-Cut Oats (Coarse Whole Groat Mechanical Hazard Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Unlike rolled or quick oats which are steamed and flattened, steel-cut oats are chopped whole oat groats. Even after 30 minutes of boiling, they retain a dense, chewy, rubbery core that requires extensive enzymatic digestion and can irritate inflamed ileal strictures.

items.name: SunChips Original Multigrain Snacks (WARNING)

Cajun cayenne/black pepper spice
Onion and garlic holy trinity base

items.name: Trader Joe's Cauliflower Gnocchi (High Cassava & Insoluble Fiber Warning)

items.name: Traditional Green Bean Casserole with Crispy Fried Onions & Mushroom Soup (Flare Avoid)

Tough green bean fibers and mushrooms

Sharp corn tortilla strips and raw onion

items.name: Burrito Sonora Loaded with Cheese & Refried Beans

items.prepOrOrderInstructions: High Fiber & Gas Warning: Avoid bean-heavy burritos. Switch to grilled chicken tacos on corn tortillas.

items.name: Fresh Peach Thick Milkshake
items.whyItWorks: Combining whole dairy ice cream with high-FODMAP real peach chunks creates a double digestive challenge: lactose induces gas and bloating, while stone fruit fructose can trigger rapid loose stools.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: High Lactose & FODMAP Warning: Consume only small sips during remission with lactase enzymes, or choose a dairy-free beverage.

items.name: Mad Moose Cafe (Eden, UT) Chipotle Chicken Grilled Cheese (Ghost Pepper Warning)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Mad Moose Cafe (Eden / Ogden Valley, UT)
items.whyItWorks: Made with ghost pepper jack cheese and spicy homemade southwest chipotle sauce. Extreme capsaicin heat causes severe gastrointestinal burning, cramping, and mucosal irritation.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid completely during active IBD. Choose the French Dip or BLT instead.

items.name: Member's Mark Chicken Alfredo with Penne Pasta (Deli Bake Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Tender penne pasta and chicken smothered in a heavy cream, butter, and parmesan sauce. Over 28g of dairy fat per serving triggers intense gastrocolic reflexes and diarrhea in sensitive bowels.

items.name: Jimmy Dean Sausage, Egg & Cheese Croissant (Greasy Pork Sausage Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Combines a butter-layered croissant with a heavily spiced, greasy pork sausage patty and processed cheese, packing 27g of fat (11g saturated). The extreme morning grease triggers an aggressive gastrocolic reflex, leading to immediate postprandial cramping and diarrhea.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Severe Fat Trigger Warning: Avoid standard pork sausage croissants. Choose Jimmy Dean Delights Turkey Sausage English Muffin instead.

items.name: DCA Lamplight Lounge Famous Lobster Nachos (Serrano Chili, Chipotle Crema & Corn Chip Warning)

items.name: Don Lee Farms Organic Veggie Bites (Raw Fiber Warning)

items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stricture & Roughage Hazard: Strictly avoid during active flares or known intestinal narrowings.

items.name: Fresh Raspberries & Blackberries (Dense Seed Stricture Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Blackberries and raspberries have one of the highest insoluble fiber loads of any fruit (8 grams per cup), consisting of hundreds of hard, woody, indigestible drupelet seeds. These seeds clump together and present an extreme obstruction hazard in strictures.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stricture & Flare Warning: Avoid whole fresh or frozen raspberries and blackberries. Consume only strained, seedless seed-free coulis or clear jellies.
watchOuts: Hard woody seeds will not break down in gastric acid and can create partial or complete small bowel blockages in patients with intestinal narrowing.

items.name: Fudgy Chocolate Walnut Brownie (Dense Cocoa & Nut Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Combines dense cocoa fats with hard, angular walnut chunks. Cocoa stimulates colonic motility, while walnut fragments resist digestion and scrape inflamed ulcer beds in the ileum and colon.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid brownies baked with whole nuts. If in remission, choose a plain, nut-free cake brownie without chocolate chips.
watchOuts: Hard walnut pieces pose acute stricture blockage risks; heavy cocoa accelerates bowel urgency.

items.name: Ghost 100% Whey Chips Ahoy Protein Powder (WARNING)
items.whyItWorks: Blends whey concentrate (lactose-containing) with actual crumbled Chips Ahoy cookies (refined palm oil, wheat flour, high fructose corn syrup, and soy lecithin). Highly inflammatory and harsh on tender guts.

items.name: Hidden Valley Original Ranch Dressing (High Dairy & Allium Warning)
items.whyItWorks: A potent multi-trigger dressing: combines cultured buttermilk and sour cream (lactose/fat) with high concentrations of dried garlic powder, dried onion, and herb flecks. One of the top self-reported sauce triggers for sudden cramping and urgent diarrhea.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: High Trigger Warning: Avoid commercial buttermilk ranch during flares. Choose a low-FODMAP garlic-free dressing or plain avocado oil mayo mixed with salt and dill.
watchOuts: High lactose, heavy saturated fat, and concentrated allium powders stimulate acute intestinal hypermotility.

items.name: Holiday Southern Creamed Sweet Corn (Insoluble Corn Hull Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Whole corn kernels have tough outer cellulose hulls that cannot be digested by human enzymes. In stricturing Crohn's, whole corn kernels frequently cause complete bowel obstructions.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: absolute avoid for stricturing Crohn's disease and active flares. Substitute smooth mashed potatoes or sweet potatoes.
watchOuts: Insoluble corn hulls pass undigested and can block narrowed intestines

items.name: Kirkland Signature Deli Macaroni & Cheese with Cavatappi (Warning)

items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Extreme Dairy & Lipid Warning: Strictly limit or avoid. If in deep remission, eat a small side portion with lactase enzyme support.

items.name: Knott's Boardwalk BBQ Roasted Sweet Corn on the Cob (Indigestible Hull Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Whole sweet corn on the cob has tough outer cellulose hulls that cannot be digested. In stricturing Crohn's, whole corn kernels frequently cause complete mechanical bowel obstructions.

watchOuts: Insoluble corn hulls pass undigested and can block narrowed intestines

items.name: Penny Ann's Country Fried Steak with Country Gravy (Warning)

items.name: Pringles Sour Cream & Onion Potato Crisps (WARNING)

items.name: Sunsweet 100% Prune Juice (High Osmotic Laxative Warning)

items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger Warning: Completely avoid prune juice during active Crohn's, colitis, or diarrhea episodes. Only use under physician guidance for rare opioid-induced constipation.
watchOuts: Concentrated natural sorbitol induces severe abdominal cramping and uncontrolled watery diarrhea.

items.name: The Not So Little Chicken Sandwich (High Fat/Grease Warning)
items.whyItWorks: An oversized fried chicken schnitzel deep-fried in oil, topped with pickled cabbage slaw and teriyaki chili sauce on a tiny miniature brioche bun. The high grease and raw pickled cabbage can provoke intense gut spasms.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Fried & Slaw Warning: Avoid during flares. If ordering in remission, peel away the thick fried coating and discard the cabbage slaw.

items.name: Thick Butterscotch Milkshake
items.whyItWorks: Blended with whole milk, heavy soft-serve ice cream, and butterscotch syrup, this thick shake packs over 25g of lactose and high refined sugar, which triggers rapid osmotic diarrhea, bloating, and painful gas in sensitive bowels.

items.name: Liquid I.V. Sugar-Free Hydration Packet (WARNING)

items.name: Very Merrytime Harvest Corn Chowder with Chorizo & Rye Croutons
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Very Merrytime ("Happy Holidays" Menu)

Heavy cream base

items.name: Raw Cauliflower Florets (High Fermentation Bloat Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Dense cruciferous structure: Raw cauliflower florets are hard, abrasive to inflamed intestinal lining, and packed with complex oligosaccharides that humans cannot digest without severe bacterial gas production.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger Warning: Avoid raw cauliflower crudité platters. If eating cauliflower, steam until completely mushy and puree into smooth cauliflower mash.
watchOuts: Severe gas and distension risk; avoid entirely during flares and active disease.

items.name: Café Rio Sweet Pork Barbacoa Burrito (Enchilada Style Warning)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Café Rio Mexican Grill (Utah County / Salt Lake)
items.whyItWorks: A giant flour tortilla wrapped around sweet braised pork, black or pinto beans, rice, and smothered in cheese and enchilada sauce. The enormous mass of whole beans, sugar glaze, melted cheese, and tomato acid creates severe distress.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: High Fiber & Sugar Warning: Avoid giant smothered burritos. Order 2 soft corn tacos with grilled chicken and white rice instead.

items.name: Double Bacon Cheeseburger with Beach Sauce

items.name: Garden of Life Raw Organic Protein Powder (WARNING)
items.whyItWorks: Contains raw sprouted grains, cracked chia seeds, flax seeds, raw legume sprouts, and live enzymes. The gritty, abrasive raw particulate matter mechanically irritates ulcerated mucosa and causes severe bloating.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID during active inflammation, ulcerations, or stricturing Crohn's disease.

items.name: Green Giant Simply Steam Broccoli in Cheese Sauce (High Sulfur & Dairy Warning)

watchOuts: Cruciferous sulfur gas plus dairy cheese sauce creates severe abdominal distension.

items.name: Raw Broccoli Florets & Stalks (Severe Gas & Cellulose Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Cruciferous vegetable trigger: Raw broccoli contains tough, crystalline insoluble cellulose and sulfur-rich glucosinolates. It is heavily fermented by colonic bacteria into hydrogen sulfide gas, causing agonizing bloating, spasms, and mechanical scraping.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: High Trigger Warning: Completely avoid raw broccoli, broccoli slaw, and vegetable tray broccoli. In deep remission, only eat well-cooked, tender-boiled florets in small amounts.
watchOuts: Major cause of gas colic and mechanical mucosal abrasion in both Crohn's and Ulcerative Colitis.

items.name: Reed's Real Ginger Ale (Zero Sugar WARNING)
items.whyItWorks: While ginger is therapeutic, Reed's uses an intensely spicy ginger brew combined with erythritol and stevia. The combination of intense pungent heat and sugar alcohol creates burning sensations and osmotic diarrhea.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID zero-sugar ginger beers with sugar alcohols. Drink warm freshly brewed ginger tea with pure honey instead.

items.name: Starbucks Iced Lemon Loaf Cake (WARNING)
items.whyItWorks: Packed with concentrated lemon oil, lemon zest extract, 470 calories, 20g fat, and 42g refined sugar. The intense citrus acid and heavy fat combo provokes sharp upper GI reflux and intestinal spasms.

items.name: Tostitos Salsa Con Queso Dip (Spicy Pepper WARNING)
items.whyItWorks: Blended with diced red bell peppers, jalapeño peppers, garlic powder, onion powder, and concentrated spice extracts. The spicy heat combined with high dairy fats frequently provokes intense nausea and rapid diarrhea.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID during flares. Choose mild, un-spiced cheese dips instead.

items.name: Whole Raw or Roasted Almonds & Walnuts (Stricture Hazard Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Whole nuts are hard, dense, and shatter during chewing into jagged angular shards. For individuals with Crohn's strictures or bowel narrowing, unchewed nut fragments act like gravel, accumulating into high-risk mechanical obstructions.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stricture Warning: Avoid whole almonds, walnuts, cashews, pecans, and trail mix. If wanting the nutritional benefits of nuts, use completely smooth almond or cashew butter instead.
watchOuts: A leading clinical trigger for acute small bowel obstruction requiring emergency hospitalization.

items.name: Vital Performance Protein Bar (WARNING)
items.whyItWorks: While collagen itself is gut-friendly, this bar binds it with chicory root fiber, whole nut pieces (almonds/peanuts), and chewy syrups that present severe blockage dangers for strictured bowels.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stick to unflavored pure collagen powder dissolved in warm liquids rather than fibrous solid protein bars.

items.name: Deep-Fried Shredded Beef Chimichanga with Queso
items.whyItWorks: A giant flour tortilla wrapped around spiced beef, deep-fried until blistered and submerged in heavy melted queso dip, packs intense oil, dairy, and spices that aggressively irritate the digestive tract.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Extreme Danger Warning: Avoid during flares or active gut inflammation. Order a soft baked enchilada or grilled street taco instead.

items.name: Double Bacon Cheeseburger with Crinkle Waffle Fries
items.whyItWorks: Two fatty beef patties smothered in melted cheddar, thick bacon strips, burger sauce, and served with a basket of deep-fried waffle fries. Packs over 55g of fat that heavily stresses digestion.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: High Fat Warning: Choose the plain grilled chicken breast sandwich or a single hamburger patty instead.

items.name: Frank's RedHot Original Cayenne Pepper Sauce (Severe Acidic Burn Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Aged cayenne red peppers, distilled vinegar, water, and garlic powder. The pungent cayenne pepper and heavy vinegar create intense burning along denuded intestinal surfaces and stimulate rapid colonic contractions.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger Warning: Avoid Frank's RedHot and Buffalo wing sauces during flares.
watchOuts: High vinegar acidity and cayenne heat inflame gastrointestinal tissue.

items.name: Homestyle Carrot Cake with Walnuts & Cream Cheese (Triple Hazard Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Despite having 'carrots' in the name, traditional bakery carrot cake is a triple threat for IBD: shredded raw carrots that remain fibrous after baking, hard angular walnut chunks (stricture hazard), chewy raisins, and heavy vegetable oil + cream cheese frosting.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Extreme Trigger Warning: Avoid bakery carrot cake during flares and strictures. If desiring cake, choose fat-free angel food cake or plain vanilla sponge.
watchOuts: High fat, dense nuts, and dried raisins make this one of the most provocative desserts for IBD symptoms.

items.name: Member's Mark Spinach & Artichoke Dip (Deli Tub Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Stringy artichoke heart bracts and whole spinach leaves combined with sour cream, cream cheese, parmesan, and garlic. Artichokes are notoriously fibrous and tough to digest, posing a major stricture risk.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Severe Stricture & Dairy Warning: Strictly avoid. The fibrous stringy artichoke leaves can cause severe blockages.

items.name: Trader Joe's Vegetable Bird's Nests (Deep-Fried Onion & Carrot Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Tangled birds-nest clusters of shredded yellow onions, carrots, and kale bound in tempura batter and deep-fried. The primary ingredient is fried whole onion shreds (massive allium fructans) saturated in frying oil, which creates agonizing gas colic and rapid transit.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Severe Trigger Warning: Avoid this fried onion tangle during active IBD.
watchOuts: Massive concentration of fried allium fructans and grease causes acute abdominal cramping.

items.name: Brussels Sprouts (High Raffinose & Sulfur Gas Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Brussels sprouts contain high concentrations of raffinose (an indigestible trisaccharide) and glucosinolates. Colonic fermentation generates extreme volumes of carbon dioxide and hydrogen sulfide gas, causing agonizing abdominal distension.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Flare Warning: Avoid Brussels sprouts during active IBD. Even in remission, eat only 2–3 well-cooked halved sprouts at a time.
watchOuts: Severe gas pressure against inflamed intestinal walls can trigger severe flares and spasm episodes.

watchOuts: Lemon curd and lemon zest (strict citrus trigger)
Dairy Bavarian cream

High rendered duck skin fat

items.name: Dal Makhani (Black Lentils in Cream Curry)
items.whyItWorks: Whole black urad lentils and kidney beans simmered for hours with butter, heavy cream, garlic, ginger, and chili. The dense bean skins resist upper-GI digestion and rapidly ferment in the colon, producing severe gas, pressure, and diarrhea.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Severe Gas & Stricture Warning: Avoid black lentils and kidney beans. Choose yellow moong dal (well pureed) or plain basmati rice with tandoori chicken.

items.name: Dried Fruit: Raisins, Prunes & Dried Figs (Extreme Insoluble Fiber Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Dehydrating fruit concentrates tough, shriveled insoluble fiber, sticky fruit skins, and high osmotic sorbitol. Dried fruits expand in the digestive tract, creating dense, leathery boluses that easily cause mechanical bowel obstructions.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Severe Stricture Warning: Avoid all dried raisins, prunes, dried cranberries, and dried figs if you have Crohn's disease, strictures, or active inflammation.

items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Severe Mucosal Warning: Avoid Tabasco sauce during active Crohn's, Colitis, or gastritis.
watchOuts: High acidity and capsaicin burn ulcerated gut mucosa.

items.name: R.W. Knudsen Organic Just Tart Cherry Juice (WARNING)

items.prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID during flares. If taken in remission for joint soreness, dilute 1 ounce into 10 ounces of water with meals.

items.name: Tostitos Medium Chunky Salsa (Onion & Pepper WARNING)

items.name: Food for Life Ezekiel 4:9 Sprouted Whole Grain Bread (WARNING)
items.whyItWorks: Crafted from freshly sprouted live grains and legumes: wheat, barley, millet, lentils, soybeans, and spelt. The dense, abrasive insoluble bran particles scratch ulcerated mucosa while the legume flours generate violent colonic gas distention.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: STRICTLY AVOID during flares or active symptoms. Choose refined white sourdough or GF white bread instead.

items.name: Granola & Muesli (High Insoluble Fiber, Nut & Seed Hazard)
items.whyItWorks: One of the absolute worst foods for Crohn's and Colitis. Granola combines raw rolled oats baked into hard clusters with whole pumpkin seeds, flax seeds, slivered almonds, and dried fruit. It forms an unyielding abrasive mass that acts like sandpaper on ulcers and is a frequent cause of ileal food impactions.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Severe Medical Warning: Completely avoid granola, muesli, and crunchy granola bars if you have Crohn's, Colitis, or bowel narrowing. Choose Rice Chex or soft toasted white bread instead.
watchOuts: Extreme stricture blockage risk: Dense mixture of raw grains, sharp seed coats, and whole nut fragments.

items.name: La Banderita Carb Counter Tortillas (WARNING)
items.whyItWorks: Engineered with 11g of isolated resistant modified wheat starch. Bypasses small intestine digestion to produce immense microbial gas and cramping in the colon.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID. Stick to traditional white flour or yellow/white corn masa tortillas.

items.name: Olipop Vintage Cola Prebiotic Soda (WARNING)
items.whyItWorks: Marketed as "gut healthy," each can delivers 9g of prebiotic fiber derived from chicory root inulin, Jerusalem artichoke, and cassava root, plus carbonation. Prebiotic inulin rapidly ferments in the colon, producing severe gas, painful distention, and cramping.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: STRICTLY AVOID. Prebiotic sodas are among the most deceptive flare triggers for patients with Crohn's disease, Ulcerative Colitis, and SIBO.

items.name: Snyder's of Hanover Jalapeño Pretzel Pieces (WARNING)
items.whyItWorks: Dense, rock-hard sourdough pretzel chunks drenched in palm oil, jalapeño pepper powder, onion powder, garlic powder, and torula yeast. The pungent capsaicin and hard sharp chunks scratch and inflame the digestive mucosa.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: STRICTLY AVOID. Hard pretzel pieces and hot peppers are a double flare trigger.

items.name: GT's Synergy Raw Kombucha Trilogy (WARNING)
items.whyItWorks: Raw, unpasteurized fermented tea containing live wild bacteria, active yeasts, organic acetic acids, and natural effervescence. items.prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID, especially if taking biologic therapies, steroids, or immunomodulators. Do not consume raw fermented unpasteurized drinks without clinical GI clearance.

items.name: Mission Carb Balance Flour Tortillas (15g Fiber WARNING)

items.name: SkinnyPop Original Popcorn (Hull Hazard WARNING)

items.name: Starbucks Nitro Cold Brew Coffee (WARNING)
items.whyItWorks: Delivers 280mg+ of concentrated caffeine infused with nitrogen microbubbles. Hyper-activates the sympathetic nervous system and triggers violent gastrocolic spasms, provoking immediate severe diarrhea and tenesmus.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: STRICTLY AVOID. If you need a warm beverage at Starbucks, order Steamed Almond Milk with vanilla or decaf Chamomile tea.

items.name: Sweet Corn on the Cob & Whole Kernel Corn (Extreme Stricture Hazard)
items.whyItWorks: The outer yellow shell (pericarp) of whole sweet corn kernels is made of pure, indestructible cellulose that human gastric enzymes cannot break down. These kernels pass through whole and clump together, making them the #1 emergency cause of small bowel obstruction in stricturing Crohn's.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Extreme Danger Hazard: Avoid sweet corn on the cob, canned whole corn, and roasted corn kernels. If desiring corn flavor, choose smooth pureed corn chowder (strained) or smooth corn grits/polenta.
watchOuts: Emergency hospital obstruction risk: Undigested corn kernels lodge in narrowed intestinal strictures, requiring surgical intervention.

items.name: Birds Eye Steamfresh Sweet Kernel Corn (Indigestible Hull Hazard Warning)
items.whyItWorks: Every single kernel retains its tough outer pericarp hull made of pure insoluble cellulose. When swallowed, corn kernels remain completely intact, clumping together in narrow strictures and forming emergency bowel obstructions.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Severe Medical Hazard: Never eat whole kernel corn if you have Crohn's disease, bowel strictures, or an ostomy. If craving corn flavor, eat smooth corn grits/polenta.
watchOuts: Primary cause of food-induced small bowel impaction requiring emergency hospital intervention.

items.name: Dave's Killer Bread 21 Whole Grains and Seeds (WARNING)
